abstract: AbstractIn the past year, the medical field's relationship to clinical AI has progressed from rapid and often speculative adoption toward evaluation of its impact on patient outcomes, clinical workflows, and society. Drawing from the Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems (SAIL) Year in Review (May 2026), this Perspective examines six key areas that dominated the domain of clinical AI in the past year: clinical AI evaluation, workflow integration, direct-to-consumer applications, regulation and societal impacts, AI in medical education, and foundational advancements in technology. AI's successes across these areas have been uneven, reflecting its jagged frontier. We highlight milestones that illustrate what AI has already achieved in health care, its potential, and major challenges that remain ahead. (Funded by the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development of the National Institutes of Health [grant number T32HD040128].).
zh_abstract: 摘要：过去一年，医学领域对临床人工智能（AI）的态度已从快速且往往带有推测性的采纳，转向评估其对患者结局、临床工作流程和社会的影响。本文为一篇观点性文章（Perspective），依据学习型健康系统人工智能研讨会（Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems，SAIL）年度回顾（2026年5月），探讨了过去一年主导临床AI领域的六个关键方面：临床AI评估、工作流程整合、直接面向消费者的应用、监管与社会影响、医学教育中的AI，以及技术的基础性进展。AI在这些方面的成功并不均衡，反映了其“锯齿状前沿”（jagged frontier）。我们重点介绍了若干里程碑，以说明AI在医疗保健领域已取得的成就、其潜力以及未来仍存在的主要挑战。（由美国国立卫生研究院尤妮斯·肯尼迪·施莱佛国家儿童健康与人类发展研究所资助［资助编号 T32HD040128］。）

title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
zh_title: TabBioMed：生物医学表格学习大规模基准
summary: 该预印本提出含94个公开生物医学表格数据集的基准，涵盖电子病历、药物发现与组学等，并评测23种模型，包括表格基础模型。
key_points: 94个数据集，统一预处理与评估框架
评测经典方法、梯度提升树、神经网络与基础模型
摘要称基础模型在模型家族层面表现最强
reason: 新的大规模基准，但为预印本，细节有限
abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.
zh_abstract: 机器学习的最新进展加速了生物医学预测，但在结构化生物医学数据上的评估仍较为分散，尤其是对于高维度、大样本量、存在缺失值和类别不平衡的数据集。我们提出了TabBioMed，这是一个大规模基准，包含94个经整理的公开生物医学表格数据集，涵盖电子健康记录、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学和系统生物学。TabBioMed通过标准化的、考虑数据集特性的预处理与评估框架整合这些数据集，从而可对分类、回归和多目标任务进行可重复的比较。我们对23个模型进行了基准测试，涵盖经典基线模型、梯度提升树、神经表格架构和表格基础模型。基础模型在模型家族层面表现出最强的预测性能。然而，其优势取决于具体情形：基于树的模型和经调优的多层感知机仍极具竞争力，在推理时间或训练成本受限的情况下往往占优。总体而言，TabBioMed表明生物医学表格学习高度依赖具体情境，最优模型的选择取决于数据情形、任务类型和计算预算。我们发布了TabBioMed，包括经整理的数据集与划分、预处理代码、基线模型和结果，为实际的模型选择和生物医学机器学习中未来方法的开发提供了可重复的基准，网址为 https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed。

title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
zh_title: Decision2Care：可审计的无文本临床决策智能体
summary: 提出不生成文本的决策智能体，由模型为EHR动作赋概率、规则执行，在546例急诊入院上诊断准确率86.5%，与MIRA-v2相当但更快。
key_points: 546例急诊入院、12种疾病评估
准确率86.5% vs MIRA-v2的86.1%
reason: 新颖的可审计智能体，有基线对比，但为预印本、证据有限
abstract: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect the factors that went into the decision. Here, we present Decision2Care, a decision agent that works up the acutely ill patient without producing any text. A decision model assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action, and fixed rules carry out the most probable one. We evaluated Decision2Care on the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases. Decision2Care reached a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5%, compared with 86.1% for the MIRA-v2 agent, and required a median of 2.2 s per work-up, compared with 92-100 s. Each work-up tracked which options Decision2Care was considering at each step. In 10 of the 12 diseases, the differential diagnosis changed most at the test on which the guideline bases the diagnosis. Where Decision2Care was most confident after a single work-up, all but four of its diagnoses were correct (98.5%). We traced each of these four errors back to a single imaging report. Three of them were corrected when that report was removed. The same kind of decision was used to select the treatments, and Decision2Care's drug orders were judged guideline-adherent more often than MIRA-v2's. In emergency patients, its prediction of death was comparable to that of three intensivists on the same cases. In five of the eight intensive care cohorts, it exceeded the best of the three 24-h severity scores within 2-6 h of records. Our results show that decision agents can carry out clinical work-ups while recording the options, probabilities, and execution rules behind each action for audit.
zh_abstract: 临床医生在审阅诊断检查流程时，会询问每一步考虑了什么，以及评估为何发生变化。由自由文本驱动的智能体可以达到医生水平的诊断准确率，但其书面推理并不总能反映决策所依据的因素。在此，我们提出 Decision2Care，一种无需生成任何文本即可对急症患者进行检查评估的决策智能体。决策模型为每个被允许的电子病历（EHR）操作分配一个概率，再由固定规则执行概率最高的操作。我们在涵盖 12 种疾病的 546 例急诊入院记录上评估了 Decision2Care。Decision2Care 的诊断准确率达到 86.5%，而 MIRA-v2 智能体为 86.1%；每次检查评估所需时间中位数为 2.2 秒，而后者为 92–100 秒。每次检查评估都会记录 Decision2Care 在每一步考虑了哪些选项。在 12 种疾病中的 10 种里，鉴别诊断变化最大的环节正是指南据以确立诊断的检查。在单次检查评估后 Decision2Care 最有把握的情形中，除四例外其诊断均正确（98.5%）。我们将这四例错误均追溯到单一份影像报告，其中三例在移除该报告后得到纠正。同类决策方式也被用于选择治疗，Decision2Care 的药物医嘱被判定为符合指南的比例高于 MIRA-v2。在急诊患者中，其对死亡的预测与三位重症医学医师在相同病例上的预测相当。在八个重症监护队列中的五个里，仅用 2–6 小时的记录，其表现就超过了三种 24 小时严重程度评分中的最佳者。我们的结果表明，决策智能体可以执行临床检查评估，同时记录每个操作背后的选项、概率和执行规则以供审计。

title: Reference-Guided Data Curation for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pretraining
zh_title: 3D医学视觉语言预训练的参考引导数据筛选
summary: 提出无需训练的参考引导数据筛选方法，用小型高质量参考集对大规模图文对排序，用于3D VLM预训练。
key_points: 在3.5万例腹部CT-报告对上验证
另含5.8万例胸片图文对
通过排名聚合融合各模态质量信号
reason: 3D医学VLM预训练新方法，有两机构数据；预印本，偏好加分
abstract: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. We address this challenge of data curation for improving 3D VLM pretraining by proposing an offline, training-free, reference-guided data curation recipe. Our approach leverages a small, high-quality reference set to independently extract quality signals for each modality of a large, uncurated pool and merges them through a rank-aggregation step into a single ranking that guides sample selection. We validate this method on datasets comprising 35k 3D abdominal CT volume-report pairs from two institutions and 58k 2D chest X-ray image-report pairs. On 3D CT, using our reference-guided data curation strategy, our curated model matches the zero-shot disease classification performance of a state-of-the-art baseline (Merlin) while using $3.3\times$ less training data and a reference set of 5k samples. On 2D chest X-rays, our method yields a curated model that matches or exceeds the zero-shot disease classification performance of a model trained on the full pool while using up to $10\times$ less training data and a reference set of only 74 samples. Ablations show that the selection is stable under resampling of the reference, that smaller reference sets still outperform random sampling, and that label rebalancing does not improve performance. To support reproducibility, we release our code.
zh_abstract: 在跨机构收集的大型医学影像数据集上训练三维视觉-语言模型（VLM）受到数据质量的制约。庞大且未经整理的图像-报告配对数据池具有冗余、类别不平衡和跨机构异质性的特点。我们针对为改进三维VLM预训练而进行数据整理的这一挑战，提出了一种离线、无需训练、以参考集为引导的数据整理方案。该方法利用一个小型高质量参考集，为大型未整理数据池的每种模态独立提取质量信号，并通过秩聚合步骤将其合并为单一排序，以指导样本选择。我们在包含来自两家机构的3.5万对三维腹部CT体数据-报告配对和5.8万对二维胸部X线图像-报告配对的数据集上验证了该方法。在三维CT上，使用我们的参考集引导的数据整理策略，所整理出的模型在零样本疾病分类性能上与最先进的基线模型（Merlin）相当，同时训练数据减少至其1/3.3（少用$3.3\times$），参考集为5千个样本。在二维胸部X线上，我们的方法得到的整理后模型，其零样本疾病分类性能达到或超过使用全部数据池训练的模型，同时训练数据最多减少至1/10（少用至多$10\times$），参考集仅74个样本。消融实验表明：样本选择在参考集重采样下是稳定的；较小的参考集仍优于随机采样；标签再平衡并不能提升性能。为支持可重复性，我们公开了代码。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Targets in Radiology Language-Image Pretraining
zh_title: 重新思考放射学语言-图像预训练中的对比目标
summary: 指出CLIP式配对目标因报告间共享发现而存在系统偏差，构建合成测试平台复现问题并提出目标修正方法。
key_points: 零样本性能先升后降且大批量失效
构建CLEVR-Radiology合成测试平台
认为偏差源于重叠事实结构
reason: 有理论洞察的视觉语言预训练预印本，摘要结果不全
abstract: CLIP-style contrastive image-text pretraining is widely used in radiology data, where each image is paired with one report and every other report in the batch is treated as a negative. Under this recipe, two failures appear, neither of which is systematically addressed by existing contrastive learning theory: zero-shot evaluation peaks then degrades while training loss keeps decreasing, and training fails to learn from large batches. We hypothesize the cause is structural rather than radiology-specific: many unpaired reports share clinical findings with a given image, so CLIP's paired-identity target is systematically biased, not merely noisy. To test this, we construct CLEVR-Radiology, a synthetic testbed that preserves only this overlapping-fact structure and reproduces both failures. With evidence that the structure is sufficient to reproduce the failures, we develop a target-misspecification theory that explains both failures from a single deterministic gradient bias amplified by batch size, and use it to motivate a minimal compatibility-based correction, CorLIP: text is treated as positive whenever its clinical assertions agree with the image, with no architecture changes. Beyond benchmark improvements, CorLIP largely removes the post-peak degradation, makes large-batch training succeed where it previously collapsed, substantially amplifies the gains from more data, and is the only configuration that remains stable up to B=2048. The correction transfers from chest X-ray to 3D CT modalities.
zh_abstract: CLIP式对比图像-文本预训练被广泛用于放射学数据，其中每幅图像与一份报告配对，批次中其他所有报告均被视为负样本。在这一方案下会出现两种失败，而现有对比学习理论均未系统地解决：零样本评估先达到峰值而后下降，同时训练损失持续降低；以及训练无法从大批量中学习。我们假设其原因是结构性的而非放射学特有的：许多未配对的报告与给定图像具有相同的临床发现，因此CLIP的配对同一性目标存在系统性偏差，而不仅仅是噪声。为验证这一点，我们构建了CLEVR-Radiology，这是一个仅保留这种重叠事实结构并能复现上述两种失败的合成测试平台。在获得该结构足以复现这些失败的证据后，我们提出了一种目标错误设定理论，用由批量大小放大的单一确定性梯度偏差解释这两种失败，并据此提出一种最小化的基于相容性的校正方法CorLIP：只要文本的临床断言与图像一致，即将其视为正样本，无需改变架构。除基准性能提升外，CorLIP在很大程度上消除了峰值后的性能下降，使大批量训练在先前崩溃的情况下得以成功，显著放大了增加数据所带来的收益，并且是唯一在批量大小B=2048以内保持稳定的配置。该校正方法可从胸部X线迁移到3D CT模态。

title: ProtoBridge-CLIP: Observation-Masked Finding Prototypes for Medical Image--Report Representation Learning
zh_title: ProtoBridge-CLIP：观察掩码发现原型的医学图像-报告表征学习
summary: 区分肯定、否定与未提及的发现，结合全局对齐与发现原型监督，在三个CT和五个胸片基准上评估。
key_points: 观察掩码排除不确定与未提及概念
文本原型与局部视觉token对齐
CT-RATE宏AUROC为73.6%
reason: 多基准含消融的VLM预训练方法，预印本，无外部临床验证
abstract: Radiology reports distinguish affirmed findings, explicit negations, and unmentioned concepts, but conventional global image--report contrastive learning often compresses these different evidence states into a single study-level target. We introduce \model{}, which combines symmetric global image--report alignment with observation-masked finding supervision and a soft relation objective over affirmed report concepts. Text-derived finding prototypes are aligned with local visual tokens, while uncertain and unmentioned concepts are excluded from direct finding labels. We evaluate the framework on three CT benchmarks and five chest-radiograph benchmarks, together with component ablations, paired and clinical retrieval, localization, perturbation robustness, calibration, and per-finding analyses. \model{} achieves macro-AUROC values of 73.6%, 66.5\%, and 68.8% on CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, and INSPECT, and 80.2%, 91.4%, 78.5%, 86.5%, and 90.8% on ChestXray14, CheXpert, PadChest, RSNA, and SIIM-ACR, respectively. Relative to the matched global-only controls, the findings and relation objectives yield consistent gains across the evaluated datasets. These results demonstrate the practical value of treating observed and unobserved report concepts differently during medical image--text representation learning.
zh_abstract: 放射学报告会区分已确认的发现、明确的否定以及未提及的概念，但传统的全局图像–报告对比学习往往将这些不同的证据状态压缩为单一的研究级目标。我们提出了 \model{}，它将对称的全局图像–报告对齐，与观察掩码的发现监督以及针对已确认报告概念的软关系目标相结合。源自文本的发现原型与局部视觉 token 对齐，而不确定和未提及的概念则被排除在直接的发现标签之外。我们在三个 CT 基准和五个胸部X线片基准上评估了该框架，并进行了组件消融、配对与临床检索、定位、扰动鲁棒性、校准以及逐发现分析。\model{} 在 CT-RATE、RAD-ChestCT 和 INSPECT 上的宏平均 AUROC 分别为 73.6%、66.5% 和 68.8%，在 ChestXray14、CheXpert、PadChest、RSNA 和 SIIM-ACR 上分别为 80.2%、91.4%、78.5%、86.5% 和 90.8%。相对于匹配的仅全局对照，发现目标和关系目标在所评估的各数据集上均带来一致的提升。这些结果表明，在医学图像–文本表征学习过程中，对报告中已观察到和未观察到的概念区别对待具有实际价值。

title: STORM: A Lightweight Structure-Free Model for Binding Affinity Prediction
zh_title: STORM：轻量无结构的结合亲和力预测模型
summary: 通过集成多种蛋白与分子表示的小模型预测结合亲和力，称在相同数据上匹配或超过Boltz-2等共折叠模型。
key_points: 无需结构，速度快、易重训练
集成多种蛋白和分子表征
相同数据训练下匹配或超越基线
reason: 药物发现新方法，有强基线对比，预印本
abstract: Accurately predicting a small molecule's binding affinity to a protein, a critical task in drug discovery, remains challenging. Physics-based approaches like free-energy perturbation (FEP) have very high computational costs and require expert setup. Recent machine learning--based cofolding models have reported accuracy approaching that of FEP---and at least one of them, Boltz-2, has already been widely adopted for affinity prediction---but they remain expensive for large computational screens and even more expensive for retraining on newly collected experimental data. To address these challenges, we introduce STORM: Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules. STORM is a fast, simple machine learning model that ensembles many small model fusions of diverse protein and molecule representations for binding affinity prediction. Trained on the same data, STORM matches or exceeds the accuracy of Boltz-2 on multiple evaluation datasets, while delivering a speed improvement of over five orders of magnitude for both inference and training. Our results also suggest opportunities to substantially improve affinity prediction accuracy by integrating historical experimental affinity data with structural and biophysical information.
zh_abstract: 准确预测小分子与蛋白质的结合亲和力是药物发现中的一项关键任务，但仍具有挑战性。基于物理的方法，如自由能微扰（FEP），计算成本极高，且需要专家进行设置。近期基于机器学习的共折叠（cofolding）模型已报告达到接近 FEP 的准确度——其中至少有一个模型 Boltz-2 已被广泛用于亲和力预测——但它们在大规模计算筛选中仍然代价高昂，而在新收集的实验数据上重新训练的成本更高。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 STORM：来自已观察参考分子的相似性迁移（Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules）。STORM 是一种快速、简单的机器学习模型，它集成了许多将多样的蛋白质和分子表征融合而成的小模型，用于结合亲和力预测。在相同数据上训练时，STORM 在多个评估数据集上达到或超过 Boltz-2 的准确度，同时在推理和训练上均实现了超过五个数量级的速度提升。我们的结果还提示，通过将历史实验亲和力数据与结构和生物物理信息相结合，有机会显著提高亲和力预测的准确度。

title: Transferable Named Sparse Features for Morphology-based Gleason Grading
zh_title: 基于可迁移命名稀疏特征的形态学Gleason分级
summary: 在病理基础模型token上训练稀疏自编码器，并与多读者标注对齐，使69个特征对应Gleason形态，用于可解释前列腺活检分级；预印本。
key_points: 2048个特征中69个按Gleason形态命名
在五个公开数据集、三种扫描仪上评估
形态图在多次对齐运行中保持稳定
reason: 病理基础模型可解释方法，多公开数据集评估，预印本；偏好加分
abstract: Deep learning systems grade prostate biopsies at the level of pathologists, but most report a grade without the glandular architecture that justifies it. This work presents a grading system built on a sparse code over the tokens of a pathology foundation model. A sparse autoencoder pretrained on biopsies is aligned with multi-reader annotations, so that 69 of its 2048 features are named after Gleason morphologies such as cribriform glands, cords, and comedonecrosis. The same code feeds a grading network, which reads all features to predict Gleason patterns and the Grade Group, while morphology maps read directly from the named features. We evaluate the system on five public datasets that include needle biopsies, tissue-microarray cores, multi-reader annotations, and three scanners. The morphology maps remain stable across alignment runs and, without retraining, detect cribriform glands in external biopsies (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUROC, 0.849) and pattern 5 in unseen cores when evaluated by up to six pathologists (AUROC 0.846 to 0.919). In an independent biopsy cohort, Grade Group agreement with three pathologists on Leica scans is close to their agreement with each other. Removing the named features reduces the corresponding Gleason pattern predictions by 49% to 98%, with effects larger than those from 20 activity-matched random feature removals. These results show that a shared sparse representation can support competitive Gleason grading while providing named morphological evidence that transfers across datasets and whose contribution to grading can be measured directly.

title: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
zh_title: ABSClaw：从虚构世界到基于现实的社会模拟
summary: 提出零代码智能体，将自然语言请求编译为可执行社会模拟，基于调查、普查、地理与真实网络数据，并用26个原子操作表达状态转移。
key_points: 人物、地点、关系均基于真实数据采样
26个任务无关的原子操作组合模拟逻辑
支持开放可扩展的生态
reason: 社会模拟方向新方法，预印本，评估信息有限
abstract: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.
zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的人工社会表现出丰富的行为，但往往缺乏科学依据：人物设定与环境均为假设，交互网络是合成的，模拟器以自由形式代码生成，导致结果难以与真实人群相联系，且对骨干模型较为敏感。我们主张，模拟世界应从观测数据中采样，而模拟逻辑应通过组合来自共享的、与任务无关的词汇表中的操作来实现。本文介绍 ABSClaw，一种零代码智能体，可将自然语言请求编译为可执行的、以现实为基础的社会模拟。ABSClaw 依据调查与普查数据、地理空间数据源和真实网络，确定谁行动、在何处行动以及与谁互动。它通过 26 种原子操作来表达状态转移。为支持开放且可扩展的生态，ABSClaw 还允许以生命周期范围的技能形式添加能力，而无需修改其核心。此外，我们提出 ABSBench，这是一个包含 193 项真实世界社会模拟任务的基准。在 ABSBench 上，ABSClaw 在所评估的社会模拟器中取得了最佳的整体表现。三个真实世界案例研究表明，对人物设定、环境和交互网络进行现实锚定，均能提高与观测结果的一致性。借助一项运行时技能，ABSClaw 执行了 13 个人群规模的模拟，共涉及 2,500 万个智能体。这些结果共同证明了 ABSClaw 在现实保真度、可扩展性和规模化方面的能力。

title: ORGANIC3D: Grounding 3D CT Vision Language Models in Organ Level Image Text Coupling
zh_title: ORGANIC3D：3D CT 视觉语言模型的器官级图文对齐
summary: 提出通过器官擦除、病灶替换、左右扰动等解剖干预评估并改进3D CT视觉语言模型器官级图文对齐的框架与基准。
key_points: 评测12个视觉编码器和7个生成式VLM
发现顶尖模型也存在明显对齐失败
用编辑后扫描训练以锚定器官级证据
reason: 3D CT VLM 基准与方法，评测较充分，预印本；命中多模态偏好
abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in 3D computed tomography (CT) classification, but high accuracy does not reflect whether their predictions rely on the correct anatomical evidence. We introduce ORGANIC3D, a framework for evaluating and improving organ level image text alignment through controlled anatomical interventions. Our benchmark assesses 12 vision encoder checkpoints and 7 generative VLMs using matched patient comparisons, organ erasure, lesion replacement, and laterality perturbations, revealing substantial alignment failures even among top performing models. To learn organ level image text correspondence, ORGANIC3D aligns each finding sentence with the anatomy aware image features and trains on edited scans to anchor this alignment in the organ's image evidence. We further extend this framework to generative VLMs, promoting evidence dependent question answering and report generation. Trained exclusively on public data, ORGANIC3D achieves SOTA classification AUROC on CTRATE, Merlin, and the heldout RADChestCT dataset and reaches 77% laterality accuracy, compared with at most 66% for prior models. Its generative VLM matches or exceeds all evaluated publicly released VLMs on visual question answering, achieves the highest report accuracy, and retracts 96 to 99% of target organ findings after organ removal, versus a maximum of 69% for other models. Together, these results establish ORGANIC3D as a framework for testing whether 3D CT vision language models ground their predictions in anatomical evidence and for improving organ level alignment alongside predictive accuracy.
zh_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在三维计算机断层扫描（CT）分类中已取得较强表现，但高准确率并不能反映其预测是否依赖正确的解剖学证据。我们提出 ORGANIC3D，这是一个通过受控解剖学干预来评估并改进器官水平图像–文本对齐的框架。我们的基准利用配对患者比较、器官擦除、病灶替换和左右侧扰动，评估了 12 个视觉编码器检查点和 7 个生成式 VLM，结果显示即便是表现最好的模型也存在显著的对齐失败。为学习器官水平的图像–文本对应关系，ORGANIC3D 将每条发现语句与具有解剖感知的图像特征对齐，并在经编辑的扫描上训练，以使这种对齐锚定于该器官的图像证据。我们进一步将该框架扩展至生成式 VLM，以促进依赖证据的问答和报告生成。ORGANIC3D 仅使用公开数据训练，在 CTRATE、Merlin 以及留出的 RADChestCT 数据集上取得了最先进（SOTA）的分类 AUROC，左右侧准确率达 77%，而既往模型最高为 66%。其生成式 VLM 在视觉问答上达到或超过所有被评估的已公开发布 VLM，取得最高的报告准确率，并在器官移除后撤回 96% 至 99% 的目标器官发现，而其他模型最高为 69%。总之，这些结果确立了 ORGANIC3D 作为一个框架的价值：既可检验三维 CT 视觉语言模型是否将其预测建立在解剖学证据之上，也可在提升预测准确率的同时改进器官水平的对齐。

title: Deep learning MGMT promoter methylation status prediction in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma using multiparametric MRI: Benchmark vs. real‑world performance.
zh_title: 多参数MRI深度学习预测胶质母细胞瘤MGMT甲基化
summary: 在949例IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤上比较多种深度学习策略，评估多中心异质条件下的稳健性与泛化性。
key_points: 整合BraTS公开数据与多机构私有队列
比较文献基线、全脑端到端与分割引导ROI
对比基准性能与真实场景表现
reason: 多中心数据、近千例，但摘要未明示独立外部验证
abstract: [Neurosurgical review] Preoperative determination of O6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) promoter methylation status is of major prognostic and predictive relevance in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma, yet currently depends on invasive tissue sampling. This study investigates deep learning-based strategies for MGMT prediction from multiparametric MRIs, with particular emphasis on robustness and generalizability under heterogeneous, multicenter conditions. A total of 949 glioblastoma cases were analyzed, integrating public benchmark data from the Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge (BraTS) with multi-institutional private cohorts acquired across diverse scanners and imaging protocols. Four complementary experimental settings were designed to compare reproduced literature baselines, private-only training, whole-brain end-to-end models, and segmentation-guided region-of-interest (ROI) pipelines. Tumor delineation was performed using an nnU-Net framework with expert quality control, and multiple three-dimensional convolutional neural network architectures were evaluated. Model performance was highest on the homogeneous BraTS benchmark, where a whole-brain DenseNet121 achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.80. However, marked performance deterioration was observed when models were evaluated on independent held-out multicenter test set. In contrast, segmentation-guided ROI-based approaches showed a more stable performance profile in this preliminary independent held-out multicenter test. Explicit lesion localization was associated with reduction in false-positive classifications, suggesting a potential benefit for performance stability across heterogeneous datasets, although validation in external cohorts from institutions not represented during training is required. Collectively, these results demonstrate that upstream methodological choices, especially tumor segmentation and ROI definition, remain critical determinants of performance in MRI-based radiogenomic modeling. Future studies should emphasize prospective multicenter validation, domain-shift harmonization, multimodal data integration, and uncertainty-aware deep learning to enhance robustness and interpretability.
zh_abstract: [神经外科综述] 术前确定O6-甲基鸟嘌呤-DNA甲基转移酶（MGMT）启动子甲基化状态对IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤的预后和预测具有重要意义，但目前仍依赖有创的组织取样。本研究探讨了基于深度学习、利用多参数MRI预测MGMT的策略，尤其强调在异质性多中心条件下的稳健性和泛化能力。共分析了949例胶质母细胞瘤病例，整合了来自脑肿瘤分割挑战赛（BraTS）的公开基准数据，以及在不同扫描仪和成像方案下采集的多机构私有队列。设计了四种互补的实验设置，用于比较复现的文献基线模型、仅使用私有数据训练、全脑端到端模型以及分割引导的感兴趣区域（ROI）流程。肿瘤勾画采用nnU-Net框架并经专家质控，并评估了多种三维卷积神经网络架构。模型性能在同质的BraTS基准上最高，其中全脑DenseNet121的受试者操作特征曲线下面积为0.80。然而，在独立的留出多中心测试集上评估时，模型性能明显下降。相比之下，在这一初步的独立留出多中心测试中，分割引导的基于ROI的方法表现出更稳定的性能。明确的病灶定位与假阳性分类的减少相关，提示其可能有助于提升跨异质数据集的性能稳定性，但仍需在训练中未涉及的机构的外部队列中进行验证。总体而言，这些结果表明，上游方法学选择，尤其是肿瘤分割和ROI定义，仍是基于MRI的影像基因组学建模性能的关键决定因素。未来研究应着重于前瞻性多中心验证、域偏移协调、多模态数据整合以及不确定性感知的深度学习，以增强稳健性和可解释性。

title: SWIMSS: An Open Multi-Center SwinUNETR Model for Multiple Sclerosis White Matter Lesion Segmentation
zh_title: SWIMSS：开放多中心SwinUNETR多发性硬化白质病灶分割模型
summary: 在瑞士七个中心1385名多发性硬化患者数据上训练并比较SwinUNETR、UNETR、MSSegDiff与LST-AI，SWIMSS表现最佳。
key_points: 七中心1385例真实世界纵向数据
对比UNETR、MSSegDiff与LST-AI
模型开放，以Dice评估
reason: 多中心大样本且开放模型，但摘要未明确外部验证，预印本
abstract: Purpose: To develop and validate SWIMSS (SWInUNETR for Multiple Sclerosis white matter lesion Segmentation), a SwinUNETR-based deep learning (DL) model for reliable automated white matter (WM) lesion segmentation, in a large multicentric cohort of people with multiple sclerosis (pwMS). Methods: A real-world longitudinal dataset of 1,385 pwMS from seven Swiss clinical centers was used to train, validate, and test SWIMSS and two state-of-the-art DL architectures: UNETR and MSSegDiff. Inference results obtained with LST-AI were also compared. Preprocessed magnetization-prepared rapid acquisition gradient echo and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI sequences, acquired with various MR systems and field strengths, served as model inputs. Model performance was evaluated using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Results: SWIMSS achieved the highest performance, with a DSC of 81.37 (95% CI: 80.63-82.11), outperforming UNETR (79.06; 95% CI: 78.33-79.79), MSSegDiff (75.70; 95% CI: 74.97-76.43), and LST-AI (63.19; 95% CI: 62.08-64.30). Normalized DSC followed a similar trend, with SWIMSS reaching 84.88. Lesion detection F1 achieved 81.14. Statistical analyses confirmed its superior performance (p < 0.001). Conclusion: SWIMSS achieved state-of-the-art performance for WM lesion segmentation. By making this model publicly available, we enable broader access to high-quality segmentation tools, allowing smaller centers, often lacking large annotated datasets or computational resources, to benefit from a model trained on a diverse, large-scale cohort. This promotes more equitable access to advanced imaging analysis and supports reproducibility and standardization in MS research.
zh_abstract: 【目的】在大型多中心多发性硬化（MS）患者（pwMS）队列中，开发并验证 SWIMSS（SWInUNETR for Multiple Sclerosis white matter lesion Segmentation），这是一种基于 SwinUNETR 的深度学习（DL）模型，用于可靠的自动化白质（WM）病灶分割。【方法】使用来自瑞士七个临床中心的 1,385 名 pwMS 的真实世界纵向数据集，对 SWIMSS 以及两种最先进的 DL 架构 UNETR 和 MSSegDiff 进行训练、验证和测试，并比较了 LST-AI 的推理结果。以多种 MR 系统和场强采集并经预处理的磁化准备快速梯度回波和液体衰减反转恢复 MRI 序列作为模型输入。使用 Dice 相似系数（DSC）及 95% 置信区间（CI）评估模型性能。【结果】SWIMSS 取得最佳性能，DSC 为 81.37（95% CI：80.63–82.11），优于 UNETR（79.06；95% CI：78.33–79.79）、MSSegDiff（75.70；95% CI：74.97–76.43）和 LST-AI（63.19；95% CI：62.08–64.30）。归一化 DSC 呈现类似趋势，SWIMSS 达到 84.88。病灶检测 F1 为 81.14。统计分析证实其性能更优（p < 0.001）。【结论】SWIMSS 在 WM 病灶分割方面达到了最先进的性能。通过公开该模型，我们使更多人能够获得高质量的分割工具，使往往缺乏大型标注数据集或计算资源的小型中心也能受益于在多样化大规模队列上训练的模型。这促进了先进影像分析的更公平获取，并支持 MS 研究中的可重复性和标准化。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Benchmarking Uncertainty Quantification in Retinal Disease Screening
zh_title: 超越准确率：视网膜疾病筛查不确定性量化基准
summary: 构建含32个数据集、逾24.2万张眼底照片的多病种基准，评估六种不确定性量化策略，发现没有普遍最优方法。
key_points: 覆盖糖网、AMD与青光眼
评估区分度、校准、选择性预测与共形预测
判别提升不必然带来可靠性提升
reason: 大规模多数据集基准，预印本，眼科方向加分
abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for evaluating retinal AI systems beyond classification accuracy, yet it remains unclear whether existing UQ strategies generalize across diseases, model architectures, and reliability criteria. We introduce a large-scale, multi-disease benchmark comprising over $242,000$ fundus photographs from $32$ datasets covering diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma. We evaluate six representative UQ strategies across three Vision Transformer configurations, assessing discrimination, probabilistic calibration, selective prediction, and conformal prediction-set coverage. Our findings reveal no universally superior model or UQ strategy: methods that improve reliability in one disease or architecture may underperform in another, while improvements in discrimination, calibration, and selective prediction do not necessarily align. Notably, computationally intensive methods do not consistently outperform simple confidence scores, and domain-specific foundation models and calibration-oriented loss functions do not guarantee greater reliability. In contrast, conformal prediction provides a complementary framework for achieving near-nominal marginal prediction-set coverage across diverse settings, subject to its statistical assumptions. These findings challenge universal UQ recommendations and highlight the need for disease-specific, model-specific, and multidimensional reliability evaluation before clinical deployment. We release standardized dataset splits, trained checkpoints, evaluation code, and an interactive research demonstration to support reproducible benchmarking.

title: Accurate and interpretable protein complex stoichiometry prediction through agentic AI with StoiAgent
zh_title: StoiAgent：基于智能体AI的可解释蛋白复合物化学计量预测
summary: 预印本提出基于开源权重Qwen3.6-27B的LLM智能体，整合序列、结构与文献证据预测蛋白复合物化学计量并保留推理轨迹。
key_points: 整合序列、模板、AlphaFold3与文献证据
在56个CASP17靶标上top-1准确率75.0%
保留思维链式可解释推理轨迹
reason: 新颖智能体方法，仅56个靶标，预印本；科学发现类上调
abstract: Accurate protein complex structure modeling requires knowledge of complex stoichiometry, yet the copy numbers of individual subunits are often unknown. Consequently, predicting protein complex stoichiometry has emerged as a major challenge in recent years. Here, we present StoiAgent, a large language model (LLM)-powered AI agent that automates the retrieval and integration of sequence, structural, and literature evidence to predict stoichiometry while preserving interpretable reasoning traces (chain of thoughts) of its evidence assessment and ranking decision. An open-weight LLM model, Qwen3.6-27B, is used by StoiAgent as the LLM backbone to combine sequences, structural templates, AlphaFold3 structure predictions, and literature evidence, and perform stoichiometry candidate generation and ranking. On 56 CASP17 protein complex targets, it achieves top-1 accuracy of 75.0%, which represents a 23.2 percentage-point improvement over PreStoi with AlphaFold3 ranking (51.8%) and matches the top-1 accuracy of StoPred. Moreover, StoiAgent has a higher top-3 and top-5 accuracy than StoPred (85.7% versus 80.4% and 87.5% versus 85.7%, respectively). Furthermore, it outperforms general-purpose frontier LLMs, including ChatGPT and Gemini, in stoichiometry prediction. Case studies further illustrate how StoiAgent evaluates competing assembly hypotheses by integrating complementary evidence, with recorded reasoning traces documenting its decision-making process. Overall, StoiAgent demonstrates the potential of LLM-powered AI agents to improve protein complex stoichiometry prediction through the automated integration of diverse sources of evidence while providing interpretable explanations to guide downstream structure modeling.
zh_abstract: 准确的蛋白质复合物结构建模需要了解复合物的化学计量比，但各个亚基的拷贝数往往未知。因此，预测蛋白质复合物化学计量比近年来已成为一项重大挑战。在此，我们提出 StoiAgent，这是一种由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的 AI 智能体，可自动检索并整合序列、结构和文献证据以预测化学计量比，同时保留其证据评估和排序决策的可解释推理轨迹（思维链）。StoiAgent 使用开放权重的 LLM 模型 Qwen3.6-27B 作为 LLM 骨干，结合序列、结构模板、AlphaFold3 结构预测和文献证据，进行化学计量比候选生成与排序。在 56 个 CASP17 蛋白质复合物靶标上，其 top-1 准确率达 75.0%，比采用 AlphaFold3 排序的 PreStoi（51.8%）提高了 23.2 个百分点，并与 StoPred 的 top-1 准确率相当。此外，StoiAgent 的 top-3 和 top-5 准确率均高于 StoPred（分别为 85.7% 对 80.4%，以及 87.5% 对 85.7%）。再者，在化学计量比预测方面，其表现优于包括 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 在内的通用前沿 LLM。案例研究进一步说明了 StoiAgent 如何通过整合互补证据来评估相互竞争的组装假说，并由所记录的推理轨迹呈现其决策过程。总体而言，StoiAgent 展示了由 LLM 驱动的 AI 智能体通过自动整合多种来源的证据来改进蛋白质复合物化学计量比预测的潜力，同时提供可解释的说明以指导下游结构建模。

title: ANCHOR: AI-NGS consensus hierarchy for optimized refinement of high-affinity binders from affinity maturation.
zh_title: ANCHOR：AI与NGS共识层级用于高亲和力结合蛋白优化
summary: 提出结合AI与NGS数据的两阶段策略，以Fyn SH2结构域为模型系统改进亲和力成熟中的候选筛选。
key_points: 富集训练的分类与回归模型构建候选池
不单纯依据模型得分排序

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Affinity maturation for the systematic discovery of high-affinity protein reagents remains a major challenge in display-based protein engineering, largely because phenotypic enrichment frequently fails to correlate with true binding affinity. To improve candidate identification, we developed ANCHOR, an artificial intelligence (AI) and next-generation sequencing (NGS) consensus hierarchy for optimized refinement that implements a score-decoupled, two-stage strategy. Enrichment-trained classifier and regression models are used to construct a candidate pool, from which group-specific consensus sequences are subsequently derived without ranking candidates solely by individual model scores. Using the phosphotyrosine-binding Fyn SH2 domain as a model system, the two models achieved strong performance on untouched independent test sets (classification area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) = 0.974; regression Pearson's r = 0.870). By leveraging a biopanning-guided filter, ANCHOR reduced the searchable sequence space by approximately four orders of magnitude while maintaining a ~90% overlap with exhaustive screening and retained 297 enrichment-predicted variants. These variants were grouped by residue identity at the least-conserved position (P4) and consensus sequences were derived within each group. Among the 16 evaluable consensus variants, 9 (56%) matched or exceeded the affinity of TrM, a previously established 100-fold-improved superbinder, with several showing a two-fold further improvement. Exploratory analyses using a structural proxy indicated robustness to parameter choices and a higher observed hit rate for ANCHOR than for the evaluated alternatives. Application to a public anti-HER2 scFv yeast-display NGS dataset demonstrated computational portability across datasets and library designs. Collectively, ANCHOR provides a practical framework for prioritizing affinity-maturation candidates from display-derived NGS data.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 用于系统发现高亲和力蛋白试剂的亲和力成熟仍是基于展示技术的蛋白质工程中的一大挑战，主要原因是表型富集往往与真实结合亲和力不相关。为改进候选序列的识别，我们开发了 ANCHOR（用于优化精炼的人工智能（AI）与二代测序（NGS）共识层级），其采用分数解耦的两阶段策略。先利用基于富集训练的分类和回归模型构建候选池，再从中推导各组特异的共识序列，而不单纯依据单个模型的分数对候选序列排序。以结合磷酸酪氨酸的 Fyn SH2 结构域作为模型体系，这两个模型在未参与训练的独立测试集上表现优异（分类受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）= 0.974；回归 Pearson r = 0.870）。通过利用生物淘选引导的过滤，ANCHOR 将可搜索序列空间缩小了约四个数量级，同时与穷举筛选保持约 90% 的重叠，并保留了 297 个经富集预测的变体。这些变体按最不保守位置（P4）的残基种类分组，并在每组内推导共识序列。在 16 个可评估的共识变体中，有 9 个（56%）的亲和力达到或超过 TrM（一种此前已确立的亲和力提高 100 倍的超级结合体），其中若干个进一步提高了两倍。使用结构代理指标的探索性分析表明，ANCHOR 对参数选择具有稳健性，且观察到的命中率高于所评估的其他替代方法。将其应用于公开的抗 HER2 scFv 酵母展示 NGS 数据集，证明了其在不同数据集和文库设计之间的计算可移植性。总之，ANCHOR 为基于展示技术所得 NGS 数据对亲和力成熟候选序列进行优先排序提供了一个实用框架。

title: Large Language Model-Enhanced MFSSG Enables Effective and Accurate Integration Analysis for Microbiome-Metabolome Data.
zh_title: 大模型增强的MFSSG用于微生物组-代谢组整合分析
summary: 提出MFSSG矩阵分解工具包，联合学习共享与模态特异图结构，用于微生物组与代谢组配对数据整合分析。
key_points: 支持样本聚类与多组学可视化
支持疾病风险分层与生物学年龄量化
摘要未体现大模型的具体作用与验证结果
reason: 工具型方法，摘要缺少验证细节，增量档
abstract: [Analytical chemistry] The massive volume of paired microbiome and metabolome measurementsgenerated through high-throughput sequencing and mass spectrometryhas created an urgent need for dedicated, integrative analytical pipelines. Existing tools lack the capacity to simultaneously support sample clustering, multi-omics visualization, disease risk stratification, and biological age quantification using matched dual-modal datasets. To overcome this analytical bottleneck, we introduce the matrix factorization with shared and specific graph learning (MFSSG) toolkit: an unsupervised matrix factorization framework that jointly learns both shared and modality-specific graph structures. MFSSG preserves cross-omics spatial consistency by leveraging shared nearest-neighbor graphs derived from analytical profiles and incorporates two complementary regularization termsentropy regularization to enhance cluster discriminability and a pre-trained microbial graph Laplacianto mitigate measurement bias inherent in microbiome sequencing versus metabolomic mass spectrometry data. Validated across three independent multi-omics cohorts derived from gastric and gut biospecimensincluding gastric cancer, end-stage renal disease, and type 1 diabetesMFSSG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art integration methods in disease classification. Furthermore, a novel pairwise learning module enables parallel and accurate quantification of the metabolic age and microbial age, facilitating refined patient risk stratification. This versatile toolkit provides a robust chemometric strategy for uncovering latent biological patterns embedded within heterogeneous multi-omics analytical data.
zh_abstract: [分析化学] 通过高通量测序和质谱产生的海量配对微生物组与代谢组测量数据，迫切需要专门的整合分析流程。现有工具无法利用匹配的双模态数据同时支持样本聚类、多组学可视化、疾病风险分层和生物学年龄量化。为克服这一分析瓶颈，我们提出了带共享与特异图学习的矩阵分解（MFSSG）工具包：一种无监督矩阵分解框架，可联合学习共享的和模态特异的图结构。MFSSG利用源自分析谱图的共享近邻图来保持跨组学空间一致性，并引入两个互补的正则化项——用于增强聚类可区分性的熵正则化，以及预训练的微生物图拉普拉斯项——以减轻微生物组测序与代谢组质谱数据之间固有的测量偏差。在来自胃和肠道生物样本的三个独立多组学队列（包括胃癌、终末期肾病和1型糖尿病）中验证，MFSSG在疾病分类方面始终优于最先进的整合方法。此外，一个新颖的成对学习模块可并行且准确地量化代谢年龄和微生物年龄，有助于更精细的患者风险分层。该多功能工具包为揭示异质多组学分析数据中蕴含的潜在生物学模式提供了稳健的化学计量学策略。

title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
zh_title: 仅凭查询用大语言模型审计黑盒临床预测模型：植入缺陷盲测
summary: 在国际卒中试验数据上训练四类模型并植入缺陷，让LLM通过仅返回预测的工具盲审，检验其解释、查错与发现新知识的能力。
key_points: 24个植入缺陷模型加8个无缺陷模型
四类模型：逻辑回归、EBM、GBT、神经网络
预先固定判定规则并程序化执行
reason: 设计严谨的盲测预印本，但摘要信息不完整
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被用于解释临床预测模型，其前景在于能够说明模型计算了什么、发现其缺陷，甚至揭示其中的新知识。我们在答案可被核查的情形下检验了这三项前景。我们基于国际卒中试验（International Stroke Trial），使用较早随机分组的患者，针对两个结局训练了四类模型（逻辑回归、可解释提升机、梯度提升树、神经网络），在 24 个副本中各植入一个缺陷（某亚组被低估预测、某危险因素方向反转或不合理的阶跃），并将其与 8 个无缺陷模型混合。GPT-6 Astra 通过一个仅返回模型预测值的工具，对每个模型进行三次盲法审计；判定规则在任何运行之前即已确定，并由程序执行。其代理模型（中位数 128 项）复现了被审计模型的对数几率，平均 $R^2$ 为 0.976（由分析人员拟合的 42 项加性代理模型为 0.959）。它在 72 次运行中的 69 次发现了植入的缺陷（96%；95% CI 80% 至 99%）；为此专门编写的脚本则发现了全部 24 个。它还报告了多得多的问题：在 1,089 条可核查报告中，60% 未通过针对模型平均行为的预先设定的核查；事后分析显示，其中大多数是真实但幅度很小的阶跃，且 15% 的可核查报告在模型中找不到对应内容。在其从无缺陷模型中读出的 601 个意外关系中，11% 在较晚随机分组的患者中成立（随机配对为 6%；回归扫描给出的更短的最强候选列表为 28%）；经训练数据核查后，为 33% 对 30%。仅凭查询访问权限，LLM 即可忠实地描述黑箱模型，并发现几乎所有植入的缺陷，而专门编写的脚本也做到了这一点；其问题报告必须在模型上核查，其发现必须在数据上验证。

title: Sex Differences in the Detection of Parkinson's Disease from Speech
zh_title: 基于语音检测帕金森病的性别差异
summary: 在四个持续发声数据集的性别平衡子集上，评估三种预训练语音模型嵌入与声学特征，比较不同性别的检测表现。
key_points: 使用深度学习与传统机器学习方法
控制性别、疾病状态及可能的年龄
摘要提示女性与男性表现存在差异
reason: 多数据集的公平性分析，预印本，神经退行性方向小幅加分
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disease in the world, and 70\% to 75\% of PD patients suffer from speech disorders at some stage. Since PD affects men more frequently than women, previous publications tend to rely on unbalanced datasets that potentially introduce sex biases into trained models. This study investigates sex differences in PD detection from speech using deep learning and traditional machine learning approaches. We evaluated speech-based PD detection using embeddings from three pre-trained speech models, combined with handcrafted acoustic features and different classifiers. Sex-specific experiments were conducted on balanced subsets of four sustained phonation datasets, controlling for sex, disease status, and, where possible, age. All recordings were obtained during a sustained phonation task. Results show that female speakers were more accurately classified than male speakers in the larger dataset. Sex-specific results show that when the models are trained on one sex, they fail to generalize to the other one. Our results highlight the importance of including sex as a variable in the development of PD detection systems.
zh_abstract: 帕金森病（PD）是世界上第二常见的神经退行性疾病，70%至75%的PD患者在某一阶段患有言语障碍。由于PD在男性中比女性更常见，既往研究往往依赖不平衡的数据集，可能给训练模型引入性别偏倚。本研究利用深度学习和传统机器学习方法，探讨基于语音检测PD时的性别差异。我们使用三种预训练语音模型的嵌入，结合手工设计的声学特征和不同的分类器，评估基于语音的PD检测。在四个持续发音数据集的平衡子集上开展了按性别分层的实验，控制了性别、疾病状态，并在可能时控制了年龄。所有录音均在持续发音任务中获得。结果显示，在较大的数据集中，女性说话者比男性说话者被更准确地分类。按性别分层的结果显示，当模型在一种性别上训练时，无法泛化到另一种性别。我们的结果强调了在开发PD检测系统时将性别作为变量纳入的重要性。

title: Bridging the Gender Gap in Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Machine Learning Approach to Screening Women for Moderate-to-Severe Disease.
source: PubMed · Respiration; international review of thoracic diseases
zh_title: 面向女性中重度阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停筛查的机器学习方法
summary: 回顾性研究基于1,210名女性的多导睡眠监测及临床记录，用四种机器学习算法区分中重度与无至轻度OSA。

采用四种机器学习算法分类
因实验室指标缺失建立两套模型

abstract: [Respiration; international review of thoracic diseases] Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) can lead to severe complications if left untreated. Several challenges hinder OSA identification in females, resulting in underdiagnosis and undertreatment in this population. This study aimed to develop a machine learning (ML) approach specifically tailored to screen women for moderate-to-severe OSA. A retrospective study was conducted using clinical records of 1,210 women who underwent polysomnography at our institution. Collected data included demographics, body metrics, nocturnal oxygen saturation levels, medical conditions, medications, laboratory measurements, and polysomnography results. Four ML algorithms were employed to classify participants into moderate-to-severe and none-to-mild OSA groups. Due to the high missingness of laboratory values in the whole cohort, two sets of models were developed: one utilizing all subjects but excluding lab tests, and another restricted to a subgroup of 383 participants that additionally incorporated hemoglobin and lipid profile alongside the other features. Without laboratory measurements, the best-performing model was adaptive boosting, which achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve and accuracy of 0.811 and 76.03%, respectively. When lab tests were included, gradient boosting machine outperformed its competitors, with the above metrics reaching 0.872 and 84.42%, respectively. The promising performance of our approach underlines the potential of artificial intelligence in refining screening strategies for OSA in women. Nadir oxygen saturation during sleep emerged as a particularly strong predictor, reinforcing the central role of nocturnal hypoxemia in OSA risk stratification. Future research should focus on incorporating broader clinical inputs and using larger, diverse datasets to develop a highly accurate, robust model that meets clinical standards and is suitable for real-world implementation.
zh_abstract: [Respiration; international review of thoracic diseases] 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）若不治疗可导致严重并发症。多种挑战阻碍了女性OSA的识别，导致该人群诊断不足和治疗不足。本研究旨在开发一种专门针对女性筛查中重度OSA的机器学习（ML）方法。我们开展了一项回顾性研究，使用了在本机构接受多导睡眠监测的1,210名女性的临床记录。收集的数据包括人口统计学、身体指标、夜间血氧饱和度水平、合并疾病、用药情况、实验室检测指标及多导睡眠监测结果。采用四种ML算法将参与者分为中重度OSA组和无至轻度OSA组。由于整个队列中实验室检测值缺失率高，我们建立了两组模型：一组纳入所有受试者但不包含实验室检查，另一组仅限于383名参与者的亚组，在其他特征之外额外纳入血红蛋白和血脂谱。在不含实验室检测时，表现最佳的模型是自适应提升（adaptive boosting），其受试者工作特征曲线下面积和准确率分别为0.811和76.03%。纳入实验室检测后，梯度提升机（gradient boosting machine）优于其他算法，上述指标分别达到0.872和84.42%。我们方法的良好表现凸显了人工智能在优化女性OSA筛查策略方面的潜力。睡眠期间最低血氧饱和度是特别强的预测因子，进一步印证了夜间低氧血症在OSA风险分层中的核心作用。未来研究应着重纳入更广泛的临床输入信息，并使用更大、更多样化的数据集，以开发出符合临床标准、适合实际应用的高精度、稳健模型。

title: Bidirectional multi-scale implicit neural representation network for topology-aware lung 4D-CT registration.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 面向拓扑感知肺4D-CT配准的双向多尺度隐式神经表示网络
summary: 提出双向多尺度隐式神经表示网络，用于处理肺4D-CT大呼吸位移配准，缓解单向由粗到细级联的误差传播。
key_points: 针对大幅呼吸运动的肺4D-CT配准
双向多尺度结构缓解误差传播
结合隐式神经表示建模连续形变
reason: 方法型研究，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Objective.Precise lung 4D-CT registration is extremely challenging due to large respiratory excursions. To capture such large-magnitude motion, existing deep learning methods typically adopt a unidirectional coarse-to-fine cascade strategy, which is vulnerable to error propagation because uncorrected coarse-level misalignments degrade subsequent finer-scale stages and often lead to spatially inconsistent deformations. While implicit neural representations (INRs) support continuous coordinate-based deformation modeling, traditional instance-specific INRs lack clinical efficiency and struggle to converge on global large deformations because of the absence of multi-scale semantic guidance. This study aims to bridge these gaps by developing a bidirectional multi-scale INR network that jointly handles large deformation modeling and localized structural fidelity.Approach.We propose a bidirectional multi-scale INR network. First, a generalized conditional INR framework is introduced to enable continuous deformation modeling without the need for retraining. Crucially, a bidirectional feature feedback mechanism built upon Swin Transformer injects high-level semantic priors into low-resolution streams, correcting coarse-level biases through top-down interaction. Furthermore, an anatomy-aware structural constraint is incorporated to promote anatomical consistency and local boundary alignment.Main results.Under the within-subject phase-held-out DIR-Lab protocol, the proposed method achieved a mean TRE of 1.28 mm and a folding rate of 0.0090%. A leave-one-case-out evaluation assessed subject-independent generalization, yielding a mean TRE of 1.53 mm and a folding rate of 0.0195%. On the independent POPI dataset, the method achieved a mean TRE of 1.84 mm and a folding rate of 0.0806%, demonstrating competitive cross-center performance. Inference took 0.33 s per case.Significance.The proposed framework effectively combines continuous coordinate modeling with deep learning efficiency, overcoming error propagation inherent in discrete coarse-to-fine strategies and preserving both global deformation consistency and local anatomical precision. Its sub-second inference and performance under leave-one-case-out and independent external testing support its potential for efficient image-guided radiation therapy workflows.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 【目的】由于呼吸幅度大，精确的肺部 4D-CT 配准极具挑战性。为捕捉这种大幅度运动，现有深度学习方法通常采用单向的由粗到细级联策略，但未被校正的粗尺度错位会降低后续更精细尺度阶段的效果，因而容易发生误差传播，并常导致空间上不一致的形变。隐式神经表示（INR）支持基于连续坐标的形变建模，但传统的实例特异性 INR 缺乏临床效率，并且由于缺少多尺度语义引导，难以在全局大形变上收敛。本研究旨在通过开发一种同时处理大形变建模和局部结构保真度的双向多尺度 INR 网络来弥补这些不足。【方法】我们提出了一种双向多尺度 INR 网络。首先，引入广义条件 INR 框架，实现无需重新训练的连续形变建模。关键的是，基于 Swin Transformer 构建的双向特征反馈机制将高层语义先验注入低分辨率流，通过自上而下的交互校正粗尺度偏差。此外，还引入了解剖感知的结构约束，以促进解剖一致性和局部边界对齐。【主要结果】在受试者内、时相留出的 DIR-Lab 方案下，所提方法的平均 TRE 为 1.28 mm，折叠率为 0.0090%。留一病例法评估了与受试者无关的泛化能力，平均 TRE 为 1.53 mm，折叠率为 0.0195%。在独立的 POPI 数据集上，该方法的平均 TRE 为 1.84 mm，折叠率为 0.0806%，显示出具有竞争力的跨中心性能。每例推理耗时 0.33 秒。【意义】所提框架有效结合了连续坐标建模与深度学习的效率，克服了离散的由粗到细策略固有的误差传播，同时保持了全局形变一致性和局部解剖精度。其亚秒级推理速度以及在留一病例法和独立外部测试中的表现，支持其在高效图像引导放射治疗工作流程中的应用潜力。

abstract: [Critical reviews in toxicology] NAMs are revolutionizing safety assessment and bridging the substantial disconnect between traditional animal toxicology studies and human exposure within the pharmaceutical industry. AI predictive toxicology uses graph neural networks, deep learning, explainable AI, PBPK, and IVIVE modeling for human-dose predictions, and micro-physiological and organ-on-a-chip systems that replicate specific physiological states. The development of NAMs has been applied to FDA initiatives, such as the Predictive Toxicology Roadmap, ISTAND MIDD, and CiPA, to demonstrate how integrated NAM systems optimized at early drug development stages provide valuable information on mechanistic toxicities related to humans and accelerate drug development. AI-QSAR models, PBPK simulations, and organ-on-a-chip technologies are increasingly integrated with discovery and early-stage preclinical workflows in different sectors. Standardization and reproducibility across platforms, transparency of AI models, multiomics integration, and global regulator convergence are required to improve the power of AI. This review is the first to provide a unified mechanistic synthesis of all three pillars of NAMs, AI-based predictive toxicology, PBPK-IVIVE modeling, and microphysiological systems (MPS), while earlier reviews covered them independently. We suggest a cyclical NAM ecosystem in which AI predictions seek translation to human pharmacokinetics, with iterative mechanistic validation via MPS, solving current challenges of translation from animals to humans. This review is distinct from others in that it presents NAM technologies as an integrated, human-relevant system rather than disparate technologies, and thus offers regulators a roadmap.
zh_abstract: [Critical reviews in toxicology] 新方法学（NAMs）正在革新安全性评价，并弥合制药行业中传统动物毒理学研究与人体暴露之间的巨大脱节。人工智能预测毒理学利用图神经网络、深度学习、可解释人工智能、PBPK 和 IVIVE 建模进行人体剂量预测，并利用复制特定生理状态的微生理系统和器官芯片系统。NAMs 的发展已应用于美国 FDA 的多项举措，如预测毒理学路线图（Predictive Toxicology Roadmap）、ISTAND MIDD 和 CiPA，以展示在早期药物开发阶段优化的整合 NAM 系统如何提供与人体相关的机制性毒性的有价值信息并加速药物开发。AI-QSAR 模型、PBPK 模拟和器官芯片技术正越来越多地整合到不同领域的药物发现和早期临床前工作流程中。要提升 AI 的效能，需要实现各平台间的标准化和可重复性、AI 模型的透明性、多组学整合以及全球监管趋同。本综述首次对 NAMs 的三大支柱——基于 AI 的预测毒理学、PBPK-IVIVE 建模和微生理系统（MPS）——进行了统一的机制性综合，而此前的综述均分别独立论述。我们提出一种循环式 NAM 生态系统：AI 预测寻求转化为人体药代动力学，并通过 MPS 进行迭代的机制验证，从而解决当前从动物到人体转化的难题。本综述的独特之处在于将 NAM 技术呈现为一个整合的、与人体相关的系统，而非零散的技术，从而为监管机构提供路线图。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Advancement of Mechanical Circulatory Support and Cardiac Care: A Systematic Review of Its Role and Potential.

abstract: [Artificial organs] In recent years, there has been a notable surge in the ability of machines to perform complex and intelligent human-centered tasks, particularly within the domain of cardiovascular health. Rapid advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) algorithms reflect the considerable potential for such analyses to meaningfully extend into translational device development and clinical usage of medical devices, especially mechanical circulatory support (MCS) therapies. Here, we investigate and report the applications, limitations, and strategies in which AI is currently being employed in MCS and the potential opportunities of AI approaches to advance the field of MCS. To effectively assess the scope and impact of AI in MCS, we conducted a systematic literature review. A comprehensive search of 4 recognized research databases (PubMed, Google Scholar, Ovid MEDLINE, and ProQuest) was performed using this Boolean string: "(Artificial Intelligence) AND (AI) AND (Mechanical Circulatory Support) AND (MCS) NOT (Heart Transplant) NOT (Cardiogenic Shock) NOT (Critical Care)." Database search results were then screened by titles and abstracts, followed by full-text eligibility assessment and duplicate removal. Following these screening and eligibility steps, 30 of the 328 identified articles remained for inclusion. Most relevant publications covered two main subjects: the prediction and management of postoperative outcomes, and the development of personalized device-patient matching and timing. Across the reviewed studies, AI/ML models demonstrated promising performance in study-specific predictions of complications, recovery-related outcomes, and survival and were investigated as tools to support clinical decision-making. Barriers to broad implementation of AI include the necessity for sizable, high-quality datasets to achieve algorithm training benchmarks, the lack of organized and complete databases, such as INTERMACS, and limited computational resources. Emerging frontiers of MCS recognize the potential for AI and ML techniques to refine image recognition capabilities, diagnostic assessment, device placement, and post-implantation monitoring approaches in the future. AI-driven approaches demonstrate a promising convergence of computational power and clinical expertise, with the potential to support more personalized, efficient, and informed management of MCS patients. title: ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking
zh_title: ProbMedTOD：贝叶斯网络引导的病史采集对话系统
summary: 提出结合贝叶斯网络与小语言模型的任务导向对话系统，用于病史采集中的诊断不确定性追踪。
key_points: 小语言模型适配隐私、成本与延迟约束
贝叶斯网络提供可审计的概率信念更新
摘要显示自动构建网络，结果未提供

abstract: Patient history taking is a strategic, multi-turn process that refines diagnostic hypotheses through iterative questioning, mirroring clinical reasoning where each inquiry updates beliefs over candidate diagnoses. Deploying AI in this setting is constrained by privacy, cost, and latency, making Small Language Models (SLMs) a more desirable backbone compared to larger LLMs. However, SLMs capture only the fast, intuitive "System 1" side of this process and lack explicit mechanisms for the deliberative "System 2" reasoning needed to maintain and update diagnostic uncertainty over time. Bayesian Networks (BayesNets) offer a natural complement, providing an interpretable framework for auditable probabilistic belief tracking. Yet, clinical BayesNets are difficult to construct due to their reliance on expert curated structure, dependencies, and parameters. We introduce ProbMedTOD, which automatically synthesizes a clinical BayesNet from a small number of clinical notes in three stages: ontology building, structure prediction, and parameter estimation. ProbMedTOD then integrates the resulting BayesNet with SLMs, enabling probabilistic reasoning in multi-turn dialogues. A BayesNet Agent maintains real-time posterior distributions over diagnoses, while a Policy Agent picks diagnostically informative questions. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV Notes show that ProbMedTOD outperforms LLM-only and retrieval-based baselines, with especially strong gains for smaller models.
zh_abstract: 病史采集是一个策略性的多轮过程，通过反复提问来完善诊断假设，这与临床推理相呼应，即每次询问都会更新对候选诊断的信念。在这一场景中部署 AI 受到隐私、成本和延迟的限制，使得小语言模型（SLM）相比更大的 LLM 成为更理想的基础模型。然而，SLM 只能捕捉该过程中快速、直觉式的“系统1”一面，缺乏进行审慎的“系统2”推理所需的显式机制，以随时间维持和更新诊断不确定性。贝叶斯网络（BayesNet）提供了天然的补充，为可审计的概率信念追踪提供了可解释的框架。然而，临床贝叶斯网络由于依赖专家整理的结构、依赖关系和参数，难以构建。我们提出 ProbMedTOD，它分三个阶段从少量临床记录中自动合成临床贝叶斯网络：本体构建、结构预测和参数估计。随后，ProbMedTOD 将所得贝叶斯网络与 SLM 整合，实现多轮对话中的概率推理。其中，BayesNet Agent 实时维护诊断的后验分布，Policy Agent 则选择具有诊断信息量的问题。在 DDXPlus 和 MIMIC-IV Notes 上的实验表明，ProbMedTOD 优于仅使用 LLM 和基于检索的基线方法，对较小模型的提升尤为显著。

title: Image-Condition-Controlled Diffusion Network with Large-Scale CT Pretraining for CT-Free Attenuation Correction in Dynamic Cardiac PET
zh_title: 大规模CT预训练的扩散网络用于动态心脏PET无CT衰减校正
summary: LUCID利用CT-RATE的10000个胸部CT学习解剖先验，合成动态心脏82Rb PET的μ图，免去CT配对。

面向无CT衰减校正
