abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a leading cause of global morbidity and mortality despite major advances in pharmacological therapy, interventional cardiology, and lifestyle-based prevention. Although many current treatments reduce disease burden and improve outcomes, they often fail to address the underlying molecular and genetic mechanisms driving disease progression dot CRISPR hyphen-based gene- editing systems (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats) have introduced the possibility of directly correcting, silencing, or modulating pathogenic genetic determinants involved in cardiovascular pathology. When integrated with artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled design, prediction, and optimization tools, an AI-guided CRISPR framework may assist in prioritizing editing strategies, predicting editing outcomes, and informing delivery design, although cardiovascular-specific validation of these applications remains limited. This narrative review examines the potential role of AI-guided CRISPR technologies in cardiovascular disease. It first outlines the major pathophysiologic mechanisms underlying CVD, then reviews molecular and genetic targets that may be amenable to editing. Current CRISPR applications in cardiometabolic and cardiovascular disorders are discussed, followed by an evaluation of how AI may support guide RNA design, off-target prediction, vector engineering, and therapeutic prioritization. Finally, major translational barriers are examined, including tissue-specific delivery, editing in non-dividing cells, long-term genomic safety, disease complexity, and regulatory implementation. Although early preclinical findings are encouraging, most cardiovascular applications remain in the experimental or early translational stage, and direct evidence for integrated AI-guided CRISPR applications in cardiovascular disease remains limited and largely preclinical. Progress in this field will depend on advances in delivery science, genome engineering, computational modelling, and long-term safety validation. AI-guided CRISPR should therefore be regarded as a developing precision medicine strategy with substantial future potential rather than an immediately deployable clinical solution.
zh_abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] 尽管药物治疗、介入心脏病学和基于生活方式的预防取得了重大进展，心血管疾病（CVD）仍是全球发病和死亡的主要原因。虽然目前许多治疗可减轻疾病负担并改善结局，但往往无法针对驱动疾病进展的潜在分子和遗传机制。基于 CRISPR（成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列）的基因编辑系统使直接纠正、沉默或调控参与心血管病理的致病遗传决定因素成为可能。当与人工智能（AI）支持的设计、预测和优化工具相结合时，AI 引导的 CRISPR 框架可能有助于确定编辑策略的优先次序、预测编辑结果并为递送设计提供依据，不过这些应用在心血管领域的专门验证仍然有限。本叙述性综述探讨了 AI 引导的 CRISPR 技术在心血管疾病中的潜在作用。文章首先概述 CVD 的主要病理生理机制，然后回顾可能适合编辑的分子和遗传靶点。接着讨论 CRISPR 在心脏代谢及心血管疾病中的现有应用，并评估 AI 如何支持向导 RNA 设计、脱靶预测、载体工程和治疗优先级排序。最后，探讨主要的转化障碍，包括组织特异性递送、非分裂细胞中的编辑、长期基因组安全性、疾病复杂性以及监管实施。尽管早期临床前研究结果令人鼓舞，但大多数心血管应用仍处于实验或早期转化阶段，关于整合 AI 引导的 CRISPR 在心血管疾病中应用的直接证据仍然有限，且主要为临床前研究。该领域的进展将取决于递送科学、基因组工程、计算建模和长期安全性验证方面的进步。因此，AI 引导的 CRISPR 应被视为一种具有巨大未来潜力的、正在发展的精准医学策略，而非可立即部署的临床解决方案。

title: State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
zh_title: 用于跨域小样本分割的状态-消息交互适配器
summary: 在冻结DINOv3中插入SMIA适配器，利用各注意力头消息与token状态交互，用于向医学或工业域的小样本分割迁移。
key_points: 冻结预训练注意力与FFN参数
按每个patch状态调节头消息更新

reason: 通用方法预印本，医学为部分应用，摘要信息有限
abstract: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.
zh_abstract: 跨域少样本分割旨在利用少量带像素标注的支持集掩码，将在自然图像上预训练的编码器适配到医学或工业领域。在冻结的 DINOv3 中，中间层各注意力头的消息（per-head attention messages）已经携带了目标与背景之间的区分信息，而基线方法的最终层相似度和预测并不能一致地反映这些信息。我们提出状态-消息交互适配器（State-Message Interaction Adapter，SMIA），在保持预训练注意力和 FFN 参数冻结的前提下，学习各头的消息应如何更新每个接收 token 的表示。SMIA 插入在各头聚合之后，将每个头的聚合输出（消息）的变换条件化于每个图像块的注意力前特征（状态），使得相似的上下文消息可以根据接收位置的不同产生不同甚至相反的更新。由于稀缺的支持集掩码仅覆盖有限的状态-消息组合，我们采用共享的低秩双线性映射，将所学习的交互限制在低维的状态、消息和输出子空间内。这些更新被加入每个被适配模块的冻结 FFN 之前，得到的适配后特征再由冻结的 FFN 和更深的模块进一步精炼，用于线性读出。SMIA 仅有 0.51M 可训练参数，推理时单次前向且无需支持集；在 20 个医学和工业任务的六个数据集上，其 5-shot 和 10-shot 的平均 mIoU 分别达到 77.40% 和 80.99%，较此前最强方法分别高出 3.61 和 3.93 个百分点。在同一 DINOv3 骨干网络上、跨三个基准的受控 10-shot 比较中，SMIA 也优于参数量相当的 AdaptFormer、LoRA 和 ParaX，并具有更好的精确率-召回率平衡。

SHAP指出KTG、等电点、芳香性为关键特征
reason: 预印本，单库内评估，传统方法增量
abstract: Antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) classifiers are typically developed and evaluated within a single curated database, leaving open how much two independently curated databases agree and what that implies for apparent cross-database generalization. We trained an XGBoost classifier on amino acid trigram frequencies and physicochemical descriptors using the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD), the field's largest curated ARG resource. The model separated resistance genes from non-resistance proteins with near-ceiling accuracy (AUROC = 0.982, MCC = 0.886); a label-shuffling null baseline collapsed to chance (AUROC = 0.508) and bootstrap confidence intervals were narrow, confirming genuine signal rather than data leakage or overfitting. SHAP analysis attributed this performance to biologically interpretable features, notably the trigram KTG, isoelectric point, and aromaticity, each consistent with known catalytic motifs in resistance enzymes. Before testing the classifier against ResFinder, one of CARD's most widely used counterparts, we assessed database independence by clustering sequences with CD-HIT, finding that 96.8-98.7% of ResFinder sequences shared substantial protein identity with CARD even at a permissive 50% identity threshold, indicating the two databases largely represent the same sequence population, with direct implications for how cross-database generalization should be measured. On the small subset of ResFinder sequences genuinely non-redundant with CARD (40-100 sequences, depending on threshold), the classifier failed completely, never classifying any as resistance genes; SHAP traced this failure to sequence length, as non-redundant sequences are nearly three times longer than training proteins, and length is among the model's most influential features. The same pattern emerged by resistance mechanism: the model achieved perfect accuracy on beta-lactamases, compact single-domain enzymes well represented in training (100%, n = 351), but correctly identified only 38.5% of efflux pump components (n = 13), a mechanism built from large, multi-domain transporters rather than compact catalytic enzymes. Together, these results describe a capable, interpretable ARG classifier alongside a quantified methodological caution: cross-database redundancy must be measured rather than assumed, and when a sequence-composition classifier fails, the failure is often explained by protein architecture rather than database origin.
zh_abstract: 抗生素耐药基因（ARG）分类器通常在单一的人工整理数据库内开发和评估，因此两个独立整理的数据库之间一致程度如何，以及这对表观的跨数据库泛化意味着什么，仍悬而未决。我们使用该领域最大的人工整理ARG资源——综合抗生素耐药性数据库（CARD），基于氨基酸三联体频率和理化描述符训练了XGBoost分类器。该模型以接近上限的准确度区分耐药基因与非耐药蛋白（AUROC = 0.982，MCC = 0.886）；标签打乱的零模型基线降至随机水平（AUROC = 0.508），自助法（bootstrap）置信区间较窄，证实其反映的是真实信号，而非数据泄漏或过拟合。SHAP分析将这一性能归因于具有生物学可解释性的特征，尤其是三联体KTG、等电点和芳香性，均与耐药酶中已知的催化基序一致。在用ResFinder（CARD最广泛使用的同类数据库之一）检验该分类器之前，我们通过CD-HIT对序列聚类来评估数据库的独立性，发现即使在宽松的50%同一性阈值下，仍有96.8–98.7%的ResFinder序列与CARD具有显著的蛋白同一性，表明两个数据库在很大程度上代表相同的序列群体，这对于应如何衡量跨数据库泛化具有直接意义。在ResFinder中与CARD真正非冗余的少量序列子集上（取决于阈值，为40–100条序列），分类器完全失败，没有将任何序列判为耐药基因；SHAP将这一失败追溯到序列长度：非冗余序列的长度几乎是训练蛋白的三倍，而长度是模型最具影响力的特征之一。按耐药机制分析也出现了相同模式：模型对β-内酰胺酶（训练中代表性充分的紧凑单结构域酶）达到完美准确率（100%，n = 351），但对外排泵组分仅正确识别38.5%（n = 13），外排泵由大型多结构域转运蛋白而非紧凑的催化酶构成。总之，这些结果既呈现了一个能力良好且可解释的ARG分类器，也给出了量化的方法学警示：跨数据库冗余必须加以测量而非想当然，而当序列组成分类器失败时，其原因往往在于蛋白质结构架构，而非数据库来源。

abstract: VReceptor is a virtual receptor simulation framework that generates realistic, sequence-dependent binding data for peptide-based therapeutics. It combines pharmacophore-inspired weighting schemes with amino acid similarity metrics to evaluate peptide design strategies in a controlled environment. Validation using the Prolactin-Releasing Peptide (PrRP) dataset confirms VReceptor's ability to approximate binding behaviours and optimize experimental planning. This framework empowers researchers in computational peptide design and active learning workflows while highlighting areas for further refinement.

title: Automated segmentation of renal structures using brightfield images of unstained kidney biopsies

abstract: The automated segmentation of unstained kidney brightfield microscopy images remains a significant challenge in medical imaging. In conventional histopathology, staining provides crucial structural and molecular contrast, allowing renal compartments and structures to be readily distinguished. The absence of staining markedly reduces this contrast, obscuring the fine architectural details that are essential for diagnosis. Addressing this gap would reduce reliance on staining protocols, reduce technical and interpretive variability, and preserve valuable tissue for downstream molecular or multi-omics analyses. Ultimately, automation of unstained image segmentation could enable faster, more objective tissue analysis while preserving samples for further molecular testing. In this work, we provide a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art segmentation methods applied to renal brightfield microscopy images. Current findings highlight a predominance of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architectures for semantic segmentation approaches while recent trends point to the growing application of transformer-based and instance-segmentation strategies. However, the field is still hampered by the scarcity and poor annotation of publicly available renal datasets. Aiming to further contribute to the enhancement of the field, a dataset of 18 Whole Slide Images (WSIs) of unstained human kidney tissue is made publicly available. Additionally, in the dataset, we provide 543 annotated tiles extracted from the WSIs, facilitating further research into stain-independent segmentation approaches. As a third contribution, we present a preliminary case study, evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning segmentation architectures, including U-Net and Segment Anything Model (SAM). Our preliminary results indicate that deep learning models demonstrate promising segmentation performance in unstained kidney biopsies. In alignment with these findings, advanced customised loss functions and data augmentation were integrated into the supervised training of the promising U-Net, DeepLabv3+, and TransUNet models, achieving significant improvements compared to the baseline experiments. To exploit the abundance of unlabelled data, we further tested FixMatchSeg, a semi-supervised learning method; however, its segmentation performance remained slightly behind the supervised methods. Taken together, these contributions establish a foundation for future research in stain-independent Computationa
zh_abstract: 未染色肾脏明场显微镜图像的自动分割仍是医学影像领域的一项重大挑战。在传统组织病理学中，染色提供了关键的结构和分子对比，使肾脏的各个区室和结构易于区分。缺乏染色会显著降低这种对比度，掩盖对诊断至关重要的精细结构细节。解决这一空白将减少对染色流程的依赖，降低技术和判读变异，并为下游分子或多组学分析保留宝贵的组织。最终，未染色图像分割的自动化可实现更快速、更客观的组织分析，同时为进一步分子检测保留样本。在本工作中，我们对应用于肾脏明场显微镜图像的最新分割方法进行了全面综述。目前的发现表明，语义分割方法以基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的架构为主，而近期趋势显示基于Transformer和实例分割的策略应用日益增多。然而，该领域仍受限于公开可用肾脏数据集的稀缺和标注不佳。为进一步推动该领域的发展，我们公开了一个包含18张未染色人类肾组织全切片图像（WSI）的数据集。此外，数据集中还提供了从WSI中提取的543个已标注图块，以促进对不依赖染色的分割方法的进一步研究。作为第三项贡献，我们呈现了一项初步案例研究，评估了包括U-Net和Segment Anything Model（SAM）在内的最新深度学习分割架构。我们的初步结果表明，深度学习模型在未染色肾活检中显示出有前景的分割性能。与此发现一致，我们将先进的定制损失函数和数据增强整合进有前景的U-Net、DeepLabv3+和TransUNet模型的监督训练中，与基线实验相比取得了显著改善。为利用大量未标注数据，我们进一步测试了半监督学习方法FixMatchSeg；然而，其分割性能仍略低于监督方法。综上，这些贡献为不依赖染色的计算病理学的未来研究奠定了基础（原文在此处截断）

title: Recording sampling rate as a negative-control exposure for detecting measurement-driven bias in heart-rate-variability-outcome associations: a quantitative bias analysis across ICU waveform databases
zh_title: 以记录采样率作阴性对照暴露检测HRV与结局关联中的测量偏倚

abstract: Importance. Heart-rate variability (HRV) is studied extensively as a prognostic marker in critical illness, yet the electrocardiographic sampling rate at which HRV is computed systematically distorts the resulting values. Whether the associations between HRV and clinical outcomes reported in the literature are partly a consequence of this distortion has not been examined directly. Objective. To evaluate whether between-database differences in native ECG sampling rate can be used as a negative-control exposure to detect measurement-driven bias in HRV-outcome associations, and to quantify the sensitivity of a published association to an empirically measured distortion coefficient using quantitative bias analysis (QBA). Design. A methods investigation in three parts. Part I sets out the causal structure and states why a strict instrumental-variable (IV) design is inappropriate here. Part II derives a bias-correction factor under a multiplicative measurement-error model and propagates the empirical confidence interval of the distortion coefficient as a sensitivity band. Part III applies the procedure to an observed HRV-mortality association from a single ICU waveform database, and examines the separate bias arising from threshold-based categorisation. Two critical-care waveform databases with different native sampling rates (MIMIC-IV Waveform, approximately 250 Hz; MIMIC-III Waveform Matched p04, 125 Hz) and an independent 500-Hz reference cohort (PTB-XL) for mechanism validation. The outcome association was estimated in 1,445 ICU stays from MIMIC-III p04, of whom 141 died in hospital (9.8%). Exposures. Native ECG sampling rate as a negative-control exposure; SDNN, RMSSD and heart rate as the measured exposures whose associations with mortality are evaluated. Main outcomes and measures. In-hospital mortality. Distortion coefficients were obtained by end-to-end reprocessing of 7,293 original waveform segments with a fixed QRS detector. Corrected odds ratios were reported as QBA sensitivity bands rather than point-identified effects. Misclassification was quantified as the proportion of recordings below a 20 ms HRV threshold reclassified above it by coarse sampling. Results. zh_abstract:
【重要性】心率变异性（HRV）作为危重症预后标志物已被广泛研究，然而计算HRV所用的心电图采样率会系统性地扭曲所得数值。文献中报告的HRV与临床结局之间的关联是否部分源于这种扭曲，尚未得到直接检验。
【目的】评估不同数据库间原始心电图采样率的差异能否作为阴性对照暴露，用于检测HRV–结局关联中由测量所致的偏倚，并使用定量偏倚分析（QBA）量化已发表关联对经验测得的扭曲系数的敏感性。
【设计】一项分为三部分的方法学研究。第一部分阐明因果结构，并说明为何此处不适合采用严格的工具变量（IV）设计。第二部分在乘性测量误差模型下推导偏倚校正因子，并将扭曲系数的经验置信区间作为敏感性区间进行传递。第三部分将该程序应用于单一ICU波形数据库中观察到的HRV–死亡率关联，并考察基于阈值分类所产生的独立偏倚。
【背景与数据来源】两个原始采样率不同的重症监护波形数据库（MIMIC-IV Waveform，约250 Hz；MIMIC-III Waveform Matched p04，125 Hz），以及用于机制验证的独立500 Hz参考队列（PTB-XL）。结局关联在 MIMIC-III p04 的1,445例ICU住院中估计，其中141例在院内死亡（9.8%）。
【暴露】原始心电图采样率作为阴性对照暴露；SDNN、RMSSD 和心率作为被测暴露，评估其与死亡率的关联。
【主要结局与指标】院内死亡率。扭曲系数通过使用固定QRS检测器对7,293个原始波形片段进行端到端重新处理而获得。校正后的比值比以QBA敏感性区间而非点识别效应的形式报告。错误分类以HRV低于20 ms阈值的记录因粗采样而被重新分类至阈值以上的比例来量化。
【结果】端到端重新处理得出的RMSSD扭曲系数：250→62.5 Hz 为1.1575（95% CI 1.0835–1.2492；188例患者的2,276个片段），125→62.5 Hz 为1.0588（95% CI 1.0294–1.1033；4,988个片段）；高频功率比低频受到的影响更大（原文此处截断）

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Missense Variant Pathogenicity Prediction in the KCNQ Gene Family
zh_title: 量子机器学习预测KCNQ基因家族错义变异致病性
summary: 预印本称首次将量子机器学习用于错义变异致病性预测，混合量子框架在KCNQ家族上AUC-ROC约0.94，与经典方法相当或更优。
key_points: 混合重上传量子神经网络与量子SVM
覆盖KCNQ全基因家族
AUC-ROC约0.94，对比经典方法
reason: 预印本，新颖但证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Missense variants in the KCNQ family of voltage-gated potassium channel genes are associated with a broad spectrum of neurological and cardiac disorders for which computational tools capable of differentiating benign and pathogenic variants are essential. Here, we present, to our knowledge, the first application of quantum machine learning (QML) to missense pathogenicity prediction. We employ a hybrid quantum framework combining data re-uploading quantum neural networks with quantum support vector machines and applied it to pathogenicity classification across the full KCNQ gene family. Systematic exploration of circuit architectures revealed that optimal hyperparameter choices enable the proposed quantum model to achieve predictive performance superior to or comparable to state-of-the-art classical machine learning approaches, reaching AUC-ROC values of approximately 0.94 across the full dataset. Although no clear quantum advantage is observed at present, these results demonstrate that quantum feature representations can effectively capture biologically relevant patterns in variant data and establish QML as a viable framework for future applications in computational genomics and precision medicine.
zh_abstract: KCNQ家族电压门控钾通道基因的错义变异与多种神经系统和心脏疾病相关，因此需要能够区分良性与致病性变异的计算工具。据我们所知，本文首次将量子机器学习（QML）应用于错义变异致病性预测。我们采用一种混合量子框架，将数据重上传量子神经网络与量子支持向量机相结合，并将其应用于整个KCNQ基因家族的致病性分类。对电路架构的系统探索表明，选择最优超参数可使所提出的量子模型取得优于或可比于最先进经典机器学习方法的预测性能，在整个数据集上AUC-ROC值约为0.94。尽管目前尚未观察到明确的量子优势，但这些结果表明量子特征表示能够有效捕捉变异数据中与生物学相关的模式，并确立了QML作为未来计算基因组学和精准医学应用的可行框架。

title: Exploring Artificial Intelligence Models for the Detection and Prediction of Sarcopenia: A Scoping Review.
zh_title: 肌少症AI检测与预测模型的范围综述
summary: 该范围综述系统梳理用于检测或预测肌少症的AI/ML模型，描述其方法、输入特征、性能、验证策略及报告规范遵循情况。
key_points: 聚焦肌少症AI/ML模型
梳理输入特征与验证策略
评估报告规范遵循情况
reason: 范围综述，上限6档，泛化主题，增量价值有限
abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Sarcopenia is a progressive skeletal muscle disorder associated with adverse health outcomes, including disability, hospitalization, and mortality. Despite the availability of consensus-based diagnostic criteria, its identification in clinical practice remains limited due to reliance on specialized assessments and resource-intensive measurements. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) approaches have emerged as promising tools to enhance sarcopenia detection; however, evidence remains methodologically heterogeneous and has not been comprehensively synthesized. The objective was to systematically map the existing literature on AI/ML models developed to detect or predict sarcopenia, describing their methodological characteristics, input features, model performance, validation strategies, and adherence to reporting standards. Methods: A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Searches were performed in five databases (MEDLINE, Scopus, SciELO, Web of Science, and LILACS) from inception to 28 February 2026. Studies were included if they developed and/or validated AI/ML models for binary classification of sarcopenia using recognized consensus definitions. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed adherence to TRIPOD+AI reporting recommendations and appraised methodological quality using the NHLBI Quality Assessment Tool. Findings were synthesized descriptively. The review protocol was registered in the Open Science Framework. Results: Of 2910 records, 28 studies (n = 34,498 participants in the primary analytical cohorts, with an additional 2800 participants in independent external validation cohorts) were included, predominantly from Asia (China n = 14, South Korea n = 7). Random Forest was the most frequent algorithm (n = 6), followed by voting classifiers, MLP, and XGBoost (n = 4 each). Clinical tabular data, including anthropometric and laboratory variables, were the most common input features. Model performance was generally high, with AUC values ranging from 0.710 to 0.975 (mean ≈ 0.869), although heterogeneity across populations and validation strategies was substantial. External validation was performed in only 7 of the 28 studies (25%). No study fully adhered to TRIPOD+AI recommendations; mean compliance was moderate, with critical gaps in code sharing, patient/public involvement, external validation, and subgroup performance reporting. Conclusions: AI/ML models
zh_abstract:
【背景/目的】肌少症是一种进行性骨骼肌疾病，与残疾、住院和死亡等不良健康结局相关。尽管已有基于共识的诊断标准，但由于依赖专业评估和资源密集型测量，其在临床实践中的识别仍然有限。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）方法已成为增强肌少症检测的有前景的工具；然而，相关证据在方法学上存在异质性，且尚未得到全面综合。本研究旨在系统梳理现有关于用于检测或预测肌少症的AI/ML模型的文献，描述其方法学特征、输入特征、模型性能、验证策略以及对报告规范的遵循情况。
【方法】按照PRISMA-ScR指南开展范围综述。检索了五个数据库（MEDLINE、Scopus、SciELO、Web of Science和LILACS），检索时间从建库至2026年2月28日。纳入使用公认共识定义、开发和/或验证用于肌少症二分类的AI/ML模型的研究。两名评审员独立筛选研究、提取数据，评估其对TRIPOD+AI报告建议的遵循情况，并使用NHLBI质量评估工具评价方法学质量。研究结果采用描述性方式综合。综述方案已在Open Science Framework注册。
【结果】在2910条记录中，共纳入28项研究（主要分析队列n = 34,498名参与者，另有2800名参与者来自独立外部验证队列），主要来自亚洲（中国n = 14，韩国n = 7）。随机森林是最常用的算法（n = 6），其次是投票分类器、MLP和XGBoost（各n = 4）。包括人体测量和实验室变量在内的临床表格数据是最常见的输入特征。模型性能总体较高，AUC值范围为0.710至0.975（均值约0.869），但不同人群和验证策略之间的异质性较大。28项研究中仅7项（25%）进行了外部验证。没有研究完全遵循TRIPOD+AI建议；平均依从程度为中等，在代码共享、患者/公众参与、外部验证和亚组性能报告方面存在关键缺失。
【结论】AI/ML模型

title: Artificial Intelligence in Cardiomyopathies: From Opportunistic Detection to Decision-Critical Risk Stratification.

abstract: [Heart failure clinics] This article examines the evolving role of artificial intelligence (AI) across the continuum of care in cardiomyopathies, from opportunistic screening to decision-critical risk stratification. AI-enhanced electrocardiography enables scalable early detection, while advanced echocardiographic and cardiac magnetic resonance-based radiomics refine myocardial substrate characterization. Multimodal models integrating imaging, electrical, and clinical data refine risk stratification beyond conventional metrics such as left ventricular ejection fraction. However, clinical translation requires external validation, calibration stability, interpretability, and structured workflow integration. AI emerges not as autonomous diagnosis, but as accountable, clinician-supervised decision support embedded within multidisciplinary cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: [心力衰竭门诊] 本文探讨人工智能（AI）在心肌病全程诊疗中不断演变的作用，涵盖从机会性筛查到决策关键的风险分层。AI增强的心电图可实现可扩展的早期检测，而先进的超声心动图及基于心脏磁共振的影像组学可进一步刻画心肌基质特征。整合影像、电学及临床数据的多模态模型，可在左心室射血分数等传统指标之外进一步优化风险分层。然而，临床转化需要外部验证、校准稳定性、可解释性以及结构化的工作流程整合。AI并非作为自主诊断工具出现，而是作为可问责的、由临床医生监督的决策支持，嵌入多学科心血管诊疗之中。

title: The Formal-Functional Gap: How Artificial Intelligence Reshapes Medical Professional Identity.
source: PubMed · Advances in medical education and practice
zh_title: 形式—功能鸿沟：AI如何重塑医生职业身份
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI对医学职业身份形成的影响，并提出医学教育中的分析框架。
key_points: 综合概念、实证与理论文献

abstract: [Advances in medical education and practice] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical practice and medical education, yet research on AI and medical professional identity has largely evolved in parallel. To examine how AI is transforming fundamental components of medical professional identity and propose a framework for understanding its implications for professional identity formation in medical education. This narrative review synthesizes conceptual, empirical, and theoretical literature on AI, professional identity formation, and clinical practice through iterative literature searching and citation tracking. Peer-reviewed studies, regulatory data, and national survey reports were considered. AI affects professional identity unevenly. Diagnostic, predictive, generative, and emerging autonomous systems most directly influence expertise, clinical reasoning, and professional autonomy, shifting physicians from exclusive holders of specialized knowledge toward validators of increasingly accessible but variably trusted information. Evidence of automation bias and reduced diagnostic performance highlights this transition. We conceptualize the divergence between the formal locus of clinical responsibility, which remains with physicians, and the functional locus of influence decisions, shared with AI, as the formal-functional gap (FFG). Its magnitude varies by AI configuration, identity component, and career stage, potentially placing trainees at risk of never-skilling and experienced physicians at risk of deskilling. Ethical responsibility, humanistic care, lifelong learning, and professional authority are affected more indirectly. AI-mediated professional identity change reflects a dynamic interaction between physicians' developmental trajectories and evolving AI capabilities. Medical education should prioritize sustained expertise, clinical reasoning, professional autonomy, AI-interpretive judgment, and human oversight. The FFG remains a conceptual framework whose relationships require empirical validation.
zh_abstract:
【背景】[医学教育与实践进展] 人工智能（AI）日益融入临床实践和医学教育，但有关AI与医学职业身份的研究在很大程度上是各自平行发展的。
【目的】探讨AI如何改变医学职业身份的基本组成部分，并提出一个框架，用于理解其对医学教育中职业身份形成的影响。
【方法】本叙述性综述通过迭代式文献检索和引文追踪，综合了关于AI、职业身份形成和临床实践的概念性、实证性和理论性文献。纳入了同行评审研究、监管数据和全国性调查报告。
【结果】AI对职业身份的影响并不均衡。诊断型、预测型、生成型以及新兴的自主系统最直接地影响专业知识、临床推理和职业自主性，使医生从专业知识的唯一持有者转变为对日益易得但可信度不一的信息进行验证的人。自动化偏倚和诊断表现下降的证据凸显了这一转变。我们将临床责任的正式归属（仍由医生承担）与决策影响的功能性归属（与AI共享）之间的分歧概念化为“正式-功能差距”（formal-functional gap，FFG）。其大小因AI配置、身份组成部分和职业阶段而异，可能使受训者面临“从未获得技能”（never-skilling）的风险，使经验丰富的医生面临技能退化（deskilling）的风险。伦理责任、人文关怀、终身学习和职业权威受到的影响则较为间接。AI介导的职业身份变化反映了医生发展轨迹与不断演进的AI能力之间的动态相互作用。
【结论】医学教育应优先重视持续的专业知识、临床推理、职业自主性、对AI的解读判断能力以及人的监督。FFG仍是一个概念框架，其相互关系有待实证验证。

title: Anticipating or Speculating? Making Futures Pay in AI Ethics
zh_title: 预见还是臆测：AI伦理中的未来想象
summary: 论证医生与医疗AI意见分歧的统一决策规则存在缺陷，因其依赖具体情境，并区分预见与臆测。

区分有益预见与无益臆测
reason: 伦理观点文章，属增量档
abstract: Philosophers have recently been trying to develop uniform decision rules for instances in which physicians' judgments diverge from the recommendations of medical artificial intelligence (AI) systems. I argue that this effort is fatally flawed because the performance and appropriate use of algorithmic recommendation systems by physicians are highly context-specific, empirical medical matters rather than epistemological ones. In such instances, general decision rules can be stipulated only to the extent that they abstract away from relevant, indeed determinative, contextual circumstances. The alleged problem of physician-AI disagreement, and others like it, play into longstanding disputes in technology ethics about the viability and utility of envisioning possible futures: is this useful "anticipation" or wasteful "speculation"? I suggest that the two may be distinguished. Anticipation explores plausible futures to help inform present actions under irreducible uncertainty. Speculation abstracts away uncertainty, developing formal solutions to stipulated circumstances whose relationship to the real present is often quite unclear. Efforts to develop crisp philosophical solutions to physician-AI disagreement, among other problems, fall into the latter category. Technology ethics should remember that fruitful futures thinking must both begin from and return to the messy, uncertain present.

title: Fiberpose: state-of-the-art fiber morphometry and instance segmentation with a distance-transform neural network
zh_title: Fiberpose：基于距离变换网络的纤维形态测量与实例分割
summary: 将SEM图像中的纤维分析转化为平滑距离变换场回归，并配套实例重建及直径、取向测量算法，提供桌面应用与网页工具。
key_points: 针对弱边界、密集纤维图像

reason: 偏生物医学工程材料图像，医疗关联弱、预印本
abstract: Analysis of fibrous structures in SEM images is a routine task in biomedical engineering and materials science. However, most available methods for fiber quantification still rely on classical image binarization followed by simple post-processing. These approaches often produce unreliable results in images with weak boundaries, heterogeneous contrast, and densely packed fibers. Here, we introduce Fiberpose, a framework that reformulates fiber analysis as direct regression of a smooth distance-transform (DT) field, together with a novel set of geometry-based algorithms specifically adapted to this representation. The predicted field directly encodes fiber geometry, while the accompanying algorithms enable instance reconstruction and measurement of diameter and orientation within a unified workflow. The framework is implemented as a standalone Python desktop application and a web tool https://fiberpose.org. On an independent dataset of fibrous SEM images, Fiberpose achieved state-of-the-art instance-segmentation accuracy in comparison with SAM2 and Cellpose-SAM, and more accurate diameter measurements than DiameterJ, Fibar and GIFT. The method remains effective in dense and weakly contrasted regions and shows qualitative generalization across microscopy modalities not represented in the training data. Fiberpose therefore provides an interpretable geometric representation and an automated pipeline for reproducible quantitative characterization of fibrous materials.
zh_abstract: 扫描电镜（SEM）图像中纤维结构的分析是生物医学工程和材料科学中的常规任务。然而，现有大多数纤维定量方法仍依赖经典的图像二值化加简单后处理。在边界较弱、对比度不均匀以及纤维密集堆积的图像中，这些方法往往产生不可靠的结果。在此，我们提出 Fiberpose，该框架将纤维分析重新表述为对平滑距离变换（DT）场的直接回归，并配套一套专门针对该表示形式设计的、基于几何的新算法。预测得到的场直接编码了纤维几何信息，而配套算法则可在统一的工作流程中完成实例重建以及直径和取向的测量。该框架以独立的 Python 桌面应用程序和网页工具 https://fiberpose.org 的形式实现。在一个独立的纤维状 SEM 图像数据集上，与 SAM2 和 Cellpose-SAM 相比，Fiberpose 达到了最先进的实例分割精度；与 DiameterJ、Fibar 和 GIFT 相比，其直径测量更为准确。该方法在密集及低对比度区域依然有效，并在训练数据未涵盖的多种显微成像模态上表现出定性的泛化能力。因此，Fiberpose 为纤维材料的可重复定量表征提供了可解释的几何表示和自动化流程。

title: Rethinking the public health research ecosystem in the era of artificial intelligence: from evidence generation to population impact.
zh_title: AI时代重新思考公共卫生研究生态：从证据到人群影响
summary: 文章提出AI赋能的公共卫生研究生态，并引入“证据到行动延迟”概念，指出瓶颈转向验证、治理与实施。
key_points: 覆盖证据综合到政策的全链条
提出证据到行动延迟指标
资源匮乏场景能力最欠缺
reason: 观点类文章，概念性框架，无实证数据
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Public health is constrained less by the generation of evidence than by the time to act on it; artificial intelligence should be judged by whether it shortens that gap. AI has largely been evaluated within disciplinary silos, obscuring how choices at one stage of the research process shape the next. In this article, we propose an AI-enabled public health research ecosystem spanning evidence synthesis, knowledge extraction, prediction, adaptive implementation, health system operations and policy, and introduce evidence-to-action latency: the interval between recognising a problem and implementing an evidence-informed response. AI does not remove the bottlenecks; it relocates them from generating evidence towards validation, governance, implementation and workforce capability. These capabilities are least available in low-resource and community-based services, where need is greatest. Because inequity in source data propagates through every subsequent stage, the aim is equity-preserving latency, not speed alone. The AI-READY Framework sets out the conditions for responsible integration. The greatest gains will come from redesigning research systems rather than optimising individual methods.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 公共卫生的制约因素不在于证据的产生，而在于将证据付诸行动所需的时间；评判人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）的标准应是其能否缩短这一差距。AI 在很大程度上是在各学科壁垒内被评估的，这掩盖了研究过程中某一阶段的选择如何影响下一阶段。本文提出一个涵盖证据综合、知识提取、预测、适应性实施、卫生系统运行与政策的 AI 赋能公共卫生研究生态系统，并引入“证据到行动延迟”（evidence-to-action latency）这一概念：即从认识到问题到实施以证据为依据的应对措施之间的时间间隔。AI 并不会消除瓶颈，而是将瓶颈从证据生成转移到验证、治理、实施和劳动力能力方面。这些能力在资源匮乏和社区为基础的服务中最为缺乏，而这些地方的需求恰恰最大。由于源数据中的不公平会传递到后续每一个阶段，因此目标应是保持公平的延迟缩短，而不仅仅是速度。AI-READY 框架（AI-READY Framework）提出了负责任整合的条件。最大的收益将来自对研究系统的重新设计，而非对单个方法的优化。

abstract: Background: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have demonstrated strong potential to transform healthcare research and practice. However, LLMs are probabilistic and generate inherently variable outputs, which create risk and uncertainty in healthcare applications. Therefore, analyzing the current research landscape of ChatGPT applications is imperative to understand applied techniques and related concerns and to facilitate their practical integration into healthcare information systems. Objective: Leveraging LLM-based agentic AI with domain experts to analyze trends in ChatGPT healthcare applications and to examine the collaborative and interpretative capacities of LLM agents in broader contexts beyond narrowly defined topics. Methods: The review used a systematic search of the PubMed and Web of Science databases, following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, and focused on ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors. To support the review process, an adaptive, iterative LLM-based agentic AI with a human-in-the-loop mechanism was employed for automated metadata extraction, identification, classification, and knowledge synthesis. The extracted information was subsequently used for temporal and thematic analyses, citation network construction, and main-path analysis. Results: Across 192 papers, the review identified 511 ChatGPT application types, 690 concern items, and 368 influence usage factors distinct from traditional IT, achieving a metadata error rate of 1.04%. The human-agentic AI workflow enabled efficient synthesis of contextual information across studies, addressing the growing challenge of timely evidence integration in medical knowledge. The findings provide insights into the evolving trajectories of ChatGPT applications in healthcare and demonstrate the value of an expert-validated human-agentic AI workflow in supporting literature analysis and streamlining review processes. Conclusion: This review provides a comprehensive overview of emerging ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors in healthcare. The study further provides meaningful insights into the operational mechanisms of agentic AI, demonstrating the potential of human-AI collaboration for medical informatics research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】随着人工智能（AI）的快速发展，ChatGPT等大语言模型（LLM）已显示出变革医疗研究与实践的强大潜力。然而，LLM具有概率性，其输出本质上存在变异，这给医疗应用带来风险和不确定性。因此，分析ChatGPT应用的当前研究格局，对于了解所应用的技术和相关问题，并促进其在医疗信息系统中的实际整合至关重要。【目的】借助基于LLM的智能体AI（agentic AI）与领域专家合作，分析ChatGPT医疗应用的趋势，并考察LLM智能体在超出狭义主题的更广泛情境下的协作和解释能力。【方法】本综述按照PRISMA-ScR指南，对PubMed和Web of Science数据库进行系统检索，聚焦于ChatGPT应用、相关问题、所用技术及使用因素。为支持综述过程，采用了带有人在回路机制的自适应、迭代式LLM智能体AI，用于自动元数据提取、识别、分类和知识综合。所提取的信息随后用于时间和主题分析、引文网络构建以及主路径分析。【结果】在192篇论文中，本综述识别出511种ChatGPT应用类型、690项问题条目和368项有别于传统信息技术的影响使用因素，元数据错误率为1.04%。人-智能体AI工作流程能够高效综合各研究的情境信息，应对医学知识中及时整合证据这一日益严峻的挑战。研究结果为ChatGPT在医疗领域应用的演变轨迹提供了见解，并证明了经专家验证的人-智能体AI工作流程在支持文献分析和简化综述流程方面的价值。【结论】本综述全面概述了医疗领域中新兴的ChatGPT应用、相关问题、所用技术和使用因素。本研究还为智能体AI的运作机制提供了有意义的见解，展示了人机协作在医学信息学研究中的潜力。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly shaping patient assessment, communication, and clinical decision-making in plastic surgery. Its potential benefits are accompanied by risks of plausible but inaccurate outputs, demographic and esthetic bias, compromised image privacy, and weakened human oversight. These risks become more consequential as systems move from providing information to recommending and executing clinical actions. This review examines the implications for patient safety, informed consent, equity, and professional accountability and outlines safeguards that scale with clinical risk and autonomy, emphasizing validation, continuous monitoring, and preservation of independent surgical judgment.

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed education, including plastic surgical training through adaptive learning platforms, automated competency assessment and intraoperative performance analytics. These platforms support competency-based medical education by enabling continuous objective evaluation, personalized feedback, trajectory predictions, and scalable simulation environments. Emerging applications include virtual patients, plastic surgery-specific adaptive question banks, surgical video analysis, and augmented-reality operative guidance. Despite promising gains in efficiency and educational precision, implementation will require careful validation, transparency, and sustained expert oversight. Strategic AI integration into training programs offers the potential to enhance technical skill acquisition, standardize evaluation and expand access to high-quality surgical education globally.
zh_abstract: [整形外科临床]人工智能（AI）已迅速改变了教育领域，包括通过自适应学习平台、自动化能力评估和术中表现分析来改变整形外科培训。这些平台通过实现持续客观评价、个性化反馈、轨迹预测以及可扩展的模拟环境，支持基于胜任力的医学教育。新兴应用包括虚拟患者、整形外科专用的自适应题库、手术视频分析以及增强现实手术导航。尽管在效率和教育精准度方面前景可期，但其实施仍需要审慎的验证、透明度和持续的专家监督。将AI战略性地整合进培训项目，有望提升技术技能的获得、使评价标准化，并在全球范围内扩大高质量外科教育的可及性。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] This article surveys artificial intelligence (AI) applications across aesthetic plastic surgery, spanning large language models (publicly available software, practice chatbots, and clinical decision support tools), simulation technologies (3 dimensional imaging platforms like Vectra and Crisalix, generative adversarial network-based and diffusion-based image generation), surgical planning, and operational tools for documentation, billing, scheduling, and marketing. It highlights validation evidence where available, alongside persistent limitations including training data bias, hallucinations, black-box opacity, and unresolved regulatory and liability questions. Despite AI's expanding capabilities, individualized surgical judgment remains irreplaceable, positioning AI as a decision-support tool that enhances, rather than substitutes, the surgeon-patient relationship.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Leadership in Academic Plastic Surgery.
zh_title: 人工智能与学术性整形外科领导力
summary: 文章讨论AI在整形外科学术领导工作中的应用场景、局限（判断、问责）及迭代式治理思路。
key_points: 涵盖战略、招聘、会议决策、科研产出与监管治理
指出AI在判断、问责和情境理解上不可靠

reason: 观点类文章，与临床AI方法关系弱
abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) offers surgical leaders a means of augmenting-not replacing-the craft of leadership. This article outlines practical applications across strategic vision, such as innovation and problem-solving, recruitment and faculty development, meetings and decision-making, project execution, academic productivity, and regulatory governance, while delineating where AI reliably fails: judgment, accountability, and contextual nuance. It introduces the throughput asymmetry that arises when AI-accelerated leaders outpace an unequipped implementing organization, and addresses the heterogeneous AI exposure spanning AI-native trainees and appropriately skeptical senior faculty. Governance should be constructed as an iterative loop rather than a static policy.
zh_abstract: [整形外科临床（Clinics in plastic surgery）] 人工智能（AI）为外科领导者提供了增强——而非取代——领导艺术的手段。本文概述了其在战略愿景（如创新与问题解决）、招聘与师资发展、会议与决策、项目执行、学术产出以及监管治理等方面的实际应用，同时指出了 AI 可靠地失效之处：判断、问责和情境细微差别。文章介绍了当由 AI 加速的领导者超越了未配备相应能力的执行组织时出现的吞吐量不对称，并探讨了从 AI 原生的受训者到持适度怀疑态度的资深教员之间 AI 接触程度的异质性。治理应被构建为一个迭代循环，而非静态政策。

title: Deep learning retinal vascular biomarker predicts preeclampsia in a multicenter prospective cohort
zh_title: 视网膜血管深度学习生物标志物预测子痫前期：多中心前瞻队列
summary: Retina-PE 多模态模型整合眼底照片、孕妇临床因素与平均动脉压，基于8616名孕妇的前瞻性多中心数据预测子痫前期，并做了外部验证。
key_points: 基于8616名孕妇的前瞻性多中心数据，回顾性建模
外部验证 AUC 约0.73–0.82，低于开发集
增益因任务而异，患者层面事件数较少
reason: 前瞻性多中心大样本并有外部验证，属重要档；眼科影像加分，但外部性能下降
abstract: Preeclampsia (PE) causes maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, yet noninvasive screening remains limited. We developed Retina-PE, a multimodal deep learning model integrating retinal photographs, maternal clinical factors, and mean arterial pressure to predict subsequent PE. Prospectively collected multicenter data from 8616 pregnant individuals were used for retrospective model development and evaluation. Development-dataset image-level areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) were 0.853 and 0.708 for PE occurrence at 24–28 and 28–32 weeks, 0.871 and 0.791 for 1- and 4-week preterm PE, and 0.979 and 0.862 for 1- and 4-week early-onset PE. Corresponding external-validation-dataset AUCs were 0.728 and 0.815, 0.801 and 0.801, and 0.776 and 0.766. Incremental performance was task-specific. Patient-level analyses showed similar patterns but included few events in some tasks. These findings support prospective evaluation of retinal imaging for maternal risk stratification.
zh_abstract: 子痫前期（preeclampsia，PE）可导致孕产妇及围产期的发病和死亡，但无创筛查手段仍然有限。我们开发了 Retina-PE，这是一种多模态深度学习模型，整合视网膜照片、孕妇临床因素和平均动脉压，用于预测随后发生的 PE。研究使用前瞻性收集的、来自多中心的 8616 名孕妇数据，进行回顾性模型开发和评估。在开发数据集中，图像水平的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为：预测 24–28 周和 28–32 周发生 PE 分别为 0.853 和 0.708；预测 1 周和 4 周早产型 PE 分别为 0.871 和 0.791；预测 1 周和 4 周早发型 PE 分别为 0.979 和 0.862。外部验证数据集中的相应 AUC 分别为 0.728 和 0.815、0.801 和 0.801，以及 0.776 和 0.766。增量性能因任务而异。患者水平分析显示出相似的模式，但部分任务中的事件数较少。这些发现支持对视网膜成像用于孕产妇风险分层开展前瞻性评估。

title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
zh_title: OpenScientist：面向临床与生物医学发现的开源智能体AI协作科学家
summary: Nature Medicine 发表开源智能体 OpenScientist，可依据科学家提出的问题生成有数据依据、可验证的分析，并经领域专家在五个生物医学案例中评估。
key_points: 五个案例由领域专家评估，分析数分钟完成
生成血浆蛋白组生存模型，在隐藏评估队列中预测生存
多发性骨髓瘤假设在外部队列中得到验证
reason: 同行评审、开源，含隐藏队列与外部队列验证；契合科学发现智能体偏好，但仅五个案例
abstract: Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.
zh_abstract: 生物医学研究受限于分析日益庞大和复杂的数据集所需的时间和领域专业知识。在此，我们介绍 OpenScientist，这是一种开源的智能体（agentic）AI 协同科学家，旨在通过研究科学家定义的问题并生成可验证、以数据为依据的分析来弥补这一差距。领域专家在五个生物医学案例研究中对 OpenScientist 进行了评估，其在数分钟内完成了原本需要人类耗费数月时间和专业知识才能完成的分析。它准确量化了阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物的表现；生成了一个血浆蛋白质组生存模型，该模型在隐藏评估队列中可预测生存；提出了一种可重复的、将 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变相联系的机制；生成了多发性骨髓瘤假设，这些假设在外部队列中得到验证，而在随机对照中信号减弱；并且在一项盲法、预先设定的蛋白质组比较中，与独立的人工分析结果表现出一致性。这些结果支持将 OpenScientist 用于与人类专家协同辅助生物医学数据分析。为支持涉及敏感临床数据集的研究，OpenScientist 可在完全物理隔离（air-gapped）的环境中运行，并使用开源模型进行推理。OpenScientist 表明，开放、可审计的智能体 AI 能够通过检索文献、生成假设、执行分析以及从复杂数据集中产生见解，来支持真实世界的临床研究。

title: STBI: dataset of over 12000 brain CT scans for machine learning in traumatic brain injury
zh_title: STBI：含1.2万余例脑CT的创伤性脑损伤机器学习数据集
summary: 发布Shiraz-TBI数据集，含3602例患者、12,155次连续脑CT，附结构化标注、时间变量及部分多模态临床与功能结局。
key_points: 37.6万余张DICOM图像，另提供NIfTI格式
放射科医生标注出血亚型、中线移位等
1259例子集含临床、治疗及功能结局
reason: 大规模公开纵向影像数据集，附临床结局，属重要档
abstract: Publicly available traumatic brain injury (TBI) imaging datasets remain limited by the absence of longitudinal imaging, standardized annotations, and linked clinical outcomes. We developed and validated the Shiraz-TBI (STBI) dataset, a large-scale multimodal resource comprising 3602 patients, 12,155 serial non-contrast brain CT examinations, and 376,195 DICOM images, with all studies additionally available in NIfTI format. Radiologists generated structured annotations for intracranial hemorrhage subtypes, mass effect, midline shift, skull fractures, Marshall CT scores, and other imaging features, while temporal variables and time-to-surgery outcomes were derived. Internal validation by neurosurgeons demonstrated near-perfect inter-rater agreement (κ > 0.85 for most variables). A multimodal subset of 1259 patients includes demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and functional outcome data. By integrating patient-level longitudinal chronologically ordered serial neuroimaging with standardized annotations, temporal information, and prognostic outcomes, STBI provides a publicly available, machine learning-ready resource for imaging analysis, disease progression modeling, prognostic prediction, and clinical decision support in TBI.
zh_abstract: 公开可用的创伤性脑损伤（TBI）影像数据集仍受限于缺乏纵向影像、标准化标注以及关联的临床结局。我们开发并验证了 Shiraz-TBI（STBI）数据集，这是一个大规模多模态资源，包含 3602 名患者、12,155 次连续非增强脑部 CT 检查和 376,195 幅 DICOM 图像，所有检查另提供 NIfTI 格式。放射科医生对颅内出血亚型、占位效应、中线移位、颅骨骨折、Marshall CT 评分及其他影像特征进行了结构化标注，同时衍生出时间变量和手术时间结局。神经外科医生进行的内部验证显示评分者间一致性近乎完美（大多数变量 κ > 0.85）。一个包含 1259 名患者的多模态子集纳入了人口统计学、临床、实验室、治疗及功能结局数据。通过将患者层面按时间顺序排列的纵向连续神经影像与标准化标注、时间信息和预后结局相整合，STBI 为 TBI 的影像分析、疾病进展建模、预后预测和临床决策支持提供了一个公开可用、适用于机器学习的资源。

title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories
zh_title: 可解释AI将痛风常规表型与多组学特征及健康轨迹关联
summary: 基于UK Biobank、中国GoutRe注册和MIMIC-IV共21,235人，用六项常规检验无监督聚类出三个痛风亚型，并关联复发与死亡风险。
key_points: 三个队列共21,235名参与者，含外部评估
六项常规检验无监督聚类得三个亚型
C2复发风险更高，C3死亡率更高
reason: 多队列外部评估、样本较大，但为亚型发现，未见临床结局干预证据
abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry (n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV (n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses supported distinct urate-inflammatory and systemic-vulnerability axes, although the C3 senescence-related genetic signal was nominal and requires replication. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: 需要能够将可规模化的临床表型与分子机制相联系的整合性框架，以解析疾病异质性。我们利用来自英国生物银行（UK Biobank，UKB；n = 10,599）、多中心中国 GoutRe 登记研究（n = 8617）和 MIMIC-IV（n = 2019）共 21,235 名参与者的常规数据，开发并在外部评估了一个可解释的痛风临床亚型框架。基于六个预先设定的常规实验室变量进行无监督学习，识别出三个亚型：C1，低负担状态，储备功能保留；C2，尿酸代谢-炎症状态，复发倾向最高，且心血管代谢及肝脏合并症负担更重；C3，以全身脆弱性和更高死亡率为特征的状态。在 UKB 中，考虑死亡竞争风险的复发分析显示，C2 相比 C1 的复发发生率更高（亚分布风险比 [sHR] 1.896，95% CI 1.710–2.101），而 C3 与 C1 无差异（sHR 0.994，95% CI 0.887–1.112）。一个包含六个变量的 CRT 模型在 UKB 中采用嵌套 10 折袋外评估重建了锁定的亚型标签，并在 GoutRe 和 MIMIC-IV 中不经重新训练进行外部应用。C1/C2/C3 的一对多 AUC 在 UKB 中分别为 0.965/0.945/0.980，在 GoutRe 中分别为 0.906/0.914/0.953，在 MIMIC-IV 中分别为 0.912/0.898/0.962。遗传学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析支持存在不同的尿酸-炎症轴和全身脆弱性轴，但 C3 与衰老相关的遗传信号仅为名义水平，尚需重复验证。常规实验室数据可以识别具有不同分子特征以及复发和死亡模式的痛风临床亚型；这些亚型能否指导临床管理仍需前瞻性评估。

title: Interpretable distance-resolved graph learning for cancer gene priority screening
zh_title: 可解释距离分辨图学习用于癌症基因优先级筛选
summary: 提出CGMap图学习框架，在生物分子网络中按距离分辨通道定位分散信号，筛选潜在癌症基因并提供可追溯的机制线索。
key_points: 距离分辨通道捕获多尺度拓扑信号
全局扩散模块量化通路背景下基因协同
泛癌设置下分析12,022个基因
reason: 新方法有可解释性，但摘要未见实验验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Systematic screening for cancer genes (CGs) is still a central goal in precision oncology, yet integrating sparse and spatially dispersed oncogenic signals to identify testable candidates remains challenging. Here we present CGMap, an interpretable graph-learning framework that uses a width-oriented parallel architecture to prioritize potential CGs from biomolecular networks and trace mechanistic cues. By constructing distance-resolved channels, CGMap localizes spatially dispersed CG signals across multiple topological scales while avoiding representation homogenization. A global diffusion module quantifies gene cooperativity along pathway contexts and yields traceable virtual interactions that map predictions to potential regulatory hypotheses, providing intrinsic interpretability for model decisions. Across multiple biomolecular networks in a pan-cancer setting, CGMap analysed 12,022 genes, consistently outperformed existing methods while remaining computationally efficient and prioritized 70 reliable candidates, including those previously unannotated in established databases. Importantly, the prioritized candidates were associated with the suppression of tumour-related phenotypes, including reduced cell proliferation, migration and invasion, along with a shift of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related features toward a non-mesenchymal state, as supported by parallel loss-of-function assays across cancer and non-malignant cell lines.
zh_abstract: 系统性筛选癌症基因（CGs）仍是精准肿瘤学的核心目标，但整合稀疏且空间分散的致癌信号以识别可检验的候选基因仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出 CGMap，一种可解释的图学习框架，采用面向宽度的并行架构，从生物分子网络中对潜在癌症基因进行优先排序并追溯机制线索。通过构建距离解析通道，CGMap 在多个拓扑尺度上定位空间分散的癌症基因信号，同时避免表征同质化。全局扩散模块沿通路背景量化基因间的协同性，并产生可追溯的虚拟相互作用，将预测结果映射到潜在的调控假说，从而为模型决策提供内在可解释性。在泛癌设置下的多个生物分子网络中，CGMap 分析了 12,022 个基因，始终优于现有方法且计算效率较高，并优先筛选出 70 个可靠候选基因，其中包括在既有数据库中此前未被注释的基因。重要的是，经癌细胞系和非恶性细胞系的平行功能缺失实验支持，这些优先候选基因与肿瘤相关表型的抑制相关，包括细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭减少，同时上皮-间质转化（EMT）相关特征向非间质状态转变。

abstract: [The Lancet regional health. Europe] A novel artificial intelligence-based electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) model (AiTiA MI v2.00.00) for the early diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction (AMI) was developed using data from Korean patients. Its performance in a European population remains unknown. Patients presenting to the emergency department (ED) with suspected AMI were enrolled in two prospective European cohorts (APACE & APACE-Light; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT00470587). The primary outcome was AMI, centrally adjudicated according to the fourth Universal Definition of MI. The AI-ECG model was applied to 12-lead ECGs recorded at ED presentation. Its diagnostic performance for AMI was directly compared to that of the BASEL score, high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (hs-cTnT), the recalibrated HEART score (all at ED presentation), and integrated physician judgment at 90 min, with the last two only available in APACE. Predefined AI-ECG triage thresholds for early rule-out and rule-in of AMI were also evaluated. Among 12,630 patients with an available digital 12-lead ECG (5047 in APACE and 7583 in APACE-Light), adjudicated AMI was diagnosed in 19% (968/5047) and 18% (1386/7583) of patients, respectively. In patients with hs-cTnT at presentation (n = 5031 and n = 7565), the AI-ECG model showed good diagnostic performance for AMI with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.78 (95% CI: 0.77-0.80) and 0.84 (0.83-0.85) and an area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.56 (0.53-0.59) and 0.65 (0.62-0.67). Its discrimination was inferior to hs-cTnT (AUC 0.94 [0.93-0.95] and 0.93 [0.92-0.94]). The AI-ECG model provided some incremental diagnostic value when combined with hs-cTnT (AUC 0.95 [0.94-0.96] and 0.95 [0.94-0.95], p < 0.001). The predefined triage thresholds ruled out 14% (706/5031) and 19% (1437/7565) of patients, with a sensitivity for AMI of 97.6% (96.5-98.5) and 97.5% (96.6-98.3), respectively. AI-ECG showed high, but not very high, diagnostic accuracy for AMI. As a diagnosis of AMI is unlikely to be ruled out on ECG alone, combining AI-ECG with hs-cTnT may improve decision making in the ED, warranting prospective studies. Europe] 一种用于急性心肌梗死（AMI）早期诊断的新型基于人工智能的心电图（AI-ECG）模型（AiTiA MI v2.00.00）利用韩国患者的数据开发而成。其在欧洲人群中的表现尚不清楚。因疑似 AMI 到急诊科（ED）就诊的患者被纳入两个欧洲前瞻性队列（APACE 和 APACE-Light；ClinicalTrials.gov 编号 NCT00470587）。主要结局为 AMI，依据第四版心肌梗死通用定义进行中心裁定。AI-ECG 模型应用于 ED 就诊时记录的 12 导联心电图。将其对 AMI 的诊断表现与 BASEL 评分、高敏心肌肌钙蛋白 T（hs-cTnT）、重新校准的 HEART 评分（均为 ED 就诊时）以及 90 分钟时的医生综合判断直接比较，后两者仅在 APACE 中可用。同时评估了预先设定的用于 AMI 早期排除和确诊的 AI-ECG 分诊阈值。在 12,630 例有可用数字 12 导联心电图的患者中（APACE 5047 例，APACE-Light 7583 例），经裁定诊断为 AMI 的比例分别为 19%（968/5047）和 18%（1386/7583）。在就诊时有 hs-cTnT 的患者中（n = 5031 和 n = 7565），AI-ECG 模型对 AMI 显示出良好的诊断表现，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 0.78（95% CI：0.77-0.80）和 0.84（0.83-0.85），精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）分别为 0.56（0.53-0.59）和 0.65（0.62-0.67）。其区分能力低于 hs-cTnT（AUC 分别为 0.94 [0.93-0.95] 和 0.93 [0.92-0.94]）。AI-ECG 模型与 hs-cTnT 联合时提供了一定的增量诊断价值（AUC 分别为 0.95 [0.94-0.96] 和 0.95 [0.94-0.95]，p < 0.001）。预先设定的分诊阈值分别排除了 14%（706/5031）和 19%（1437/7565）的患者，对 AMI 的敏感度分别为 97.6%（96.5-98.5）和 97.5%（96.6-98.3）。AI-ECG 对 AMI 显示出较高但不是非常高的诊断准确性。由于仅凭心电图不太可能排除 AMI 诊断，将 AI-ECG 与 hs-cTnT 联合可能改善 ED 的决策，值得开展前瞻性研究。资助方：瑞士国家科学基金会、瑞士心脏基金会、Innosuisse、巴塞尔大学医院、巴塞尔大学、Abbott、Beckman Coulter、Idorsia、LSI Medience Corporation、Roche、Ortho Clinical Diagnostics、Quidel、Siemens、SpinChip、Upstream 和 Singulex、韩国健康产业开发院（KHIDI）。

title: Dual chain-of-thought AI‑PDCA framework for clinical history taking and documentation

abstract: Clinical history-taking and documentation are foundational competencies in undergraduate medical training, yet scalable and individualized training tools remain limited. Large language model (LLM)-based systems provide automated practice opportunities but often lack structured medical reasoning, closed-loop instructional design, and integration into formal curricula. As part of a curriculum reform initiative, we constructed a clinical case repository, developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated faculty Plan–Do–Check–Act (PDCA) training framework supported by dual chain-of-thought (CoT)-driven LLMs, and evaluated the reliability of AI-based scoring against faculty assessment. We then conducted a retrospective observational analysis of routinely collected educational performance data from 135 undergraduate medical students enrolled in one of three existing instructional configurations: traditional instruction, AI-assisted training, or AI + PDCA training. Educational outcomes were assessed using standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) assessments. The AI + PDCA configuration was associated with the highest OSCE performance in both history-taking and clinical documentation. Among the two AI-supported configurations, longitudinal mixed-effects modeling showed steeper learning trajectories in the AI + PDCA configuration than in the AI-assisted configuration. These findings suggest that integrating AI-derived learning analytics with faculty-guided instructional intervention may support a closed-loop educational model associated with favorable competency acquisition while maintaining human oversight. This framework offers a scalable approach for implementing trustworthy, competency-based AI-enhanced medical education in routine academic practice.
zh_abstract: 临床病史采集与文书记录是本科医学教育的基础能力，但可规模化且个体化的训练工具仍然有限。基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统可提供自动化练习机会，但往往缺乏结构化的医学推理、闭环教学设计，也未融入正式课程。作为课程改革举措的一部分，我们构建了临床病例库，开发了由双重思维链（CoT）驱动的LLM支持的、融合人工智能（AI）的教师“计划–执行–检查–处理”（PDCA）培训框架，并评估了基于AI的评分与教师评分相比的可靠性。随后，我们对135名本科医学生的常规收集的教育表现数据进行了回顾性观察分析，这些学生分别参加三种现有教学配置之一：传统教学、AI辅助训练或AI + PDCA训练。教育结果采用标准化客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）进行评估。AI + PDCA配置在病史采集和临床文书记录两方面的OSCE成绩均最高。在两种AI支持的配置中，纵向混合效应模型显示，AI + PDCA配置的学习轨迹比AI辅助配置更陡。这些结果提示，将AI衍生的学习分析与教师指导的教学干预相结合，可能支持一种闭环教育模式，该模式与良好的能力获得相关，同时保持人工监督。该框架为在日常教学实践中实施可信赖的、以能力为导向的AI增强型医学教育提供了一种可规模化的方法。

title: Image-guided and augmented reality-assisted robotic surgery.

summary: 综述近12-18个月泌尿外科机器人手术中3D模型、AR及AI辅助配准的证据，含一项AI驱动3D-AR引导前列腺切除的随机试验。
key_points: 一项随机试验显示AI 3D-AR引导降低总体切缘阳性率
部分肾切除中3D模型发展到灌注图与自动AI配准

reason: 综述类上限6分；涉及RCT证据但为转述，属值得一看档
abstract: [Current opinion in urology] Image-guided and augmented-reality (AR)-assisted robotic surgery is moving from static preoperative visualization toward dynamic, automated navigation. This review summarizes evidence from the past 12-18 months on three-dimensional (3D) virtual models, AR, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted registration in robotic urology, focusing on which applications have moved to comparative and randomized evidence, and on how far this rationale now generalizes beyond the centers that first described it. In radical prostatectomy, a randomized trial of AI-driven 3D-AR guidance vs. cognitive MRI guidance showed lower overall positive margins, less postoperative radiotherapy, and better 12-month continence. In partial nephrectomy, 3D models have progressed from anatomical planning to perfusion-mapped clamping and automated AI-based registration, with favorable outcomes across comparative, meta-analytic, and propensity-matched series, including in horseshoe kidneys and totally endophytic tumors. Independent European groups have reported automated registration, segmentation, and nephrometry tools, and small series have extended image guidance to kidney transplantation, vena cava thrombectomy, upper tract urothelial carcinoma, and testicular cancer surgery. Randomized evidence in prostatectomy, a maturing pathway in partial nephrectomy, and growing independent replication support an expanding but still procedure-limited role for image-guided robotic surgery. Standardized protocols, objective accuracy metrics, multicenter validation, and structured training remain necessary before wider adoption.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in urology] 图像引导和增强现实（AR）辅助的机器人手术正从静态术前可视化转向动态、自动化的导航。本综述总结了过去12至18个月内关于机器人泌尿外科中三维（3D）虚拟模型、AR和人工智能（AI）辅助配准的证据，重点关注哪些应用已进入对照和随机证据阶段，以及这一原理在多大程度上可推广到最初报道它的中心之外。在根治性前列腺切除术中，一项比较AI驱动的3D-AR引导与认知融合MRI引导的随机试验显示，总体切缘阳性率更低，术后放疗更少，12个月控尿情况更好。在肾部分切除术中，3D模型已从解剖规划发展到灌注图指导的阻断和基于AI的自动配准，在对照研究、荟萃分析和倾向匹配系列中均获得良好结局，包括马蹄肾和完全内生型肿瘤。欧洲的多个独立团队报道了自动配准、分割和肾脏评分（nephrometry）工具，小型系列研究还将图像引导扩展到肾移植、腔静脉取栓、上尿路尿路上皮癌和睾丸癌手术。前列腺切除术中的随机证据、肾部分切除术中日趋成熟的研究路径，以及不断增加的独立重复验证，支持图像引导机器人手术的作用正在扩大，但仍局限于特定术式。在更广泛应用之前，仍需要标准化方案、客观的准确性指标、多中心验证和结构化培训。

abstract: [Journal of medical systems] Clinical registries capture adverse events (AEs) in free-text fields that are rarely analyzed. We developed a reproducible large language model (LLM)-assisted workflow using 11,216 free-text entries from 18,069 patients in the German Stroke Registry; 9,146 informative entries were retained after filtering. Embedding-based clustering showed poor separation, whereas an LLM-guided taxonomy identified 89 leaf labels. On the model-assisted 1,000-entry development set used for model and prompt selection, GPT-5.4 reached F1 92.4% (95% confidence interval [CI] 91.4-93.4). On 300 held-out entries, weighted F1 against clinician consensus was 96.5% (94.6-98.1) for frozen GPT-5.4 labels and 90.5% (87.5-93.5) for locally run Qwen 3.5 27B. For AE concepts with a comparable structured field, free text documented 1,345 additional instances (+19.6% over 6,867 structured instances); it also documented 7,546 instances of AE concepts without a structured equivalent, most often pneumonia, urinary tract infection and delirium. Beyond baseline covariates and the structured AE count, integrated complication concepts increased the area under the curve for prediction of good functional outcome by 0.025 (95% CI 0.021-0.028) and for death by 0.018 (0.014-0.021); gains were minimal after including the discharge National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) score. On 1,979 public coronary-trial fragments from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov (AACT), the software ran end to end, demonstrating its technical applicability to a second clinical text corpus. In conclusion, this workflow enables structured analysis of clinical registry free text and complements structured adverse-event documentation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical systems] 临床登记系统在自由文本字段中记录了不良事件（AE），但这些内容很少被分析。我们利用德国卒中登记中18,069例患者的11,216条自由文本记录，开发了一种可重复的大语言模型（LLM）辅助工作流程；筛选后保留了9,146条有信息量的记录。基于嵌入的聚类分离效果较差，而LLM引导的分类体系识别出89个叶节点标签。在用于模型和提示词选择的、经模型辅助的1,000条开发集上，GPT-5.4的F1达到92.4%（95%置信区间[CI] 91.4-93.4）。在300条留出记录上，与临床医生共识相比，冻结的GPT-5.4标签的加权F1为96.5%（94.6-98.1），本地运行的Qwen 3.5 27B为90.5%（87.5-93.5）。对于存在可比结构化字段的AE概念，自由文本额外记录了1,345例（比6,867例结构化记录多19.6%）；它还记录了7,546例没有结构化对应项的AE概念，最常见的是肺炎、尿路感染和谵妄。在基线协变量和结构化AE计数之外，整合的并发症概念使预测良好功能结局的曲线下面积增加0.025（95% CI 0.021-0.028），预测死亡的曲线下面积增加0.018（0.014-0.021）；纳入出院时美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（NIHSS）评分后，增益极小。在来自ClinicalTrials.gov汇总分析数据库（AACT）的1,979条公开冠状动脉试验文本片段上，该软件可端到端运行，证明其在第二个临床文本语料库上的技术适用性。总之，该工作流程可对临床登记的自由文本进行结构化分析，并对结构化不良事件记录形成补充。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled clinical decision support (CDS) challenges core assumptions of the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) recently updated CDS guidance, including the concepts of independent clinician review of outputs and manufacturer-intended use for exempting certain CDS tools from medical device regulation. We examine the FDA's January 2026 CDS guidance in the context of the evolving landscape of AI-enabled CDS tools, clinician interaction studies with AI-enabled CDS, and AI governance frameworks. Although the FDA's framework distinguishes non-device CDS from regulated software, AI-enabled CDS may synthesize and transform clinical information in ways that are difficult to verify during routine care, increasing clinician susceptibility to automation bias. Incorporating pragmatic triggers into existing governance frameworks can help identify scenarios with a heightened risk for clinical decision influence. Oversight calibrated to real-world clinical decision influence is needed to strengthen practical safety standards for AI-enabled CDS.

title: Machine learning for small-molecule antibiotics - discovery to pre-clinical optimization.
source: PubMed · Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases

summary: 综述机器学习在小分子抗生素从发现到临床前优化中的应用，背景为抗菌素耐药危机和药物管线匮乏。

abstract: [Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases] The rapid rise of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) poses a critical global health crisis, with 4.71 million associated deaths and 1.14 million attributable deaths in 2021. By 2050, these tolls are forecasted to rise to 8.22 million associated deaths and 1.91 million attributable deaths annually. Despite this growing burden, the antibacterial pipeline is alarmingly lean, with few candidates exhibiting truly novel mechanisms of action (MOA). This innovation gap is worsened by the lack of economic incentives for large pharmaceutical companies to develop new antibiotics, placing increasing pressure on academic laboratories and small biotechnology companies. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising, albeit unproven, toolset to accelerate and reduce the cost of antibiotic discovery and development. To review a cross-section of ML methods and their applications across the preclinical antibiotic discovery and development pipeline. Google Scholar and PubMed were searched through June 2026, combining terms for machine learning, deep learning, and artificial intelligence with antibiotic discovery and development, virtual screening, generative molecular design, and ADMET prediction. Primary research articles were prioritized, with preprints from arXiv and bioRxiv included where no peer-reviewed version was available. Reference lists of retrieved articles and WHO antibacterial pipeline reports were also screened. ML approaches enable more efficient exploration of vast chemical spaces in silico, facilitating the discovery of structurally novel antibacterial compounds in phenotype- and target-based applications. Both discriminative and generative models have demonstrated success in discovering new scaffolds and in multi-property optimization tasks. In target-based discovery, ML-guided docking strategies have improved scalability relative to more computationally demanding physics-based methods. ML-guided methods can improve the efficiency, scalability, and success rate of antibiotic discovery and development programs. However, the implementation of these models will require high-quality training data and rigorous experimental validation prior to end-to-end integration.
zh_abstract: [Clinical microbiology and infection：欧洲临床微生物学和传染病学会官方出版物] 抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）的迅速上升构成严峻的全球健康危机，2021年相关死亡人数为471万，归因死亡人数为114万。预计到2050年，这些数字将分别升至每年822万例相关死亡和191万例归因死亡。尽管负担日益加重，抗菌药物研发管线却极为贫乏，真正具有全新作用机制（MOA）的候选药物寥寥无几。由于大型制药公司缺乏研发新型抗生素的经济激励，这一创新缺口进一步扩大，使学术实验室和小型生物技术公司承受的压力日益增加。机器学习（ML）已成为一种有前景但尚未得到证实的工具集，可加速抗生素的发现与开发并降低成本。目的：综述各类ML方法及其在临床前抗生素发现与开发管线中的应用。检索了截至2026年6月的Google Scholar和PubMed，检索词结合了机器学习、深度学习和人工智能，以及抗生素发现与开发、虚拟筛选、生成式分子设计和ADMET预测。优先纳入原始研究文章；对于没有同行评审版本的，纳入arXiv和bioRxiv的预印本。同时筛查了所检索文章的参考文献列表以及WHO抗菌药物研发管线报告。ML方法能够在计算机上更高效地探索庞大的化学空间，有助于在基于表型和基于靶点的应用中发现结构新颖的抗菌化合物。判别式模型和生成式模型均已在发现新骨架及多属性优化任务中取得成功。在基于靶点的发现中，相较于计算要求更高的基于物理的方法，ML引导的对接策略提高了可扩展性。ML引导的方法可以提高抗生素发现与开发项目的效率、可扩展性和成功率。然而，在实现端到端整合之前，这些模型的应用需要高质量的训练数据和严格的实验验证。

title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
zh_title: Bonbon：分子相互作用基础模型的涌现生物学能力
summary: 预印本提出 Bonbon，基于约3.2万亿token的蛋白-配体序列配对训练，零样本展现功能、残基、化学键三级涌现能力，并可泛化到分布外复合物。
key_points: 仅用序列训练，无结构坐标与任务监督
零样本识别作用机制、结合位点（含变构）及共价/非共价

reason: 预印本，基础模型方法新颖、训练规模大，但摘要未见代码开放或外部实验验证
abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
zh_abstract: 在大规模无标注语料上训练的基础模型会产生涌现能力，即超出训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出 Bonbon，一种用于分子相互作用的基础模型，在约 3.2 万亿个配对蛋白质-配体序列 token 上训练。Bonbon 在单一表示空间中展现出三种处于不同分辨率层级的零样本涌现能力：功能层面（作用机制）、残基层面（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构位点区分）以及化学键层面（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力均可泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon 仅在蛋白质-配体序列上训练，没有任何任务特异性监督，也没有结构坐标。我们在从 42M 到 1.6B 参数的六种模型规模上进行了受控的缩放实验；尽管预训练损失平滑下降，所评估的每种能力在最大规模上，其连续指标均出现陡然跃升。这表明仅凭基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时出现。这里报告的能力是在 1:2,000 的参数与 token 比例下训练后出现的，以适应配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。同样的冻结表示在结合与亲和力预测上达到最先进水平，速度比共折叠（co-folding）方法快五个数量级。在涵盖七个蛋白家族、九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon 对从头设计化合物的剂量-反应命中率达 61.5%，产生了此前未报道可抑制这些蛋白的结构新颖分子，其中包括针对分布外靶点的分子。

title: Who Benefits from Telemonitoring? Uplift Modelling of a Nationwide Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Programme

summary: 基于新加坡PTEC-HT项目16,694例回顾性数据，估计项目对血压控制的平均效应，并用提升建模分析异质性获益。
key_points: 倾向评分匹配后血压控制率74%对69%
基线未控制者提升12个百分点（63%对50%）
进一步用uplift建模识别获益人群
reason: 全国项目较大样本，但为回顾性无外部验证，上限6
abstract: Home blood pressure (BP) telemonitoring programmes are being deployed at national scale, yet enrolment resources are finite and the benefit of telemonitoring is unlikely to be uniform across patients. We study the Primary Technology-Enhanced Care for Hypertension (PTEC-HT) programme, a nationwide telemonitoring programme for hypertensive patients in Singapore. Using retrospective data on 16,694 patients registered between August 2020 and May 2024, we first estimate the average treatment effect of the programme on 6-month BP control against a propensity-score-matched non-participant cohort, finding an absolute improvement of 5 percentage points in the rate of BP control (74% vs. 69%, $p = 3\times10^{-12}$), rising to 12 percentage points (63% vs. 50%, $p = 1\times10^{-15}$) among patients with uncontrolled BP at baseline. We then move beyond the average effect and apply uplift modelling to estimate individual treatment effects. Across five uplift learners evaluated with 5-fold cross-validation and Qini curves, an uplift random forest performed best on the full cohort and an S-learner on the uncontrolled-baseline subcohort, although performance bands overlapped across learners. On held-out patients, realised uplift was largest in the top predicted-uplift groups and declined across the ranking. These patients had higher baseline BP grade, more recent hypertension diagnosis and lower medication and diagnosis burden, a profile we offer as hypothesis-generating for targeted enrolment. A handcrafted rule built from these features was competitive with the learned models, outperforming all of them on the uncontrolled-baseline cohort, suggesting that uplift models are useful for discovering heterogeneity that can be distilled into simple enrolment criteria for directing limited care team capacity.
zh_abstract: 家庭血压（BP）远程监测项目正在全国范围内推广，但入组资源有限，且远程监测的获益不太可能在所有患者中一致。我们研究了新加坡面向高血压患者的全国性远程监测项目——初级技术增强型高血压护理（PTEC-HT）项目。利用2020年8月至2024年5月登记的16,694例患者的回顾性数据，我们首先以倾向评分匹配的非参与者队列为对照，估计该项目对6个月血压控制的平均处理效应，发现血压控制率绝对提高5个百分点（74%对69%，$p = 3\times10^{-12}$），在基线血压未控制的患者中升至12个百分点（63%对50%，$p = 1\times10^{-15}$）。随后我们超越平均效应，应用提升建模（uplift modelling）估计个体处理效应。在采用5折交叉验证和Qini曲线评估的五种提升学习器中，提升随机森林在全队列中表现最佳，S-learner在基线未控制亚队列中表现最佳，但各学习器的性能区间存在重叠。在留出患者中，实际提升在预测提升最高的组中最大，并沿排序递减。这些患者的基线血压分级更高、高血压诊断时间更近，且用药和诊断负担更低，该特征可作为针对性入组的假设生成性依据。基于这些特征构建的手工规则与学习模型相比具有竞争力，在基线未控制队列中优于所有学习模型，提示提升模型有助于发现异质性，并可将其提炼为简单的入组标准，以引导有限的护理团队能力。

title: Viro-BERT: Whole-Genome Attention for Robust Viral Pathogen Classification from Next-Generation Sequencing Data.
zh_title: Viro-BERT：全基因组注意力的病毒病原体分类
summary: 提出将完整病毒基因组切分为重叠512 token窗口、共享DistilBERT编码并后期融合平均概率的分类方法，以解决固定窗口截断问题。
key_points: 针对猴痘、HSV-1等大DNA病毒的截断盲区
窗口独立处理，显存不随基因组长度增长

reason: 新方法有基线对比，但摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Virus research] Classifying viral pathogens from next-generation sequencing (NGS) data is central to diagnosis and genomic surveillance. Most deep learning classifiers, however, read only a fixed window at the start of each genome, typically a few hundred to a few thousand base pairs, and so ignore more than 95% of the sequence of large DNA viruses such as monkeypox virus (MPV) and herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1). We refer to this problem as Truncation Blindness. Here we present Viro-BERT, which splits a complete genome into overlapping 512-token windows, encodes each window with a shared DistilBERT encoder, and averages the window-level class probabilities in a Late Fusion Consensus layer. Because the windows are processed independently, memory use does not grow with genome length. We compared Viro-BERT with one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN), bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and RoBERTa baselines on 14 viral classes, using the same segmentation and training protocol for all models. Viro-BERT reached 96.79% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.17%. We then added random substitution noise to the test genomes. At 5% noise, the accuracy of the 1D-CNN fell by 5.57 percentage points, whereas Viro-BERT still classified 93.68% of genomes correctly. Positional and attention analyses on HSV-1 showed that Viro-BERT uses diagnostic signal from across the genome rather than from its 5' end alone. These results indicate that whole-genome context is needed for viral classifiers that remain reliable on noisy clinical data.
zh_abstract: [病毒研究] 基于新一代测序（NGS）数据对病毒病原体进行分类，是诊断和基因组监测的核心。然而，大多数深度学习分类器只读取每个基因组起始处的固定窗口（通常为几百至几千个碱基对），因此忽略了猴痘病毒（MPV）和单纯疱疹病毒1型（HSV-1）等大型DNA病毒超过95%的序列。我们将这一问题称为“截断盲区”（Truncation Blindness）。在此，我们提出 Viro-BERT：它将完整基因组切分为相互重叠的512个token窗口，用共享的 DistilBERT 编码器对每个窗口编码，并在“后期融合共识”（Late Fusion Consensus）层中对各窗口级别的类别概率取平均。由于各窗口独立处理，内存使用不随基因组长度增长。我们在14个病毒类别上，将 Viro-BERT 与一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）、双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）和 RoBERTa 基线模型进行比较，所有模型均采用相同的切分方式和训练方案。Viro-BERT 的准确率达到96.79%，宏平均F1分数为96.17%。随后，我们向测试基因组中加入随机替换噪声。在5%噪声下，1D-CNN 的准确率下降了5.57个百分点，而 Viro-BERT 仍能正确分类93.68%的基因组。对 HSV-1 的位置分析和注意力分析表明，Viro-BERT 利用的是来自整个基因组的诊断信号，而非仅来自其5'端。这些结果表明，要使病毒分类器在含噪声的临床数据上保持可靠，需要利用全基因组上下文。

title: BioLM-Score: Language-Prior Conditioned Probabilistic Geometric Potentials for Protein-Ligand Scoring.
zh_title: BioLM-Score：语言先验条件的蛋白-配体打分
summary: 将冻结的蛋白与分子语言模型嵌入融入残基-原子距离似然框架，在DEKOIS 2.0筛选终点上优于匹配几何基线，但亲和力打分与排序未一致提升。
key_points: 结合预训练生物分子语言模型嵌入与门控图卷积
