title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare
zh_title: BenchmarkHub：医疗大模型可复现评测的开源平台
summary: 开源平台（MIT许可），用固定种子抽题、记录完整提示与推理设置，支持语言与视觉语言模型及工具型智能体的可审计评测。
key_points: 提供浏览器、命令行和REST API三种入口
确定性规则评分并保存每次提示与结果
代码在GitHub公开
reason: 开源评测工具有实用性，但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are solely judged by their scores on biomedical benchmarks, yet these scores are rarely reproducible since the prompts, inference settings and model builds are seldom reported. We developed BenchmarkHub, an open-source platform for auditable evaluation of language and vision-language models for biomedical research. Methods: BenchmarkHub is a Python web application (Django 5.2, SQLite) released under the MIT licence and available at https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub. The application can be accessed through a browser interface, a set of command-line tools and a REST API, so interactive exploration and scripted pipelines produce identical, comparable records. The platform samples questions with fixed seeds, runs models directly or as tool-using agents in a code sandbox, grades answers with deterministic rules and stores every prompt, reply and tool call. The interface provides a leaderboard to rank performance of the models, allowing model comparison without any preexisting programming knowledge. Findings: We used BenchmarkHub to evaluate 12 open-weight models in five experiments on 15 biomedical benchmarks (11 text, two multimodal and two computational biology) and two general benchmarks. The pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% (95% CI 43.0-49.3) to 80.9% (78.3-83.3). Re-grading the responses with simple answer-extraction rules lowered a model's accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points, leading to a reorder of the leaderboard. Published scores were found for 23 out of the 143 benchmark/model combinations tested. The accuracy measured by BenchmarkHub was lower than in the published results in 19 out of the 23 available comparisons. The effect of four prompting protocols (1: default prompt; 2: asking the model to answer the letter only; 3: chain-of-thought prompting; 4: three-shot prompting) changed MedQA accuracy by up to 11.3 points but was not significant after multiple-testing correction with 150 questions. We also tested the impact of ablation on benchmarking using the MMMU benchmark dataset. Removing images lowered the accuracy by 18.0 and 19.3 points respectively for the two strongest models. Finally, the accuracy of agentic benchmarks using a sandboxed interpreter increased on computational biology tasks by 36-63 points. Interpretation: Benchmarking is essential to assess the impact and validity of LLMs for medical applications. BenchmarkHub allows a fair and rigorous comparison of models across esta

title: HieraPTM: From PTM Site Recognition to Functional Phosphosite Prediction through Hierarchical Context and Protein Mechanics
zh_title: HieraPTM：从PTM位点识别到功能性磷酸化位点预测
summary: 提出分层跨任务框架，整合局部序列、蛋白语言模型表示与三维结构信息识别多种PTM，并经参数高效迁移预测功能性磷酸化位点。
key_points: HieraPTM融合序列、PLM与结构信息
HieraFuncPhos通过参数高效适配迁移表示
检索局部与远端力学证据用于功能优先级排序
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein post-translational modifications (PTMs) regulate cellular signaling and protein function, making accurate site identification essential for understanding protein regulation. However, PTM site recognition and functional phosphosite prediction are largely modeled independently, limiting the transfer of large-scale recognition knowledge to functional prioritization. Here, we introduce HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos, a cross-task hierarchical framework that separately models and conditionally integrates transferable PTM recognition representations and function-specific mechanical evidence. HieraPTM integrates local sequence patterns, protein language model representations, and three-dimensional structural information to recognize multiple PTM types. HieraFuncPhos transfers these representations through parameter-efficient adaptation and adaptively retrieves local and distal mechanical evidence conditioned on functional representations. At HSP90AA1 T36 and T115, the model reveals distinct mechanical response patterns consistent with published nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) observations, suggesting that the framework not only prioritizes functional phosphosites but also provides biophysically grounded, testable hypotheses regarding site-specific regulation. HieraPTM achieved macro-averaged AUROC and AUPRC values of 0.9237 and 0.8425 across eight PTM tasks, while maintaining competitive performance on severely imbalanced external benchmarks. HieraFuncPhos achieved an AUROC of 0.8274 and an AUPRC of 0.8188, outperforming existing comparison methods. Together, this framework connects PTM site recognition, functional prioritization, and structure-informed hypotheses regarding potential regulatory processes.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTM）调控细胞信号传导和蛋白质功能，因此准确识别修饰位点对于理解蛋白质调控至关重要。然而，PTM位点识别与功能性磷酸化位点预测在很大程度上是各自独立建模的，限制了大规模识别知识向功能优先级排序的迁移。在此，我们提出HieraPTM-HieraFuncPhos，一种跨任务分层框架，分别建模并有条件地整合可迁移的PTM识别表征与功能特异性的力学证据。HieraPTM整合局部序列模式、蛋白质语言模型表征和三维结构信息，用于识别多种PTM类型。HieraFuncPhos通过参数高效的适配迁移这些表征，并在功能表征的条件下自适应地检索局部和远端的力学证据。在HSP90AA1的T36和T115位点，该模型揭示了与已发表的核磁共振（NMR）观察结果一致的不同力学响应模式，提示该框架不仅可对功能性磷酸化位点进行优先级排序，还能就位点特异性调控提供有生物物理学依据、可检验的假设。HieraPTM在八项PTM任务上的宏平均AUROC和AUPRC分别为0.9237和0.8425，同时在严重不平衡的外部基准上保持了有竞争力的性能。HieraFuncPhos的AUROC为0.8274，AUPRC为0.8188，优于现有对比方法。总体而言，该框架将PTM位点识别、功能优先级排序以及关于潜在调控过程的结构学假设联系在一起。

title: Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning for Uncertainty-Robust Multi-Label Chest X-ray Classification
zh_title: ReCaRL：面向不确定性的可靠性感知胸片多标签分类
summary: 提出图辅助框架，用训练标签关联构建可靠性加权、置信门控的更新，并以观测掩码处理不确定标注，评估含内部与外部判别。
key_points: 图由训练标签关联构建，避免僵化层级
观测掩码处理不确定标注
与平坦、加权、图及层级惩罚基线比较
reason: 有外部评估与基线对比，但为预印本、增量方法
abstract: Background: Automated multi-label classification of chest radiographs is complicated by overlapping imaging findings, noisy report-derived labels, and changes in disease co-occurrence across clinical settings. Existing clinical-hierarchy methods can encode label relationships, but a rigid hierarchy may conflate categorical membership with empirical association and propagate annotation errors. Methods: We investigated Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning (ReCaRL), a graph-assisted framework for multi-label chest radiograph classification. An image encoder produces initial finding scores, while a graph constructed from training-label associations provides reliability-weighted, confidence-gated updates. Uncertain annotations are handled with observation masks. The evaluation compares flat, weighted, graph-based, and hierarchy-penalty baselines, with internal and external discrimination and calibration assessments. Results: In the internal evaluation, ReCaRL achieved macro AUROC 0.821 and macro AUPRC 0.437, compared with 0.812 and 0.423 for the masked/weighted baseline. Mean AUROC across five common findings was 0.865 versus 0.858. External testing yielded AUROC 0.799 and AUPRC 0.409. Post-hoc calibration reduced the internal Brier score from 0.113 to 0.102 and the external expected calibration error from 0.082 to 0.061, without changing AUROC or AUPRC. Conclusions: Reliability-aware graph propagation and confidence gating were associated with modest improvements in multi-label chest radiograph classification relative to the matched masked/weighted baseline. Post-hoc calibration improved probability reliability in the reported evaluations. The findings do not establish a benefit in prospective clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 【背景】胸部X线片的自动多标签分类因影像学表现重叠、来源于报告的标签存在噪声以及不同临床环境中疾病共现情况的变化而变得复杂。现有的临床层级方法可以编码标签之间的关系，但僵化的层级结构可能将类别归属与经验性关联混为一谈，并传播标注错误。【方法】我们研究了可靠性感知临床关系学习（ReCaRL），这是一种用于多标签胸部X线片分类的图辅助框架。图像编码器生成初始表现得分，而由训练标签关联构建的图则提供经可靠性加权、置信度门控的更新。不确定的标注通过观察掩码处理。评估比较了扁平、加权、基于图和层级惩罚的基线方法，并进行了内部和外部的区分度及校准评估。【结果】在内部评估中，ReCaRL的宏平均AUROC为0.821，宏平均AUPRC为0.437，而掩码/加权基线分别为0.812和0.423。五种常见表现的平均AUROC为0.865，对比0.858。外部测试的AUROC为0.799，AUPRC为0.409。事后校准使内部Brier评分从0.113降至0.102，外部期望校准误差从0.082降至0.061，且未改变AUROC或AUPRC。【结论】相对于匹配的掩码/加权基线，可靠性感知的图传播和置信度门控与多标签胸部X线片分类的适度改善相关。事后校准在所报告的评估中改善了概率可靠性。这些发现并不能证明其在前瞻性临床决策中的获益。

title: Affinity-guided design of PDZ-binding peptides in a shared latent space
summary: 提出在共享潜空间中以亲和力预测引导设计 PDZ 结合肽的深度学习方法，可兼顾单靶点、脱靶感知与双靶点目标。
zh_title: 共享潜空间中亲和力引导的 PDZ 结合肽设计
key_points: PDZ-PBM 共享潜空间由亲和力预测学习得到
将设计目标表述为潜空间中的方向
支持单靶点、脱靶感知与双靶点设计
reason: 有新意的蛋白设计预印本，证据有限
abstract: PDZ-binding motifs (PBMs) are short C-terminal sequences that bind PDZ domains and contribute to protein localization and complex assembly. Designing PBMs could modulate these interactions while leaving most of the original protein sequence unchanged. Because PDZ recognition preferences overlap, modulating intended interactions requires considering off-target binding alongside target affinity. Computational PBM design methods generally use sequence-based affinity prediction and structure-based evaluation, but it remains challenging to guide sequence searches toward different binding objectives with a single trained model. Here, we propose a deep learning-based method to design PBMs by analytically formulating single-target, off-target-aware, and dual-target design objectives as directions in a PDZ-PBM shared latent space learned through quantitative PDZ-PBM affinity prediction. In single-target PBM redesign for DLG4-PDZ3, our method identified 100 top-ranked candidates, 84 of which were in the top 1% for experimentally measured interaction fitness in a published mutant library, compared with 64 using an existing method. In single-target de novo design of 10-residue PBMs, our method achieved the highest median in silico binding scores among the compared methods for three of the four PDZ domains tested. In off-target-aware and dual-target PBM design for PTPN3 and SCRIB-PDZ3, off-target-aware design increased between-group score differences within each domain at the cost of lower target-domain scores, whereas dual-target design yielded scores close to those of the respective single-target designs for both domains. Together, these results show that shared latent representations learned from quantitative affinities allow a single trained model to guide PBM design across different binding objectives without retraining.

title: Benchmarking general and medical LLM performance in Parkinson's disease management.
summary: 用45个合成帕金森病病例评估 Gemini 1.5 Pro 与 OpenEvidence，评估较好但管理建议可靠性较低，两者无显著差异。
zh_title: 通用与医学大模型在帕金森病管理中的基准评测
key_points: 45个合成病例，两名专科医生评分
临床评估较好，管理建议较不可靠
医学专用模型数值略优但差异不显著
reason: 小样本合成病例评测，无显著差异，属增量档
abstract: [Clinical parkinsonism & related disorders] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as clinical support tools, yet their performance in Parkinson's disease (PD) management remains insufficiently characterized. We evaluated a general-purpose LLM (Gemini 1.5 Pro) and a medically specialized LLM (OpenEvidence) using 45 synthetic PD vignettes requiring generative assessment and management recommendations. Responses were independently rated by two movement disorders fellows using predefined 5-point Likert scales, with adjudication by a senior specialist when required. Both models demonstrated generally good performance in clinical assessment, whereas management recommendations were less reliable. A modest numerical advantage was observed for the medically specialized model across assessment, plan, and composite outcomes, although no statistically significant differences were identified. Qualitative analysis showed that clinically relevant errors occurred in both models, predominantly reflecting treatment strategy errors. These findings suggest that, in the specific model versions evaluated, LLMs may support clinical reasoning in PD, but require cautious interpretation, particularly for treatment recommendations.

title: Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data
zh_title: 面向儿童ECMO有限临床数据的支持约束离线策略改进
summary: 提出FQI-SC离线强化学习框架，仅在有数据支持的状态-动作内优化，在78条儿童ECMO轨迹上评估。
key_points: 限制于经验支持的状态-动作对
低数据区默认沿用临床医生策略
78条轨迹、超6000小时数据
reason: 样本小、离线评估，无临床验证
abstract: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury. Standard reinforcement learning can propose risky, out-of-distribution actions, while imitation learning is limited to reproducing clinician behavior. We introduce Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration (FQI-SC), an offline reinforcement learning framework that cautiously improves upon expert behavior by restricting optimization to empirically supported state-action pairs and defaulting to the clinician baseline in low-data regions. On 78 pediatric trajectories totaling over 6,000 hours of clinical data, we evaluate our framework using Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) and a behavioral disagreement. Additionally, we formalize the performance-safety trade-off by introducing a unified Balance Score ($S(π)$). Our empirical evaluation shows that support-constrained policy improves the Balance Score by 38\% relative to FQI, improves estimated value by 1.28 FQE units over imitation learning, and reduces disagreement with clinician actions by 71\% relative to FQI.
zh_abstract: 对接受 ECMO（体外膜肺氧合）的儿童进行管理，需要在短期生理稳定与预防神经系统损伤的长期目标之间取得平衡。标准强化学习可能提出有风险的、超出分布范围的动作，而模仿学习则仅限于复现临床医生的行为。我们提出支持约束拟合 Q 迭代（Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration，FQI-SC），这是一种离线强化学习框架：它将优化限制在经验上有数据支持的状态-动作对内，并在数据稀少的区域默认采用临床医生的基线策略，从而谨慎地在专家行为基础上加以改进。我们在 78 条儿科轨迹（总计超过 6,000 小时临床数据）上，使用拟合 Q 评估（Fitted Q-Evaluation，FQE）和行为分歧指标对该框架进行评估。此外，我们通过引入统一的平衡得分（Balance Score，$S(π)$）将性能与安全性之间的权衡形式化。我们的实证评估显示，与 FQI 相比，支持约束策略使平衡得分提高 38%；与模仿学习相比，估计价值提高 1.28 个 FQE 单位；与 FQI 相比，与临床医生动作的分歧减少 71%。

title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
zh_title: PECA：小语言模型临床推理的可微简洁性适配
summary: 在QLoRA监督微调目标中加入单一可微简洁性项，以缓解小语言模型在医学任务中回答冗长的问题（预印本）。
key_points: 针对小模型医疗问答过长的问题
在QLoRA微调目标中加入可微长度项
无需偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师
reason: 新方法但摘要无结果信息，属增量档
abstract: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.
zh_abstract: 较小的语言模型（SLM）使得在大型专有模型成本过高的场景中部署临床自然语言处理成为可能，而参数高效微调则使其能够在普通硬件上完成专门化。但训练之后仍存在一个障碍：在医学任务上，这些模型的回答长度远超临床问题的实际所需。在临床决策支持和床旁使用场景中，时间紧迫，即使底层推理是合理的，这种冗长也难以付诸行动。现有的长度控制方法依赖偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，这削弱了使 SLM 具有吸引力的可及性。我们提出参数高效简洁性适配（Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation，PECA），它在 QLoRA 监督微调目标中加入单一的可微简洁性项。由于词元数量是离散且不可微的，PECA 转而在生成长度超过词元预算后提高序列结束符的概率，这是一种可在常规训练中优化的平滑信号，无需偏好数据、辅助模型，仅需一块普通 GPU。在 medical-o1-reasoning-SFT 语料上微调的 17 亿参数模型中，PECA 使平均回答长度减少 72.8%，同时将多项选择诊断准确率从 40.8% 提高到 44.0%。对简洁性强度进行扫描，可描绘出一条可解释的准确率—长度前沿，用于在简洁性与诊断完整性之间取得平衡。

title: Data Archive for 2D and 3D Electrical Impedance Tomography with moderate conductivity contrast phantoms
zh_title: 2D/3D电阻抗断层成像中等对比度体模开放数据
summary: 公开KIT4/KIT5设备采集的胸部与头部体模EIT测量数据、网格和示例重建代码，供重建算法开发测试（预印本）。
key_points: 含圆柱、胸形及带电阻颅骨头形体模
提供计算网格与示例重建代码
适用于2D与3D重建算法
reason: 公开数据但为体模，规模与临床相关性有限
abstract: This document describes open Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) measurement data that were collected from biomedical imaging inspired phantoms with moderate conductivity contrasts. The data were collected with the KIT4 and KIT5 EIT measurement devices at the University of Eastern Finland, and are intended for EIT image reconstruction algorithm development and testing. The data from thoracic imaging inspired cylindrical and chest-shaped phantoms are suitable for 2D algorithms, and the data from an intracerebral hemorrhage imaging inspired head-shaped phantom with resistive skull are suitable for 3D algorithms. In addition to the measurement data, computational meshes and example reconstruction codes are provided and sample reconstructions included.
zh_abstract: 本文档描述了开放的电阻抗断层成像（EIT）测量数据，这些数据采集自受生物医学成像启发、电导率对比度适中的体模。数据由东芬兰大学的 KIT4 和 KIT5 EIT 测量设备采集，用于 EIT 图像重建算法的开发与测试。受胸部成像启发的圆柱形和胸腔形体模的数据适用于二维算法，而受脑出血成像启发、带有电阻性颅骨的头形体模的数据适用于三维算法。除测量数据外，还提供了计算网格和示例重建代码，并包含样例重建结果。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven multiple sclerosis diagnosis using genomic and medical imaging data: a review.
zh_title: AI驱动的多发性硬化诊断：基因组与影像数据综述
summary: 按PRISMA纳入26项研究，涵盖MRI、视网膜OCT、血液转录组、SNP及多模态临床数据，评述AI在MS诊断与进展评估中的应用。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA，纳入26项研究
覆盖MRI、OCT、转录组、SNP
聚焦多模态数据提升诊断
reason: 纳入研究较少的综述，信息增量有限
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is an immune-mediated central nervous system condition with heterogeneous clinical manifestations, progressive neurodegeneration, and considerable variability in disease trajectory. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) methods, have improved MS diagnosis and risk prediction. However, comprehensive review studies emphasizing the potential of existing AI-powered MS diagnosis remain limited. Thus, this study investigates the utilization of multimodal data by AI models to enhance diagnostic accuracy, evaluate disease progression, and optimize personalized care strategies. By adhering to PRISMA guidelines, this review included 26 studies encompassing MRI-based analysis, retinal OCT imaging, blood transcriptomics, SNP genotyping, and multimodal clinical datasets. An additional classification of these studies by modality was performed, and they were assessed with respect to dataset size, performance metrics, biomarkers, methodological robustness, and model interpretability. The findings indicate a consistent trend toward outstanding diagnostic performance, with some AI models achieving accuracies exceeding 95% using medical imaging and genomic data. However, limited external validation and interpretability procedures create a gap in clinical applicability and trustworthiness. This review highlights AI's growing potential to revolutionize MS diagnosis.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 多发性硬化（MS）是一种免疫介导的中枢神经系统疾病，临床表现异质，伴有进行性神经退行性变，疾病轨迹差异很大。人工智能（AI），尤其是机器学习（ML）方法的最新进展已改善了 MS 的诊断和风险预测。然而，强调现有 AI 驱动的 MS 诊断潜力的综合性综述研究仍然有限。因此，本研究探讨了 AI 模型利用多模态数据来提高诊断准确性、评估疾病进展并优化个体化照护策略。遵循 PRISMA 指南，本综述纳入了26项研究，涵盖基于 MRI 的分析、视网膜 OCT 成像、血液转录组学、SNP 基因分型及多模态临床数据集。我们另按数据模态对这些研究进行了分类，并从数据集规模、性能指标、生物标志物、方法学稳健性和模型可解释性方面进行了评估。结果表明，诊断性能总体上呈现出色趋势，一些 AI 模型利用医学影像和基因组数据的准确率超过95%。然而，外部验证和可解释性方法有限，造成了临床适用性和可信度方面的差距。本综述强调了 AI 在革新 MS 诊断方面日益增长的潜力。

title: Fine-Tuned Small Language Model for Synthetic Clinical Data Generation and Predictive Healthcare Analytics
summary: 提出基于微调 Phi-2 小语言模型生成合成临床数据，用于增强远程监测生命体征预测模型的训练数据。
zh_title: 微调小语言模型生成合成临床数据以支持预测分析
key_points: 以微调 Phi-2 生成合成临床样本
用于缓解医疗数据稀缺与不平衡
目标是改进生命体征预测的深度学习模型
reason: 预印本，数据增强方法，摘要未见外部验证，属增量档
abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad dataset, through a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-based method and by applying few-shot prompting techniques. The resulting model was used afterwards in the augmentation of a small-sized dataset, composed of vital sign values and labels associated with pathological and physiological states. The experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuned SLMs improved the performance on medical domain, achieving higher scores for both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) evaluation metrics compared to the pretrained model. Moreover, the fine-tuned SLM is effective for generating structured synthetic clinical data. When used for data augmentation, the generated dataset improved the performance of a LSTM predictive model, increasing the classification accuracy from 89.0% to 93.7% and showing consistent improvements in precision, recall, and F1-score.
zh_abstract: 医学数据集可获得性降低，是为远程医疗解决方案开发预测模型时面临的一项重要挑战，尤其是在可用数据不平衡或难以通过传统方法扩充的情况下。小语言模型（Small Language Models，SLMs）因计算需求较低且易于适应专门任务，已成为应对这些局限的、可替代大语言模型（Large Language Models，LLMs）的有前景方案。然而，其性能仍高度依赖于可用训练数据的质量和代表性。本文提出一种基于微调的 Microsoft Phi-2 模型的临床数据增强方法，用于生成合成实例，以改进基于深度学习的远程监测生命体征预测模型。Phi-2 模型通过在 MedQuad 数据集上进行监督微调、采用基于量化低秩适配（Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation，QLoRA）的方法并应用少样本提示（few-shot prompting）技术，适配到医学领域。随后，该模型被用于扩充一个小规模数据集，该数据集由生命体征数值以及与病理和生理状态相关的标签组成。实验结果表明，微调后的 SLM 在医学领域的表现有所提升，与预训练模型相比，在词汇层面（ROUGE）和语义层面（BERTScore）的评估指标上均获得更高得分。此外，微调后的 SLM 能够有效生成结构化的合成临床数据。用于数据增强时，所生成的数据集提升了 LSTM 预测模型的性能，使分类准确率从 89.0% 提高到 93.7%，并且在精确率、召回率和 F1 分数上也呈现一致的提升。

title: A risk-aware individualized blood pressure target to avoid hypotension in surgery
summary: 提出在线个体化血压目标与去甲肾上腺素剂量选择方法，在4096例虚拟患者中对74%给出推荐，并在回顾性记录上评估校准。
zh_title: 术中避免低血压的风险感知个体化血压目标
key_points: 拟合简化PK/PD模型并传播不确定性
目标是使MAP低于65mmHg的风险受限
无合适目标时交还临床医生决策
reason: 预印本，虚拟患者与回顾性评估，无前瞻验证
abstract: We propose an online method for choosing both a blood pressure target and a norepinephrine dose for an individual surgical patient. From a short record of mean arterial pressure (MAP) and norepinephrine delivery, the method fits a reduced pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic model and uses a local Gaussian approximation to propagate uncertainty to future MAP readings. It searches for the lowest target for which a bolus and constant infusion keep the predicted probability of at least one MAP reading below 65 mmHg after the rise phase within a prescribed limit. If no such target is found, the decision returns to the clinician. We assess calibration of the predicted minimum MAP on retrospective surgical records under the doses actually administered. In a cohort of 4,096 virtual patients, the method recommended a dose for 74 % of patients at a nominal risk of 5 %. Among the patients receiving a recommendation, 6.9 % had a reading below 65 mmHg. A fixed target of 70 mmHg yielded a rate of 25 % when applied to the full virtual cohort.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一种在线方法，用于为个体手术患者同时选择血压目标和去甲肾上腺素剂量。该方法基于一小段平均动脉压（MAP）和去甲肾上腺素给药记录，拟合一个简化的药代动力学/药效动力学模型，并利用局部高斯近似将不确定性传递至未来的 MAP 读数。该方法搜索最低的血压目标，使得在采用一次推注加持续输注的情况下，上升阶段之后至少出现一次 MAP 读数低于 65 mmHg 的预测概率保持在规定限值之内。若找不到这样的目标，则将决策交还给临床医生。我们在回顾性手术记录上，针对实际给予的剂量，评估了预测最低 MAP 的校准情况。在 4,096 名虚拟患者的队列中，在名义风险为 5% 时，该方法为 74% 的患者推荐了剂量。在获得推荐的患者中，6.9% 出现了低于 65 mmHg 的读数。将固定目标 70 mmHg 应用于整个虚拟队列时，该比例为 25%。

title: Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
zh_title: Raysemble：单张X光重建度量尺度三维骨骼
summary: 从单张X光重建8块腰椎与骨盆骨骼，在23例留出患者的43个CT生成的模拟X光上优于15种方法。
key_points: 分离形状与位置，输出毫米级三维骨骼
测试为模拟X光，仅23例患者
reason: 样本小且为模拟X光，缺外部验证
abstract: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.
zh_abstract: Raysemble 通过将形状与位置分离，从单张 X 线片重建八块腰椎和骨盆骨。每个三维查询在其图像投影处采样区域和全局特征。一个共享解码器预测归一化的骨形状。预测的深度和相机几何确定三维中心和尺度，用于将这些形状重采样到以毫米为单位的统一网格上。评估使用 23 例留出患者的 43 份 CT 扫描，每份生成一张模拟前后位 X 线片。在不对 CT 进行刚性配准的情况下，Raysemble 在 15 种被评估方法中领先，三个随机种子的平均 Dice 为 65.24%，HD95 为 9.09 mm，ASSD 为 3.32 mm。在输入相同的情况下，其 Dice 比 VolumeNeRF 提高 5.86 个百分点。

title: FGCARL: Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: FGCARL：用于医学图像分割的Fisher引导持续自适应表征学习
summary: 针对多中心域偏移与类别偏移并存的持续学习场景，提出医学图像分割方法以缓解灾难性遗忘。
key_points: 同时处理域偏移与类别偏移
缓解序贯适应中的灾难性遗忘
Fisher信息引导表征学习
reason: 新方法但摘要无具体结果，预印本
abstract: Deep learning (DL) has achieved remarkable success in medical image segmentation by learning data-driven representations from large-scale annotated datasets. However, medical images are often collected independently across clinical sites, resulting in substantial domain shifts due to differences in imaging modalities, acquisition protocols, and intensity distributions. Meanwhile, segmentation classes may vary across sites due to differences in annotation standards, leading to class shifts. These evolving domains and class definitions can substantially degrade segmentation performance on newly encountered data, while sequential adaptation may cause catastrophic forgetting of knowledge acquired from previously encountered domains and classes. Existing incremental learning methods for medical image segmentation primarily address either domain shifts or class shifts, with these two settings largely investigated independently. This separation leaves a critical gap in developing a unified approach that can simultaneously adapt to evolving domains and newly introduced classes while retaining previously acquired knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning, a unified framework for domain- and class-incremental 3D volumetric medical image segmentation. FGCARL comprises two key components: Mutual Adaptive Instance Representation (MAIR), which adaptively aligns feature distributions across sequentially encountered domains through bidirectional normalization and denormalization, and Fisher-Guided Knowledge Retention (FGKR), which selectively preserves parameters important for previously learned domains and classes through Fisher-guided regularization. Experimental results demonstrate that FGCARL consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods, effectively adapting to domain and class shifts while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
zh_abstract: 深度学习（DL）通过从大规模标注数据集中学习数据驱动的表征，在医学图像分割中取得了显著成功。然而，医学图像往往由各临床中心独立采集，成像模态、采集方案和强度分布的差异导致显著的域偏移。同时，由于标注标准的差异，各中心的分割类别可能不同，从而造成类别偏移。这些不断演变的域和类别定义可能显著降低对新遇到数据的分割性能，而序贯适应还可能导致对先前遇到的域和类别所获知识的灾难性遗忘。现有用于医学图像分割的增量学习方法主要处理域偏移或类别偏移之一，这两种设置在很大程度上是被独立研究的。这种割裂在开发能够同时适应不断演变的域和新引入的类别、并保留先前所获知识的统一方法方面留下了关键空白。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Fisher 引导的持续自适应表征学习（Fisher-Guided Continuously Adaptive Representation Learning，FGCARL），这是一个用于域增量和类别增量三维体积医学图像分割的统一框架。FGCARL 包含两个关键组件：互适应实例表征（Mutual Adaptive Instance Representation，MAIR），通过双向归一化和反归一化，自适应地对齐序贯遇到的各域之间的特征分布；以及 Fisher 引导的知识保留（Fisher-Guided Knowledge Retention，FGKR），通过 Fisher 引导的正则化，选择性地保留对先前学习的域和类别重要的参数。实验结果表明，FGCARL 持续优于最先进的方法，能够有效适应域和类别偏移，同时减轻灾难性遗忘。

title: Towards Democratising Low-Data Medical Image Classification: CPU-Trainable ZACH-ViT and Its Geometric Variants
zh_title: 面向低数据医学图像分类的CPU可训练ZACH-ViT及几何变体
summary: 评估参数不足26万的ZACH-ViT四种几何头与紧凑MIL基线，在7个MedMNIST+及3个外部数据集的低数据设置下比较（预印本）。
key_points: 每类仅50张训练图像，五个随机种子
Compact-TransMIL 23轮宏F1最高53.34%
延长训练在300项比较中239项提升
reason: 小模型低数据比较，指标较低，增量档
abstract: Medical image classification in resource-constrained settings must contend with limited annotations and computational capacity. We evaluate four ZACH-ViT variants with linear, Euclidean prototype, Poincare and spherical heads alongside two compact multiple-instance-learning baselines. All models are trained from scratch with fewer than 260,000 parameters across seven MedMNIST+ datasets and three external benchmarks (PCam, ISIC2017 and Shenzhen tuberculosis radiographs). The low-data protocol uses 50 training images per class and five seeds, with validation-selected checkpoints at 23 and 47 epochs; a full-data reference uses one seed. Compact-TransMIL achieves the highest ten-dataset mean test Macro-F1 at 23 epochs (53.34%) and with full data (73.93%). At 47 epochs, ZACH-Linear narrowly leads (57.76% versus 57.54% for Compact-TransMIL). Extending training improves Macro-F1 in 239 of 300 paired comparisons. On ISIC2017, hZACH-Spherical has the highest 47-epoch low-data Macro-F1 (44.09% with SD 4.09%), whereas ZACH-EuclideanProto leads with full data (51.27%). We additionally conduct 40 CPU-only training runs on ISIC2017 and Shenzhen using four CPU threads; model-only single-image inference requires approximately 4-9 ms, while image decoding and preprocessing substantially increase end-to-end latency. The results demonstrate the feasibility of CPU-only training on the tested platform and the task- and regime-dependence of compact medical imaging under strict resource constraints.
zh_abstract: 资源受限环境下的医学图像分类必须应对标注有限和计算能力有限的问题。我们评估了四种 ZACH-ViT 变体（分别采用线性头、欧氏原型头、庞加莱头和球面头），以及两种紧凑型多示例学习基线。所有模型均从头训练，参数量少于 260,000，涵盖七个 MedMNIST+ 数据集和三个外部基准（PCam、ISIC2017 和深圳结核病胸片）。低数据方案每类使用 50 张训练图像和五个随机种子，在第 23 和 47 个训练轮次取验证选出的检查点；全数据参考使用一个随机种子。Compact-TransMIL 在 23 个轮次时（53.34%）以及全数据条件下（73.93%）取得最高的十个数据集平均测试 Macro-F1。在 47 个轮次时，ZACH-Linear 以微弱优势领先（57.76%，对比 Compact-TransMIL 的 57.54%）。延长训练在 300 次配对比较中的 239 次中提高了 Macro-F1。在 ISIC2017 上，hZACH-Spherical 在低数据 47 轮次时 Macro-F1 最高（44.09%，标准差 4.09%），而全数据条件下 ZACH-EuclideanProto 领先（51.27%）。我们还使用四个 CPU 线程，在 ISIC2017 和深圳数据集上进行了 40 次仅用 CPU 的训练；仅模型的单图推理约需 4–9 毫秒，而图像解码和预处理会显著增加端到端延迟。结果表明，在所测试的平台上仅用 CPU 训练是可行的，并且在严格资源约束下，紧凑型医学影像模型的表现依赖于任务和训练条件。

title: Distribution-First Framework for Learning Risk-Sensitive Individualized Treatment Rules
zh_title: 风险敏感个体化治疗规则的分布优先学习框架
summary: 先估计各治疗下的条件结局分布，再以插件方式评估分位数、CVaR等准则，统一学习风险敏感个体化治疗规则（预印本）。
key_points: 统一分位数、CVaR及累积前景理论准则
先估分布再构造治疗规则
摘要提及理论保证，细节未给出
reason: 统计方法新意，无临床验证，增量档
abstract: Learning a risk-sensitive individualized treatment rule (ITR) with patient covariates is challenging when the treatment criterion depends on the full conditional outcome distribution rather than only its conditional mean. Existing methods are largely criterion-specific, making it difficult to compare multiple treatment criteria within a common pipeline, such as quantiles, conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), and complex preference-based objectives such as cumulative prospect theory. We propose a distribution-first framework for risk-sensitive ITR learning that first estimates treatment-specific conditional outcome distributions and then constructs the target ITR by plug-in criterion evaluation. The proposed framework unifies treatment rule learning across multiple criteria and accommodates hard-to-optimize objectives within the same estimation pipeline. On the theoretical side, it yields a general error propagation result for locally Hölder-stable criteria, linking first-stage distribution estimation error to downstream criterion estimation and treatment regret, together with sharper regret bounds under standard margin conditions. Empirically, we show that the proposed framework outperforms direct criterion-specific methods in multiple settings and further evaluate it on the ACTG175 HIV clinical trial, a randomized study comparing several antiretroviral regimens in HIV-infected adults.
zh_abstract: 当治疗标准取决于完整的条件结局分布而非仅取决于其条件均值时，利用患者协变量学习风险敏感的个体化治疗规则（ITR）具有挑战性。现有方法大多针对特定标准，难以在同一流程中比较多种治疗标准，例如分位数、条件风险价值（CVaR），以及累积前景理论等基于复杂偏好的目标。我们提出了一种“分布优先”的风险敏感 ITR 学习框架：首先估计各治疗的条件结局分布，然后通过插件式（plug-in）标准评估构建目标 ITR。该框架统一了多种标准下的治疗规则学习，并能在同一估计流程中处理难以优化的目标。在理论方面，该框架给出了针对局部 Hölder 稳定标准的一般误差传播结果，将第一阶段的分布估计误差与下游标准估计及治疗遗憾（regret）联系起来，并在标准边际条件（margin conditions）下给出了更紧的遗憾界。在实证方面，我们表明所提框架在多种情境下优于直接针对特定标准的方法，并进一步在 ACTG175 HIV 临床试验（一项比较 HIV 感染成人中几种抗逆转录病毒治疗方案的随机研究）上对其进行了评估。

title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks
zh_title: 阿拉伯语与英语医学问答的校准与保形预测
summary: 在MedMCQA和MedAraBench上评估两个7B开源模型，原始概率过度自信，温度缩放可去除82%–93%校准误差，保形预测达到名义覆盖率。
key_points: Qwen英语准确率0.561，阿拉伯语0.430
温度缩放大幅降低期望校准误差
低准确率时保形预测集合较大
reason: 规范的不确定性评估但模型小、仅考试题，增量性质
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted. I study the calibration and uncertainty of two open-weight models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Jais-adapted-7B-chat (both run in 4-bit precision), on 2,816 English multiple-choice questions from MedMCQA and 4,927 Arabic multiple-choice questions from MedAraBench. Accuracy was 0.561 (English) and 0.430 (Arabic) for Qwen, and 0.369 and 0.308 for Jais. Raw option probabilities were overconfident in all four settings (expected calibration error 0.242 to 0.486), and a single temperature parameter removed 82% to 93% of that error. Split conformal prediction reached its nominal coverage in all 24 settings I tested (within 0.006), but the sets were large when accuracy was low: at 90% coverage, temperature-scaled sets contained on average 63% (Qwen, English), 78% (Qwen, Arabic), 86% (Jais, English) and 89% (Jais, Arabic) of the options. The margin between the top two option probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers best for Qwen on English (AUROC 0.734) and worst for Jais on Arabic (0.579). Answering only the 20% most confident questions lowered Qwen's English error from 0.439 to 0.098. Jais showed a strong prior for option C (49% of English and 60% of Arabic predictions). Scoring Latin letters only cut the Arabic share to 29% but left accuracy, raw ECE and AUROC nearly unchanged. Because the two benchmarks differ in subject, level and number of options, I do not attribute differences between languages to language itself. Code is available at https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地接受医学考试题测试，但仅凭准确率无法说明何时可以信任某个答案。我研究了两个开放权重模型——Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Jais-adapted-7B-chat（均以 4 位精度运行）——在来自 MedMCQA 的 2,816 道英文多选题和来自 MedAraBench 的 4,927 道阿拉伯文多选题上的校准与不确定性。Qwen 的准确率在英文和阿拉伯文上分别为 0.561 和 0.430，Jais 分别为 0.369 和 0.308。原始选项概率在全部四种设置中均过度自信（期望校准误差为 0.242 至 0.486），而单个温度参数可消除其中 82% 至 93% 的误差。分割共形预测（split conformal prediction）在我测试的全部 24 种设置中均达到了名义覆盖率（偏差在 0.006 以内），但当准确率较低时预测集较大：在 90% 覆盖率下，经温度缩放的预测集平均包含选项总数的 63%（Qwen，英文）、78%（Qwen，阿拉伯文）、86%（Jais，英文）和 89%（Jais，阿拉伯文）。前两名选项概率之间的差值（margin）对区分正确与错误答案的效果，在 Qwen 英文上最好（AUROC 0.734），在 Jais 阿拉伯文上最差（0.579）。仅回答置信度最高的 20% 问题时，Qwen 的英文错误率从 0.439 降至 0.098。Jais 表现出对选项 C 的强烈先验偏好（英文预测的 49%、阿拉伯文预测的 60%）。仅对拉丁字母评分可将阿拉伯文中的这一比例降至 29%，但准确率、原始 ECE 和 AUROC 几乎不变。由于两个基准在学科、难度层级和选项数量上存在差异，我不将语言间的差异归因于语言本身。代码见 https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty。

title: Ontology-Based SEA-CDM Integration for Vaccine Clinical Trials: Query, Similarity, and Design Recommendation
zh_title: 面向疫苗临床试验的本体驱动SEA-CDM整合：查询、相似度与设计推荐
summary: 从AACT提取9,147条疫苗试验记录，映射到SEA-CDM并关联疫苗与不良事件本体，构建Neo4j知识图谱并评估三类应用。
key_points: 提取9,147条疫苗相关研究记录
链接Vaccine Ontology与OAE
构建关系表与Neo4j知识图谱
reason: 知识图谱整合方法，证据有限的预印本，增量档
abstract: ClinicalTrials.gov provides valuable information for vaccine research, but fragmented data structures and inconsistent vaccine naming complicate systematic cross-trial analysis. The Study-ExperimentAssay Common Data Model (SEA-CDM) provides a standardized structure for biomedical study data, while biomedical ontologies supply semantic relationships among concepts. We extracted 9,147 vaccinerelated study records from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov (AACT) database, mapped their records into SEA-CDM, and linked vaccine products and reported adverse events (AEs) to the Vaccine Ontology (VO) and Ontology of Adverse Events (OAE), respectively. Building on the existing Ontology-based SEA Network (OSEAN), we organized the integrated data into relational tables and a Neo4j knowledge graph while retaining links to original registrations. We evaluated three applications to assess semantic trial retrieval, context-aware AE ranking and trial similarity, and trial design recommendation. First, VO-based query expansion retrieved 41 candidate RNA vaccine trials compared with 16 using exact VO identifier matching. Second, a context-aware AE ranking model incorporating SEA-CDM features and VO-derived vaccine families improved recall@10 from 0.317 to 0.383 over a frequency-based baseline. TransE and CompGCN embeddings achieved Hits@10 of 0.950 and 0.946, respectively, for retrieving trials sharing the same VO identifier within disease-specific candidate sets. Third, an ontology-based clinical trial design recommendation model was developed using several machine learning methods under leave-one-Material-out evaluation across 23 vaccine classes, although performance varied across classes. These findings demonstrate how structural and semantic integration can support multiple clinical trial analyses using vaccine studies as a case study. This framework provides a foundation for extending ontology-supported data integration and analysis to other clinical research domains.

title: Spatial multi-omic profiling of non-autonomous transcriptomic and epigenomic responses to genetic perturbation
zh_title: 空间多组学解析基因扰动的非自主转录与表观响应
summary: 提出Perturb-Tags空间多组学技术，在完整组织中联合测量单核表达、gRNA、染色质可及性与空间位置。
key_points: 空间条形码标记细胞核用于CRISPR池筛
同时获得转录组与染色质可及性
细胞分辨率，灵敏度高于既往空间扰动方法
reason: 主要为实验技术，AI成分不明显，预印本
abstract: Multicellular organisms develop and maintain differentiated cell states through a combination of cell-autonomous and non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms, including signal transduction pathways mediated by ligands, receptors, and kinases. Genetic perturbation through CRISPR pooled screening is widely used to study cell-autonomous regulatory mechanisms, but the challenges of cellular-resolution in situ measurement have limited the study of non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms. We developed Perturb-Tags, a spatial multi-omic technique for pooled CRISPR screening that tags nuclei with spatial barcodes, allowing joint measurement of single-nucleus gene expression, CRISPR guide RNAs, chromatin accessibility, and spatial positions within intact tissue. Perturb-Tags achieves cellular-resolution, unbiased gene expression and multi-omic profiling, and higher sensitivity than previous spatial perturbation approaches. We used Perturb-Tags to systematically perturb ligands, receptors, and all expressed kinases in human embryoid bodies. These experiments revealed extensive non-autonomous gene expression changes after perturbation, including distance-dependent loss of signaling pathway activity upon ligand knockdown, compensatory upregulation of alternative signaling pathways, and responses to receptor and kinase knockdown that vary with cell microenvironment. We also identified changes in the spatial organization of cells with ligand and kinase knockdowns. Finally, we trained a graph neural network to model the combined effects of genetic perturbations on gene expression and chromatin accessibility across an entire tissue. Our work provides a powerful experimental and computational platform for mechanistic studies of non-autonomous regulatory mechanisms across healthy and diseased tissues.
zh_abstract: 多细胞生物通过细胞自主和非自主调控机制的结合来发育并维持分化的细胞状态，这些机制包括由配体、受体和激酶介导的信号转导通路。通过CRISPR混合筛选进行的遗传扰动被广泛用于研究细胞自主调控机制，但在细胞分辨率下进行原位测量的挑战限制了对非自主调控机制的研究。我们开发了Perturb-Tags，这是一种用于CRISPR混合筛选的空间多组学技术，它用空间条形码标记细胞核，从而能够在完整组织内联合测量单核基因表达、CRISPR向导RNA、染色质可及性和空间位置。Perturb-Tags实现了细胞分辨率、无偏倚的基因表达和多组学分析，且灵敏度高于以往的空间扰动方法。我们利用Perturb-Tags对人类拟胚体中的配体、受体和所有表达的激酶进行了系统性扰动。这些实验揭示了扰动后广泛的非自主基因表达变化，包括配体敲低后信号通路活性随距离而丧失、替代信号通路的代偿性上调，以及对受体和激酶敲低的反应随细胞微环境而异。我们还发现了配体和激酶敲低后细胞空间组织的变化。最后，我们训练了一个图神经网络，用于模拟遗传扰动对整个组织中基因表达和染色质可及性的综合影响。我们的工作为在健康和患病组织中研究非自主调控机制提供了一个强大的实验与计算平台。

title: Do Rule-Derived Labels Improve Prediction When Reported Labels Are Limited? A Two-Site Machine Learning Study
zh_title: 标签有限时规则衍生标签能否提升预测：双中心研究
summary: 在斯坦福与UT西南两个电子病历数据集上，探索规则衍生弱标签在已报告标签稀缺时对大肠杆菌尿培养耐药预测的作用。
key_points: 预测头孢吡肟等药物的非敏感性
设置10%至100%的标签预算比较
使用逻辑回归与梯度提升模型
reason: 双中心探索性预印本，结果未知，属增量档
abstract: **Background.** Rule derived (weak) labels can enlarge a training set when reported labels are scarce. Their value depends on label quality, on how the extra records shift the training distribution, and on whether the comparison accounts for reported labels set aside for tuning or calibration. **Methods.** We ran an exploratory label-budget experiment on *Escherichia coli* urine cultures from two de-identified electronic health record datasets: Stanford ARMD and UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW. The task was to predict reported non-susceptibility to cefepime, cefoxitin and ceftazidime (Stanford) and to cefepime and ceftazidime (UT Southwestern). Reported-label budgets of 10%, 25%, 50% and 100% of development patients were drawn over five patient-disjoint outer splits. Logistic regression and histogram gradient boosting were trained with reported labels only, or with added rule-derived labels using equal weights, a tuning-selected weight, class-proportion adjustment or prior-probability correction. These were compared with an all-budget reported-only baseline that used every budgeted reported label for training. Stanford used the inferred labels released with the dataset and a feature set including resistance history. UT Southwestern used researcher-derived labels from Stanford rule text, which were not validated for that site, and an age-only primary model. Brier-score differences were assessed with paired patient-cluster bootstrap intervals. **Results.** All rule-derived labels were susceptible. Equal-weight augmentation lowered mean predicted risk well below observed prevalence (for example, Stanford cefepime at the 10% budget: 0.35% versus 4.85%) and had a higher Brier score than the all-budget baseline in every drug, model and budget summary. The tuning-selected weight did not consistently improve on the all-budget baseline. Its median Brier difference was positive in 38 of 40 drug, model and budget summaries. Its paired intervals lay above zero in 100 of 296 Stanford analyses and 31 of 198 UT Southwestern analyses, and below zero in 3 and 5. The tuning set often selected a weight of zero (146 of 296 and 153 of 198 analyses). At UT Southwestern, the age-only models showed little discrimination (median AUROC 0.49 to 0.54), so those comparisons mainly reflect calibration. **Conclusions.** Under these designs, rule-derived labels did not consistently improve probability prediction over a reported-only model that used the whole reported-label budget for training.
zh_abstract: 【背景】当已报告的标签稀缺时，规则衍生（弱）标签可扩充训练集。其价值取决于标签质量、额外记录如何改变训练分布，以及比较时是否考虑了为调参或校准而留出的已报告标签。【方法】我们基于两个去标识化电子健康记录数据集——Stanford ARMD和UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW——中的大肠埃希菌（*Escherichia coli*）尿培养，开展了一项探索性标签预算实验。任务是预测对头孢吡肟、头孢西丁和头孢他啶（Stanford）以及对头孢吡肟和头孢他啶（UT Southwestern）的已报告不敏感。在5个患者互不重叠的外部划分上，分别抽取开发集患者10%、25%、50%和100%的已报告标签预算。逻辑回归和直方图梯度提升仅用已报告标签训练，或加入规则衍生标签训练，加入时采用等权重、调参选定权重、类别比例调整或先验概率校正。这些方法与“全预算仅已报告标签”基线（将预算内所有已报告标签均用于训练）进行比较。Stanford使用随数据集发布的推断标签，以及包含耐药史的特征集。UT Southwestern使用研究者根据Stanford规则文本衍生的标签（这些标签未在该机构验证）和仅含年龄的主模型。Brier评分差异采用配对的患者聚类自助法区间评估。【结果】所有规则衍生标签均为敏感。等权重扩充使平均预测风险远低于观测患病率（例如Stanford头孢吡肟在10%预算下：0.35%对4.85%），并且在每个药物、模型和预算的汇总中，其Brier评分均高于全预算基线。调参选定权重并未持续优于全预算基线：在40个药物、模型和预算汇总中，有38个的Brier差异中位数为正。其配对区间在Stanford的296项分析中有100项、在UT Southwestern的198项分析中有31项位于零以上，位于零以下的分别为3项和5项。调参集常选定权重为零（分别为296项中的146项和198项中的153项）。在UT Southwestern，仅含年龄的模型几乎没有区分能力（AUROC中位数0.49至0.54），因此这些比较主要反映校准情况。【结论】在这些设计下，与将全部已报告标签预算用于训练的仅已报告标签模型相比，规则衍生标签并未持续改善概率预测。

title: Sepsis in 2026: from bundles to biology. A critical review.
source: PubMed · Revista espanola de quimioterapia : publicacion oficial de la Sociedad Espanola de Quimioterapia
zh_title: 2026年脓毒症：从集束化到生物学的批判性综述
summary: 综述指出脓毒症标准化集束措施获益或近上限，AI、宿主反应生物标志物与快速微生物诊断有望缩短有效干预时间。
key_points: 2026版SSC更新强调早识别与及时抗菌
脓毒症异质性是标准化措施的核心局限
AI等手段为缩短干预时间提供新机会
reason: 综述类，AI仅为其中一部分，属增量档
abstract: [Revista espanola de quimioterapia : publicacion oficial de la Sociedad Espanola de Quimioterapia] Sepsis remains associated with a substantial burden of morbidity and mortality despite more than two decades of Surviving Sepsis Campaign (SSC) recommendations. The 2026 update reinforces early recognition, resuscitation, timely antimicrobial therapy, source control, and reassessment, yet the benefit of increasingly intensive implementation of standardized measures may be approaching a ceiling. A central limitation is treating sepsis as a homogeneous entity despite the wide variation in etiologies, host susceptibility, immune responses, and clinical trajectories. Artificial intelligence, host-response biomarkers, rapid microbiological diagnosis, and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic optimization provide new opportunities to shorten the time to effective intervention. In parallel, transcriptomic, genomic, and routine clinical data can identify subphenotypes and endotypes associated with different prognoses and potentially different treatment responses. Secondary analyses of clinical trials illustrate how an intervention that is neutral overall may be beneficial in biologically defined subgroups. The next step should combine SSC bundles with biological stratification, adaptive trial designs, and point-of-care tools capable of matching treatment to patient profile in real time. This review proposes a transition from standardized sepsis management toward precision medicine: the right treatment for the right patient at the right time.

title: Self-reported artificial intelligence use, knowledge, and perceptions among undergraduate medical students at a Peruvian university.
zh_title: 秘鲁某大学本科医学生AI使用、知识与认知的自报调查
summary: 2024年在秘鲁一所大学开展横断面问卷调查，分析278名医学生的AI使用情况、知识与认知。

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in medical education, yet evidence regarding its actual use, knowledge, and perceptions among undergraduate medical students in Peru remains limited. This study aimed to estimate the prevalence of self-reported AI use for academic activities and to describe patterns of use, self-reported knowledge, and perceptions among undergraduate medical students at a Peruvian university, with an exploratory assessment of associated characteristics. We conducted an observational, analytical, cross-sectional study in 2024 among students enrolled at Universidad Ricardo Palma. A total of 279 responses were received; one respondent did not provide informed consent and was excluded, leaving 278 participants for analysis. Data were collected using an adapted online questionnaire based on previously published instruments. AI use was assessed through a separate yes/no question regarding previous use of any AI tool. Overall, 257 of 278 participants (92.4%) reported previous AI use for academic activities. Most participants self-reported basic knowledge of AI principles (89.2%) and awareness of its use in medicine (95.3%). Among the predefined AI-tool categories, ChatGPT (69.1%) and Canva (19.8%) were the most frequently reported. The primary contribution of this study is descriptive, documenting the prevalence and patterns of AI use, self-reported knowledge, and perceptions in the surveyed population. Secondary exploratory regression analyses suggested associations with daily digital-device use and perceptions regarding treatment planning, but these estimates should be interpreted cautiously because only 21 participants were classified as non-users. These findings highlight the need for structured education addressing critical, ethical, and responsible AI use in undergraduate medical training.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 人工智能（AI）在医学教育中的应用日益增多，但关于秘鲁医学本科生实际使用、知识和认知方面的证据仍然有限。本研究旨在估计自我报告的将AI用于学业活动的患病率，描述秘鲁某大学医学本科生的使用模式、自我报告的知识和认知，并对相关特征进行探索性评估。我们于2024年在Universidad Ricardo Palma在读学生中开展了一项观察性、分析性横断面研究。共收到279份回复；1名受访者未提供知情同意而被排除，最终278名参与者纳入分析。数据通过基于已发表工具改编的在线问卷收集。AI使用情况通过一个关于既往是否使用过任何AI工具的单独是/否问题进行评估。总体而言，278名参与者中有257人（92.4%）报告既往将AI用于学业活动。大多数参与者自我报告具备AI原理的基础知识（89.2%）并了解其在医学中的应用（95.3%）。在预先定义的AI工具类别中，ChatGPT（69.1%）和Canva（19.8%）是最常被报告的。本研究的主要贡献是描述性的，记录了被调查人群中AI使用的患病率和模式、自我报告的知识及认知。次要的探索性回归分析提示，AI使用与每日数字设备使用及对治疗计划的认知存在关联，但由于仅有21名参与者被归为非使用者，这些估计值应谨慎解读。这些发现凸显了在医学本科培训中开展针对批判性、符合伦理且负责任地使用AI的系统性教育的必要性。

title: Unsupervised AI-assisted self-medication: a cross-sectional survey.
source: PubMed · Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy
zh_title: 无监督的AI辅助自我药疗：横断面调查
summary: 对叙利亚255名成人的在线调查显示，自我药疗率为80.8%，30.6%未经处方使用抗生素，并评估其使用AI获取用药信息的情况。
key_points: 255名成人，2026年2–3月在线调查
80.8%报告自我药疗
同时评估AI信任、药师偏好与隐私意识
reason: 小样本横断面问卷，无对照，增量档
abstract: [Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy] Self-medication is common worldwide and increasingly informed by artificial intelligence (AI) tools, but their intersection is understudied, particularly in conflict-affected settings such as Syria. To assess self-medication among adults living in Syria and their use of AI tools for medication-related information. An online cross-sectional survey of 255 adults (22 February-7 March 2026) assessed self-medication, AI use, trust, pharmacist-AI preferences, and privacy awareness. Analyses comprised descriptive statistics, chi-square tests with Cramér's V, and exploratory principal component analysis (PCA; n = 86 complete cases) with a sensitivity analysis (n = 149). Self-medication was reported by 80.8% of respondents, without a sex difference (p = 0.579), and 30.6% used antibiotics without prescription. AI tools were used for health queries by 61.6% (ChatGPT by 45.5% of all respondents), more often by younger (p = 0.002) and more educated respondents (p < 0.001). Among AI users, 66.2% asked medication-related questions, 68.2% trusted AI information conditionally, and 59.2% preferred pharmacists; in 16 of 17 disagreements, the pharmacist's advice was followed. PCA identified self-medication intensity, health literacy, and AI engagement components; the first two were reproduced in the sensitivity analysis, whereas a weak link between adverse drug reactions and AI engagement was not. In this digitally connected sample, AI-assisted health information seeking was common and coexisted with frequent self-medication and non-prescribed antibiotic use. These cross-sectional associations support digital health literacy initiatives, safeguards within AI platforms, and pharmacist engagement with AI-informed patients.

title: Beyond Binary Classification: Multiclass Machine Learning for Diabetes and Prediabetes Risk Prediction Using NHANES
zh_title: 基于NHANES的糖尿病与糖尿病前期多分类风险预测
summary: 利用15,356名成人的NHANES数据，比较传统机器学习与Transformer模型对正常、糖尿病前期、糖尿病的三分类预测，标签用HbA1c定义但不入特征。
key_points: 15,356名成人，排除HbA1c以防泄漏
比较传统ML与Transformer模型
采用留出测试集评估
reason: 公开调查数据、无外部验证，增量档
abstract: Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes. We develop a supervised learning framework to classify adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data. The framework uses routinely collected demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables from 15,356 adults, with glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) used only to define labels and excluded from input features to prevent leakage. We compare conventional machine learning and transformer-based models and examine two binary formulations: normal versus prediabetes, and normal versus combined prediabetes and diabetes. Models are evaluated on a held-out test set using precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 score. In the multiclass setting, performance is broadly consistent across models, with accuracy up to 0.72 and macro-averaged F1 of 0.70. Prediabetes remains the most challenging class, with F1 scores of 0.54 to 0.56 for conventional models and 0.53 to 0.55 for transformers, reflecting its overlap with both neighboring states. When the task is reduced to normal versus prediabetes, F1 scores rise modestly to 0.62 to 0.64. A more substantial improvement is observed under a broader screening formulation combining prediabetes and diabetes, with F1 scores of 0.73 to 0.74 across all models. These findings suggest that feature overlap along the biological continuum between normal and diabetic states contributes more to the difficulty of prediabetes detection than model architecture. Multiclass prediction provides a more clinically informative representation of metabolic risk progression but highlights a trade-off between clinically meaningful stratification and predictive accuracy.

title: ALMeD: Medieval French Gold-Standard
zh_title: ALMeD：中世纪法语医学文本黄金标准语料
summary: 发布在建的中世纪法语医学与外科论著语义标注语料，用于补足以文学和法律文本为主的现有资源（预印本）。
key_points: 涵盖古法语、中古法语及盎格鲁-诺曼语
语义消歧的黄金标准
目前为进行中的工作
reason: 小众历史语料，在建，与临床关系弱
abstract: Medieval French is one of the Romance vernacular languages with a significant history of transmission and an enormous influence on other vernacular languages of the time. The sources convey valuable knowledge about all aspects of culture. The study of Medieval French has, over the last few years, increasingly benefited from NLP-based methods. There have been numerous efforts to parse medieval French; however, these efforts use corpora comprising legal texts and -- primarily -- literary texts as their foundation and training data. This means that, except for juridical resources, scientific literature is overlooked. We present ALMeD, an annotated, semantically rich corpus (work-in-progress) of medical and surgical treatises produced in medieval French, i.e., Old and Middle French, including Anglo-Norman. Our semantically disambiguated gold standard goes beyond existing resources, focusing on medical terminology, and accounts for morphological development, evolving syntactical structures and the lack of spelling normalisation in these languages.
zh_abstract: 中古法语是罗曼语族的一种方言（俗语），有着重要的传承历史，并对当时的其他方言产生了巨大影响。这些文献资料传达了关于文化各方面的宝贵知识。近年来，中古法语研究越来越多地受益于基于自然语言处理（NLP）的方法。已有大量工作致力于对中古法语进行句法分析；然而，这些工作以法律文本以及——主要是——文学文本构成的语料库作为基础和训练数据。这意味着，除司法资料外，科学文献被忽视了。我们提出 ALMeD，这是一个经过标注、语义丰富的中古法语（即古法语和中古法语，包括盎格鲁-诺曼语）医学与外科论著语料库（进行中的工作）。我们经过语义消歧的金标准超越了现有资源，聚焦于医学术语，并兼顾这些语言的形态演变、不断变化的句法结构以及拼写缺乏规范化的情况。

title: Subject-Held-Out Evaluation of Deep Ground Reaction Force Estimators Across Two Laboratories: Leakage and Cross-Laboratory Transfer
zh_title: 跨两实验室的地面反作用力深度估计器受试者留出评估
summary: 在两个独立数据集上比较三种序列模型，评估试验级划分导致的数据泄漏及跨实验室迁移。
key_points: 试验级划分会高估受试者留出的R²
比较卷积、卷积-循环、卷积-Transformer模型
样本仅6人与10人，检验跨实验室迁移
reason: 样本很小的方法学评估，增量档
abstract: Deep networks that estimate ground reaction forces and centers of pressure from motion-capture markers are validated within one laboratory, in a seldom-stated coordinate frame, and sometimes with trial-level splits that put the same person in the training and the test set. We measured what each practice costs, and whether such models transfer between laboratories. Three sequence models (convolutional, convolutional-recurrent, and convolutional-transformer) were evaluated on two independent datasets, locomotion (6 subjects) and occupational patient handling (10 subjects), under one pipeline, one tuning procedure, three seeds, and four protocols: trial-level split, leave-one-subject-out, pooled two-laboratory training with matched held-out subjects, and cross-laboratory transfer. At a fixed configuration, trial-level splits overstated the subject-held-out coefficient of determination by +0.040 to +0.194; on occupational data the overstatement exceeded every difference between architectures. With subjects held out, the three models reached values between 0.583 and 0.804; the leader differed between datasets, and gaps lay within subject-to-subject variability. Pooling the laboratories changed neither dataset on matched subjects. Transfer between laboratories was below chance in both directions, including the vertical force, which no in-plane rotation can affect. Leaving force targets in the plate frame while inputs were heading-aligned cost 0.57 of locomotion anteroposterior-force explained variance, enough to make that force look hardest; a Newton's-law correlation detected the mismatch before training. Split protocol and target frame changed reported accuracy more than architecture did. Learned force estimators should be validated with subjects held out, checked for frame consistency before training, and tested across laboratories before deployment claims are made.
zh_abstract: 根据动作捕捉标记点估计地面反作用力和压力中心的深度网络，通常在单一实验室内验证，所用坐标系很少明确说明，有时还采用试次层面的数据划分，使同一人同时出现在训练集和测试集中。我们衡量了每种做法的代价，以及此类模型能否在不同实验室之间迁移。在统一的流程、统一的调参程序、三个随机种子和四种方案下，我们在两个独立数据集——运动（6 名受试者）和职业性患者搬运（10 名受试者）——上评估了三种序列模型（卷积、卷积-循环和卷积-Transformer）。四种方案为：试次层面划分、留一受试者交叉验证、两实验室合并训练并匹配留出受试者，以及跨实验室迁移。在固定配置下，试次层面划分使留出受试者的决定系数被高估 +0.040 至 +0.194；在职业数据上，这一高估超过了各架构之间的所有差异。在留出受试者的条件下，三种模型的取值介于 0.583 和 0.804 之间；表现领先的模型在不同数据集间不同，且差距处于受试者间变异范围之内。合并两个实验室对匹配受试者上的任一数据集均无改变。实验室之间的迁移在两个方向上均低于随机水平，包括任何平面内旋转都无法影响的垂直力。当输入按朝向对齐而力目标仍保留在测力板坐标系时，运动数据前后向力的可解释方差损失 0.57，足以使该方向的力看起来最难估计；基于牛顿定律的相关性检验在训练前即可发现这种不匹配。数据划分方案和目标坐标系对所报告准确度的影响大于架构。学习型力估计器应在留出受试者的条件下验证，在训练前检查坐标系一致性，并在提出部署主张之前进行跨实验室测试。

title: Robot-Induced Bias in Movement Smoothness Metrics for Rehabilitation: Quantification and Correction in Simulation
zh_title: 康复中机器人引起的运动平滑度指标偏差：仿真量化与校正
summary: 通过校准至已发表卒中与健康组运动学的人机闭环仿真，量化机器人力学对七项平滑度指标的偏差。
key_points: LDLJ中位偏差：卒中0.93、健康1.79基准单位
库仑摩擦和表观质量是主要贡献因素
偏差在11种稳健性变体中持续存在
reason: 仅仿真研究、非AI核心，增量档
abstract: Robot mechanics can bias kinematic measures of recovery and limit comparisons across rehabilitation devices. We developed a closed-loop human-robot simulation calibrated to published healthy and stroke group kinematics. Paired runs held motor-control parameters and movement plans fixed to quantify bias in seven metrics relative to a low-impedance reference, normalized using external repeatability benchmarks. Within a subset informed by published device specifications, median log dimensionless jerk (LDLJ) bias was 0.93 and 1.79 benchmark units for stroke and healthy profiles, respectively. Sobol analysis identified Coulomb friction and apparent mass as leading contributors; LDLJ bias persisted across 11 robustness variants. LDLJ bias increased as simulated movements became less fragmented. If recovery similarly reduces fragmentation, this effect could partly mask improvement in measured smoothness. Correction combining identified robot dynamics and observed metrics with gradient-boosted trees reduced median normalized absolute error from 0.77 to 0.10 for LDLJ and from 0.24 to 0.08 for spectral arc length (SPARC) in the device-informed subset of a random 20% hold-out. Median smoothness residuals remained at or below 0.15 benchmark units across four separately held-out parameter regions. Under an alternative controller, LDLJ error decreased from 1.60 to 0.17 without retraining, although transfer varied across metrics. These simulation results support mechanical characterization and movement-dependent correction toward more comparable robotic assessments, motivating validation in patients.
zh_abstract: 机器人力学特性可能使恢复的运动学测量产生偏差，并限制不同康复设备之间的比较。我们开发了一个闭环人-机器人仿真，并根据已发表的健康人群和卒中人群组的运动学数据进行了校准。配对运行保持运动控制参数和运动计划不变，以量化七项指标相对于低阻抗参照的偏差，并使用外部重复性基准进行归一化。在依据已发表设备规格选取的子集中，卒中和健康特征下对数无量纲加加速度（LDLJ）偏差的中位数分别为 0.93 和 1.79 个基准单位。Sobol 分析确定库仑摩擦和表观质量为主要贡献因素；LDLJ 偏差在 11 种稳健性变体中持续存在。随着仿真运动的碎片化程度降低，LDLJ 偏差增大。如果恢复同样会降低碎片化程度，这一效应可能部分掩盖所测平滑度的改善。将已识别的机器人动力学与观测指标相结合并采用梯度提升树进行校正后，在随机 20% 留出集的设备依据子集中，LDLJ 的归一化绝对误差中位数从 0.77 降至 0.10，频谱弧长（SPARC）从 0.24 降至 0.08。在四个单独留出的参数区域中，平滑度残差中位数均保持在 0.15 个基准单位或以下。在另一种控制器下，无需重新训练，LDLJ 误差从 1.60 降至 0.17，但不同指标间的迁移情况有所不同。这些仿真结果支持开展力学特性表征和依赖运动的校正，以实现更具可比性的机器人评估，并提示需要在患者中进行验证。

title: Normalized membrane ratio of TROP2 as a predictor of clinical outcomes with datopotamab deruxtecan in non-small-cell lung cancer
zh_title: TROP2归一化膜比值预测NSCLC中Dato-DXd临床结局
summary: 开发全监督计算病理方法TROP2 QCS，量化肿瘤细胞膜与胞质TROP2，提出归一化膜比值（NMR）用于预测Dato-DXd疗效。
key_points: 传统IHC目视评分无法预测TROP2 ADC疗效

reason: Nature Medicine计算病理预测治疗反应，关联临床试验结局，属重要档；摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd)—a trophoblast cell surface antigen 2 (TROP2)-directed antibody–drug conjugate—has demonstrated efficacy in patients with advanced nonsquamous non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ± actionable genomic alterations. However, TROP2 expression by pathologist assessment using conventional immunohistochemistry with visual scoring does not predict response to TROP2-directed antibody–drug conjugates in NSCLC. We developed TROP2 quantitative continuous scoring (QCS)—a fully supervised computational pathology approach that quantifies TROP2 expression in individual NSCLC cells and subcellular components from immunohistochemistry-stained slides. Using QCS to determine TROP2 expression at the tumor cell membrane and cytoplasm, normalized membrane ratio (NMR) was developed (ratio of membrane relative to membrane + cytoplasmic TROP2) in the biomarker-evaluable population of patients with advanced NSCLC in the TROPION-PanTumor01 study (n = 115). The TROP2 NMR cut-point was optimized and validated in patients with nonsquamous NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations (primary intended-use population, n = 221) in the biomarker-evaluable population (n = 352) of the TROPION-Lung01 trial. Association with clinical outcomes was assessed. Progression-free survival was longer in Dato-DXd-treated (median 7.2 versus 4.0 months; hazard ratio 0.40, 95% confidence interval 0.25–0.64) but not docetaxel-treated (median 4.1 versus 4.4 months; hazard ratio 0.94, 95% confidence interval 0.59–1.49) patients with TROP2 NMR-positive versus TROP2 NMR-negative samples (treatment by biomarker status interaction P = 0.0098), indicating that TROP2 NMR may be a predictive biomarker for Dato-DXd.
zh_abstract: Datopotamab deruxtecan（Dato-DXd）是一种靶向滋养层细胞表面抗原2（TROP2）的抗体偶联药物，已在伴或不伴可干预基因组改变的晚期非鳞状非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中显示出疗效。然而，采用常规免疫组织化学结合目测评分、由病理医师评估的TROP2表达，并不能预测NSCLC患者对TROP2靶向抗体偶联药物的反应。我们开发了TROP2定量连续评分（quantitative continuous scoring，QCS）——一种完全监督式的计算病理学方法，可在免疫组织化学染色切片上对单个NSCLC细胞及其亚细胞结构中的TROP2表达进行定量。利用QCS测定肿瘤细胞膜和细胞质中的TROP2表达，在TROPION-PanTumor01研究中可进行生物标志物评估的晚期NSCLC患者人群（n = 115）中建立了标准化膜比值（normalized membrane ratio，NMR，即膜TROP2相对于膜+细胞质TROP2的比值）。在TROPION-Lung01试验可进行生物标志物评估的人群（n = 352）中，针对无可干预基因组改变的非鳞状NSCLC患者（主要预期使用人群，n = 221），对TROP2 NMR截断值进行了优化和验证，并评估了其与临床结局的关联。在接受Dato-DXd治疗的患者中，TROP2 NMR阳性样本患者相比TROP2 NMR阴性样本患者的无进展生存期更长（中位7.2个月对4.0个月；风险比0.40，95%置信区间0.25–0.64）；而在接受多西他赛治疗的患者中则无此差异（中位4.1个月对4.4个月；风险比0.94，95%置信区间0.59–1.49）（治疗与生物标志物状态交互作用P = 0.0098），提示TROP2 NMR可能是Dato-DXd的预测性生物标志物。

key_points: 整合肿瘤-基质界面特征与空间自相关

reason: 新方法有一定新意，但为预测性分析，摘要未见临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment remains a major obstacle to precision oncology. Although existing drug-sensitivity models can capture transcriptional heterogeneity, they generally do not account for the spatial organization of predicted drug responses. Here, we developed DeepTNR, a spatially resolved framework that integrates tumor-stroma interface features, spatial autocorrelation, and distance-dependent associations between local cellular composition and predicted drug sensitivity. Across nine tumor types, with colorectal cancer (CRC) as a representative example, DeepTNR identified irinotecan as the most sensitive drug and revealed significant spatial autocorrelation in its predicted response patterns. Spatial proximity effect analysis further showed that local enrichment of immune and proliferative programs positively was associated with increased irinotecan sensitivity. Together, these findings demonstrate the potential of DeepTNR to resolve intratumoral therapeutic heterogeneity and identify niche-specific vulnerabilities.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤微环境内的异质性仍是精准肿瘤学的主要障碍。尽管现有的药物敏感性模型能够捕捉转录异质性，但它们通常未考虑预测药物反应的空间组织。在此，我们开发了 DeepTNR，这是一个空间分辨框架，整合了肿瘤-基质界面特征、空间自相关，以及局部细胞组成与预测药物敏感性之间随距离变化的关联。在九种肿瘤类型中，以结直肠癌（CRC）为代表性示例，DeepTNR 识别出伊立替康是最敏感的药物，并揭示其预测反应模式存在显著的空间自相关。空间邻近效应分析进一步表明，免疫和增殖程序的局部富集与伊立替康敏感性增加呈正相关。总之，这些发现表明 DeepTNR 具有解析肿瘤内治疗异质性并识别特定生态位易感性的潜力。

abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Clinical documentation is a major contributor to physician workload and burnout, particularly in high-acuity settings such as emergency departments. Ambient AI scribes have emerged as a response, but commercial products cost US $99 to more than US $600 per physician per month, operate as opaque systems, and often process data on vendor-controlled infrastructure. These characteristics limit organizational control over data sovereignty, quality improvement, and clinical workflows and create barriers to adoption in resource-constrained settings. We aimed to develop an open-source, modular AI scribe platform that could be deployed entirely within institutional infrastructure, and to evaluate its real-world use across a provincial health system. We developed Berta, an open-source, modular platform that pairs a Next.js front end and a FastAPI back end with configurable automatic speech recognition and large language model components. A closed-source implementation developed in parallel with Berta was deployed at Alberta Health Services (AHS), Canada's largest provincially integrated health system at the time of implementation, and operated within AHS's existing Snowflake AI Data Cloud infrastructure. All clinical audio and text remained within the secure AHS environment. Use and session metadata were automatically recorded during routine clinical use by emergency physicians across AHS between November 2024 and July 2025, and physicians were emailed an optional survey. Operating costs were estimated from Snowflake service consumption over the same period. During the 9-month study period, 197 emergency physicians registered at 105 urban and rural facilities used the system, generating 21,548 clinical sessions and more than 2700 hours of audio. Monthly session volume grew from 675 sessions in November 2024 to 5463 in July 2025. Mean recorded session length was 7.6 minutes, and 42% (82/197) of users customized at least 1 documentation template. Operating costs averaged less than US $30 per physician per month, representing a 70% to 95% reduction in cost compared with commercial subscription prices; this comparison excludes personnel costs for development and maintenance. Survey respondents (69-73 per item) rated user-friendliness as good (median 5, IQR 4-6), reported a median time saving of 16 to 30 (IQR 0-15 to 46-60) minutes per shift, and rated documentation quality the lowest. abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.
zh_abstract: 医学影像对于疾病诊断、指导治疗以及长期监测患者至关重要。尽管人工智能已推进了影像判读，但现有医学模型往往只处理有限的任务，而通用的专有模型则无法获取实现医学专业水平所需的私有临床影像。开发能够解读复杂检查并在临床决策背景下传达其发现的模型，仍然是一项重大挑战。在此，我们展示了Neuro-VL——一种基于常规临床诊疗中近一百万例神经影像检查训练的视觉-语言模型，能够解读完整的影像检查并就其发现进行自然语言对话。在内部和国际数据集中，Neuro-VL在诊断、定位和描述异常以及生成完整的放射学报告方面，均优于前沿通用模型和专门的医学模型。该模型还能比较系列检查以评估疾病进展，并且相比OpenAI和Google的领先前沿模型，能更可靠地抵御误导性的临床假设。这些结果将卫生系统学习从个体预测扩展到交互式影像判读和疾病的纵向监测。它们展示了如何利用卫生系统的集体临床经验来开发具有专业水平和广泛临床能力的医学AI。

abstract: Diagnostic scores of conventional ECG findings from ECG foundation models contain information relevant to the detection of ventricular dysfunction. These representations can be directly reused for low LVEF detection and further integrated into interpretable predictive models, providing a scalable and extensible computational framework for existing AI-ECG systems. Future research should validate the framework in population-based screening settings and larger international cohorts.

title: Speak before the reveal: a practical method to protect clinical reasoning from artificial intelligence scribe deskilling, never-skilling, and mis-skilling.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 先说后看：防止AI抄写员导致临床推理能力退化
summary: 该观点文章提出“先说后看”方法，让医生在生成病历前先口述综合判断与计划，以降低环境AI抄写员带来的技能退化、未养成与误习风险。
key_points: 指出现有治理多关注准确性、隐私与同意
区分去技能化、未技能化与误技能化
讨论培训实施、评估与治理策略
reason: 观点类文章，无实证数据，但关注AI抄写员的教育治理问题
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes are rapidly becoming normalized in clinical practice, yet governance frameworks focus on accuracy, privacy, consent, and medicolegal status. Risks to clinician capabilities have received less attention. Speak before the reveal is a proposed method in which clinicians verbalize critical cognitive steps, such as synthesis and plan, before note generation. Recent work distinguishes deskilling in senior clinicians, never-skilling from premature offload in trainees and mis-skilling, the internalization of AI errors and inappropriate use as sound practice. This Perspective builds on emerging evidence that reasoning before seeing AI output may protect unaided reasoning. Training implementation, evaluation, adherence challenges, validation methodology, and governance strategies for training bodies, health services, and scribe vendors are discussed. Speak before the reveal is a low-cost, testable approach to maintaining clinical reasoning for individuals or organizations. Successful AI scribe adoption requires preserving clinicians' ability to work without AI support.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 环境式人工智能（AI）抄录工具正迅速在临床实践中常态化，但相关治理框架主要关注准确性、隐私、知情同意和医疗法律地位，对临床医生能力所面临的风险关注较少。“揭示前先说”（Speak before the reveal）是一种拟议方法，即临床医生在生成病历之前，先口头表述关键的认知步骤，如综合分析和计划。近期研究区分了以下几种情形：资深临床医生的技能退化（deskilling）；学员因过早卸载认知任务而导致的从未习得技能（never-skilling）；以及错误习得技能（mis-skilling），即内化AI的错误并将不恰当的使用方式视为合理实践。本文为一篇观点性文章，基于越来越多的证据，即在查看AI输出之前先进行推理可能有助于保护独立推理能力。文中讨论了培训实施、评估、依从性挑战、验证方法，以及面向培训机构、医疗服务机构和抄录工具供应商的治理策略。“揭示前先说”是一种成本低、可检验的方法，可用于个人或机构维持临床推理能力。AI抄录工具的成功应用需要保持临床医生在无AI支持情况下工作的能力。

title: AI-monitored bioadhesive for sutureless microvascular anastomosis.
zh_title: AI监测的生物粘合剂用于无缝线微血管吻合
summary: Science研究提出微针互锁粘合系统，内置AI辅助无线传感器，可实时监测血流动力学并预测并发症。
