title: Deep learning-based identification and counting of early-stage follicles in rat ovaries.
zh_title: 深度学习识别并计数大鼠卵巢早期卵泡
summary: 针对H&E染色大鼠卵巢切片，开发全自动模型识别原始卵泡与早期生长卵泡，在200张全切片独立测试集上经病理医师验证。
key_points: 两个模型分别识别原始卵泡与早期生长卵泡
独立测试集含200张全切片图像
预测经病理医师验证，性能较高
reason: 动物毒理病理，有独立测试集但规模与影响有限
abstract: [Veterinary pathology] Counting ovarian early follicles helps assess the impact of pharmaceuticals and endocrine-disrupting chemicals on female fertility. Traditional manual counting methods are labor-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to intra- and interobserver variability, leading to inconsistent results. This study addresses these limitations by developing a fully automated solution for the identification and quantification of early-stage follicles in hematoxylin and eosin-stained rat ovarian sections, with the aim of enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and reproducibility. We developed a deep learning model designed to identify primordial type 1 and type 2 follicles, and a second model focusing on detecting early growing follicles. The automated system exhibited high performance on an independent test data set of 200 whole-slide images, whose predictions were validated by pathologists. The models achieved high precision and recall, with 98.49% and 90.92%, respectively, for type 1; 95.97% and 97.54% for type 2; and 99.45% and 80.09% for early growing follicles. Further comparisons with manual annotations performed by 4 independent pathologists revealed significant interobserver variability. While human performance was hindered by factors such as fatigue and inconsistent criteria application, resulting in variable precision and recall and high rates of missed follicles, the algorithm maintained superior consistency and overall higher F1-scores. Furthermore, a comparison between manual work and the algorithm's productivity showed that the algorithm was 11 times faster than manual quantification. These results demonstrate that the automated approach not only matches expert accuracy but also effectively eliminates subjectivity and diagnostic drift inherent in manual counting, providing a reproducible method for follicle counting, and significantly enhancing workflow efficiency.
zh_abstract: [兽医病理学] 卵巢早期卵泡计数有助于评估药物和内分泌干扰化学物质对女性生育力的影响。传统的人工计数方法费力、耗时，且存在观察者内和观察者间差异，导致结果不一致。本研究针对这些局限，开发了一种全自动解决方案，用于识别和定量苏木精-伊红染色的大鼠卵巢切片中的早期卵泡，旨在提高效率、准确性和可重复性。我们开发了一个用于识别原始卵泡1型和2型的深度学习模型，以及另一个专注于检测早期生长卵泡的模型。该自动化系统在包含200张全切片图像的独立测试数据集上表现出色，其预测结果经病理学家验证。模型取得了较高的精确率和召回率：1型分别为98.49%和90.92%；2型分别为95.97%和97.54%；早期生长卵泡分别为99.45%和80.09%。与4名独立病理学家进行的人工标注进一步比较显示，观察者间存在显著差异。人工表现受疲劳和标准应用不一致等因素影响，导致精确率和召回率不稳定，且漏检卵泡的比例较高，而该算法保持了更优的一致性和总体更高的F1分数。此外，人工工作与算法效率的比较表明，该算法比人工定量快11倍。这些结果表明，该自动化方法不仅可达到专家水平的准确性，还能有效消除人工计数中固有的主观性和诊断漂移，提供了一种可重复的卵泡计数方法，并显著提高了工作流程效率。

title: Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
zh_title: 环境 AI 记录员评估方法高度碎片化
summary: 对54项环境 AI 记录员评估研究的梳理发现，共有十个评估维度和40项指标，被操作化为96种方式，其中36%仅被单一研究使用。
key_points: 44/54项研究以文书效率和时间为主
安全性与临床结局的评估最不一致
缺乏统一的评估协议与标准化指标
reason: 有信息量的综述类研究，指出评估标准缺口，综述类上限6
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes have moved rapidly from experimental pilots to enterprise-wide deployment across health systems, promising reduced documentation burden and improved clinician experience. While research evaluating these tools has expanded quickly, there are no agreed-upon protocols or standardized metrics for assessing their performance, making it difficult to compare findings or cumulatively synthesize evidence across studies. Across 54 recent evaluation studies, we identify ten evaluation dimensions and 40 distinct metrics, operationalized in 96 different ways-35 of them (36%) used by only a single study. Assessment is dominated by documentation efficiency and time, measured in 44 of 54 studies. The other dimensions appear at broadly similar rates (16-24 studies each), and safety and clinical outcome least consistently of all. Ripple effects on the broader care system, such as impact on patients' care outcomes, redistribution of work, changes in billing and coding intensity, and downstream use of notes by other clinicians are rarely assessed. Moreover, the metrics used rely heavily on self-report and are fragmented and inconsistently operationalized, which limits comparability and hinders synthesis across studies. As an effort to support more rigorous and cumulative evaluation, in this paper we review the study designs, data sources, and metrics commonly used to evaluate ambient AI scribes in healthcare settings, discuss the limitations of current evaluation practice, and argue for a more holistic approach grounded in a standardized, multi-dimensional set of metrics.

title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
zh_title: EM-DETR示例引导的病灶检测基础模型
summary: 提出学生-教师策略整合异构标注的多域医学影像数据集，并在EM-DETR框架上构建多域病灶检测基础模型（预印本）。
key_points: 学生-教师训练合并异构标签空间
缓解灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习
基于示例引导的EM-DETR框架扩展
reason: 新方法预印本，基础检测模型方向，证据有限
abstract: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习（DL）的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在辅助临床医生方面展现出巨大潜力，但其性能在很大程度上依赖于大规模、标注良好的数据集。在医学病灶检测中，全面、标准化标注的稀缺以及现有数据集的异质性限制了稳健基础模型的发展。在本研究中，我们提出了一种构建多领域病灶检测基础模型的新方法，即整合同时标注了解剖结构和异常的多种医学影像数据集。我们首先提出一种学生-教师训练策略，以有效合并标签空间异质的数据集，缓解灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习。此外，在我们先前提出的基于示例的 EM-DETR 框架的基础上，我们对其进行改进，使其能够从多个特定领域数据集中联合学习，从而实现跨模态的细粒度、基于示例的检测。我们的模型取得了最先进（SOTA）的结果：在胸部X线片（CXR）的四项关键发现上，图像级 AUC 得分比之前的 SOTA 高出 1 个百分点。我们在 CXR 和乳腺X线摄影中取得了领先的 mAP50，比仅在单一数据集上训练的 EM-DETR 高出 2-3 个百分点。该方法为医学影像中可扩展的基础模型铺平了道路，使其能够利用异质数据，同时保持稳健且可泛化的性能。

title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
zh_title: 对比式发现：基于竞争性解释的开放式科学发现
summary: 提出以互斥且穷尽的竞争性解释集合替代单一假设，让LLM智能体按证据对信念的再分配来评分和收敛。
key_points: 现有智能体仅对假设与其补集做逐点检验
对比集合可用于重评已收集证据或引导搜索
在六个数据集上评测（摘要未给出更多细节）
reason: 科学发现智能体新方法，有评测但为预印本，与医疗关联较间接
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地用于开放式的、数据驱动的科学发现，但其中大多数以逐点方式评估假设，即仅将一个经验性论断 $h$ 与其补集 $\neg h$ 进行检验。当证据否定 $h$ 时，智能体只能得知某一种解释不太可能成立，却不知道证据支持哪一种替代解释。为了找回这一替代解释，我们提出对比式发现（Contrastive Discovery），用对比集取代单一假设；对比集由一个科学问题及一组互斥且穷尽的竞争性解释构成。每个实验依据其证据如何在该集合内重新分配信念来评分，当信念集中于某一种解释时，该问题即被解决。由于对比集只改变智能体提出和评分的单位，现有智能体可以利用它们对已收集的证据重新评估，或用以指导搜索。在六个领域中，信念变化最大的逐点候选假设里有 $89\%$ 为被否定的假设。在相同证据下，对比集将这些候选中的 $73\%$ 解析到了具体的替代解释。当由对比集指导搜索时，在相同实验预算下，智能体解决的问题比逐点惊奇度（surprisal）方法多 $67\%$。在一项盲法研究中，$38$ 名人类专家在 $78\%$ 的已解决问题上选择了相同的解释；在逐点智能体否定其假设并停止的问题中，这一比例为 $82\%$。综上，这些结果支持将显式的竞争性解释作为一种方式，使发现型智能体能在相同的证据和验证预算下解决更多科学问题。

title: Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
zh_title: 面向心血管疾病检测的偏差感知心电图预训练
summary: 提出基于近百万条无标注12导联心电图的自监督框架，含偏差定位与关联重建模块，报告AUROC最高提升6.5%。
key_points: 用近百万条无标注12导联心电图预训练
DLE检测波形偏差，ARE建模跨导联关联
AUROC最高提升6.5%，F1亦有提升
reason: 大规模自监督心电预训练，预印本，外部验证未明
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are critical for cardiovascular disease (CVD) detection. Most current deep learning models rely on supervised, task-specific training, which limits their ability to generalize across diseases, patient populations, and acquisition settings. This paper presents a self-supervised ECG feature extraction framework that learns from nearly one million unlabeled 12-lead ECG recordings. The framework includes two modules: Deviation Localization Embedding (DLE), which detects waveform-level deviations from normal patterns, and Association Reconstruction Embedding (ARE), which models cross-lead associations through deviation-guided reconstruction to capture abnormal patterns expressed across multiple leads. These modules enable the framework to capture subtle deviation-related patterns and their cross-lead context. The framework achieves up to 6.5% AUROC and 12.8% F1 improvements over prior methods on multiple public datasets, even without additional fine-tuning the pretrained feature extractor. Embedding visualizations show that the learned features support meaningful disease grouping and anomaly identification. The approach reduces the need for labeled data and can support clinicians in diverse healthcare settings. The framework has potential to improve early detection and monitoring of cardiovascular diseases, contributing to more accessible and equitable heart care.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）信号对心血管疾病（CVD）的检测至关重要。目前大多数深度学习模型依赖于有监督的、针对特定任务的训练，这限制了其在不同疾病、患者人群和采集环境之间的泛化能力。本文提出了一种自监督心电图特征提取框架，该框架从近一百万条未标注的12导联心电图记录中学习。该框架包含两个模块：偏差定位嵌入（Deviation Localization Embedding，DLE），用于检测波形层面偏离正常模式的情况；以及关联重建嵌入（Association Reconstruction Embedding，ARE），通过偏差引导的重建对跨导联关联进行建模，以捕捉在多个导联中表现出的异常模式。这些模块使该框架能够捕捉细微的偏差相关模式及其跨导联上下文。即使不对预训练的特征提取器进行额外微调，该框架在多个公开数据集上相比既往方法仍取得最高达 6.5% 的 AUROC 提升和 12.8% 的 F1 提升。嵌入可视化显示，所学特征支持有意义的疾病分组和异常识别。该方法减少了对标注数据的需求，可为不同医疗环境中的临床医生提供支持。该框架有望改善心血管疾病的早期检测和监测，有助于实现更可及、更公平的心脏医疗。

title: Chem World: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Physics-Aware Framework for Trustworthy Molecular Property Prediction
zh_title: Chem World：面向可信分子性质预测的大规模基准与物理感知框架
summary: 提出整合17个公开数据集、逾80万实例、10类性质的分子性质预测基准，并提出物理感知组合建模方法PACM。
key_points: 涵盖单分子与多组分体系，含药物溶解度
统一评估分子表示与组合建模
提出结合物理约束的PACM方法
reason: 大规模基准有新意，但为预印本且偏化学
abstract: Molecular property prediction is fundamental to computational chemistry and drug formulation research, yet existing benchmarks remain fragmented across datasets, properties, and evaluation protocols, limiting systematic evaluation of model generalization. We introduce Chem World, a large-scale benchmark integrating 17 public datasets with over 800,000 molecular and chemical-system instances across 10 property tracks, covering single-molecule and multi-component systems, including drug solubility. Chem World provides a unified testbed for evaluating molecular representations and compositional modeling across diverse chemical properties. Building on the benchmark, we propose PACM (Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling), which combines molecular representations with composition-aware modeling and domain-specific physical constraints. Extensive experiments show that molecular language models provide strong and transferable representations, while PACM consistently improves prediction across diverse chemical systems. Chem World and our PACM-powered drug-property prediction Agent support generalizable chemical modeling and offer a foundation for AI-assisted biomedical research and drug formulation development.
zh_abstract: 分子性质预测是计算化学和药物制剂研究的基础，然而现有基准在数据集、性质和评估方案上仍较为分散，限制了对模型泛化能力的系统评估。我们提出了 Chem World，这是一个大规模基准，整合了17个公共数据集，包含超过800,000个分子及化学体系实例，涵盖10个性质赛道，涉及单分子体系和多组分体系，包括药物溶解度。Chem World 为评估不同化学性质下的分子表示和组成建模提供了统一的测试平台。在此基准基础上，我们提出了 PACM（Physics-Aware Compositional Modeling，物理感知组成建模），它将分子表示与组成感知建模及特定领域的物理约束相结合。大量实验表明，分子语言模型可提供强大且可迁移的表示，而 PACM 在多种化学体系中持续提升预测效果。Chem World 及我们基于 PACM 的药物性质预测智能体（Agent）支持可泛化的化学建模，并为人工智能辅助的生物医学研究和药物制剂开发提供了基础。

title: A Concept-Based Interpretable Framework for Clinical Text-based Prediction via Token-Concept Attention without Concept Supervision
zh_title: 无需概念监督的临床文本可解释预测：词元-概念注意力框架
summary: 提出基于交叉注意力瓶颈的框架，在无概念标注下为临床文本预测提供基于概念的解释。
key_points: 利用预训练语言模型嵌入文本与医学概念描述
交叉注意力估计各词元的概念相关性
无需昂贵的概念标注即可解释
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见充分验证结果
abstract: Objective: Concept-based interpretation has emerged as a promising approach for explaining blackbox models using human-understandable, high-level concepts. However, most existing methods require annotated concept labels to train the model to identify concepts in the input, and obtaining such annotations in clinical text is often expensive. This study aims to enable concept-based interpretation for language models without concept supervision on clinical prediction tasks. Methods: We propose a novel framework that enables concept-based interpretation without concept supervision through a tailored cross-attention bottleneck. Clinical text and the text descriptions of medical concepts are first tokenized and embedded by a pretrained language model. A cross-attention module then estimates the presence of each concept for each text token, producing concept relevance scores that capture how concepts are involved throughout the note. These scores are pooled and used in a linear prediction layer to model clinical outcomes in an interpretable manner. Results: The performance of the proposed framework was compared against blackbox models across two tasks: chest trauma severity stratification using a private dataset and an in-hospital mortality prediction task using the publicly available MIMIC-III dataset. The proposed framework achieved AUROC values within 0.02 of the corresponding blackbox models. The framework also enabled cohort- and patient-level interpretation, capturing the overall concept importance across the cohort and patient-specific concept contributions. Conclusion: Our proposed framework realizes concept-based interpretation without requiring ground-truth concept presence labels. It improves the transparency of clinical text predictions while maintaining strong performance in clinical prediction tasks.
zh_abstract: 【目的】基于概念的解释已成为一种有前景的方法，可利用人类可理解的高层概念来解释黑箱模型。然而，现有大多数方法需要带标注的概念标签来训练模型识别输入中的概念，而在临床文本中获取此类标注通常成本高昂。本研究旨在在临床预测任务中，实现无需概念监督的语言模型概念解释。【方法】我们提出了一种新颖的框架，通过定制的交叉注意力瓶颈（cross-attention bottleneck）实现无需概念监督的基于概念的解释。首先由预训练语言模型对临床文本和医学概念的文本描述进行分词和嵌入。随后，交叉注意力模块估计每个文本词元（token）中各概念的存在情况，生成概念相关性得分，以反映概念在整篇病历中的参与方式。这些得分经池化后输入线性预测层，以可解释的方式对临床结局建模。【结果】在两项任务中将所提框架与黑箱模型的性能进行了比较：使用私有数据集的胸部创伤严重程度分层，以及使用公开的 MIMIC-III 数据集的院内死亡率预测任务。所提框架的 AUROC 值与相应黑箱模型相差在 0.02 以内。该框架还能够实现队列层面和患者层面的解释，既可呈现整个队列中概念的总体重要性，也可呈现患者特异性的概念贡献。【结论】我们提出的框架无需真实概念存在标签即可实现基于概念的解释。它在保持临床预测任务强劲性能的同时，提高了临床文本预测的透明度。

title: DrugCoding: A Scientific Programming Agent for Drug Discovery
zh_title: DrugCoding：面向药物发现的科学编程智能体
summary: 提出集成任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作与程序化工具执行的药物发现智能体系统。
key_points: 针对分子设计、性质预测、虚拟筛选流程
含自适应模型路由与多智能体协作
通过编程方式执行多阶段科学计算
reason: 药物发现智能体新方法预印本，摘要未见评测细节，有方向加分
abstract: Drug discovery involves multiple interconnected research stages, including molecular design, property prediction, and virtual screening. These processes are characterized by complex workflows, interdependent computational tasks, and diverse specialized tools, placing substantial demands on the coordination of scientific models and computational resources. However, existing large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents still face challenges in autonomous planning of complex tasks, adaptive selection of specialized models, and reliable execution of multi-stage scientific computations, limiting their effectiveness in automating complex drug discovery workflows. To address these challenges, we propose DrugCoding, a scientific programming agent system that integrates scientific task planning, adaptive model routing, multi-agent collaboration, and programmatic tool execution. DrugCoding enables autonomous task planning and dynamic model adaptation for complex research objectives. It can flexibly invoke specialized scientific models, autonomously generate and execute code according to task requirements, and leverage multi-agent collaboration to support efficient execution and reliable validation of complex scientific tasks. To evaluate DrugCoding's performance in scientific tool invocation and multi-stage task execution, we conduct multi-turn tool-calling experiments across diverse language models and scientific tool interfaces. Experimental results demonstrate that DrugCoding achieves an average session-level Pass@1 of 97.35% on the full benchmark, outperforming the strongest baseline, Codex, by 9.24%. On the challenging subset, DrugCoding achieves 97.92%, exceeding the strongest baseline.
zh_abstract: 药物发现涉及多个相互关联的研究阶段，包括分子设计、性质预测和虚拟筛选。这些过程具有工作流程复杂、计算任务相互依赖、专用工具多样等特点，对科学模型与计算资源的协调提出了很高要求。然而，现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学智能体在复杂任务的自主规划、专用模型的自适应选择以及多阶段科学计算的可靠执行方面仍面临挑战，限制了其在复杂药物发现工作流程自动化中的效果。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DrugCoding，一种集成科学任务规划、自适应模型路由、多智能体协作和程序化工具执行的科学编程智能体系统。DrugCoding 能够针对复杂的研究目标实现自主任务规划和动态模型适配。它可以灵活调用专用科学模型，根据任务需求自主生成并执行代码，并借助多智能体协作支持复杂科学任务的高效执行和可靠验证。为评估 DrugCoding 在科学工具调用和多阶段任务执行方面的性能，我们在多种语言模型和科学工具接口上开展了多轮工具调用实验。实验结果表明，DrugCoding 在完整基准上的会话级平均 Pass@1 为 97.35%，比最强基线 Codex 高 9.24%。在高难度子集上，DrugCoding 达到 97.92%，超过最强基线。

title: MicroBT: Centroid-Guided Synergistic Learning for Multi-Modal Micro Brain Tumor Segmentation and Counting
zh_title: MicroBT：多模态微小脑肿瘤分割与计数
summary: 提出以质心为锚点的多模态框架，针对小于3毫米的微小脑肿瘤病灶进行分割与实例计数，缓解重叠类损失对小病灶的抑制。
key_points: 重叠类目标偏向大区域，微小病灶被抑制
利用尺度不变的病灶质心做实例级建模
目标是提升分割并实现可靠病灶计数
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档；肿瘤影像略加分
abstract: Multi-modal brain tumor segmentation is essential for clinical diagnosis, radiotherapy planning, and longitudinal monitoring. While recent studies have achieved remarkable overall segmentation performance, they rely on overlap-based objectives that inherently favor large regions, causing sub-3 mm micro-lesions to be systematically suppressed during training. Moreover, existing pixel-level segmentation frameworks lack explicit instance-level modeling, leading to unreliable lesion counting that directly impacts clinical staging and therapeutic decisions. To address these challenges, we propose MicroBT, a unified multi-modal framework for micro brain tumor segmentation and counting. Our core insight is that a fundamental geometric property is inherently scale-invariant: regardless of size, each lesion possesses a well-defined centroid. Leveraging this, we first devise a centroid-anchored synergistic paradigm that utilizes predicted centroids as shared anchors to simultaneously condition dense segmentation and instance-level localization. To counteract the tumor size imbalance, we further devise a Volume-Calibrated Loss (VC-Loss) that adaptively amplifies the gradient contribution of micro-lesions, alongside a Size-Aware Curriculum Optimization (SACO) that stabilizes multi-task training by establishing global representations before progressively unlocking fine-grained localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroBT outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on metastases, where micro-lesion ($\leq 3$ mm) localization precision improves by approximately 7% and counting estimation errors decrease by approximately 26%. The code is available at https://github.com/leonlou921/MicroBT.

title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
zh_title: FedVP：通过汇集本地验证器实现异构模型联邦学习
summary: 预印本提出联邦验证器池，各客户端本地训练验证器，服务器汇集其判断选答案而不聚合参数，在五个公开医学问答数据集上评估。
key_points: 异构LLM可通过共享验证协作
LLM骨干冻结，不合并参数
在五个公开医学问答数据集评估
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，有基线评估但证据有限
abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qwen and LLaMA backbones ranging from 3B to 14B parameters. FEDVP consistently improves performance across all five clients and outperforms the strongest conventional federated baselines by 1.46-5.79 percentage points in mean accuracy.
zh_abstract: 传统联邦学习依赖共享的模型主干来聚合客户端更新，这限制了部署不同系列、不同规模大语言模型（LLM）的机构之间的协作。我们提出联邦验证器池（Federated Verifier Pool，FEDVP），这是一种新的联邦学习范式，使异构客户端能够通过共享验证而非参数聚合来协作。每个客户端使用本地数据以及其所选 LLM 主干生成的回答训练一个验证器。服务器汇集这些独立训练的验证器，并综合它们的判断来选择答案，而无需合并模型参数。这使得 LLM 主干和验证器在架构和规模上均可不同，同时保持 LLM 主干冻结，并从改进的答案选择中获得协作收益。我们在五个作为联邦客户端的公开医学问答数据集上评估 FEDVP，使用参数规模从 3B 到 14B 的 Qwen 和 LLaMA 主干。FEDVP 在全部五个客户端上均持续提升性能，平均准确率比最强的传统联邦基线高出 1.46–5.79 个百分点。

title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
zh_title: TransGHOST：眼科显微手术中器械遮挡区域的实时免合成重建
summary: 预印本提出因果、参考引导的重建流程，用已记录帧的几何重采样恢复器械遮挡的组织区域，提供逐像素置信度与来源，并在新的兽医临床数据上评估。
key_points: 非生成式安全模式可实时运行
基于仅可见区域拟合的几何变换重采样
提供逐像素置信度，不支持像素标记为弃权
reason: 眼科手术视频新方法，思路清晰，但为预印本且数据为兽医临床，属值得一看档
abstract: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level instrument and anatomy labels. Only the occluded region is scored, and each scoring target is verified to differ from the reference supplied to the system. Safe mode reaches 31.89 dB masked PSNR and 0.915 masked SSIM at 51.7 ms median and 85.5 ms 95th-percentile latency. On a pre-declared held-out cohort using instrument cutouts excluded from segmentation training, it reaches 29.83 dB masked PSNR, while matched-mask evaluation on validation shows a 3.45 dB advantage over LaMa. Region-aware reference selection improves masked PSNR by 3.60 dB over recency when candidate references can themselves be occluded. Reference-age analysis further defines the operating interval for the brief, repeated occlusions targeted by TransGHOST.
zh_abstract: 眼科显微手术中的术中场景感知受器械遮挡所限：当器械进入高倍放大视野时，会同时遮住术者以及处理视频的机器人辅助系统感知组件所需观察的组织。生成式图像修复可以去除遮挡物，但会用合成内容替代缺失的图像内容，在视觉来源可追溯性很重要时并不适用。许多视频修复方法还依赖未来帧，无法在线运行。我们提出 TransGHOST，一种因果的、参考引导的重建流程，其非生成式安全模式可实时运行。每一个被恢复的像素值均通过对已记录帧进行重采样获得，所用几何变换仅基于可见区域拟合。该系统提供逐像素的置信度和来源信息，并将缺乏支持的像素标记为弃权。我们在一个新的犬白内障手术兽医临床语料库上评估 TransGHOST，该语料库带有像素级器械和解剖结构标注。仅对被遮挡区域评分，并验证每个评分目标均与提供给系统的参考不同。安全模式的遮罩区域 PSNR 达 31.89 dB，遮罩区域 SSIM 达 0.915，中位延迟为 51.7 ms，第 95 百分位延迟为 85.5 ms。在预先声明的留出队列上（使用未纳入分割训练的器械抠图），其遮罩区域 PSNR 为 29.83 dB；而在验证集上进行的匹配遮罩评估显示其比 LaMa 高 3.45 dB。当候选参考帧本身可能被遮挡时，区域感知的参考选择比按时间最近选择使遮罩区域 PSNR 提高 3.60 dB。参考帧年龄分析进一步界定了 TransGHOST 所针对的短暂、反复遮挡的工作区间。

title: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
zh_title: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割
summary: 提出MEOW框架，无需更新参数即可将非交互分割骨干转为交互式开放世界学习器，并在未见类别上持续改进。
key_points: 参数无关的转导推理结合记忆巩固
对训练中未见类别预测持续改进
可零样本迁移至micro-CT等其他模态
reason: 新颖方法的预印本，有零样本迁移但证据有限
abstract: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.

title: Leveraging state-of-the-art AI structure predictors to generate atomic resolution ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins
zh_title: 利用多种 AI 结构预测器生成无序蛋白原子级构象系综
summary: bAIes 框架扩展至 AlphaFold2/3、Boltz-1/2、ESMFold 等六种预测器，系统比较其距离分布，并生成 IDP 原子分辨率构象系综，预印本。
key_points: 比较六种结构预测工具的残基间距离分布
bAIes 生成的系综精度与实验数据相当
是对既有框架的扩展
reason: 有基线对比的方法扩展，但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are central to many biological processes, but their function depends on dynamic conformational ensembles rather than a single structure. Despite the impact of artificial intelligence on protein structure prediction, determining these ensembles at atomistic resolution remains challenging. Recently, we introduced bAIes, a framework that leverages the structural information encoded in AlphaFold2 distograms to generate conformational ensembles of IDPs at atomistic resolution. Here, we extend this framework to six state-of-the-art structure prediction tools (AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, Boltz-1, Boltz-2, ESMFold, and ESMFold2) and systematically compare the structural information encoded in their predicted inter-residue distance distributions. Despite differences between predictors, we show that bAIes generates ensembles with comparable accuracy against experimental NMR and SAXS data, and competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art all-atom simulations and alternative IDP ensemble generation methods. These results demonstrate that bAIes is robust to the choice of structure predictor and that the distance distributions generated by different deep learning architectures contain valuable information about the conformational preferences of disordered proteins. More broadly, our work highlights the potential of combining AI-derived structural information with physics-based modeling to generate atomistic ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins and regions.

title: Pocket similarity guided selection of protein targets for systematic protein ligand dataset generation
zh_title: 基于口袋相似性选择蛋白靶点以系统生成配体数据集
summary: 利用PocketVec描述符绘制人类球状蛋白口袋组，识别15,559个蛋白中51,535个预测可成药口袋，用于为Target 2035选择多样化靶点。
key_points: PocketVec为无需比对的结合位点描述符
覆盖15,559个蛋白、51,535个预测可成药口袋
以口袋相似性而非序列或折叠选靶，最大化多样性
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，服务开放数据计划，但证据有限
abstract: The scarcity of large, diverse, and unbiased protein ligand binding datasets limits the performance of machine learning approaches in drug discovery, particularly for understudied proteins. The Target 2035 initiative aims to address this gap by generating open-access binding data for more than 2,000 human proteins, a goal whose value depends on maximizing the diversity of the selected targets. Because proteins with different folds can share chemically analogous binding sites, we reasoned that pocket similarity, rather than sequence or fold similarity, is the appropriate criterion for selecting representative targets that maximize coverage of the human pocketome. Here, we use PocketVec, an alignment-free descriptor of binding sites, to map the human globular pocketome, identifying 51,535 predicted druggable pockets across 15,559 proteins. A two level hierarchical clustering, first within protein families and then across the whole proteome, grouped these pockets into 1,865 clusters of chemically similar binding sites. After discarding 533 clusters containing pockets with known ligands, we selected the 100 most populated of the remaining 1,332 ligand free clusters and chose two high quality representative pockets per cluster, ranked by their resemblance to known ligand-binding sites. Finally, we implemented two complementary prioritization strategies, one favoring structurally unexplored proteins and the other proteins amenable to experimental follow up, and selected 200 pockets from 100 different clusters from each strategy, with 89 clusters in common. Both selections cover over 10,000 pockets in ~5,600 proteins, approximately 36% of the human proteins with annotated druggable pockets, which represents a 2.8- to 4.4-fold increase in the number of covered pockets, domains, and proteins than random selection baselines. This pocket based framework offers a principled strategy to select diverse targets for Target 2035 and other large scale protein ligand data generation efforts in chemical biology.
zh_abstract: 大型、多样且无偏的蛋白质-配体结合数据集的匮乏限制了机器学习方法在药物发现中的性能，尤其是对于研究不足的蛋白质。Target 2035 计划旨在填补这一空白，为2,000多种人类蛋白质生成开放获取的结合数据，其价值取决于所选靶点多样性的最大化。由于具有不同折叠的蛋白质可能共享化学上相似的结合位点，我们认为，用于选择能够最大化覆盖人类口袋组（pocketome）的代表性靶点的合适标准是口袋相似性，而非序列或折叠相似性。在此，我们使用 PocketVec（一种免比对的结合位点描述符）绘制人类球状蛋白口袋组图谱，在15,559个蛋白质中识别出51,535个预测的可成药口袋。通过两级层次聚类（先在蛋白质家族内，再在整个蛋白质组范围内），这些口袋被分为1,865个化学相似结合位点的簇。在剔除533个含有已知配体口袋的簇后，我们从其余1,332个无配体簇中选取了口袋数最多的100个，并为每个簇选出两个高质量的代表性口袋，按其与已知配体结合位点的相似程度排序。最后，我们实施了两种互补的优先排序策略，一种偏向结构上未被探索的蛋白质，另一种偏向适于后续实验的蛋白质，每种策略均从100个不同的簇中选出200个口袋，两者有89个簇相同。两种选择均覆盖约5,600个蛋白质中的10,000多个口袋，约占具有已注释可成药口袋的人类蛋白质的36%，与随机选择基线相比，所覆盖的口袋、结构域和蛋白质数量增加了2.8至4.4倍。这一基于口袋的框架为 Target 2035 及其他化学生物学领域的大规模蛋白质-配体数据生成工作提供了选择多样化靶点的原则性策略。

title: DE-Rigor-Agent: An Agentic Workflow for Assumption-Aware Differential Expression Analysis of Bulk RNA-seq Data
zh_title: DE-Rigor-Agent：考虑假设的RNA-seq差异表达分析智能体
summary: 提出分三阶段、先检验统计假设再筛选方法的LLM智能体，用于bulk RNA-seq差异表达分析，并在140个模拟数据集上评估。
key_points: 三阶段：输入标准化、方法过滤、方法执行
基于专家标准与数据诊断评估六种方法
在14种困难场景的140个模拟数据集上评估
reason: 新颖智能体方法，有模拟评估但属预印本，证据有限
abstract: Differential expression (DE) methods for bulk RNA-seq differ in their statistical assumptions, input data requirements, and supported study designs. Large language model (LLM) agents can automate DE analysis, but they may default to popular methods without checking whether these methods are appropriate for the data. We introduce DE-Rigor-Agent, an assumption-aware agent that organizes DE analysis into three stages: input standardization, method filtering, and method execution. Before executing any DE method, the agent uses expert-curated criteria and dataset-specific diagnostics to evaluate six commonly used methods, documents the reasons for retaining or excluding each method, and executes all retained methods. We evaluated DE-Rigor-Agent on 140 simulated datasets spanning 14 challenging scenarios involving small sample sizes, zero inflation, expression outliers, pre-normalized inputs, and confounded batch effects. Benchmarks showed that method-dataset incompatibilities could lead to inflated false discovery rates (FDRs) or reduced statistical power. Two general-purpose LLM agent baselines, including one explicitly prompted to consider statistical assumptions, selected DESeq2 or edgeR for nearly all datasets. In contrast, DE-Rigor-Agent's filtering decisions closely matched the incompatibilities introduced in the simulations and remained consistent across random seeds, with little additional computational cost. These results demonstrate that DE-Rigor-Agent provides an automated approach to assessing method suitability, making DE analysis more rigorous and transparent.
zh_abstract: 用于批量 RNA-seq 的差异表达（DE）方法在统计假设、输入数据要求和所支持的研究设计方面各不相同。大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以自动化 DE 分析，但它们可能默认选用常用方法，而不检查这些方法是否适合数据。我们提出了 DE-Rigor-Agent，这是一种具有假设意识的智能体，将 DE 分析组织为三个阶段：输入标准化、方法筛选和方法执行。在执行任何 DE 方法之前，该智能体利用专家整理的标准和针对数据集的诊断来评估六种常用方法，记录保留或排除每种方法的理由，并执行所有保留的方法。我们在 140 个模拟数据集上评估了 DE-Rigor-Agent，这些数据集涵盖 14 种具有挑战性的情景，涉及小样本量、零膨胀、表达异常值、预先归一化的输入以及混杂的批次效应。基准测试表明，方法与数据集不兼容可能导致错误发现率（FDR）升高或统计效能降低。两个通用 LLM 智能体基线（其中一个被明确提示考虑统计假设）对几乎所有数据集都选择了 DESeq2 或 edgeR。相比之下，DE-Rigor-Agent 的筛选决策与模拟中引入的不兼容情况高度吻合，并在不同随机种子下保持一致，且额外计算成本很小。这些结果表明，DE-Rigor-Agent 提供了一种评估方法适用性的自动化途径，使 DE 分析更加严谨和透明。

title: The Confessions of a Protein Language Model: Steering, Activations, and What Predicted Confidence Cannot Certify
zh_title: 蛋白语言模型的“自白”：调控、激活与预测置信度的局限
summary: 审计已发表的蛋白生成筛选流程中的重复调控、ESMFold置信度和激活读出，指出预测置信度不能证明可折叠性。
key_points: 调控在α50=1.240x处出现置信度断崖
未调控激活预测置信度门控，ROC-AUC 0.786
长度和组成匹配对照中稳定性预测不优于随机
reason: 有新意的审计型预印本，证据有限
abstract: Protein generate-and-screen pipelines use interventions and readouts to select candidates, but rarely test whether these track their intended targets. We audit published repetition steering, ESMFold confidence, and an activation readout. Steering preserves confidence at its operating point, but a fitted cliff follows at alpha_50 = 1.240x (sweep's own control: 64.0%). Direction matters at moderate matched-norm push, but not at saturation. Unsteered generator activations predict the confidence gate (ROC-AUC 0.786 +/- 0.004), supporting cost-aware, model-specific triage. We also replicate established length sensitivity, through which shortening can manufacture false nulls. Yet on composition- and length-matched design--scramble pairs, no balanced-accuracy interval excludes chance for experimental stability. Predicting the gate does not establish foldability. We should test what a readout measures before using it to select. Code and data: https://github.com/paninishah/plm-steering-audit
zh_abstract: 蛋白质“生成—筛选”流程使用干预和读出来选择候选物，但很少检验这些干预和读出是否追踪其预期目标。我们审计了已发表的重复序列引导（repetition steering）、ESMFold 置信度和一种激活读出。引导在其工作点处保持了置信度，但随后出现拟合的断崖，alpha_50 = 1.240x（该扫描自身的对照：64.0%）。在中等的范数匹配推动下，方向很重要，但在饱和时则不然。未经引导的生成器激活可预测置信度门控（ROC-AUC 0.786 +/- 0.004），支持具有成本意识的、针对特定模型的分诊。我们还复现了已知的长度敏感性，缩短序列可由此造成假阴性结果。然而，在组成和长度匹配的设计—打乱（design–scramble）序列对上，对于实验稳定性，没有任何平衡准确率区间排除随机水平。预测门控并不能证明可折叠性。在使用某一读出进行选择之前，我们应检验它测量的究竟是什么。代码和数据：https://github.com/paninishah/plm-steering-audit

title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
zh_title: 审计生物医学研究智能体的决策溯源
summary: BioAgent-DF 通过恢复或移植计算位点的数值，检验科学智能体在结论不变时是否读取并引用了不同证据；预印本，未经同行评审。
key_points: 在 SciFact 八个批次上测试 Qwen3.5-4B 与 Gemma 3 4B
完全恢复后参考证据集复原，结论保持不变
基线提示下的结论变化在显式示例提示下未复现
reason: 新颖的智能体审计方法，但模型小、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes in four. These seven combinations cover two claims. Full restoration recovers the reference evidence sets while verdicts remain unchanged. Verdict changes observed under the baseline prompt did not recur under the explicit-example prompt. Complementary tool and optimizer experiments distinguish recovery of numerical state, recovery of ranked lists, and restoration of an agent's visible history. These results show that an audit should track both the evidence an agent uses and its final answer. In hERG cardiac-safety assay allocation, silent numerical faults changed testing decisions while the fixed-budget shortlist kept the same number of compounds labeled as blockers. After the agent had used faulty values, restoring its earlier execution state and supplying certified scores recovered all 39 changed decisions, whereas replacing the prediction file recovered none; no incorrect action was committed. A streaming implementation of the arithmetic checks reduced the total time for forward execution and verification by 42.4% relative to the original FP64 implementation, with identical flags and recovery outputs.

title: Structural-preserving diffusion generation for zero-shot CECT-to-NCCT synthesis.
zh_title: 结构保持扩散生成实现零样本CECT到NCCT合成
summary: 提出无需配对数据、基于预训练扩散模型推理的SPDG方法，将增强CT合成为平扫CT。
key_points: 无需配对数据，零样本设置
基于预训练扩散模型仅推理生成
目标是简化流程并减少辐射和配准误差
reason: 方法有新意，但摘要未见外部验证或临床结局
abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Contrast-enhanced and non-contrast computed tomography (CECT/NCCT) are widely used in various clinical scenarios. CECT-to-NCCT synthesis enables NCCT images to be directly generated from CECT images. This streamlines clinical workflows, reduces radiation exposure risk, and prevents co-registration errors. However, to learn the mapping relationship between CECT and NCCT images, existing CECT-to-NCCT synthesis methods typically require supervised settings, which are reliant on substantial paired data. In this paper, we propose a structural preservation diffusion generation (SPDG) method for zero-shot CECT-to-NCCT synthesis. SPDG does not rely on paired data and can be implemented on a pretrained vanilla diffusion model, utilizing an inference-only process to generate NCCT images. Specifically, our SPDG is a guided diffusion generation method that uses the generative prior of the diffusion model and exploits structure-dependent guidance functions to achieve CECT-to-NCCT synthesis. Using guide images from CECT, we design consistency guidance and smoothness constraints as guidance functions for NCCT image generation. Based on the distribution characteristics of the enhanced regions in CECT images, we split the image into a potential enhancement region and an intensity stable region, and designed specific consistency guiding functions for each. The SPDG method is evaluated on abdomen and head and neck datasets, and the results demonstrate that state-of-the-art performance is achieved in unsupervised CECT-to-NCCT synthesis.

title: Machine Learning Applications in Prostate Cancer Genomics: From Mutation Signatures to Clinical Prediction Models.
source: PubMed · Research and reports in urology
zh_title: 前列腺癌基因组学中的机器学习：从突变特征到临床预测模型
summary: 叙述性综述，讨论机器学习在前列腺癌突变特征、生物标志物发现与临床预测模型中的应用及局限。
key_points: 涵盖突变特征分析与标志物发现
讨论基因组与临床数据整合
指出现有方法局限与转化问题
reason: 叙述性综述，类上限低，增量档
abstract: [Research and reports in urology] Prostate cancer (PCa) is a highly heterogeneous disease with variable clinical outcomes. Advances in next-generation sequencing have enabled comprehensive genomic profiling, generating large-scale datasets that require sophisticated analytical tools. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for extracting clinically relevant insights from these datasets. This narrative review examines current ML applications in PCa genomics, focusing on mutation signature analysis, biomarker discovery, and clinical prediction models. We also discuss the integration of genomic and clinical data, the limitations of current approaches, and how ML-driven methods can be translated into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [泌尿外科研究与报告] 前列腺癌（PCa）是一种高度异质性疾病，临床结局各异。二代测序的进步使得全面的基因组分析成为可能，产生了需要复杂分析工具的大规模数据集。机器学习（ML）已成为从这些数据集中提取临床相关见解的有力方法。本叙述性综述探讨了 ML 在 PCa 基因组学中的当前应用，重点关注突变特征分析、生物标志物发现和临床预测模型。我们还讨论了基因组数据与临床数据的整合、现有方法的局限性，以及如何将 ML 驱动的方法转化为临床实践。

title: The evolving landscape of artificial intelligence in cholecystectomy: a bibliometric and science-mapping analysis.
zh_title: 胆囊切除术中AI研究的文献计量与科学图谱分析
summary: 基于559篇文献，分析AI在胆囊切除术研究中的发表趋势、合作网络和主题演变。
key_points: 中国发文最多，美国总被引最高
使用bibliometrix与VOSviewer分析
reason: 文献计量分析，无新方法或临床证据，增量档
abstract: [Updates in surgery] To map the global research landscape and thematic evolution of artificial intelligence (AI)-related research in cholecystectomy and to identify major contributors, collaboration patterns, and intellectual foundations. English-language articles and reviews were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus. After deduplication and eligibility screening, 559 publications were included. Publication trends, scientific collaboration, keyword co-occurrence, conceptual structure, thematic evolution, and co-citation and citation-burst patterns were analyzed using bibliometrix, VOSviewer, and Python. Research activity increased markedly in recent years, with 424 publications (75.8%) appearing between 2022 and 2025. China contributed the largest publication output, whereas the United States received the highest total citations. Keyword and conceptual-structure analyses identified research domains involving AI and computational methods, surgical workflow and intraoperative visual analysis, and computer-vision-based applications. Thematic evolution suggested a progression from early workflow- and convolutional-neural-network-related research toward machine learning, deep learning, radiomics, surgical phase recognition, and more recent transformer-related approaches. Twinanda et al. [1] showed the strongest citation burst and occupied a prominent position in the reference co-citation network. AI-related research in cholecystectomy has expanded rapidly and become increasingly diverse in its methodological and application-oriented focus. Current bibliometric patterns suggest growing attention to workflow analysis, computer vision, surgical phase recognition, and newer model architectures. Further multicenter validation and prospective clinical evaluation are needed to determine whether these developments translate into generalizable and clinically meaningful applications.
zh_abstract: [外科学进展] 旨在描绘人工智能（AI）相关胆囊切除术研究的全球研究格局和主题演变，并识别主要贡献者、合作模式和知识基础。从 Web of Science 核心合集和 Scopus 检索英文文章和综述。经去重和资格筛选后，共纳入 559 篇出版物。使用 bibliometrix、VOSviewer 和 Python 分析了发表趋势、科研合作、关键词共现、概念结构、主题演变以及共被引和引文突现模式。近年来研究活动明显增加，424 篇（75.8%）发表于 2022 年至 2025 年之间。中国的发文量最大，而美国的总被引次数最高。关键词和概念结构分析确定了涉及 AI 与计算方法、手术工作流程与术中视觉分析以及基于计算机视觉的应用等研究领域。主题演变提示，研究由早期与工作流程和卷积神经网络相关的研究，逐步发展到机器学习、深度学习、影像组学、手术阶段识别，以及近期与 Transformer 相关的方法。Twinanda 等 [1] 显示出最强的引文突现，并在参考文献共被引网络中占据突出位置。胆囊切除术中与 AI 相关的研究已迅速扩展，其方法学和应用导向的重点日益多样化。目前的文献计量模式提示，工作流程分析、计算机视觉、手术阶段识别和较新的模型架构日益受到关注。仍需进一步开展多中心验证和前瞻性临床评估，以确定这些进展能否转化为可推广且具有临床意义的应用。

title: Deep Learning-Enhanced Lateral-Flow Microarray Biosensor for Multiplexed Inflammatory Biomarker Analysis.
zh_title: 深度学习增强的侧向流微阵列生物传感器用于多重炎症标志物检测
summary: 研究提出基于表面增强拉曼散射的侧向流微阵列芯片LF-SERS-MAC，结合AI辅助分析，在单张纸基器件上检测三种炎症蛋白。
key_points: SERS侧向流微阵列芯片，空间编码阵列图案
单一纸基器件同时检测三种炎症蛋白
整合AI辅助分析以提升定量稳健性
reason: 分析化学传感器工作，AI为辅助组件，信息有限，属增量档
abstract: [Analytical chemistry] Beyond simply functional integration, achieving synergistic enhancements in multiplex detection, quantitative robustness, and intelligent analysis remains a key challenge for next-generation biosensing platforms in precision diagnostics. Lateral flow biosensors are attractive paper-based platforms because of their simplicity, low cost, and rapid operation; however, conventional line-type formats and visual readouts may limit their multiplex quantitative capability. Here, we present a surface-enhanced Raman scattering-based lateral flow microarray chip (LF-SERS-MAC) platform that integrates spatially encoded microarray patterns with AI-assisted analysis to enable sensitive, specific, and stable detection of three inflammatory proteins on a single paper device. The platform employs AuNPDTNB@antibody nanoprobes that simultaneously provide strong Raman signals and specific recognition of target proteins. The 4 × 4 microarray architecture enables spatially separated detection channels and predefined replicate microdots, supporting standardized SERS sampling and replicate-based signal averaging. More importantly, a 2D transformation-based deep learning model was developed for inflammation classification and concentration prediction, which demonstrates higher accuracy than conventional AI models. This platform can be further scaled to high-throughput paper chips, facilitating its clinical translation as a next-generation multiplexed intelligent biosensing strategy.
zh_abstract: [分析化学] 除了单纯的功能集成之外，在多重检测、定量稳健性和智能分析方面实现协同增强，仍是面向精准诊断的下一代生物传感平台的关键挑战。侧向流生物传感器因其简便、低成本和快速操作而成为有吸引力的纸基平台；然而，传统的线型形式和目视读数可能限制其多重定量能力。在此，我们提出一种基于表面增强拉曼散射的侧向流微阵列芯片（LF-SERS-MAC）平台，该平台将空间编码的微阵列图案与人工智能辅助分析相结合，可在单一纸质装置上对三种炎症蛋白进行灵敏、特异且稳定的检测。该平台采用AuNPDTNB@抗体纳米探针，同时提供强拉曼信号和对靶蛋白的特异性识别。4 × 4微阵列结构实现了空间分离的检测通道和预设的重复微点，支持标准化的SERS采样和基于重复的信号平均。更重要的是，我们开发了一种基于二维变换的深度学习模型，用于炎症分类和浓度预测，其准确性高于传统人工智能模型。该平台可进一步扩展为高通量纸芯片，有助于其作为下一代多重智能生物传感策略实现临床转化。

title: Rethinking Peer Review in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: A Tiered Model for Health Promotion Journals.
source: PubMed · American journal of health promotion : AJHP
zh_title: 重新思考AI时代的同行评审：健康促进期刊的分层模型
summary: 文章指出生成式AI加速论文产出而同行评审基本未变，审稿人面临压力，并为健康促进期刊提出分层评审模型。
key_points: AI使作者写作加速，审稿负担加重
许多期刊禁止审稿人使用AI以保护保密稿件
提出面向健康促进期刊的分层评审模型
reason: 期刊治理类观点文章，非医疗AI技术进展，属增量档
abstract: [American journal of health promotion : AJHP] The number of papers published in health promotion journals has grown substantially for two decades, and mainstream use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has accelerated that growth. Yet peer review remains fundamentally unchanged. Review still depends on volunteer time, and many journals prohibit reviewers from using AI to protect confidential, unpublished work. The result is an asymmetry: authors write faster with AI, while reviewers face mounting demand without the same tools. Funding agencies have begun responding; the NIH, for example, now caps annual application submissions per principal investigator. Journals cannot impose comparable limits because submissions are scattered across thousands of independent outlets, and requiring authors to complete reviews in proportion to their publications would be nearly impossible to enforce. We propose a solution that concentrates limited reviewer capacity on the most complex and consequential research. Cross-sectional and other descriptive studies would be evaluated by a purpose-built AI reviewer, trained to assess methodological rigor in such studies and designed not to retain or learn from unpublished manuscripts. Accepted papers would appear in a companion journal or section of the parent title. Traditional peer review would then be reserved for longitudinal, experimental, and other higher-impact research. Beyond easing reviewer burden, this model creates a transparent signal of rigor that could help tenure and promotion committees reward quality over publication quantity.
zh_abstract: [American journal of health promotion : AJHP] 二十年来，健康促进期刊发表的论文数量大幅增长，而生成式人工智能（AI）的主流化使这一增长进一步加速。然而，同行评审在根本上并无改变。评审仍依赖志愿者的时间，许多期刊为保护保密的未发表工作而禁止评审人使用 AI。结果造成不对称：作者借助 AI 写作更快，而评审人面对不断增加的需求却没有同样的工具。资助机构已开始应对；例如，美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）现已限制每位主要研究者每年提交的申请数量。期刊无法实施类似限制，因为投稿分散在成千上万家独立出版机构，而要求作者按其发表论文的比例完成评审几乎无法执行。我们提出一种解决方案，将有限的评审能力集中于最复杂、最重要的研究。横断面研究及其他描述性研究将由专门构建的 AI 评审员评估，该评审员经训练可评估此类研究的方法学严谨性，并被设计为不保留未发表稿件也不从中学习。被接受的论文将刊登于母刊的姊妹期刊或专栏。传统同行评审则保留给纵向研究、实验性研究及其他更高影响力的研究。除减轻评审负担外，该模式还创造了一种透明的严谨性信号，可帮助终身教职和晋升委员会奖励质量而非发表数量。

title: Symmetry-Consistent Attention Supervision for Explainable Multi-label Temporal-Bone CT Assessment.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 对称一致注意力监督的颞骨CT可解释多标签评估
summary: 基于ResNet-18与类特异注意力池化，对颞骨CT内中耳状态做多标签评估，用对称一致性正则约束注意力。
key_points: 87例患者2399幅CT图像
稀疏多边形标注监督注意力
左右翻转等变一致性正则
reason: 单中心小样本，仅内部测试，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] The purpose of this study is to develop an explainable deep learning framework for region-wise, multi-label assessment of inner- and middle-ear status on temporal-bone computed tomography (CT). The framework used a ResNet-18 encoder with class-specific attention pooling to predict eight labels representing normal and congenital malformation states of the left and right inner and middle ears. Sparse polygon annotations supervised attention using masked binary cross-entropy, Dice-overlap, and outside-mask penalties. A left-right equivariant consistency regularizer enforced bilateral symmetry under horizontal flipping. The dataset comprised 2399 axial and coronal CT images from 87 patients. Development used fourfold patient-level cross-validation on 35 patients (1018 images), followed by evaluation on a held-out internal test set of 52 patients (1381 images). In cross-validation, the full model achieved a macro-AUC of 0.765 and a macro-F1 of 0.627. On the held-out internal test set, image-level evaluation yielded a macro-AUC of 0.688 and a macro-F1 of 0.572, representing the highest mean performance among the evaluated CNN, vision transformer, and MedViT baselines. Patient-level aggregation further yielded a macro-AUC of 0.716 and a macro-F1 of 0.621. The proposed attention maps were also more side-specific and anatomically concentrated than baseline heatmaps. Attention supervision and bilateral equivariance may improve interpretable temporal-bone CT assessment. Larger external studies and patient-level evaluation are required before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 本研究旨在开发一种可解释的深度学习框架，用于在颞骨计算机断层扫描（CT）上对内耳和中耳状态进行分区域、多标签评估。该框架采用带有类别特异性注意力池化的 ResNet-18 编码器，预测代表左右内耳和中耳正常及先天性畸形状态的八个标签。稀疏的多边形标注通过掩码二元交叉熵、Dice 重叠以及掩码外惩罚项来监督注意力。左右等变一致性正则化项在水平翻转下强制保持双侧对称性。数据集包含来自 87 名患者的 2399 幅轴位和冠状位 CT 图像。模型开发在 35 名患者（1018 幅图像）上采用四折患者水平交叉验证，随后在 52 名患者（1381 幅图像）的保留内部测试集上进行评估。在交叉验证中，完整模型的宏平均 AUC 为 0.765，宏平均 F1 为 0.627。在保留的内部测试集上，图像水平评估的宏平均 AUC 为 0.688，宏平均 F1 为 0.572，在所评估的 CNN、视觉 Transformer 和 MedViT 基线中平均性能最高。患者水平聚合进一步得到宏平均 AUC 0.716 和宏平均 F1 0.621。所提出的注意力图也比基线热图更具侧别特异性，并更集中于解剖结构。注意力监督和双侧等变性可能改善可解释的颞骨 CT 评估。在临床部署之前，仍需要更大规模的外部研究和患者水平评估。

title: Medical Artificial Intelligence for Rural Areas of Developing Countries a Boon or Bane: A Contemporary Narrative Review.
zh_title: 发展中国家农村医疗AI：利弊的叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述讨论印度农村医疗AI在可及性、效率与医生短缺方面的潜力，以及教育、伦理、隐私和实施障碍。
key_points: AI或缓解农村医疗资源差异

reason: 叙述性综述，泛泛讨论，属增量档
abstract: [Health science reports] The integration of medical artificial intelligence (AI) in rural India holds transformative potential for enhancing healthcare access and quality. This narrative review examines the promising applications of medical AI in addressing healthcare disparities, increasing service efficiency, and mitigating physician shortages in underserved areas. However, challenges persist, including medical students' limited awareness and education about AI, reluctance to engage in rural health services, and migration trends affecting healthcare delivery. Effective implementation demands a multifaceted approach, tackling technological, economic, and contextual obstacles through stakeholder collaboration. Ethical considerations such as bias, data privacy, and local workforce involvement are paramount for the responsible deployment of medical AI. This review delves into both the opportunities and challenges, emphasizing the importance of addressing these issues through enhanced education and ethical frameworks. Ultimately, a balanced strategy is essential to harness the potential of medical AI in revolutionizing rural healthcare, highlighting the need for innovative policies that align technological advancements with community needs.

title: Dermatologist or AI? Patient Preferences in Skin Assessment.
zh_title: 皮肤评估：患者更信任皮肤科医生还是AI
summary: 对147名参与者的横断面调查显示，在面部图像评估中，受访者对皮肤科医生的信心高于AI。
key_points: 通过MTurk和REDCap开展问卷调查
对独立评估面部特征，医生信心评分4.37，AI为3.82
考察公众对AI的信任、舒适度与安全顾虑
reason: 小样本在线问卷，增量档，无临床结局
abstract: [Dermatology and therapy] Artificial intelligence (AI) is playing an expanding role in dermatology, particularly in diagnosing skin cancer and other cutaneous diseases. However, little is known about public perceptions towards AI for skincare evaluation and management. The purpose of this study was to assess public trust, comfort, and security concerns about AI-based facial evaluation. A cross-sectional survey was administered to 147 participants through Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) and REDCap. Participants rated comfort, trust, and security concerns regarding AI and dermatologist evaluation of facial images using a 5-point Likert scale. Wilcoxon Signed-Rank tests were used to compare preference for AI vs. dermatologists. Participants expressed greater confidence in dermatologists than AI for independent evaluation of facial features (mean 4.37 vs. 3.82, P < 0.001) and trust in creating a skincare management plan (mean 4.46 vs. 3.87, P < 0.001). Privacy and security concerns were prevalent, with 69% agreeing they were worried about security risks of AI facial imaging. Participants had confidence in AI technology for skincare evaluation and management, although they tended to prefer dermatologists over AI. Security was a concern for AI facial imaging.
zh_abstract: [皮肤病学与治疗] 人工智能（AI）在皮肤病学中的作用日益扩大，尤其是在诊断皮肤癌和其他皮肤疾病方面。然而，公众对用于皮肤护理评估和管理的 AI 的看法所知甚少。本研究旨在评估公众对基于 AI 的面部评估的信任、舒适度和安全顾虑。通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk（MTurk）和 REDCap 对 147 名参与者进行了横断面调查。参与者使用 5 点 Likert 量表，对 AI 和皮肤科医生评估面部图像的舒适度、信任度和安全顾虑进行评分。采用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验比较对 AI 与皮肤科医生的偏好。在独立评估面部特征方面，参与者对皮肤科医生的信心高于 AI（均值 4.37 vs. 3.82，P < 0.001）；在制定皮肤护理管理方案方面，对皮肤科医生的信任也高于 AI（均值 4.46 vs. 3.87，P < 0.001）。隐私和安全顾虑普遍存在，69% 的参与者同意其担心 AI 面部成像的安全风险。参与者对用于皮肤护理评估和管理的 AI 技术有信心，但倾向于更偏好皮肤科医生而非 AI。安全性是 AI 面部成像方面的一个顾虑。

title: Therapeutic Robots: Understanding the Limits of AI.
zh_title: 治疗性机器人：从精神分析视角审视AI的局限
summary: 从精神分析角度批判AI治疗聊天机器人，认为其缺乏主体性、移情与象征化能力，并呼吁伦理反思与监管。
key_points: 质疑将聊天机器人称为“治疗性”的合理性
案例显示用户与其关系停留在“仿佛”层面

reason: 理论性观点文章，无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [American journal of psychoanalysis] This paper critically examines the use of therapeutic chatbots based on artificial intelligence from a psychoanalytic perspective. Drawing on current literature, it questions the legitimacy of labeling these tools as "therapeutic," arguing that they lack essential elements such as subjectivity, transference, symbolization, and the capacity for psychic transformation. A case example illustrates how the relationship users establish with chatbots is narcissistic remaining in the "as if" register in the absence of a real other to enable intersubjectivity. Ethical, epistemological, and clinical implications are discussed, especially in relation to vulnerable populations. The paper highlights the urgency for ethical reflection, regulation, and long-term research as these technologies advance in the field of mental health.
zh_abstract: [American journal of psychoanalysis] 本文从精神分析的角度对基于人工智能的治疗性聊天机器人的使用进行了批判性审视。本文结合现有文献，质疑将这些工具称为“治疗性”的正当性，认为它们缺乏主体性、移情、象征化以及心理转化能力等基本要素。一个个案示例说明，用户与聊天机器人建立的关系是自恋性的，由于缺少能够促成主体间性的真实他者，这种关系始终停留在“好像”（as if）的层面。文章讨论了其伦理、认识论和临床层面的影响，尤其是对脆弱人群的影响。随着这些技术在心理健康领域的发展，本文强调了开展伦理反思、监管和长期研究的紧迫性。

title: Artificial intelligence for automated lung nodule detection in chest computed tomography scans.
zh_title: 胸部CT肺结节自动检测的AI：从早期算法到深度学习
summary: 综述回顾1994–1999年四篇奠基论文，并梳理AI肺结节检测从传统算法到深度学习及肺癌筛查应用的演进。
key_points: 回顾四篇1990年代奠基性论文
涵盖检测、体积测量与恶性风险分层
追溯从CAD到深度学习的演进

abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] Automated detection of pulmonary nodules on computed tomography has evolved from rule-based image processing algorithms to sophisticated artificial intelligence (AI) systems capable of nodule localisation, volumetric measurement and malignancy risk stratification. Four landmark papers published between 1994 and 1999 established the computational foundations of this field, introducing grey-level thresholding, morphological feature extraction, neural networks and three-dimensional analysis as core detection principles. We provide an overview of these foundational studies and trace the subsequent evolution of AI-based nodule detection, from early computer-aided detection systems to modern deep learning frameworks evaluated in the context of lung cancer screening programmes.
zh_abstract: [Breathe (Sheffield, England)] 计算机断层扫描上肺结节的自动检测已从基于规则的图像处理算法，发展为能够进行结节定位、体积测量和恶性风险分层的复杂人工智能（AI）系统。1994 年至 1999 年间发表的四篇里程碑式论文奠定了该领域的计算基础，将灰度阈值法、形态学特征提取、神经网络和三维分析引入为核心检测原理。我们概述了这些奠基性研究，并追溯了基于 AI 的结节检测随后的演变，从早期的计算机辅助检测系统到在肺癌筛查项目背景下评估的现代深度学习框架。

title: CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
zh_title: CLADE：检索增强模型在证据不足时的类别级作答
summary: 指出检索段落仅给出粗粒度类别时，语言模型倾向直接作答而非弃答或继续检索，并借助本体解决可消解的不足（预印本）。
key_points: 提出“可消解不足”概念
模型面对粗粒度证据仍作答
利用领域本体映射候选答案
reason: 生物医学RAG新问题设定，信息有限，增量档
abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems often retrieve passages that are accurate and relevant but state the answer at a coarser level of granularity than the question requires. For example, a question may ask which specific disease a drug treats (familial hyperlipidemia), while the retrieved passage mentions the broader disease family (hyperlipidemia). Prior work on context sufficiency treats such coarse passages simply as insufficient. We argue that they form a distinct case, which we call resolvable insufficiency: text alone cannot settle the fine-grained answer, but the broader category it mentions maps to a short list of candidate answers in a domain ontology. When language models read these coarse, family-only passages, they exhibit a phenomenon we call Clade (Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence): they answer instead of abstaining or searching further. On biomedical questions from PrimeKG, family-only passages reduce abstention by 13.8 points compared to uninformative passages, and the resulting guesses are wrong about half the time. A counterfactual test confirms the cause: replacing an exact disease name with its broader family name lowers abstention by 17.4 points compared to deleting the sentence. Simple fixes like confidence filtering, scaling to a larger model, and explicitly instructing the model to abstain cannot resolve Clade, and this replicates on ecological species interactions in GloBI. Finally, we test whether an ontology can turn coarse passages into exact answers. Given the correct family, an ontology list includes the true answer in 98.5% of cases, but string matching finds that family on the page for only 19.8%. Letting the model choose the family raises this to 30.0% and end-to-end recovery from 10.0% to 26.8%. Overall, our results show when language models should stop guessing and consult an ontology, and highlight which steps of that process remain unsolved.
zh_abstract: 检索增强系统常常检索到准确且相关的段落，但这些段落陈述答案的粒度比问题所要求的更粗。例如，问题可能询问某种药物治疗的具体疾病（家族性高脂血症），而检索到的段落只提到更广泛的疾病类别（高脂血症）。以往关于上下文充分性的研究将此类粗粒度段落简单地视为不充分。我们认为它们构成一种独特情形，称之为可解析的不充分性（resolvable insufficiency）：仅凭文本无法确定细粒度答案，但其中提到的更宽泛类别可在领域本体中映射到一个简短的候选答案列表。当语言模型阅读这些粗粒度、仅含类别信息的段落时，会表现出一种我们称为 Clade（Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence，基于不足证据的类别层级作答）的现象：它们会直接作答，而不是弃答或进一步检索。在 PrimeKG 的生物医学问题上，与无信息段落相比，仅含类别信息的段落使弃答率降低 13.8 个百分点，且由此产生的猜测约有一半是错误的。一项反事实测试证实了原因：与删除该句子相比，将确切的疾病名称替换为其更宽泛的类别名称会使弃答率降低 17.4 个百分点。置信度过滤、扩大到更大模型以及明确指示模型弃答等简单修正方法均无法解决 Clade，并且这一现象在 GloBI 的生态物种相互作用数据上得到复现。最后，我们检验本体能否将粗粒度段落转化为精确答案。给定正确的类别，本体列表在 98.5% 的情况下包含真实答案，但字符串匹配仅在 19.8% 的情况下能在页面上找到该类别。让模型选择类别可将这一比例提高到 30.0%，并将端到端恢复率从 10.0% 提高到 26.8%。总体而言，我们的结果表明了语言模型应在何时停止猜测并查询本体，并指出该过程中哪些步骤仍未解决。

title: What Factors Matter for Collection-Level Counting with Human-AI Collaboration?
zh_title: 人机协作集合级计数：哪些因素重要
summary: 预印本在12个任务（含生物医学显微镜等）中比较人机协作计数框架下的模型、估计器与适配策略，指出多模态模型可作免训练起点。
key_points: 覆盖12个任务，含生物医学显微成像
多模态模型为免训练的强起点
比较模型、估计器与适配策略
reason: 预印本，人机协作有新意，但医疗仅为部分任务，证据有限
abstract: Many scientific and policy decisions require estimating the total number of target objects across a large image collection. Exhaustive human labeling is often infeasible, while raw model predictions can be biased, especially under domain shift. Recent human-AI estimation methods combine imperfect model predictions with limited human verification to obtain reliable collection-level estimates. However, existing work provides little guidance on how practitioners should choose among models, estimators, and adaptation strategies for a new deployment. We study these choices within a common human-in-the-loop counting framework across 12 tasks spanning biomedical microscopy, ground-level and aerial wildlife surveys, and overhead imagery of urban structures. Our results show that modern multimodal models provide a strong, training-free starting point for many tasks, while fine-tuned detectors become more advantageous at larger labeling budgets and across repeated deployments. Estimation efficiency improves further when model predictions are used to prioritize which units humans label, rather than sampling uniformly. We also find that each model's ranking quality can be estimated with a small pilot set, yielding practical guidance for selecting strategies on new counting tasks. In a field deployment on aerial pronghorn surveys, a task-specific adaptation of these methods meets the survey's $\pm 5\%$ tolerance after reviewing a median of only $3.2\%$ of collected images.
zh_abstract: 许多科学和政策决策需要估计大型图像集合中目标物体的总数。对其进行全面的人工标注往往不可行，而模型的原始预测可能存在偏差，在领域偏移下尤其如此。近期的人机协同估计方法将不完美的模型预测与有限的人工核验相结合，以获得可靠的集合层面估计。然而，对于从业者在新部署中应如何在模型、估计器和适应策略之间做出选择，现有工作几乎没有提供指导。我们在一个通用的人在回路计数框架下研究这些选择，涵盖 12 项任务，涉及生物医学显微成像、地面与航空野生动物调查以及城市建筑的俯视影像。结果表明，现代多模态模型为许多任务提供了强大的、无需训练的起点，而微调后的检测器在标注预算较大以及重复部署时更具优势。若利用模型预测来决定优先由人工标注哪些单元，而不是均匀采样，估计效率会进一步提高。我们还发现，每个模型的排序质量可以用小规模的试点集来估计，从而为在新的计数任务中选择策略提供实用指导。在一项针对叉角羚航空调查的实地部署中，这些方法经针对任务的调整后，仅需复核所采集图像的中位数 $3.2\%$，即可满足调查 $\pm 5\%$ 的容许误差。

title: Prior-informed machine learning for clinically interpretable medical diagnosis.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology
zh_title: 先验引导机器学习实现可解释临床诊断
summary: 提出PIML框架，通过贝叶斯推断结合临床生成式推理与数据驱动判别模型，给出患者特异的可解释诊断结果。
key_points: 贝叶斯推断融合临床先验与ML
将敏感度/特异度优化纳入建模
在三个临床场景中验证
reason: 方法有新意，但摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] Traditional machine learning (ML) in medical diagnostics often suffers from limited clinical interpretability and poor generalization, owing to its black-box, data-driven nature. Here, we present Prior-Informed Machine Learning (PIML), a framework that integrates clinically grounded generative reasoning with data-driven, ML-enabled discriminative modeling through Bayesian inference to provide clinically interpretable, patient-specific diagnostic outcomes. By embedding the optimization of sensitivity and specificity in data-driven diagnosis-requirements for subsequent Bayesian inference-directly into the ML model development process, PIML enables a synergistic integration of machine learning and clinical expertise that cannot be achieved through either data-driven or clinically grounded approaches alone. PIML was validated across three clinical domains-cervical neoplasia detection, high-risk oral lesion detection, and preterm birth detection-where Bayesian inference was systematically employed to integrate electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)-based machine learning with domain-specific clinical expertise, thereby enabling more comprehensive and enhanced diagnostic decision-making. Our results demonstrate that PIML generally improves diagnostic performance compared with standard ML approaches and provides competitive or superior performance relative to knowledge-based and feature-level prior integration strategies. This work presents an innovative, systematic framework with strong potential for widespread adoption in addressing medical diagnostic challenges across heterogeneous clinical environments.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] 传统机器学习（ML）在医学诊断中因其黑箱、数据驱动的特性，常常存在临床可解释性有限和泛化能力差的问题。在此，我们提出先验知识引导的机器学习（Prior-Informed Machine Learning，PIML）框架，该框架通过贝叶斯推断，将基于临床的生成式推理与数据驱动、由 ML 实现的判别式建模相结合，以提供具有临床可解释性、针对患者个体的诊断结果。通过将数据驱动诊断中敏感性和特异性的优化（后续贝叶斯推断的必要条件）直接嵌入 ML 模型开发过程，PIML 实现了机器学习与临床专业知识的协同整合，这是单独采用数据驱动或基于临床的方法所无法实现的。PIML 在三个临床领域得到验证——宫颈肿瘤检测、高危口腔病变检测和早产检测——其中系统性地运用贝叶斯推断，将基于电阻抗谱（EIS）的机器学习与特定领域的临床专业知识相整合，从而实现更全面、更强的诊断决策。我们的结果表明，与标准 ML 方法相比，PIML 总体上提高了诊断性能，并且相对于基于知识和特征层面的先验整合策略，提供了具有竞争力或更优的性能。这项工作提出了一个创新的、系统性的框架，在应对异质临床环境中的医学诊断挑战方面具有被广泛采用的巨大潜力。

title: Identification of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal targets utilizing artificial intelligence-driven precision medicine.
zh_title: AI驱动精准医学识别代谢脆弱性与合成致死靶点
summary: 综述强调肿瘤代谢中计算预测与实验验证的证据差异，讨论AI与基因组规模系统生物学产生代谢假设的局限。
key_points: 区分计算预测与实验确认的脆弱性
机器学习整合多组学输出候选靶点与组合
指出文献对预测可靠性的表述不够严谨
reason: 综述类，有一定信息量但属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Cancer metabolism is highly plastic, and most attempts to turn that plasticity into a therapeutic target fail for a specific, recurring reason: a computational prediction of a metabolic vulnerability is not the same evidentiary object as an experimentally confirmed one, and the two are routinely discussed as if they were interchangeable. This review takes that distinction as its starting point rather than its conclusion. Artificial intelligence and genome-scale systems biology have made it easy to generate metabolic hypotheses at a scale no experimental program could match - machine learning models trained on genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data now output candidate vulnerabilities, biomarkers, and drug combinations faster than they can be tested - but the resulting literature has not been consistently honest about how far any given prediction has actually traveled toward clinical relevance. We examine six areas where this gap is most visible: multi-omics data integration, genome-scale metabolic network modeling, computational discovery of metabolic vulnerabilities and synthetic lethal interactions, single-cell and spatial resolution of metabolic heterogeneity, AI-guided drug and biomarker discovery, and the small set of studies that have actually reached clinical testing. Rather than summarizing these areas as separate literatures, we grade every substantive finding discussed against an explicit four-tier evidence standard - associative, mechanistic, perturbation-validated, or clinically tested - and we apply that standard critically rather than deferentially: several widely cited computational vulnerabilities remain unconfirmed outside the cell lines in which they were discovered, genome-scale models continue to carry unresolved gaps in reaction coverage that limit their predictive reach, and, of the AI-derived metabolic predictions discussed in this review, only one has so far been tested in a completed prospective clinical trial. We argue that this shortage of prospective validation, not a shortage of computational sophistication, is the field's central constraint, and we close by identifying where methodological effort would do the most good: standardized validation reporting, tissue-resolved rather than bulk metabolic models, and closer coupling between computational prediction and the specific experimental designs capable of falsifying it.
zh_abstract: [肿瘤学前沿] 癌症代谢具有高度可塑性，而大多数试图将这种可塑性转化为治疗靶点的尝试之所以失败，有一个具体且反复出现的原因：对代谢脆弱性的计算预测与经实验证实的脆弱性并不是同一种证据对象，但二者常被当作可互换的对象来讨论。本综述将这一区别作为出发点而非结论。人工智能和基因组规模的系统生物学使得以任何实验项目都无法比拟的规模生成代谢假说变得容易——基于基因组、转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据训练的机器学习模型，现在输出候选脆弱性、生物标志物和药物组合的速度快于其被检验的速度——但由此产生的文献并未始终如实说明任何一项预测实际上向临床相关性推进了多远。我们考察了这一差距最为明显的六个领域：多组学数据整合、基因组规模代谢网络建模、代谢脆弱性和合成致死相互作用的计算发现、代谢异质性的单细胞和空间分辨率研究、人工智能引导的药物和生物标志物发现，以及少数真正进入临床测试的研究。我们并非将这些领域作为独立文献分别总结，而是依据明确的四级证据标准——关联性、机制性、扰动验证、临床检验——对所讨论的每一项实质性发现进行分级，并以批判而非顺从的方式应用该标准：若干被广泛引用的计算脆弱性在其发现所用的细胞系之外仍未得到证实，基因组规模模型在反应覆盖方面仍存在未解决的缺口，限制了其预测范围，并且在本综述讨论的人工智能衍生代谢预测中，迄今仅有一项在已完成的前瞻性临床试验中得到检验。我们认为，该领域的核心制约因素是前瞻性验证的不足，而非计算复杂度的不足；最后我们指出了方法学上投入努力最有价值之处：标准化的验证报告、组织分辨而非整体（bulk）的代谢模型，以及计算预测与能够证伪它的具体实验设计之间更紧密的结合。

title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
zh_title: HandsOnAid：离线急救助手的构建与评估
summary: 在手机端对4-bit Gemma 2B用QLoRA微调，构建离线急救问答助手，并用41对问答与多个LLM评审对七种配置评分。
key_points: 基于5550对FirstAidQA微调
七种配置含安全门与检索
微调较基础模型均分提高1.08

abstract: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.
zh_abstract: 紧急情况可能发生在没有手机信号、附近也没有救护车的地方。手机上的小型语言模型在此类情形下可能有所帮助，但其建议必须安全且准确。我们构建了 HandsOnAid，这是一个使用 QLoRA 在 FirstAidQA 数据集（包含 5,550 个急救问答对的语料库）上微调的 4 位 Gemma 2B 模型。我们比较了七种配置，包括基础模型、4 位和 8 位微调模型，以及加入长度下限、安全门控或检索的版本。我们使用了一个包含 41 个问答对的题库，其参考答案经医学审核并遵循 ANZCOR 指南，评分采用严格的 0–5 分量表，并设有十二条安全否决规则。四个前沿大语言模型评判者（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）对每个回答进行盲评，并使用 45 个隐藏对照检验评判者的可靠性。微调使平均得分较基础模型提高 +1.08，达到 2.34。得分最高的配置为带检索的 4 位微调模型，得分为 2.51（满分 5 分）。一名医学专业人员还对基础模型、4 位微调模型和检索配置的 40 个回答进行了盲评，其得分与大语言模型评判者的平均得分相近。关键词审查发现，训练语料对评分量表所要求的 ANZCOR 指南若干细节覆盖有限，这提示训练数据中信息缺失可能是得分偏低的原因之一。在智能手机设备（Pixel 7 Pro）上，使用六个 CPU 线程且无网络连接时，4 位微调模型在十个问题上平均 6.86 秒生成首个可显示文本，14.88 秒生成完整回答。

title: RNA Small-Molecule Binding-Site Prediction by Integrating RNA Language Models and Structural Geometry
zh_title: 整合RNA语言模型与结构几何的RNA小分子结合位点预测
summary: 提出RSMBind图注意力框架，融合局部三维几何描述符与预训练RNA语言模型嵌入，进行核苷酸级结合位点预测。
key_points: 图注意力网络用于核苷酸级预测
融合三维几何特征与RNA语言模型嵌入
服务于RNA靶向药物发现
reason: 方法性预印本，摘要无充分对比结果
abstract: RNAs are emerging as promising therapeutic targets, and small-molecule binding can modulate their structure and function, creating opportunities for therapeutic development. Accurate identification of RNA small-molecule binding sites is therefore important for understanding RNA-ligand interactions and facilitating RNA-targeted drug discovery. However, the structural complexity of RNA and the limited availability of experimentally characterized RNA-ligand complexes pose challenges for computational binding-site prediction. In this study, we propose RSMBind, a graph attention-based deep learning framework for nucleotide-level prediction of RNA-small molecule binding sites. The model integrates geometric descriptors of the local three-dimensional environment with pretrained RNA language model embeddings to capture complementary structural and sequence information. We investigate three pretrained RNA language models RNA-BERT, ERNIE-RNA and RNA-FM and assess the contributions of sequence representations and geometric features through feature-level ablation experiments. The model is developed using the TR60 and HARIBOSS datasets and evaluated on four independent benchmark datasets: RB9, TE18, TL12 and JL10. RSMBind achieves the highest MCC among the compared methods on three of the four benchmarks, with relative improvements of 17.1% on RB9, 7.2% on TL12 and 16.0% on JL10 over the best previously reported results, while achieving competitive performance on TE18. Furthermore, RSMBind retains predictive capability when using only pretrained RNA language model embeddings, highlighting their potential utility when explicit tertiary structural features are unavailable. Structural analysis indicates differences in prediction performance across RNA structural regions, with loop-associated binding sites generally being captured more effectively than those embedded within stem regions. Additionally, 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations of selected RNA-ligand complexes provide insights into the relationship between predicted binding probabilities and dynamic ligand proximity, further highlighting the role of conformational dynamics in evaluating structure-based predictions. The source code is available at [ https://github.com/sharma-nandita/RSMBind].
zh_abstract: RNA 正在成为有前景的治疗靶点，小分子结合可以调节其结构和功能，为治疗开发创造了机会。因此，准确识别 RNA–小分子结合位点对于理解 RNA–配体相互作用和促进 RNA 靶向药物发现具有重要意义。然而，RNA 结构的复杂性以及经实验表征的 RNA–配体复合物数量有限，给结合位点的计算预测带来了挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了 RSMBind，一种基于图注意力的深度学习框架，用于核苷酸水平的 RNA–小分子结合位点预测。该模型将局部三维环境的几何描述符与预训练 RNA 语言模型的嵌入相结合，以捕捉互补的结构和序列信息。我们研究了三种预训练 RNA 语言模型 RNA-BERT、ERNIE-RNA 和 RNA-FM，并通过特征层面的消融实验评估序列表征和几何特征的贡献。该模型使用 TR60 和 HARIBOSS 数据集开发，并在四个独立基准数据集 RB9、TE18、TL12 和 JL10 上进行评估。RSMBind 在四个基准中的三个上取得了对比方法中最高的 MCC，相比此前报道的最佳结果，在 RB9、TL12 和 JL10 上分别相对提高了 17.1%、7.2% 和 16.0%，同时在 TE18 上取得了具有竞争力的性能。此外，当仅使用预训练 RNA 语言模型嵌入时，RSMBind 仍保持预测能力，凸显了其在缺乏明确三级结构特征时的潜在用途。结构分析表明，不同 RNA 结构区域的预测性能存在差异，与环相关的结合位点通常比位于茎区的结合位点更容易被有效捕获。此外，对选定 RNA–配体复合物进行的 100 ns 分子动力学模拟，为预测的结合概率与配体动态接近程度之间的关系提供了见解，进一步凸显了构象动力学在评估基于结构的预测中的作用。源代码可在 [https://github.com/sharma-nandita/RSMBind] 获取。

abstract: Summary: Identifying epigenetically modified bases (e.g., methylation) is crucial for many important applications such as discovering mechanisms of cancer development, cell differentiation, and bacterial defense. Nanopore sequencing generates electrical signals that can differentiate canonical bases from modified ones. To detect base modifications from signals, machine learning (ML) methods and statistical approaches are commonly used. These methods can either detect a specific modification type or require an additional unmodified copy of the same DNA as a control group. However, no released model detects modification types beyond those it was trained for, which makes it difficult to detect rare modification types without an unmodified control. Our goal is to accurately identify the presence of modified sites regardless of their modification type, which we define as modification-agnostic detection. To this end, we propose RawMod, a transformer-based modification-agnostic and control-free method for detecting epigenetically modified genomic positions. The key idea of RawMod is to compare the raw signals of many reads at each site with the unmodified reference sequence, using a small model that learns many modification types as a single modified class. Based on our extensive evaluations on the detection of various modification types (5mC, 5hmC, 4mC, 6mA, and 5hmU) using various genomes, RawMod achieves the highest mean AUROC across modifications compared to control-based methods and control-free modification models. A single RawMod model with 0.23M parameters detects five modification types with a mean AUROC of 0.964, against 0.799 for the best released model. When a modification type is withheld from training, RawMod still detects it (AUROC 0.91--0.98), provided another modification of the same base was seen in training. We use RawMod to map 5hmU without a control across a 7.7 Mb contig of the Amphidinium carterae genome, consistent with two published trends. Further, we show that the modification-aware embeddings from RawMod can be used to differentiate read origin (e.g., cell types, tumor/normal origin, and native/PCR-amplified DNA). We discuss how RawMod can enable further work on label-free classification of cell types using these modification-aware embeddings. abstract: [ArXiv] To accelerate chemical exchange saturation transfer magnetic resonance fingerprinting (CEST-MRF) using temporal deep learning reconstruction. Ten healthy volunteers underwent repeated test-retest golden-angle radial CEST-MRF acquisitions with 30 measurements and 34 spokes per measurement. The Movienet network was adapted to reconstruct accelerated radial CEST-MRF data. Separate models were trained using 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 20, and 34 spokes per measurement. Temporal and coil correlations were exploited by concatenating time and coil dimensions in the input. GRASP-based locally low-rank (GRASP-LLR) reconstruction was used for comparison. Quantitative DRONE fitting generated tissue parameter maps. Movienet-8 was evaluated with leave-one-subject-out analysis. Prospectively acquired 8-spoke datasets were compared with paired 34-spoke acquisitions, and Movienet-8 and Movienet-34 were compared with a 64-spoke acquisition. In the held-out retrospective series, median Pearson correlations between Movienet and GRASP-LLR were 0.795, 0.947, 0.974, 0.977, and 0.981 for 1, 8, 16, 20, and 34 spokes, respectively. Corresponding NRMSE values were 14.7, 8.2, 5.9, 5.3, and 5.1 percent. Across 10 leave-one-subject-out volunteers, median image correlation was 0.965 and NRMSE was 7.5 percent. Reconstruction of a 30-slice series required 1.7 s with Movienet versus approximately 45 min with GRASP-LLR. Movienet enables whole-brain radial CEST-MRF acquisition in 3 min, with image reconstruction in less than 2 s.
