abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] The assessment of the risk of bias (RoB) of each study is a necessary but labor-intensive step in conducting a systematic review (SR). There is a potential for AI to reduce the time and effort needed for RoB assessment and improve consistency between reviewers, but little is known about the accuracy of AI-based RoB assessments. In this study, we aim to evaluate the performance of a large language model (LLM) when given the questions from the RoB tool and the relevant passages from the full-text papers in assessing RoB in observational studies of environmental exposures and health outcomes. We evaluated the performance of GPT-5-mini on 128 observational studies from a SR of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances and health outcomes conducted by the National Academies of Sciences. The navigation guide (NavGuide), a domain-based RoB tool designed for environmental studies, was used. For each paper-domain pair, the LLM was provided with the questions and guidance from the NavGuide and the human-identified text passages addressing that domain. The LLM returned a structured RoB rating, which was compared to the human-adjudicated ratings to quantify agreement and identify patterns of discrepancy. GPT-5-mini RoB assessments for exact matches (64.5%; κ=0.199, Gwet AC2=0.882, F1-score=0.311) remained lower than the concordance between humans and the reference standard (87.5%-91.4%). Performance improved substantially for partial matches, reflecting agreement in direction but not necessarily in magnitude (eg, "low" and "probably low"), with percent concordance of 91.9% (κ=0.241, Gwet AC2=0.910, F1-score=0.614; for humans, 97.9%-98.6% concordance). Performance varied across the NavGuide domains, with the worst performance in domain 1 (selection bias) and the best in domain 4 (outcome assessment). The models tended to be more stringent than humans, often assigning higher RoB ratings (eg, "probably low" when humans assigned "low"). Our results suggest that although concordance was moderate and inconsistent across domains, LLMs may be sufficiently accurate for use with human oversight. LLMs can flag cases for human adjudication or consistency checking but are not ready for use as an independent second reviewer without human oversight.
zh_abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] 对每项研究进行偏倚风险（RoB）评估是开展系统综述（SR）中必要但耗费人力的步骤。人工智能有可能减少RoB评估所需的时间和精力，并提高评价者之间的一致性，但关于基于AI的RoB评估准确性的了解甚少。本研究旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）在获得RoB工具的问题及全文论文相关段落的情况下，评估环境暴露与健康结局观察性研究RoB的表现。我们在美国国家科学院开展的一项关于全氟和多氟烷基物质与健康结局的系统综述中的128项观察性研究上评估了GPT-5-mini的表现。使用的是专为环境研究设计的基于领域的RoB工具——导航指南（navigation guide，NavGuide）。对于每一个论文-领域对，向LLM提供NavGuide的问题和指导，以及人工识别出的涉及该领域的文本段落。LLM返回结构化的RoB评级，并与人工裁定的评级进行比较，以量化一致性并识别差异模式。GPT-5-mini的RoB评估在完全匹配方面（64.5%；κ=0.199，Gwet AC2=0.882，F1分数=0.311）仍低于人工与参考标准之间的一致性（87.5%–91.4%）。在部分匹配方面表现显著改善，即方向一致但程度不一定一致（例如“低”与“可能低”），一致率为91.9%（κ=0.241，Gwet AC2=0.910，F1分数=0.614；人工为97.9%–98.6%）。不同NavGuide领域的表现各异，领域1（选择偏倚）最差，领域4（结局评估）最好。模型往往比人工更为严格，常给出更高的RoB评级（例如人工评为“低”时模型评为“可能低”）。我们的结果提示，尽管一致性处于中等水平且各领域间不一致，LLM在有人工监督的情况下可能具有足够的准确性。LLM可用于标记需要人工裁定或一致性核查的病例，但在没有人工监督的情况下尚不能作为独立的第二评价者使用。

title: Beyond Model Choice: A Harness-Centered Framework for Designing Clinical Large Language Model Agents.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research
zh_title: 超越模型选择：以harness为中心的临床LLM智能体设计框架
summary: 观点文章主张将harness作为临床智能体设计、评估与报告的显式单元，并提出三层框架。
key_points: harness负责信息选择、动作约束与执行验证
基准显示不同harness配置性能差异明显
提出可修订的三层框架
reason: 观点类文章，有一定框架意义，受观点上限约束
abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Clinical large language model agents depend on both model capability and the surrounding system that selects information, constrains actions, and verifies execution. In this Viewpoint, we argue that this harness should be an explicit unit of clinical agent design, evaluation, and reporting. Our aim is to help clinical informatics and development teams specify this layer and to help evaluators and institutional governance teams assess its contributions and risks. Selected benchmarks show substantial performance differences across harness configurations, but architecture comparisons, bundled improvements, and within-model component comparisons support different levels of causal attribution. We propose a revisable 3-tier framework: tier 1 specifies general orchestration functions, including prompts, tools, output schemas, control flow, memory, and generic verification; tier 2 specifies their clinical adaptations for knowledge integration, differential reasoning, missingness and temporality, safety verification, and workflow alignment; and tier 3 specifies a failure-driven evaluation cycle applied to both. Our contribution is a framework that makes these connections explicit. We provide classification rules, an illustrative clinical example, a proposed evaluation protocol, and a minimum reporting checklist. Observable execution traces are distinguished from private model reasoning, with provenance and privacy safeguards supporting retrospective reconstruction. Evaluation should separate task success, clinical correctness, process safety, and operational reliability. Lightweight fine-tuning can complement harness design; their interaction requires controlled study. The framework is a proposal for empirical testing, not a validated taxonomy or evidence of deployment safety.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 临床大语言模型智能体既取决于模型能力，也取决于负责筛选信息、约束行动并验证执行的周边系统。在本观点文章中，我们主张这一“支架”（harness）应成为临床智能体设计、评估和报告中的一个明确单元。我们的目的是帮助临床信息学和开发团队明确规定这一层，并帮助评估者和机构治理团队评估其贡献与风险。所选基准测试显示，不同支架配置之间存在显著的性能差异，但架构比较、捆绑式改进以及模型内部的组件比较，所支持的因果归因程度各不相同。我们提出一个可修订的三层框架：第1层规定通用的编排功能，包括提示词、工具、输出模式、控制流、记忆和通用验证；第2层规定其在知识整合、鉴别推理、缺失与时序性、安全验证以及工作流程对齐方面的临床适配；第3层规定一个由失败驱动的评估循环，应用于前两层。我们的贡献是提出了使这些联系明确化的框架。我们提供了分类规则、一个说明性的临床示例、一项拟议的评估方案以及一份最低报告清单。可观察的执行轨迹与模型的私有推理相区分，并通过溯源和隐私保护措施支持回顾性重建。评估应区分任务成功、临床正确性、过程安全性和运行可靠性。轻量级微调可与支架设计相互补充；二者的相互作用需要对照研究。该框架是供实证检验的提议，而非经过验证的分类体系，亦不构成部署安全性的证据。

title: Development and Evaluation of a Transformer-Based Multi-Scale Feature Model for the Classification of Benign and Malignant Breast Lesions in Ultrasound Image.
zh_title: 基于Transformer多尺度特征的乳腺超声良恶性分类模型
summary: 提出MSF-US框架，融合多尺度特征与注意力机制，在多中心乳腺超声数据上与ResNet-50、ViT、Swin等比较，5折交叉验证准确率约0.906。
key_points: 多尺度特征融合加注意力机制
多中心数据集，5折交叉验证
平均准确率0.9057，与主流模型对比
reason: 仅交叉验证、无独立外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Ultrasonic imaging] This study introduces MSF-US, a novel deep learning framework integrating multi-scale feature fusion and attention mechanisms. It aims to enhance early breast cancer detection and improve diagnostic accuracy in ultrasound images, particularly addressing the challenges of capturing global and local features in dense breast tissue. The MSF-US model combines hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction with attention mechanisms to selectively focus on diagnostically relevant regions. The framework was rigorously validated on a multi-center dataset of breast ultrasound images. Its performance was compared against state-of-the-art models, such as ResNet-50, Vision Transformer (ViT), and Swin Transformer, evaluating accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC). In 5-fold cross-validation, MSF-US yielded an average accuracy of 0.9057, sensitivity of 0.9075, and AUC of 0.9212 with high net clinical benefit. On the independent C3 test set, it surpassed 8 SOTA baselines with a peak accuracy of 0.9406, F1 score of 0.9483, and AUC of 0.9391. Evaluation on 3 diverse public cohorts (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and BrEaST) confirmed excellent cross-center generalizability, achieving AUCs up to 0.9519. Ablation analysis validated that the synergy of multi-scale feature fusion and attention mechanisms significantly boosted diagnostic precision over single-scale baselines. MSF-US delivers state-of-the-art performance in breast ultrasound imaging, offering a highly reliable tool for early breast cancer detection. Its innovative design successfully addresses the limitations of existing methods, presenting significant clinical potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [超声成像] 本研究提出MSF-US，这是一种整合多尺度特征融合和注意力机制的新型深度学习框架。其目的是增强早期乳腺癌检测并提高超声图像的诊断准确性，特别是应对在致密乳腺组织中捕获全局和局部特征的挑战。MSF-US模型将分层多尺度特征提取与注意力机制相结合，以选择性地聚焦于具有诊断意义的区域。该框架在多中心乳腺超声图像数据集上进行了严格验证，并将其性能与ResNet-50、Vision Transformer（ViT）和Swin Transformer等最先进模型比较，评估准确率、敏感性、特异性和曲线下面积（AUC）。在5折交叉验证中，MSF-US的平均准确率为0.9057，敏感性为0.9075，AUC为0.9212，且临床净获益较高。在独立的C3测试集上，其超越了8个SOTA基线，最高准确率为0.9406，F1分数为0.9483，AUC为0.9391。在3个不同的公共队列（BUSI、BUS-BRA和BrEaST）上的评估证实了其出色的跨中心泛化能力，AUC最高可达0.9519。消融分析验证了多尺度特征融合与注意力机制的协同作用相比单尺度基线显著提升了诊断精度。MSF-US在乳腺超声成像中提供了最先进的性能，为早期乳腺癌检测提供了高度可靠的工具。其创新设计成功解决了现有方法的局限性，在提高诊断准确性和改善患者预后方面具有重要的临床潜力。

title: Standardising ocular surface photography for artificial intelligence: current limitations and a proposed roadmap.
source: PubMed · Progress in retinal and eye research
zh_title: 面向AI的眼表摄影标准化：局限与路线图
summary: 综述指出眼表摄影缺乏统一采集与处理规范，影响可重复性与设备间可比性，并提出AI应用的标准化路线图。
key_points: 裂隙灯摄影缺乏标准化采集与处理方案
曲面几何、离轴照明、自动色彩校正等限制可重复性
提出面向AI的标准化路线图
reason: 综述/路线图类，无新数据，眼科方向略加分
abstract: [Progress in retinal and eye research] Slit-lamp colour photography remains a cornerstone of anterior segment documentation and longitudinal monitoring. However, conventional slit-lamp photography has seen relatively limited technological advancement compared with the rapid development of quantitative anterior-segment modalities such as AS-OCT, Scheimpflug tomography and confocal microscopy. Despite the wide diffusion of digital cameras, smartphones, and high-end slit-lamp systems, ocular surface photography (OSP) remains hampered by the absence of standardised acquisition and processing protocols. The convex, aspheric geometry of the ocular surface, off-axis illumination, peripheral defocus, automatic colour correction, and pupil-driven exposure variation in retroillumination limit reproducibility, inter-device comparability, and clinical utility. In this review we critically appraise current OSP applications across major ocular surface conditions (dry eye disease, conjunctival hyperaemia, infectious keratitis, ocular surface burns, and ocular surface neoplasia), mapping the hardware, software, and reproducibility limitations that constrain clinical practice. We then examine how these limitations propagate into artificial intelligence (AI) development, where the absence of large, well-annotated, demographically diverse OSP datasets, together with the lack of reproducible quantitative phenotypes and reliable labels, is now the principal bottleneck to clinically deployable models; we discuss patient-level data partitioning and external validation, and outline how deep learning, federated learning and foundation models can both utilise and improve OSP. Finally, we propose a minimum acquisition and dataset specification, tiered by clinical setting from research to community screening, and a staged roadmap that combines hardware standardisation (focus-stacked, illumination-controlled, colour-calibrated acquisition), interoperable metadata-rich storage (DICOM where infrastructure permits), quantitative phenotype definition, and diverse international dataset collaborations, so that the ocular surface can benefit from quantitative imaging and AI as other areas of ophthalmology have begun to.
zh_abstract: [Progress in retinal and eye research] 裂隙灯彩色照相仍是眼前节记录和纵向监测的基石。然而，与AS-OCT、Scheimpflug断层成像和共聚焦显微镜等定量眼前节检查方式的快速发展相比，传统裂隙灯摄影的技术进步相对有限。尽管数码相机、智能手机和高端裂隙灯系统广泛普及，眼表摄影（OSP）仍因缺乏标准化的采集和处理方案而受到限制。眼表的凸形非球面几何结构、离轴照明、周边离焦、自动色彩校正，以及后照法中由瞳孔驱动的曝光变化，限制了其可重复性、不同设备间的可比性和临床实用性。在本综述中，我们批判性地评价了OSP在主要眼表疾病（干眼病、结膜充血、感染性角膜炎、眼表烧伤和眼表肿瘤）中的当前应用，梳理了制约临床实践的硬件、软件和可重复性方面的局限。随后我们探讨了这些局限如何传导至人工智能（AI）的开发：缺乏大规模、标注良好、人口学多样的OSP数据集，以及缺乏可重复的定量表型和可靠标签，是目前可临床部署模型的主要瓶颈；我们讨论了患者层面的数据划分和外部验证，并概述了深度学习、联邦学习和基础模型如何既能利用又能改进OSP。最后，我们提出了按从研究到社区筛查的临床场景分层的最低采集和数据集规范，以及一个分阶段路线图，该路线图结合了硬件标准化（焦点堆叠、照明可控、色彩校准的采集）、可互操作且元数据丰富的存储（在基础设施允许时采用DICOM）、定量表型定义，以及多样化的国际数据集合作，使眼表能够像眼科其他领域一样受益于定量成像和AI。

title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
zh_title: 静态恢复不等于动态稳定：蛋白质基序支架的动力学感知基准
summary: 提出BILBY-PRO基准（220个功能基序案例），并评估六种支架生成模型，强调动态稳定性评价。
key_points: 基于PROSITE的220个案例、174条目
评估六个近期支架生成模型
RFDiffusion、Proteina覆盖目标更多
reason: 新基准且对比多模型，预印本，规模中等，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质基序支架（motif scaffolding）基准用于评估生成模型能否围绕功能上重要的残基构建支架。其结论取决于所测试的基序以及定义成功的标准。现有基准通常使用小规模、人工筛选的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往取决于构象系综及其转变。在此，我们同时解决基准范围和成功标准两方面的问题。我们提出了BILBY-PRO，这是一个由系统方法得到的、来自与PROSITE关联的实验结构的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自174个PROSITE基序模式条目的220个案例。对六个近期支架生成模型的评估显示，它们在目标覆盖率和独特解产出方面呈现出不同模式：RFDiffusion和Proteina解决的目标更多，而ESM3在其所解决的目标上产生更多独特的成功支架。我们进一步提出了BILBY-MD，一种基于参照的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于原始MotifBench基准中静态求解成功的设计时，它将基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保留以及基序二面角自由能景观与参照模拟进行比较。在55个静态求解成功的模型-问题配对中，31个满足我们的MD支持标准，仅8个通过全部检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常得到MD支持，而界面样或依赖上下文的基序失败更为频繁。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但并不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY突出了基序支架评估的三个互补维度：目标覆盖率、独特解产出以及MD支持的动力学保真度。

title: Artificial intelligence in cardiology for non-experts: decoding key terms and understanding machine learning methodologies. A Scientific Statement of the ESC Working Group on e-Cardiology, the European Heart Rhythm Association (EHRA), the Association for Acute CardioVascular Care (ACVC), the Heart Failure Association (HFA), the European Association of Cardiovascular Imaging (EACVI), the European Association of Preventive Cardiology (EAPC), and the European Association of Percutaneous Cardiovascular Interventions (EAPCI) of the ESC, the ESC Regulatory Affairs Committee, and the ESC Digital Cardiology and Artificial Intelligence Committee.
source: PubMed · European heart journal. Digital health
zh_title: 面向非专家的心脏病学AI：术语与机器学习方法（ESC科学声明）
summary: ESC多个工作组发布科学声明，旨在提升临床医生对心脏病学AI术语和机器学习方法的素养。
key_points: 面向非AI专业的心脏科医生
解读关键术语与机器学习方法
涵盖诊断、风险预测、工作流与治疗决策
reason: 科学声明属观点类，教育性质，增量档
abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Evidence-based medicine represents the systematic approach through which physicians today use the best available scientific evidence from clinical research to guide their clinical decision-making process. However, the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI), with its diverse models and potential applications in medicine, is leading to a new form of research driven by 'big data' and heterogeneous datasets, extending beyond conventional statistical analysis and thereby making AI literacy an increasingly essential competence for clinicians. Artificial intelligence applications in cardiology have shown potential to support disease diagnosis, risk prediction, workflow efficiency, and therapeutic decision-making. However, despite these opportunities, AI may also represent a technological barrier for many physicians, due to its mathematical foundations and the speed at which models evolve. A solid understanding of AI concepts is therefore necessary for cardiologists to critically interpret results and engage with this new research landscape. This scientific statement explores AI in cardiology from an educational perspective, outlining the key knowledge required to build adequate AI literacy. The goal is to enable cardiologists not only to avoid reliance on external experts for methodological decisions, but also to collaborate with greater insight and informed judgment.
zh_abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] 循证医学是指医生如今借以运用临床研究中可获得的最佳科学证据来指导临床决策过程的系统方法。然而，人工智能（AI）及其多样化的模型和在医学中的潜在应用的出现，正在催生一种由“大数据”和异质性数据集驱动的新型研究形式，其范围超出了传统统计分析，从而使 AI 素养日益成为临床医生的一项必备能力。人工智能在心脏病学中的应用已显示出支持疾病诊断、风险预测、提高工作流程效率和治疗决策的潜力。然而，尽管存在这些机遇，由于其数学基础以及模型更新的速度，AI 对许多医生而言也可能构成一道技术壁垒。因此，心脏病学家需要扎实理解 AI 概念，以便批判性地解读结果并参与这一新的研究领域。本科学声明从教育的角度探讨心脏病学中的 AI，概述建立足够 AI 素养所需的关键知识。其目标是使心脏病学家不仅无需在方法学决策上依赖外部专家，而且能够以更深入的洞察力和明智的判断力开展合作。

title: Digital Scribes in Dentistry: Opportunities, Risks and Practical Considerations.
zh_title: 牙科数字抄写员：机遇、风险与实践考量
summary: 叙述性综述，探讨数字抄写员在澳大利亚牙科实践中的证据、挑战与实施要点。
key_points: 基于语音识别与AI从医患对话生成病历
潜在益处：提升工作流效率、减轻文书负担
局限：遗漏、事实错误、牙科术语识别差
reason: 叙述性综述，牙科证据有限，属增量档
abstract: [Australian dental journal] Digital scribes are increasingly being adopted in healthcare to reduce documentation burden and improve clinical workflow. These systems generate clinical records from clinician-patient conversations using speech recognition and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. While studies in medicine suggest benefits including reduced administrative workload and improved clinician experience, evidence in dentistry remains limited. This narrative review examines the current evidence, challenges, and implementation considerations associated with digital scribes in Australian dental practice. Potential benefits include improved workflow efficiency, documentation support, clinician satisfaction and enhanced practitioner-patient relationships. Reported limitations include omissions, factual inaccuracies, poor recognition of dental terminology, reduced performance in complex communication environments and the generation of misleading or excessive clinical records. Potential unintended consequences include automation bias, changes in clinician-patient interactions, impacts on clinical reasoning, patient self-censorship, and equity concerns related to algorithmic bias. Dental practitioners remain professionally accountable for the accuracy and completeness of AI-generated clinical records. Consequently, implementation of digital scribes in dental settings requires robust governance, informed consent processes, clinician oversight and ongoing performance auditing. Further research is needed to evaluate the impact of digital scribes in dental practice, including their effects on patient outcomes, dental education and health equity.
zh_abstract: [澳大利亚牙科杂志] 数字抄录员（digital scribes）在医疗领域的应用日益增多，旨在减轻文书记录负担并改善临床工作流程。这类系统利用语音识别和人工智能（AI）技术，根据临床医生与患者之间的对话生成临床记录。医学领域的研究提示其益处包括减少行政工作量和改善临床医生体验，但牙科领域的证据仍然有限。本叙述性综述探讨了数字抄录员在澳大利亚牙科实践中的现有证据、挑战及实施方面的考虑。潜在益处包括提高工作流程效率、辅助文书记录、提高临床医生满意度以及改善医患关系。已报告的局限性包括遗漏、事实性错误、对牙科术语识别不佳、在复杂沟通环境中表现下降，以及生成具有误导性或过多的临床记录。潜在的非预期后果包括自动化偏倚、临床医生与患者互动的改变、对临床推理的影响、患者自我审查，以及与算法偏倚相关的公平性问题。牙科从业者仍需对 AI 生成的临床记录的准确性和完整性承担专业责任。因此，在牙科场所实施数字抄录员需要健全的治理、知情同意流程、临床医生监督以及持续的性能审核。仍需进一步研究以评估数字抄录员在牙科实践中的影响，包括其对患者结局、牙科教育和健康公平的作用。

title: CrossBoneNet: An Ultralightweight Hybrid CNN-ViT Architecture via Asymmetric Reversed Cross-Attention for Radiographic Fracture Detection.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: CrossBoneNet：用于骨折X线检测的超轻量CNN-ViT混合架构
summary: 提出超轻量CNN-ViT模型CrossBoneNet，通过非对称反向交叉注意力融合局部与全局特征，面向边缘设备的X线骨折检测。
key_points: 结合CNN局部微骨折与ViT全局解剖识别
提出非对称反向交叉注意力融合特征
面向资源受限的边缘AI部署
reason: 增量档：轻量架构新意有限，摘要未见外部验证信息
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Misdiagnoses in emergency departments are often associated with the difficulty in interpreting radiological findings on bone fractures due to millimetric fractures, overlapping bones, or superimpositions. Despite the high efficiency of state-of-the-art models in diagnosing such cases, their massive computational requirements severely hinder their implementation on resource-constrained devices in real-world clinical settings. In this study, we propose an ultralightweight CNN-ViT model, CrossBoneNet, which is designed for edge AI compatibility with minimal memory requirements. CrossBoneNet combines local microfracture detection using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and global anatomical recognition using vision transformers (ViTs). The model merges features from both architectures using the proposed asymmetric reversed cross-attention, where CNN features act as queries and ViT features act as keys and values-to efficiently map fine-grained local anomalies into a broader global anatomical context. Operating with a minimal parameter count (0.593 M) and low computational cost (1.527 GFLOPs), CrossBoneNet achieved a PR-AUC of 0.8498 ± 0.0086 and a ROC-AUC of 0.8427 ± 0.0072 on the MURA dataset in a patient-wise isolated evaluation. It achieves highly competitive performance-remaining within a 4% margin of the 88.59 million parameter ConvNeXt-Base model-while delivering over 99% memory savings. After fine-tuning on the FracAtlas dataset, CrossBoneNet achieved a specificity of 0.9760 ± 0.0080 and PR-AUC of 0.7568 ± 0.0414, demonstrating effective cross-domain transfer learning. With a compact footprint (< 3 MB) and high specificity at the default 0.50 operating threshold, CrossBoneNet demonstrates potential as a point-of-care decision support and worklist prioritization tool on resource-constrained devices, while calibrating the decision threshold (e.g., τ = 0.3837 and τ = 0.3449 ) enables high-sensitivity screening modes (achieving 85.03% and 89.96% sensitivity on MURA, respectively), pending prospective validation. This retrospective study establishes proof of concept; future work will focus on prospective clinical trials and expansion to multiclass fracture classification.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 急诊科的误诊常与骨折影像学表现解读困难相关，原因包括毫米级骨折、骨骼重叠或叠加影像。尽管最先进的模型在诊断此类病例方面效率很高，但其庞大的计算需求严重阻碍了它们在真实临床环境中资源受限设备上的部署。在本研究中，我们提出了一种超轻量级CNN-ViT模型CrossBoneNet，其设计兼容边缘AI，内存需求极低。CrossBoneNet结合了利用卷积神经网络（CNN）的局部微骨折检测和利用视觉Transformer（ViT）的全局解剖识别。该模型通过所提出的非对称反向交叉注意力融合两种架构的特征，其中CNN特征作为查询（queries），ViT特征作为键和值（keys and values），从而有效地将细粒度的局部异常映射到更广泛的全局解剖背景中。CrossBoneNet参数量极少（0.593 M），计算成本低（1.527 GFLOPs），在MURA数据集上按患者隔离评估时，PR-AUC为0.8498 ± 0.0086，ROC-AUC为0.8427 ± 0.0072。其性能极具竞争力——与8859万参数的ConvNeXt-Base模型相差不超过4%——同时节省了超过99%的内存。在FracAtlas数据集上微调后，CrossBoneNet的特异度为0.9760 ± 0.0080，PR-AUC为0.7568 ± 0.0414，显示出有效的跨域迁移学习能力。CrossBoneNet体积小巧（< 3 MB），在默认0.50操作阈值下具有较高的特异度，显示出作为资源受限设备上的床旁决策支持和工作列表优先级排序工具的潜力；同时，校准决策阈值（例如τ = 0.3837和τ = 0.3449）可实现高灵敏度筛查模式（在MURA上分别达到85.03%和89.96%的灵敏度），有待前瞻性验证。这项回顾性研究确立了概念验证；未来工作将聚焦于前瞻性临床试验以及扩展至多类别骨折分类。

title: Deep Learning-Based Analysis of Microscopic Hyperspectral Images of HER2-Stained Breast Cancer Sections for Molecular Status Prediction.
zh_title: 基于深度学习的HER2染色乳腺癌切片显微高光谱图像分子状态预测
summary: 在43例病例上用弱监督多实例学习模型SpectralMix-MIL分析高光谱图像，预测HER2状态，测试集AUROC为0.923。
key_points: 43例病例，高光谱128波段
SpectralMix-MIL结合光谱投影与注意力池化
患者级测试AUROC 0.923，AUPRC 0.910
reason: 病理方向有新意，但单中心小样本，仅内部划分验证
abstract: [Journal of biophotonics] HER2 assessment in breast cancer relies on immunohistochemistry (IHC) with reflex in situ hybridization for equivocal cases, while conventional bright-field imaging provides limited quantitative optical information. We investigated microscopic hyperspectral imaging (HSI) of HER2-stained sections for slide-level molecular status prediction. HSI data from 43 cases (21 HER2-positive, 22 HER2-negative; 400-1000 nm, 128 bands) were acquired between January 2024 and August 2025. After calibration, optical-density conversion, tissue masking, and Savitzky-Golay smoothing, we developed SpectralMix-MIL, a weakly supervised multiple-instance learning model combining learnable spectral projection (K = 32) with attention pooling. On a patient-level 7:3 train/test split, SpectralMix-MIL achieved an AUROC of 0.923 and AUPRC of 0.910. Repeated stratified fivefold cross-validation yielded mean AUROC 0.904 ± 0.041 and AUPRC 0.892 ± 0.045, while leave-one-out cross-validation yielded AUROC 0.897. These findings support microscopic HSI for quantitative breast cancer molecular phenotyping, pending larger external validation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of biophotonics] 乳腺癌中的HER2评估依赖免疫组化（IHC），对于结果不明确的病例则需反射性进行原位杂交，而传统明场成像提供的定量光学信息有限。我们研究了对HER2染色切片进行显微高光谱成像（HSI）以预测玻片水平的分子状态。2024年1月至2025年8月期间采集了43例病例（21例HER2阳性，22例HER2阴性；400-1000 nm，128个波段）的HSI数据。经过校准、光密度转换、组织掩膜和Savitzky-Golay平滑处理后，我们开发了SpectralMix-MIL，这是一种弱监督多示例学习模型，将可学习的光谱投影（K = 32）与注意力池化相结合。在按患者水平7:3划分的训练/测试集上，SpectralMix-MIL的AUROC为0.923，AUPRC为0.910。重复分层五折交叉验证得到的平均AUROC为0.904 ± 0.041，AUPRC为0.892 ± 0.045，而留一法交叉验证的AUROC为0.897。这些发现支持将显微HSI用于乳腺癌分子表型的定量分析，尚需更大规模的外部验证。

title: Task-adaptive anonymisation enables privacy-preserving sharing of clinical speech data
zh_title: 任务自适应匿名化实现临床语音数据的隐私保护共享
summary: 提出CASA临床自适应语音匿名化智能体，按任务需求动态调整声纹与内容匿名化，兼顾隐私与临床效用。
key_points: 临床语音含声纹与敏感内容，共享有隐私风险
将匿名化转为任务引导的优化过程
通过递归自我改进动态调整策略
reason: 预印本，方法有新意，智能体用于隐私保护，证据有限
abstract: Clinical speech is increasingly used for disease screening and clinical assessment, but directly distributing speech recordings poses privacy risks because they contain both speaker-identifying voiceprints and sensitive spoken content. Existing speech anonymisation approaches are primarily developed for general speech applications or task-specific clinical speech and overlook that different clinical tasks rely on distinct speech characteristics, necessitating task-adaptive anonymisation strategies to protect patient privacy while preserving clinical utility. Here we introduce CASA, a clinically adaptive speech anonymisation agent that transforms anonymisation from a fixed processing procedure into a task-guided optimisation process, dynamically tailoring voiceprint and content anonymisation to task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements. Through recursive self-improvement (RSI), CASA iteratively evaluates and refines anonymisation strategies against task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements, while learning from these outcomes to guide more efficient planning in subsequent clinical tasks. CASA is validated across 14 clinical tasks encompassing five languages, diverse elicitation paradigms, and mental health, cognitive and voice disorders. CASA preserved disease-related classification performance while meeting speaker-anonymisation requirements across all clinical tasks, versus only 8/14 for the strongest fixed method. Assessments of resistance to speaker re-identification by external attackers and identification and redaction of sensitive personal information in clinical speech further demonstrated CASA's dual protection of speaker identity and sensitive spoken content. Clinical expert assessments further supported the preservation of clinically relevant information and the acceptability of anonymised speech for controlled research sharing.
zh_abstract: 临床语音越来越多地用于疾病筛查和临床评估，但直接分发语音录音存在隐私风险，因为其同时包含可识别说话人的声纹和敏感的口述内容。现有的语音匿名化方法主要针对通用语音应用或特定任务的临床语音而开发，忽视了不同临床任务依赖于不同的语音特征，因此需要任务自适应的匿名化策略，以在保护患者隐私的同时保留临床效用。在此，我们提出了CASA，一种临床自适应语音匿名化智能体，它将匿名化从固定的处理流程转变为任务引导的优化过程，根据任务特定的隐私和临床效用要求动态调整声纹和内容的匿名化。通过递归自我改进（RSI），CASA针对任务特定的隐私和临床效用要求，迭代地评估并优化匿名化策略，同时从这些结果中学习，以指导后续临床任务中更高效的规划。CASA在14项临床任务中得到验证，涵盖五种语言、多样的语音诱发范式，以及心理健康、认知和嗓音障碍。在所有临床任务中，CASA在满足说话人匿名化要求的同时保持了疾病相关的分类性能，而最强的固定方法仅在14项中的8项做到这一点。对外部攻击者说话人重识别的抵抗能力评估，以及对临床语音中敏感个人信息的识别与删除评估，进一步证明了CASA对说话人身份和敏感口述内容的双重保护。临床专家评估进一步支持了临床相关信息的保留以及匿名化语音可用于受控研究共享的可接受性。

title: Open Problems in Chatbots and Mental Health
zh_title: 聊天机器人与心理健康的开放问题
summary: 综述通用聊天机器人用于情感与心理健康支持时，在评估、安全与政策方面的关键开放问题。
key_points: 指出谄媚、强化妄想信念、危机应对差等风险
静态基准无法证明聊天机器人安全
多轮交互评估与模拟方法需要验证
reason: 综述/观点类上限6，议题相关，精神健康LLM方向小幅上调
abstract: General-purpose chatbots are increasingly used for emotional and mental health support. They can be useful, but issues such as sycophancy, reinforcement of delusional beliefs, and poor crisis response create risks that are difficult for researchers to study and evaluate. In this paper, we review the most critical open problems for researchers and policymakers in the use of general-purpose chatbots and their effects on mental health. First, there are tractable problems in the controlled evaluation of chatbots: establishing the construct and ecological validity of evaluations, evaluating multi-turn interactions, and connecting evaluations to improvements in chatbot behavior. For example, conventional benchmarks that primarily rely on static datasets cannot establish chatbot safety, and novel simulation methods need validation. Second, researchers must connect their studies of chatbots and mental health to real-world evidence. This includes analyzing the chatbot products that AI companies and mental health practitioners have deployed, including their user interfaces and human review and escalation practices for user welfare concerns. However, clinical analysis opportunities afforded by real chat log data sharing are complicated by significant privacy concerns. Finally, we argue that researchers should take an active role in the construction and refinement of evidence-based policy through corporate and governmental decisions such as user protections, standards of care, protected access to user chat logs, data sharing between institutions, incident reporting, and post-deployment monitoring. Such behavioral evaluations, studies of real-world outcomes, and data governance depend on each other and must be addressed in tandem. We believe a coordinated research effort would have substantial real-world impact.

title: Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality
zh_title: 条件扩散代理表征恢复：缺失SLO模态下的BCVA预测
summary: 针对白内障术前SLO图像缺失，提出在潜在特征空间用条件扩散恢复代理表征，融合OCT与临床文本预测术后最佳矫正视力。
key_points: 融合术前OCT、SLO与临床文本
不重建原始图像，而在潜在空间恢复SLO代理表征
用于白内障术后BCVA预测
reason: 眼科多模态预印本，新方法但证据有限，缺外部验证信息
abstract: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space. Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.
zh_abstract: 术前预测术后最佳矫正视力（BCVA）有助于白内障手术的预后评估和个体化决策。多模态学习可以整合术前光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像、扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）图像和临床文本，以刻画患者状态。然而，在真实临床数据中，由于采集或数据管理问题，SLO 图像常常缺失，导致多模态输入不完整。针对这一问题，本文提出一种基于条件扩散的 SLO 代理表征恢复与融合预测方法。该方法并不重建原始 SLO 图像，而是将 SLO 缺失表述为潜在特征空间中的代理表征恢复问题。具体而言，首先融合 OCT 图像特征和临床文本特征，构建 OCT-文本条件表征，以引导扩散模型的反向去噪过程，估计样本特异性的 SLO 代理表征。随后，将恢复得到的 SLO 代理表征作为不可用 SLO 模态的替代，纳入下游多模态融合预测网络，用于术后 BCVA 预测。实验在 2,141 例术前多模态白内障样本上进行，其中 SLO 缺失率为 58.80%。在预测绝对误差不超过 0.1 LogMAR 的标准下，所提方法的准确率为 0.9714，平均绝对误差为 0.0423，优于具有代表性的术后视力预测方法和缺失模态学习方法。这些结果表明，表征层面的代理恢复可以减轻 SLO 模态缺失对术后 BCVA 预测的影响。

title: scPolyA enables efficient, interactive and agent-guided alternative polyadenylation analysis in single-cell and spatial transcriptomes

abstract: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) changes which regulatory sequences an RNA retains, creating a layer of cellular variation that gene-level expression profiles cannot resolve. Here we present scPolyA, a unified, AI-enabled framework that transforms conventional single-cell and spatial 3'-end transcriptomes into quantitative maps of RNA-end choice. scPolyA connects de novo poly(A)-site discovery to cell- and spot-resolved measurements of terminal-site usage, 3' untranslated region length and intronic polyadenylation, enabling differential APA analysis across cell states and tissue regions. Its integrated deep-learning module, DeepCPS, improves recognition of sparsely supported poly(A) sites and predicts cleavage positions at nucleotide resolution. An integrated graphical workspace brings parameter exploration, efficient rerunning and genome browsing together, while an APA-specialised AI agent translates natural-language research questions into executed analyses, verified outputs and evidence-guided interpretation. Across diverse single-cell protocols and spatial platforms, scPolyA achieves higher reference-atlas agreement than most evaluated de novo methods, while single-cell benchmarks demonstrate competitive runtime and memory use. Applied to cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, scPolyA reveals recurrent 3' untranslated region shortening in tumour keratinocytes across all ten patients and corresponding patterns in tumour-enriched regions, with tissue-level contrasts shaped by cellular composition. scPolyA extends conventional transcriptomics from gene abundance to RNA-end regulation, linking transcript choices to cellular states and tissue organisation.

title: MELD: Mutation Effect Learning through Differential embeddings

reason: 新方法预印本，基线对比有限，信息截断
abstract: We introduce MELD (Mutation Effect Learning through Differential Embeddings), a compact model for predicting the functional consequences of single nucleotide variants (SNVs) by training directly on the wild-type (WT) versus mutant differential. Interpreting SNVs is central to clinical genomics, yet experimental characterization cannot scale to millions of observed variants. Leading sequence-to-function models (Enformer, Borzoi, AlphaGenome) are trained on absolute genomic tracks and score variants post hoc through in-silico mutagenesis (ISM), so the WT-mutant difference never enters the training loss. MELD instead places the logit difference {Delta}z = zmut - zwt inside the supervised objective. It combines a shared CNN-Transformer encoder, a mutant-specific mutation-mask boost, multiscale mutation-centered pooling, and a learned adaptive amplification factor . On ClinVar (1.57M variants), MELD (1.9M parameters) reached an AUROC of 0.986 versus 0.800 for a same-data, same-backbone ISM baseline, with ablations confirming the contribution of each component. On a shared benchmark, it outperformed frozen foundation models with 3-1,300x more parameters (AUROC 0.967 vs. 0.924 for AlphaGenome and 0.936 for Nucleotide Transformer). With only 50, 000 training variants, it exceeded the ISM baseline trained on all 1.48M (AUROC 0.903 vs. 0.796) variants. On BRCA1 saturation genome editing, frozen MELD achieved a Spearman {rho} of 0.42, above Borzoi (0.40), and ClinVar transfer raised it to 0.45. These results demonstrate that direct differential supervision is a compact, data-efficient alternative to post-hoc ISM scoring with substantially larger pretrained models.

abstract: Fragmentomics analyzes features of circulating cell-free DNA fragments (e.g., fragment length or end motifs) derived from whole-genome sequencing of liquid biopsy samples (blood or other body fluids), enabling non-invasive early cancer detection. Here we present mFrag, a framework that integrates external methylation reference atlases with fragmentomic features for lung cancer detection. mFrag comprises two complementary methods: mFrag-Weight, which uses DNA methylation information to weight fragmentomic features, and mFrag-Net, which integrates fragmentomic features and external DNA methylation data through neural networks. We average the output probabilities of the two methods to obtain a final prediction score. The mFrag model was trained using 287 individuals at risk for lung cancer. In an independent case-control testing set comprising 385 non-cancer controls and 46 cancers (28 stage I, 12 stage II, and 6 stage III or IV), mFrag outperforms a DELFI-style fragmentomic approach, improving PR-AUC from 0.455 to 0.720 and sensitivity at 99% specificity from 0.043 to 0.478, with ROC-AUC from 0.871 to 0.908. For stage I lung cancer, mFrag raises PR-AUC from 0.314 to 0.558 and ROC-AUC from 0.855 to 0.894. Applied to end 4-mer motif features, mFrag likewise improved over an unweighted baseline, with gains contributed by both mFrag-Weight and mFrag-Net. In summary, mFrag improves the accuracy of fragmentomics-based lung cancer detection through integrating external DNA methylation data and the complementarity of its two component models, without incurring any additional data-generating cost.
zh_abstract: 片段组学（Fragmentomics）分析源自液体活检样本（血液或其他体液）全基因组测序的循环游离DNA片段特征（如片段长度或末端基序），可实现无创早期癌症检测。在此，我们提出mFrag，一个将外部甲基化参考图谱与片段组学特征相整合用于肺癌检测的框架。mFrag包含两种互补方法：mFrag-Weight利用DNA甲基化信息对片段组学特征加权；mFrag-Net通过神经网络整合片段组学特征与外部DNA甲基化数据。我们对两种方法的输出概率取平均，得到最终预测分数。mFrag模型使用287名肺癌风险个体进行训练。在一个独立的病例-对照测试集中（包含385名非癌症对照和46例癌症，其中I期28例、II期12例、III或IV期6例），mFrag优于DELFI式片段组学方法：PR-AUC从0.455提高到0.720，99%特异性下的敏感性从0.043提高到0.478，ROC-AUC从0.871提高到0.908。对于I期肺癌，mFrag将PR-AUC从0.314提高到0.558，ROC-AUC从0.855提高到0.894。应用于末端4-mer基序特征时，mFrag同样优于未加权基线，且mFrag-Weight和mFrag-Net均有贡献。总之，mFrag通过整合外部DNA甲基化数据以及两个组成模型的互补性，提高了基于片段组学的肺癌检测准确性，且不产生任何额外的数据生成成本。

title: Realism and resolution: How AI-predicted protein structures differ from experimental structures
zh_title: AI预测蛋白结构与实验结构的真实性与分辨率差异
summary: 提出WhatRes，从坐标评估表观分辨率与真实性，发现高置信度预测模型仍存在键长键角变化偏小的过度理想化。
key_points: 两轴评估：表观分辨率与真实性
预测模型几何变异低于高分辨率晶体结构
高置信度模型同样存在过度理想化
reason: 预印本，新评估方法有价值但证据有限
abstract: Protein structure predictors can recover protein folds with remarkable accuracy, and their models are increasingly used as if they were experimental structures. Yet even for a confidently predicted fold, it remains difficult to judge how faithfully the model reproduces protein geometry. We introduce WhatRes, which assesses a structure from its coordinates on two complementary axes. Apparent resolution estimates the experimental resolution its local geometry most closely resembles. Realism measures how closely that geometry matches experimental structures at the same apparent resolution. Predicted models can score well on apparent resolution while showing systematically less variation in bond lengths and angles than is observed in high-resolution crystal structures. WhatRes reveals this over-idealisation even in high-confidence models.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质结构预测工具能够以惊人的准确度还原蛋白质折叠，其预测模型也越来越多地被当作实验结构来使用。然而，即使对于预测置信度很高的折叠，也仍难以判断该模型对蛋白质几何结构的还原有多忠实。我们提出了 WhatRes，它根据坐标在两个互补的维度上评估结构。表观分辨率（apparent resolution）用于估计其局部几何结构与哪种实验分辨率最为接近。真实度（realism）用于衡量该几何结构与处于相同表观分辨率的实验结构的匹配程度。预测模型在表观分辨率上可能得分很好，但其键长和键角的变异却系统性地小于高分辨率晶体结构中观察到的变异。WhatRes 揭示了这种过度理想化现象，即使在高置信度模型中也是如此。

title: GeneEmbedLLM: Harnessing Large Language Models for Gene Functional Embedding and Association Prediction
zh_title: GeneEmbedLLM：用大语言模型生成基因功能嵌入
summary: 整合五个数据库的文本注释，基于Longformer与对比学习生成基因嵌入，并在多项下游任务上验证。
key_points: 整合五个权威数据库的多源结构化文本
采用基于Longformer的属性感知注意力
下游任务涵盖分子互作、表型依赖与表观调控
reason: 新方法有基线对比，但摘要未见代码与外部验证细节
abstract: Effective and high-quality gene function representations are crucial for bioinformatics tasks. While biological knowledge about genes is inherently textual, encompassing functional descriptions and pathway annotations, current methods often rely on single-source, non-textual data, failing to capture the rich semantic information in multi-source gene annotations. In this paper, we propose GeneEmbedLLM, a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered framework for generating universal, semantically-aware gene embeddings. The proposed approach advances the gene representation learning through multi-source structured text integration from five authoritative databases and attribute-aware attention based on Longformer architecture and contrastive learning. Experimental results on diverse downstream tasks, ranging from molecular interactions and phenotypic dependencies to epigenetic regulation, confirm the validity and effectiveness of our proposed approach, where competitive performance is achieved across all evaluated benchmarks. We further validate the quality of the generated embeddings through comprehensive analyses, including embedding visualizations, intra-pathway similarity assessments, ablation study, and parameter analysis.
zh_abstract: 有效且高质量的基因功能表征对生物信息学任务至关重要。基因的生物学知识本质上是文本性的，包括功能描述和通路注释，而现有方法往往依赖单一来源的非文本数据，未能捕捉多来源基因注释中丰富的语义信息。本文提出 GeneEmbedLLM，一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的框架，用于生成通用的、具有语义感知的基因嵌入。该方法通过整合来自五个权威数据库的多来源结构化文本，并基于 Longformer 架构的属性感知注意力和对比学习，推进了基因表征学习。在从分子相互作用、表型依赖性到表观遗传调控等多种下游任务上的实验结果证实了所提方法的有效性，在所有评估基准上均取得了有竞争力的性能。我们还通过全面分析进一步验证了所生成嵌入的质量，包括嵌入可视化、通路内相似性评估、消融研究和参数分析。

title: Randomized Trial Protocol: Head-to-Head Comparison of Two Ambient Artificial Intelligence Documentation Tools on Clinician Usability
zh_title: 两款环境AI文书工具对临床医生可用性的头对头随机试验方案
summary: UCLA Health拟对374名门诊医生随机比较Nabla与Epic的环境AI文书工具，评估可用性、文书负担、EHR时间等。
key_points: 双臂平行组1:1随机，单一医疗系统
比较Nabla与Epic环境AI方案
指标含可用性、编码账单与患者沟通体验
