abstract: [Work (Reading, Mass.)] BackgroundOccupational therapists working in cognitive rehabilitation may face high cognitive demands, and professional isolation. Although AI is used for information retrieval and decision support, its role in supporting reflective clinical reasoning remains insufficiently conceptualized. As scholarly attention shifts from automation toward augmentation of professional judgment, the next step is to understand how AI may support reflective reasoning in complex rehabilitation work.ObjectiveTo examine key challenges in cognitive rehabilitation and explore how these needs may inform a conceptual design for GenAI-mediated mentoring within clinical work.MethodsA qualitative study grounded in Design Thinking methodology was conducted with 30 female occupational therapists (age range 24-64 years, M = 41.26, SD = 10.35) with wide range of clinical experience (less than one year to more than 20 years) from diverse settings. They completed a demographic questionnaire and participated in two Design Thinking workshops (n = 14; n = 16). Seven participants subsequently engaged in follow-up interviews to refine design implications. All sessions were audio-recorded, transcribed, and analyzed thematically.ResultsThe thematic analysis yielded four themes: (A) The Therapist's role (B) Challenging therapist-client interactions, (C) Loneliness of the Therapist (D) Expectations for guidance or support aspects. These findings informed the conceptualization of a GenAI mentoring framework grounded in real-world clinical demands.ConclusionsThe findings support the design of generative AI systems as dialogic, context-sensitive tools intended to strengthen professional judgment, warranting further examination of their integration within real-world clinical workflows.
zh_abstract: [工作（Reading, Mass.）] 【背景】从事认知康复的作业治疗师可能面临较高的认知需求和职业孤立。尽管AI已用于信息检索和决策支持，但其在支持反思性临床推理方面的作用仍缺乏充分的概念化。随着学术关注从自动化转向对专业判断的增强，下一步是了解AI如何在复杂的康复工作中支持反思性推理。【目的】考察认知康复中的主要挑战，并探讨这些需求如何为临床工作中由生成式AI（GenAI）介导的指导（mentoring）的概念设计提供参考。【方法】采用以设计思维（Design Thinking）方法为基础的定性研究，纳入30名来自不同机构的女性作业治疗师（年龄范围24-64岁，M = 41.26，SD = 10.35），其临床经验跨度较大（不足一年至20年以上）。她们填写了人口统计学问卷，并参加了两次设计思维工作坊（n = 14；n = 16）。随后有7名参与者参加了随访访谈，以完善设计启示。所有环节均进行录音、转录并进行主题分析。【结果】主题分析得出四个主题：（A）治疗师的角色；（B）具有挑战性的治疗师-来访者互动；（C）治疗师的孤独感；（D）对指导或支持方面的期望。这些发现为基于真实临床需求的GenAI指导框架的概念化提供了依据。【结论】研究结果支持将生成式AI系统设计为对话式、情境敏感的工具，以增强专业判断，其在真实临床工作流程中的整合有待进一步检验。

title: Methodological Adherence, Reporting Completeness, and Risk of Bias in AI-Assisted Systematic Reviews: A Matched Meta-Research Study
zh_title: AI辅助系统综述的方法学依从性与偏倚风险：匹配元研究
summary: 预印本，将报告使用AI的系统综述与未用AI的综述按1:2匹配，比较方法学依从、报告完整性和偏倚风险。

按1:2匹配对照综述
比较依从性、报告完整性与偏倚风险

abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to accelerate systematic reviews that inform clinical practice and policy. However, evidence on the methodological adherence, reporting completeness, and risk of bias of completed AI-assisted reviews is limited. Objective: To compare methodological adherence, reporting completeness, and risk of bias between published systematic reviews with reported AI assistance and matched reviews with no reported AI use, and to assess AI-use transparency. Methods: We conducted a matched-cohort meta-research study of English-language, peer-reviewed health systematic reviews. AI-assisted reviews published during 2023--2025 were matched 1:2 to reviews with no reported AI use using individualized MEDLINE searches targeting publication timing, clinical domain, review type, and meta-analysis status. When more than two eligible comparators were available, two were randomly selected. AI assistance was defined as reported use during searching, screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, evidence synthesis, or substantive drafting. Full texts and supplementary materials were examined to classify reported AI use. The primary outcome was a prespecified modified 13-item AMSTAR-2 methodological-adherence score (range 0 -- 13; noninferiority margin &-1 point). Secondary outcomes included PRISMA 2020 reporting completeness and ROBIS risk of bias; AI-use transparency was assessed descriptively. Adapted 13-item AMSTAR-2 confidence categories were summarized descriptively, while critical- and noncritical-domain adherence was examined in exploratory adjusted analyses. Multivariable regression models adjusted for journal impact tier, funding reporting, formal review-group affiliation, review-team size, and review-question type, using cluster-robust standard errors by matched set. Sensitivity analyses included matched-set fixed-effects models. The study was registered on the Open Science Framework (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q5JRW). Results: The cohort included 231 systematic reviews: 77 AI-assisted and 154 with no reported AI use. Mean 13-item AMSTAR-2 scores were 7.58 and 9.63, respectively. In multivariable-adjusted analyses, AI-assisted reviews scored 1.64 points lower (95% CI &-2.37 to &- 0.91); noninferiority was not demonstrated. PRISMA adherence was estimated to be 4.7 percentage points lower among AI-assisted reviews in primary adjusted analyses (95% CI &-8.9 to &-0.6) and 6.4 points lower in matched-set fixed-effects
zh_abstract: 【背景】人工智能（AI）越来越多地用于加速为临床实践和政策提供依据的系统评价。然而，关于已完成的 AI 辅助系统评价在方法学依从性、报告完整性和偏倚风险方面的证据有限。【目的】比较已报告使用 AI 辅助的已发表系统评价与未报告使用 AI 的匹配系统评价在方法学依从性、报告完整性和偏倚风险上的差异，并评估 AI 使用的透明度。【方法】我们开展了一项针对英文、同行评审的健康类系统评价的匹配队列元研究。将 2023–2025 年间发表的 AI 辅助系统评价，通过针对发表时间、临床领域、综述类型和是否含荟萃分析的个体化 MEDLINE 检索，按 1:2 与未报告使用 AI 的系统评价匹配。当符合条件的对照超过两个时，随机选取两个。AI 辅助被定义为在检索、筛选、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、证据综合或实质性写作过程中有报告的使用。通过查阅全文及补充材料来对已报告的 AI 使用进行分类。主要结局为预先设定的改良版 13 项 AMSTAR-2 方法学依从性评分（范围 0–13；非劣效界值 &-1 分）。次要结局包括 PRISMA 2020 报告完整性和 ROBIS 偏倚风险；AI 使用透明度采用描述性评估。改编后的 13 项 AMSTAR-2 可信度类别进行描述性汇总，而关键与非关键领域的依从性则在探索性调整分析中检验。多变量回归模型对期刊影响力层级、资助报告、正式综述小组隶属关系、综述团队规模和综述问题类型进行调整，并按匹配组使用聚类稳健标准误。敏感性分析包括匹配组固定效应模型。本研究已在开放科学框架（Open Science Framework）注册（DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q5JRW）。【结果】队列共纳入 231 项系统评价：77 项为 AI 辅助，154 项未报告使用 AI。13 项 AMSTAR-2 平均得分分别为 7.58 和 9.63。在多变量调整分析中，AI 辅助系统评价得分低 1.64 分（95% CI &-2.37 至 &- 0.91）；未能证明非劣效。在主要调整分析中，AI 辅助系统评价的 PRISMA 依从性估计低 4.7 个百分点（95% CI &-8.9 至 &-0.6），在匹配组固定效应模型中低 6.4 个百分点（原文至此截断）

title: StableProt: Structure-Aware Deep Learning for Protein Thermostability (Tm) and Environmental Adaptation (OGT) Prediction
zh_title: StableProt：结构感知的蛋白热稳定性与环境适应预测
summary: StableProt结合序列与Foldseek 3Di结构token，基于冻结SaProt骨干，预测蛋白熔解温度Tm和最适生长温度OGT。
key_points: 双任务头设计以避免梯度冲突
对嗜温蛋白14%下采样以缓解偏倚
针对点预测缺乏校准的问题
reason: 蛋白预测预印本，增量方法，摘要信息有限
abstract: Predicting protein melting temperature (Tm) and organismal optimal growth temperature (OGT) is essential for enzyme engineering, biocatalyst design, and metagenomic bioprospecting, yet computational prediction faces several fundamental bottlenecks: sequence-only representations miss tertiary packing; dual-task coupling induces destructive gradient conflict; natural database skew (>87% mesophiles) drives mesophilic collapse; and existing tools produce uncalibrated point predictions. To address these challenges, we present StableProt, a structure-aware framework that couples amino acid sequences with Foldseek 3Di structural tokens via a frozen SaProt backbone to capture 3D contacts. Disjoint heads condition thermodynamic stability on ecological context without gradient conflict, while targeted 14% mesophilic subsampling expands thermophile representation to eliminate mesophilic collapse. Calibrated ensemble modeling reduces calibration error to 1.92%, providing dependable 95% confidence intervals. Evaluating models across 10{degrees}C temperature intervals reveals severe baseline collapse at thermal extremes, whereas StableProt maintains robust accuracy across regimes. On ProThermDB and zero-shot FireProtDB, StableProt achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic accuracy (CRPS = 4.52{degrees}C and 8.71{degrees}C) while recovering 92.0% of hyperthermophiles ([≥]80{degrees}C), and in prospective validation, its calibrated intervals capture both enzyme stability (75.3% coverage) and host environmental growth temperatures (78.1% coverage). StableProt is freely accessible as an interactive web server at https://stableprot.dixitlab.org/.
zh_abstract: 预测蛋白质解链温度（Tm）和生物体最适生长温度（OGT）对酶工程、生物催化剂设计和宏基因组生物勘探至关重要，但计算预测面临若干根本性瓶颈：仅基于序列的表示会遗漏三级堆积信息；双任务耦合会引发破坏性的梯度冲突；天然数据库的偏倚（>87%为中温菌）导致中温菌塌陷（mesophilic collapse）；并且现有工具只给出未经校准的点预测。为应对这些挑战，我们提出StableProt，这是一个结构感知框架，通过冻结的SaProt骨干网络将氨基酸序列与Foldseek 3Di结构标记相结合，以捕获三维接触信息。相互独立的预测头使热力学稳定性以生态背景为条件，同时避免梯度冲突；而针对性的14%中温菌下采样扩大了嗜热菌的代表性，从而消除了中温菌塌陷。经校准的集成建模将校准误差降至1.92%，提供可靠的95%置信区间。在以10°C为间隔的温度区间上评估模型发现，基线模型在温度极端处严重塌陷，而StableProt在各温度区间均保持稳健的准确性。在ProThermDB和零样本FireProtDB上，StableProt取得了最先进的概率预测准确性（CRPS分别为4.52°C和8.71°C），同时召回了92.0%的超嗜热菌（≥80°C）；在前瞻性验证中，其校准后的区间同时涵盖了酶稳定性（覆盖率75.3%）和宿主环境生长温度（覆盖率78.1%）。StableProt作为交互式网络服务器免费开放，网址为 https://stableprot.dixitlab.org/。

title: Predicting acute radiation dermatitis in breast cancer patients using artificial intelligence: a systematic review.
source: PubMed · Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery
zh_title: AI预测乳腺癌放疗急性放射性皮炎：系统综述
summary: 系统检索四个数据库至2025年12月，用CHARMS提取数据、PROBAST+AI评估AI预测急性放射性皮炎模型的质量与偏倚。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、MEDLINE
采用CHARMS框架提取数据
用PROBAST+AI评估偏倚与适用性
reason: 系统综述，摘要未见纳入数量与结论，属增量档
abstract: [Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery] Acute radiation dermatitis (ARD) is a common toxicity of breast cancer radiotherapy that affects quality of life. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based models have been increasingly developed to predict ARD, but their methodological quality and clinical readiness remain unclear. This study aimed to systematically evaluate AI-based prediction models for ARD. A systematic search of PubMed, Embase (Ovid), Web of Science, and MEDLINE (Ovid) was conducted for studies published up to December 1, 2025. Studies were eligible if they developed and/or validated AI-based models for predicting ARD in patients with breast cancer receiving radiotherapy. Data were extracted using the CHARMS framework. Model quality, applicability, and risk of bias were assessed using the Prediction Model Risk of Bias Assessment Tool plus Artificial Intelligence (PROBAST + AI) tool. Given the substantial heterogeneity among studies, a qualitative synthesis was performed. Nineteen studies involving 8,506 patients were included, with sample sizes ranging from 20 to 2,058. Most studies were single-center (16/19), and only three were multicenter. Validation area under the curve (AUC) values ranged from 0.66 to 0.99. The models incorporated clinical, dosimetric, radiomics, and/or dosiomics features, with 5-154 predictors in the final models. Calibration and decision curve analysis were rarely reported, and no study performed external validation. Most studies had a high or unclear risk of bias according to PROBAST + AI, mainly related to small sample sizes, incomplete reporting, and lack of external validation. Although current AI-based models for predicting ARD in breast cancer radiotherapy demonstrate promising discriminatory performance, their methodological limitations and lack of external validation limit their readiness for routine clinical implementation. Future studies with more rigorous designs, standardized outcome assessment, transparent reporting, and independent external validation are required to facilitate clinical translation.
zh_abstract:
[医学与外科定量成像] 急性放射性皮炎（ARD）是乳腺癌放疗中常见的毒性反应，会影响生活质量。基于人工智能（AI）的模型越来越多地被开发用于预测 ARD，但其方法学质量和临床就绪程度仍不明确。本研究旨在系统评估基于 AI 的 ARD 预测模型。
【方法】系统检索了 PubMed、Embase（Ovid）、Web of Science 和 MEDLINE（Ovid）中截至2025年12月1日发表的研究。纳入标准为开发和/或验证用于预测接受放疗的乳腺癌患者 ARD 的 AI 模型的研究。使用 CHARMS 框架提取数据。使用预测模型偏倚风险评估工具加人工智能版（PROBAST + AI）评估模型质量、适用性和偏倚风险。鉴于研究间存在显著异质性，进行了定性综合。
【结果】共纳入19项研究，涉及8,506例患者，样本量范围为20至2,058。多数研究为单中心（16/19），仅3项为多中心。验证集曲线下面积（AUC）范围为0.66至0.99。模型纳入了临床、剂量学、影像组学和/或剂量组学特征，最终模型中的预测因子为5至154个。校准和决策曲线分析很少被报告，且没有研究进行外部验证。根据 PROBAST + AI，多数研究存在高或不明确的偏倚风险，主要与样本量小、报告不完整和缺乏外部验证有关。
【结论】尽管目前用于预测乳腺癌放疗 ARD 的 AI 模型显示出有前景的区分性能，但其方法学局限和缺乏外部验证限制了其用于常规临床实施的就绪程度。未来需要设计更严谨、结局评估标准化、报告透明并进行独立外部验证的研究，以促进临床转化。

title: Region-aware error triage for medical image segmentation with groupwise conformal risk control
zh_title: 基于分组保形风险控制的医学图像分割区域感知错误分诊
summary: 提出RACE-Triage，在不改动分割掩膜的前提下，对边界带与非边界区域分别做保形风险控制以标记潜在错误，在ISIC 2018和BUSI上评估。
key_points: 后处理式错误分诊，不改变分割掩膜
边界带与非边界区域分别校准阈值
在皮肤镜与乳腺超声数据集上验证
reason: 预印本，公开数据集验证，方法有新意但证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Segmentation masks are increasingly reviewed rather than redrawn, which requires knowing where a mask is likely wrong. Learned error maps rank pixels by risk, but the number of pixels to warn is chosen ad hoc, and calibrating one warning threshold over all error pixels may leave errors far from the predicted contour under-flagged. We propose RACE-Triage, a post-hoc error triage framework that leaves the segmentation mask unchanged. A risk network is trained on out-of-fold predictions from backbone-independent inputs. The predicted contour partitions each image into a boundary band and a non-boundary region, and conformal risk control is applied separately in each region to bound the expected fraction of missed errors among cases with errors there. On ISIC 2018 dermoscopy and BUSI breast ultrasound (where patient identifiers are unavailable, so independence across images is assumed), pooled control met its overall target but missed on average 31.8% and 36.4% of non-boundary errors. Regional control reduced these fractions to 19.3% and 20.9% and raised the recall of size-filtered false-negative components from 0.722 to 0.818 and from 0.611 to 0.763. The mean warned area grew by 1.6 and 4.9 percentage points, and its 95th percentile reached 23.5% and 38.5%. The effect held across three seeds and a second backbone, and area-matched heuristics did not reproduce it. On the external PH$^2$ set, frozen thresholds exceeded both targets, whereas recalibration with 100 local images brought the mean over repeated splits below them. Regional calibration improves non-boundary error coverage at a measured increase in warned area.
zh_abstract: 分割掩膜越来越多地是被审阅而非重新绘制，这就需要知道掩膜在哪些位置可能出错。习得的错误图按风险对像素排序，但需要警示的像素数量是临时选定的；而且对所有错误像素校准单一警示阈值，可能使远离预测轮廓的错误被警示不足。我们提出 RACE-Triage，一种不改变分割掩膜的事后错误分诊框架。风险网络在与骨干网络无关的输入的折外（out-of-fold）预测上训练。预测轮廓将每幅图像划分为边界带和非边界区域，并在各区域分别应用保形风险控制（conformal risk control），以约束在该区域存在错误的病例中漏检错误的期望比例。在 ISIC 2018 皮肤镜和 BUSI 乳腺超声数据集上（因无法获得患者标识符，故假定图像间相互独立），合并控制达到了总体目标，但平均漏检了 31.8% 和 36.4% 的非边界错误。分区域控制将这些比例降至 19.3% 和 20.9%，并将经大小过滤的假阴性连通分量的召回率分别从 0.722 提高到 0.818、从 0.611 提高到 0.763。平均警示面积分别增加 1.6 和 4.9 个百分点，其第 95 百分位数分别达到 23.5% 和 38.5%。该效应在三个随机种子和第二种骨干网络上均成立，面积匹配的启发式方法无法复现该效应。在外部 PH$^2$ 数据集上，冻结阈值超出了两个目标；而使用 100 张本地图像重新校准后，重复划分的均值低于两个目标。分区域校准以可测量的警示面积增加为代价，改善了非边界错误的覆盖。

title: MotionBench-XAI: Benchmarking What Shapes Shapley Explanations in Spatiotemporal Machine Learning
zh_title: MotionBench-XAI：时空机器学习中Shapley解释影响因素的基准
summary: 提出基准，含五个带精确真值Shapley值的合成时空数据集及真实数据，用于研究玩家定义、缺失填补等选择如何影响解释质量，涉及帕金森严重度评估。
key_points: 五个合成数据集提供精确Shapley真值
考察玩家定义、填补与评估方式
涵盖人体运动的帕金森评估场景
reason: 预印本基准，临床关联较弱，属增量档
abstract: Predicting outcomes from spatiotemporal data, such as assessing Parkinson's severity from human motion, often requires explainability in addition to accuracy. Practitioners need to know what drove the prediction, whether it be spatial (a body joint), temporal (a specific window), or both. Shapley values are attributions computed by treating input features as players in a cooperative game and measuring how the model output changes as coalitions of players are removed. Computing them involves choosing what counts as players, how absent players are imputed, and how the game is evaluated. How these choices affect explanation quality is poorly understood for spatiotemporal data, and real data carries no ground-truth attributions to check against. We present MotionBench-XAI, a benchmark built on i) five synthetic spatiotemporal datasets with exact ground-truth Shapley values, ii) three real datasets across clinical gait, electrocardiogram, and audio, iii) ten attribution methods across three player sets, and iv) three trained architectures. We show that grouping features into players, across time, space, or both, matters more than the choice of imputer. Generative imputers improve explanations only when their conditional models are accurate. On real data, the standard proxy metrics select contradictory best methods. We distill these findings into practical insights and provide an open-source pipeline.

title: MEDALLION: Manifold Embedding Distillation and Attributions for Low-dimensional Latent InterpretatiON
zh_title: MEDALLION：通过蒸馏与归因解释低维嵌入
summary: 提出通过知识蒸馏和神经特征归因来解释t-SNE、UMAP等低维嵌入的框架，在MNIST和单细胞转录组中验证。
key_points: 用神经编码器蒸馏任意嵌入
结合多种神经特征归因方法
应用于单细胞转录组
reason: 预印本，通用方法，医学应用有限，属增量档
abstract: Dimensionality reduction is widely used to visualize high-dimensional data and guide scientific discovery, yet interpreting which original features contribute to low-dimensional representations remains challenging, particularly for black-box methods such as t-SNE and UMAP. We introduce \textbf{MEDALLION} (Manifold Embedding Distillation and Attributions for Low-dimensional Latent InterpretatiON), a novel framework for interpreting low-dimensional embeddings through knowledge distillation and neural feature attribution. MEDALLION distills any given embedding with a neural encoder which we explain via a broad range of existing neural feature attribution methods. Through experiments on MNIST and applications in single-cell transcriptomics, we show MEDALLION provides informative feature attributions that cast additional insights into the underlying embedding and compare its performance with existing interpretability approaches.

title: Lead Optimization in Drug Discovery: Integrating Advanced Computational Approaches for Enhanced Drug Design.
zh_title: 先导化合物优化：整合先进计算方法的药物设计
summary: 综述计算机辅助药物设计在靶点识别、先导优化、ADMET和药物重定位中的应用，涵盖SBDD与LBDD两类方法。
key_points: 介绍CADD在药物研发各环节的作用
涵盖基于结构与基于配体的设计方法
涉及分子对接等计算技术
reason: 泛泛综述，属增量档，AI特异性不强
abstract: [Current computer-aided drug design] The process of drug discovery is complex, lengthy, and expensive; it can take more than a decade to succeed and demands significant investments of financial resources. Despite these efforts, drug candidates still experience high failure rates during clinical trials. Computeraided Drug Design (CADD) has emerged as a powerful tool to overcome these obstacles in pharmaceutical research. CADD is used for drug development, such as target identification, lead discovery, optimisation, ADMET, and drug repurposing. CADD reduces the time and cost of drug discovery. Computational chemistry, bioinformatics, and structural biology are incorporated to predict drug-target interactions. The two major methodologies used to identify and optimise potential drug candidates are Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) and Ligand-Based Drug Design (LBDD). Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, Quantitative Structure- Activity Relationship (QSAR) modelling, pharmacophore modelling, and virtual screening are the techniques that allow efficient prediction of binding affinity, molecular behaviour, and biological activity. The recent advent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has also enhanced CADD tools by screening large datasets, predicting pharmacokinetic properties, and designing new molecules. These developments have boosted the efficiency, accuracy, and success rate of drug discovery. (CADD) reduces time costs, as do the physical and technological capabilities of the field of computational technologies. The integration of AI continues to grow, and CADD is bound to assume a more crucial role in designing safer and more efficient therapeutic agents in the future. In this review, we will discuss the general concepts of CADD, the methodologies of CADD, and CADD in drug discovery.
zh_abstract: [当代计算机辅助药物设计] 药物发现过程复杂、漫长且昂贵；成功可能需要十多年，并需要大量资金投入。尽管付出了这些努力，候选药物在临床试验中仍有很高的失败率。计算机辅助药物设计（CADD）已成为克服药物研究中这些障碍的有力工具。CADD用于药物开发的多个方面，如靶点识别、先导化合物发现、优化、ADMET以及药物重新定位。CADD可减少药物发现的时间和成本。计算化学、生物信息学和结构生物学被整合用于预测药物-靶点相互作用。用于识别和优化潜在候选药物的两大主要方法是基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）和基于配体的药物设计（LBDD）。分子对接、分子动力学模拟、定量构效关系（QSAR）建模、药效团建模和虚拟筛选是能够高效预测结合亲和力、分子行为和生物活性的技术。人工智能（AI）的近期出现也通过筛选大型数据集、预测药代动力学性质以及设计新分子，增强了CADD工具。这些进展提高了药物发现的效率、准确性和成功率。（CADD）降低了时间成本，计算技术领域的物理和技术能力亦然。AI的整合持续增长，CADD势必在未来设计更安全、更有效的治疗药物中发挥更为关键的作用。在本综述中，我们将讨论CADD的一般概念、CADD的方法学以及药物发现中的CADD。

title: Artificial intelligence in Saudi otolaryngology research: a scoping review of the current landscape, gaps, and future directions.
zh_title: 沙特耳鼻喉科AI研究的范围综述
summary: 按PRISMA-ScR检索2019至2026年文献，梳理沙特耳鼻喉科AI研究的主题、空白与方向。
key_points: 覆盖人工耳蜗、鼻科、头颈肿瘤等领域
检索多个数据库并遵循PRISMA-ScR
旨在识别研究空白与未来方向
reason: 区域性范围综述，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in otolaryngology, but the extent and focus of AI research in Saudi Arabia remain unclear. This scoping review mapped the available evidence and identified key research themes and knowledge gaps. A scoping review was conducted following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, and the Saudi Medical Journal archive were searched for studies published between January 2019 and April 2026. Eligible studies investigated AI applications or clinician perspectives within Saudi otolaryngology. The evidence was mapped across major otolaryngology domains, including cochlear implantation and hearing, rhinology and skull base surgery, facial plastic surgery, laryngology and voice, head and neck oncology, surgical and other ENT-related interventions for obstructive sleep apnoea, AI education and implementation, and AI-assisted patient education. The searches identified 2,925 database records, four records from other sources and seven records from an updated search and expert suggestions; thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence covered AI awareness and education, large language model (LLM)-based patient education, cochlear implantation, rhinology and skull base surgery, facial plastic surgery, laryngology and voice, and head and neck oncology; no eligible study addressed surgical or other ENT-related interventions for obstructive sleep apnoea. Clinicians were generally positive about AI, while clinical studies showed promising performance of AI models. LLM chatbots generally gave accurate postoperative advice, although, when validated tools were used, their responses were harder to read and less actionable than patient-education standards recommend. However, limited AI education, small or non-Saudi datasets, limited external validation, and implementation barriers remained important challenges. AI research in Saudi otolaryngology remains limited but is expanding across several clinical domains. Future research should prioritise Saudi-specific datasets, multicentre clinical validation, structured AI education, rigorous bilingual (Arabic and English) evaluation of LLM-generated patient information, and safe integration of AI into clinical practice in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
zh_abstract: [外科学前沿（Frontiers in surgery）] 人工智能（AI）在耳鼻咽喉科的应用日益增多，但沙特阿拉伯 AI 研究的范围与重点仍不明确。本范围综述梳理了现有证据，并确定了主要研究主题和知识空白。我们按照 PRISMA-ScR 指南开展范围综述，检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、Google Scholar 以及 Saudi Medical Journal 档案库中 2019 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月发表的研究。符合条件的研究探讨了沙特耳鼻咽喉科中的 AI 应用或临床医生的看法。证据按主要耳鼻咽喉科领域进行梳理，包括人工耳蜗植入与听力、鼻科学与颅底外科、面部整形外科、喉科学与嗓音、头颈肿瘤学、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的外科及其他耳鼻咽喉相关干预、AI 教育与实施，以及 AI 辅助的患者教育。检索共获得 2,925 条数据库记录、4 条其他来源记录，以及 7 条来自更新检索和专家推荐的记录；13 项研究符合纳入标准。证据涵盖 AI 认知与教育、基于大语言模型（LLM）的患者教育、人工耳蜗植入、鼻科学与颅底外科、面部整形外科、喉科学与嗓音以及头颈肿瘤学；没有符合条件的研究涉及阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的外科或其他耳鼻咽喉相关干预。临床医生总体上对 AI 持积极态度，临床研究显示 AI 模型表现良好。LLM 聊天机器人总体上能给出准确的术后建议，但在使用经验证的工具评估时，其回答比患者教育标准所建议的更难阅读，也更缺乏可操作性。然而，AI 教育有限、数据集规模小或非沙特来源、外部验证有限以及实施障碍，仍是重要挑战。沙特耳鼻咽喉科的 AI 研究仍然有限，但正在多个临床领域扩展。未来研究应优先考虑沙特特有的数据集、多中心临床验证、结构化的 AI 教育、对 LLM 生成的患者信息进行严格的双语（阿拉伯语和英语）评估，以及依照沙特 2030 愿景将 AI 安全地整合进临床实践。

summary: 针对前列腺手术自动化中的实验模型，提出解剖引导的CT三维分割流程，以应对小而不一致的数据集和人工标注负担。

abstract: Full autonomy has been a long-term goal in robotic surgery and a near-to-medium-term goal for prostatectomy. Due to the relatively closed structure of the procedure, its standard-of-care robotic/laparoscopic solutions, and procedure economics, prostate procedures are an optimal early target for surgical automation. Prototyping and testing of possible solutions is done in constructed laboratory phantoms, either synthetic tissues or animal phantoms. To enable measurement of perceptual and robotic motion error, phantoms undergo volumetric imaging; these images are critical to both a potential deployed automatic system, used in planning motion and treatment (cutting, ablation, suturing, etc.), as well as post-hoc assessment of system performance. Rapid iteration on these phantom models yields small, inconsistent datasets, while the current workflow for human annotation is often anatomically unreliable and prohibitively time-consuming, rendering deep learning unsuitable at reasonable scales. To address these limitations, we present an automated 3D segmentation pipeline that uses classical medical image-processing techniques to encode the known anatomy of the phantoms as explicit geometric and intensity priors, which requires no training corpus and is transferred to each new phantom revision without re-annotation. Across 57 scans spanning multiple phantom revisions, our pipeline recovers the capsule interior at 0.83 median Dice on 11 contrast-suppressed scans and detects all 32 annotated focal lesions without false positives, completing a full scan in 2-8 minutes on commodity CPU hardware versus 1-2 hours by hand.
zh_abstract: 完全自主一直是机器人手术的长期目标，也是前列腺切除术的中近期目标。由于该手术结构相对封闭、已有标准治疗的机器人/腹腔镜方案以及手术经济性，前列腺手术是手术自动化的理想早期目标。可能方案的原型设计和测试是在构建的实验室仿真体（phantom）中完成的，包括合成组织或动物仿真体。为了能够测量感知误差和机器人运动误差，仿真体需接受容积成像；这些图像对于可能部署的自动系统（用于规划运动和治疗，如切割、消融、缝合等）以及系统性能的事后评估都至关重要。对这些仿真体模型的快速迭代产生的数据集小且不一致，而目前的人工标注流程往往在解剖学上不可靠且耗时过长，使深度学习在合理规模下并不适用。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种自动化三维分割流程，该流程使用经典医学图像处理技术，将仿真体的已知解剖结构编码为显式的几何和强度先验，无需训练语料，并且无需重新标注即可迁移到每个新的仿真体版本。在跨越多个仿真体版本的 57 次扫描中，我们的流程在 11 次对比抑制扫描上以 0.83 的 Dice 中位数还原了包膜内部，并检测出全部 32 个已标注的局灶性病变，无假阳性；在普通 CPU 硬件上完成一次完整扫描需 2–8 分钟，而人工需 1–2 小时。

abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).
zh_abstract:
【背景】目前尚无基于证据的指南可用于对抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性者进行风湿科转诊分诊。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测新发ANA检测阳性的个体中哪些人将发展为系统性自身免疫性疾病，并在一项为期2年的随机实用性研究中评估其对自身免疫性疾病诊断时间的影响。
【方法】该模型被整合到一家学术医疗系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有ANA阳性个体按1:1随机分组，且与风险评分无关。在干预组中，高风险评分的个体被邀请接受加急的风湿科评估。在对照组中，仅计算风险评分，但不据此采取行动。所有参与者均接受标准诊疗，并可被转诊至风湿科。每6个月进行一次病历回顾，评估患者是否已接受风湿科评估并被诊断为自身免疫性疾病。主要结局为从ANA检测阳性到诊断的时间，采用Cox比例风险模型进行分析。在ANA阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较各研究组中被诊断为自身免疫性疾病的比例。
【结果】在2385名被随机分组的个体中，随机分组后排除部分个体，干预组分析了954人，对照组分析了1006人。干预组个体自ANA阳性之日起至自身免疫性疾病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比，1.9；95%置信区间，1.3至2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫性疾病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为43天，对照组为138天。在ANA检测阳性后6个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组有23%、对照组有16%被诊断为自身免疫性疾病（P=0.07）。
【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入该临床预测模型的干预措施与自身免疫性疾病诊断时间的显著缩短相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

title: AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization for childhood brain tumors.
zh_title: MANTIS：儿童脑肿瘤AI精准预后与治疗个体化
summary: 基于2,786例患者DNA甲基化数据构建神经网络，预测髓母细胞瘤与室管膜瘤10年个体化生存并估计治疗效应。

abstract: [Nature genetics] Accurate prediction of patient outcomes remains a critical challenge in oncology, in particular for childhood brain tumors, in which treatment decisions need to carefully balance risk of tumor recurrence and death against severe therapy-induced sequelae. Here, we developed MANTIS (methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions), a precision artificial intelligence (AI) tool for medulloblastoma and ependymoma outcome prediction built on genome-wide DNA methylation array data from 2,786 patients. MANTIS generates individualized survival probabilities over a 10-year period and achieves concordance indices as high as 0.80 ± 0.07, significantly exceeding the predictive accuracy of current clinical indicators. Extending MANTIS to estimate individualized treatment effects identifies ~60% of patients with average-risk medulloblastoma without a significant survival disadvantage (P = 0.683) when treated with less intensive craniospinal irradiation doses, which is associated with improved neurocognitive outcomes. In conclusion, our study establishes a foundation for AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization in childhood brain tumors and offers a blueprint for similar initiatives in other cancer types.
zh_abstract: [Nature genetics] 准确预测患者结局仍是肿瘤学中的一项关键挑战，在儿童脑肿瘤中尤为如此，因为治疗决策需要在肿瘤复发和死亡风险与治疗所致的严重后遗症之间审慎权衡。在此，我们开发了MANTIS（methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions，基于甲基化谱和人工神经网络的时间依赖性个体化生存预测），这是一种用于髓母细胞瘤和室管膜瘤结局预测的精准人工智能（AI）工具，基于2,786例患者的全基因组DNA甲基化芯片数据构建。MANTIS可生成10年内的个体化生存概率，一致性指数最高可达0.80 ± 0.07，显著超过当前临床指标的预测准确性。将MANTIS扩展用于估计个体化治疗效应后，发现约60%的标危型髓母细胞瘤患者在接受强度较低的全脑全脊髓照射剂量治疗时，生存方面无显著劣势（P = 0.683），而这与神经认知结局改善相关。总之，我们的研究为儿童脑肿瘤中基于AI的精准预后和治疗个体化奠定了基础，并为其他癌症类型的类似工作提供了蓝本。

abstract: [Insights into imaging] Preoperative identification of FIGO 2023 stage I endometrial cancer (EC) is important for treatment planning. We aimed to develop and validate a deep-learning radiomics nomogram (DLRN) based on multiparametric MRI to distinguish stage I EC from stage II-IV disease. This study retrospectively enrolled patients from three centers. Patients from Centers 1 and 2 were randomly split into a training set (n = 616), and an internal test set (n = 158), and Center 3 served as an external test set (n = 232). The DLRN integrated deep-learning features, intratumoral and peritumoral radiomics features, and clinical characteristics. The DLRN was compared with clinical, radiomics, and deep-learning models. Discrimination was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with AUCs compared using DeLong's test. A total of 1006 patients (mean age, 56.5 ± 9.7 years) were analyzed. In the internal test set, the DLRN achieved an AUC of 0.852, higher than the clinical (0.673; p = 0.001), original radiomics (0.765; p = 0.030), and combined radiomics (0.793; p = 0.050) models. In the external test set, the DLRN remained robust (AUC = 0.829) and outperformed the clinical, original radiomics, and combined radiomics models (AUC = 0.680, 0.681, and 0.743; all p < 0.005). With DLRN assistance, radiologists showed improved diagnostic performance. The MRI-based DLRN showed robust discrimination between FIGO 2023 stage I and stage II-IV EC across test sets, supporting its potential for preoperative risk stratification and decision support. Question The introduction of the FIGO 2023 staging system has made the differentiation between stages more challenging, highlighting the need for better tools. Findings A new MRI-based deep-learning radiomics nomogram (DLRN) accurately identifies high-risk patients, significantly outperforming traditional and individual clinical prediction methods. Critical relevance statement This tool helps doctors make better preoperative treatment plans, potentially improving patient outcomes in endometrial cancer.
zh_abstract: [Insights into imaging] 术前识别FIGO 2023 I期子宫内膜癌（EC）对治疗规划具有重要意义。我们旨在基于多参数MRI开发并验证一种深度学习影像组学列线图（DLRN），以区分I期EC与II–IV期疾病。本研究回顾性纳入了来自三个中心的患者。中心1和中心2的患者被随机分为训练集（n = 616）和内部测试集（n = 158），中心3作为外部测试集（n = 232）。DLRN整合了深度学习特征、瘤内和瘤周影像组学特征以及临床特征。将DLRN与临床模型、影像组学模型和深度学习模型进行比较。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估区分能力，并用DeLong检验比较AUC。共分析1006例患者（平均年龄56.5 ± 9.7岁）。在内部测试集中，DLRN的AUC为0.852，高于临床模型（0.673；p = 0.001）、原始影像组学模型（0.765；p = 0.030）和联合影像组学模型（0.793；p = 0.050）。在外部测试集中，DLRN仍表现稳健（AUC = 0.829），优于临床模型、原始影像组学模型和联合影像组学模型（AUC分别为0.680、0.681和0.743；均 p < 0.005）。在DLRN辅助下，放射科医师的诊断表现有所提升。基于MRI的DLRN在各测试集中均显示出对FIGO 2023 I期与II–IV期EC稳健的区分能力，支持其在术前风险分层和决策支持中的应用潜力。问题：FIGO 2023分期系统的引入使各期之间的区分更具挑战性，凸显了对更好工具的需求。发现：一种新的基于MRI的深度学习影像组学列线图（DLRN）能够准确识别高危患者，显著优于传统方法和单一的临床预测方法。关键相关性声明：该工具有助于医生制定更好的术前治疗方案，有望改善子宫内膜癌患者的预后。

abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.
zh_abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] 医学影像领域的人工智能正从针对特定任务的算法转向可适应的基础模型（foundation models, FMs）和视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于MRI仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要将多参数、容积化、跨多个序列的影像与临床背景相结合。本系统综述评估了35项关于MRI中单模态FM和多模态VLM的研究，总结了新兴的模型架构、下游应用以及临床转化面临的挑战。目前的研究集中于神经影像领域，其中诊断分类是最为成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅度很高，但临床准确性较差，因而仍受限。MRI采集方式的异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限，以及缺乏以安全性为重点的评估指标，阻碍了其更广泛的应用。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更紧密的整合、稳健的评估框架，以及更好的模型可解释性。

title: AI for reducing claims and compensation payments from missed fractures on radiographs.
zh_title: AI骨折检测可减少X线漏诊理赔
summary: 回顾性多中心研究评估BoneView在巴黎地区AP-HP医院漏诊骨折赔偿案例中的潜在价值，并设对照患者与三位放射科医生阅片。
key_points: 纳入2013–2019年38家医院获赔的漏诊骨折索赔
每例索赔配5名对照患者
三位不同经验放射科医生独立阅片
reason: 回顾性多中心、含医生阅片对照，但结果不明，属值得一看档
abstract: [European radiology] To evaluate the potential of BoneView, an artificial intelligence (AI) tool for fracture detection on radiographs in claims cases related to missed fractures that resulted in financial compensation. This retrospective, multicenter study included all patients who submitted a claim and received financial compensation for missed fractures on radiographs between January 2013 and December 2019 across the 38 university hospitals of the Greater Paris area (AP-HP-France). For each claimant, 5 control patients were selected from a contemporary single-center cohort of patients who underwent radiographs of the same anatomical regions (with or without fracture) performed in the emergency department of a university hospital, irrespective of fracture status. Three radiologists (musculoskeletal fellow, 5-year fellowship-trained radiologist, and > 20-year expert) independently performed blinded, unassisted, and AI-assisted interpretations following a 3-month washout. Sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were calculated with and without AI and for standalone AI. Compensation amounts were used to estimate potentially avoidable payouts. 156 patients (mean age, 42.2 years; 113 (72.4%) males), including 26 claimants with missed fractures on radiographs and 130 controls, were evaluated. 27/130 (20.8%) of the control cohort had fractures. Standalone AI sensitivity was 80.8% (21/26; 95% CI [60.7-93.5]) for claimants and 96.3% (26/27; 95% CI [81.0-99.9]) for the control cohort (p = 0.10). AI assistance did not significantly improve sensitivity, with expert reader sensitivity increasing from 81.1% to 92.5% (p = 0.10). Total compensation was €282,850 (€10,878 per case). AI-assisted detection could have potentially mitigated €265,314, representing a 93.8% theoretical reduction in institutional financial liability. AI-assisted fracture detection identified most missed fractures on radiographs leading to compensation and may help reduce medicolegal risk and compensation-related financial burden. Question Can AI-assisted fracture detection identify fractures missed by radiologists on radiographs that led to compensated medicolegal claims and institutional financial liability? Findings Standalone AI detected 21/26 (80.8%) of missed fractures in patients with compensated claims, corresponding to €265,314/€282,850 (93.8%) of total compensation in this cohort. Clinical relevance AI-assisted fracture detection can potentially increase radiologists' diagnostic accuracy and reduce medicolega
zh_abstract: [European radiology] 评估BoneView（一种用于X线片骨折检测的人工智能（AI）工具）在导致经济赔偿的漏诊骨折索赔案例中的潜力。这项回顾性多中心研究纳入了2013年1月至2019年12月间在大巴黎地区38家大学医院（AP-HP，法国）因X线片漏诊骨折提出索赔并获得经济赔偿的所有患者。对每名索赔者，从同期单中心队列中选取5名对照患者，这些患者在某大学医院急诊科接受了相同解剖部位的X线检查（无论是否有骨折，不考虑骨折状态）。三名放射科医生（肌肉骨骼专科进修医生、受过5年专科进修培训的放射科医生和有20年以上经验的专家）在3个月洗脱期后，分别独立进行盲法、无辅助和AI辅助的阅片。计算了使用和不使用AI时以及AI单独使用时的敏感度、特异度和准确度。利用赔偿金额估算可能避免的赔付。共评估156例患者（平均年龄42.2岁；113例（72.4%）为男性），其中包括26名X线片漏诊骨折的索赔者和130名对照者。对照队列中27/130（20.8%）有骨折。AI单独使用的敏感度在索赔者中为80.8%（21/26；95% CI [60.7-93.5]），在对照队列中为96.3%（26/27；95% CI [81.0-99.9]）（p = 0.10）。AI辅助并未显著提高敏感度，专家阅片者的敏感度从81.1%升至92.5%（p = 0.10）。总赔偿额为282,850欧元（每例10,878欧元）。AI辅助检测理论上可避免265,314欧元，相当于机构经济责任理论上减少93.8%。AI辅助骨折检测识别出了导致赔偿的大多数X线片漏诊骨折，可能有助于降低医疗法律风险和与赔偿相关的经济负担。问题 AI辅助骨折检测能否识别放射科医生在X线片上漏诊、并导致获赔的医疗法律索赔和机构经济责任的骨折？发现 AI单独使用检出了获赔索赔患者中21/26（80.8%）的漏诊骨折，对应该队列总赔偿额的265,314欧元/282,850欧元（93.8%）。临床意义 AI辅助骨折检测有可能提高放射科医生的诊断准确性并降低医疗法律风险。

title: A Systematic Review of Bias, Validation, and Explainability in Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Dental Diagnostics.
zh_title: 牙科诊断AI算法的偏倚、验证与可解释性系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA并在PROSPERO注册的系统综述，评估多个牙科领域AI诊断的性能、方法学质量、偏倚、验证与可解释性。
key_points: 检索多个数据库至2025年12月
采用QUADAS-2与RoB 2评估偏倚
关注验证、可解释性与临床适用性
reason: 系统综述，方法规范，但摘要未见结论与纳入量，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To critically evaluate the current role of artificial intelligence (AI) in dental diagnosis across multiple dental disciplines, assessing diagnostic performance, methodological quality, risk of bias, validation, explainability, and clinical applicability. This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42025639340). PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, LILACS, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched up to December-2025. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Risk of bias in diagnostic accuracy studies was assessed using QUADAS-2-tool, evaluating the domains of patient selection, index test, reference standard, flow and timing whilst randomised studies were assessed using Cochrane RoB 2-tool. Reporting quality and transparency of AI-model development and validation were assessed using the selected items from TRIPOD-AI reporting guideline. Methodological quality and risk of bias in AI model development and evaluation were additionally assessed using PROBAST+AI. Ninety-six studies met the inclusion criteria, of which 90.6% were retrospective. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) were the most frequently used architecture (82.3%). Sixteen studies failed to specify the CNN architecture used. Reported diagnostic accuracy ranged from 81% to 99% across dental specialties, with high performance in implantology (92-99%), orthodontics (88-99%), endodontics (87-99%). Panoramic radiographs and cone-beam computed tomography were the most used imaging modalities. QUADAS-2 analysis indicated that high-risk of bias in 55.2% of studies and most lacked external validation, whilst Assessment using selected TRIPOD+AI items identified important gaps in reporting completeness and transparency, particularly in sample-size justification, missing-data handling, protocol availability, study registration, and data or code availability. AI demonstrates substantial technical capability to enhance diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. However, the predominance of retrospective designs, limited external validation, and methodological weaknesses constrain the strength of current evidence. The use of AI is potentially considered as a decision-support tool rather than replacement for clinical judgement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 【目的】批判性评价人工智能（AI）目前在多个牙科学科牙科诊断中的作用，评估其诊断性能、方法学质量、偏倚风险、验证、可解释性及临床适用性。【方法】本系统评价按照 PRISMA 指南进行，并已在 PROSPERO 注册（CRD42025639340）。检索了 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Embase、LILACS、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、Web of Science 和 ClinicalTrials.gov，检索截至 2025 年 12 月。两名评价者独立完成研究筛选、数据提取和偏倚风险评估。诊断准确性研究的偏倚风险采用 QUADAS-2 工具评估，涵盖患者选择、待评价试验、参考标准、流程与时间等领域；随机研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具评估。AI 模型开发与验证的报告质量和透明度采用 TRIPOD-AI 报告指南中的选定条目评估。AI 模型开发和评价的方法学质量及偏倚风险另采用 PROBAST+AI 评估。【结果】96 项研究符合纳入标准，其中 90.6% 为回顾性研究。卷积神经网络（CNN）是最常用的架构（82.3%）。16 项研究未说明所使用的 CNN 架构。各牙科专科报告的诊断准确率为 81% 至 99%，其中种植学（92–99%）、正畸学（88–99%）、牙髓病学（87–99%）表现较高。全景片和锥形束计算机断层扫描是最常用的影像学检查方式。QUADAS-2 分析显示 55.2% 的研究存在高偏倚风险，且大多数缺乏外部验证；采用选定的 TRIPOD+AI 条目进行的评估发现，在报告的完整性和透明度方面存在重要缺陷，尤其是样本量依据、缺失数据处理、研究方案可获取性、研究注册以及数据或代码可获取性。【结论】AI 显示出提高诊断准确性和效率的巨大技术能力。然而，回顾性设计占主导、外部验证有限以及方法学缺陷限制了现有证据的强度。AI 可被视为决策支持工具，而非临床判断的替代。

title: The surgeon in the loop: automation bias and human-AI interaction in robotic surgery.
zh_title: 环内外科医生：机器人手术中的自动化偏倚与人机交互
summary: 19名外科医生在机器人胆囊切除静态帧上画切口线，评估暴露于模拟AI叠加引导后对错误建议的采纳与修改程度。
key_points: 两阶段对照实验，19名医生
先无引导，再加模拟AI叠加
量化自动化偏倚与错误建议接受率
reason: 人机协作评估有新意，但样本小、为模拟静态实验
abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] Artificial intelligence systems for intraoperative surgical guidance are approaching clinical deployment, yet no study has quantified automation bias (defined as the tendency to over-rely on automated recommendations) in the context of surgical decision-making. As these systems enter operative workflows, the surgeon's ability to recognize and override incorrect AI guidance becomes a critical safety requirement. To measure the extent to which surgeons modify incision plans after exposure to AI-labeled visual guidance and to determine the rate at which incorrect AI suggestions are accepted. A two-phase controlled experiment was conducted among 19 surgeons (10 residents, 2 fellows, 7 attendings). Participants drew incision lines on 20 static frames from robotic cholecystectomy videos, first without guidance (Phase 01) and then with a mock AI overlay (Phase 02). Overlays were either correct (derived from expert consensus) or deliberately incorrect (shifted toward unsafe anatomy) at an approximately 70:30 ratio. No actual AI model was used. The primary outcome was mean perpendicular distance (MPD) between Phase 01 and Phase 02 lines. Secondary outcomes included AI-corridor adherence, over-reliance and under-reliance rates, behavioral accuracy, and confidence shift. Across 231 paired observations, MPD did not differ significantly between correct (75.5 pixels; SD, 33.4) and incorrect (71.1 pixels; SD, 31.7) overlay conditions (P = .35). Directional analysis revealed that surgeons accepted incorrect AI suggestions in 60.6% of incorrect-overlay frames (43/71), with a specificity for rejecting incorrect guidance of only 39.4% (28/71). Correct suggestions were accepted 76.9% of the time (123/160). Overall behavioral accuracy was 65.4%. Self-reported confidence increased significantly after AI exposure (Δ = + 0.65; P < .001). Surgeons accepted approximately 3 of every 5 incorrect AI recommendations. As intraoperative AI systems approach deployment, surgeon oversight cannot be assumed to neutralize algorithmic error; it must be empirically measured, deliberately designed for, and prospectively validated.
zh_abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] 用于术中手术引导的人工智能系统正接近临床应用，但尚无研究在手术决策背景下量化自动化偏倚（定义为过度依赖自动化推荐的倾向）。随着这些系统进入手术工作流程，外科医生识别并否决错误 AI 指导的能力成为关键的安全要求。目的：衡量外科医生在接触带 AI 标记的视觉引导后修改切口方案的程度，并确定错误 AI 建议被接受的比例。方法：在 19 名外科医生（10 名住院医师、2 名专科培训医师、7 名主治医师）中开展了一项两阶段对照实验。参与者在 20 帧机器人胆囊切除术视频的静态画面上绘制切口线，先在无引导下（第 01 阶段），再在模拟 AI 叠加图引导下（第 02 阶段）。叠加图或正确（源自专家共识），或被刻意设为错误（向不安全的解剖结构偏移），比例约为 70:30。未使用真实的 AI 模型。主要结局为第 01 阶段与第 02 阶段切口线之间的平均垂直距离（MPD）。次要结局包括 AI 通道依从性、过度依赖和依赖不足率、行为准确性以及信心变化。结果：在 231 对配对观察中，正确叠加条件（75.5 像素；SD 33.4）与错误叠加条件（71.1 像素；SD 31.7）之间的 MPD 无显著差异（P = .35）。方向性分析显示，外科医生在 60.6%（43/71）的错误叠加画面中接受了错误的 AI 建议，拒绝错误引导的特异度仅为 39.4%（28/71）。正确建议的接受率为 76.9%（123/160）。总体行为准确率为 65.4%。接触 AI 后自我报告的信心显著提高（Δ = +0.65；P < .001）。结论：外科医生接受了约每 5 条错误 AI 建议中的 3 条。随着术中 AI 系统接近应用，不能假定外科医生的监督会抵消算法错误；必须对其进行实证测量、有意识地设计并前瞻性验证。

title: Machine learning for RNA-small molecule interactions: methodologies, evaluation, and future directions.
zh_title: RNA-小分子相互作用的机器学习：方法、评估与未来方向
summary: 综述RNA-小分子相互作用预测的计算方法，涵盖结合位点、结合偏好与结合构象三项任务。
key_points: 总结数据资源与分子表示
覆盖三类核心预测任务
讨论评估方式与未来方向
reason: 信息量较大的方法综述，涉及药物发现，属值得一看档
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] RNA is emerging as a compelling therapeutic target due to its rich structural diversity and central involvement in gene regulation, splicing, translation, and cellular signaling. Alongside advances in structural biology, computational approaches, especially machine learning and deep learning, have transformed the systematic analysis of RNA-small molecule interactions. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey of computational methods for RNA-small molecule interaction prediction, with a particular emphasis on three core tasks: binding site prediction, binding preference prediction, and binding pose prediction. We first summarize the data resources commonly used to support these tasks and outline molecular representations that capture RNA structural features and the chemical properties of small molecules. We then review a spectrum of computational approaches for the above three tasks, ranging from statistical methods and traditional machine learning to deep learning. We further evaluate representative methods for each task, providing insights into their respective strengths and limitations. Finally, we highlight open challenges in current research on RNA-small molecule interactions, including limited data availability, the black-box nature of the models, and the growing need for generative modeling. We discuss emerging directions such as data augmentation, model interpretability, and RNA-targeted small-molecule design as promising pathways to address these challenges and advance rational RNA-targeted drug discovery.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] RNA 因其丰富的结构多样性以及在基因调控、剪接、翻译和细胞信号传导中的核心作用，正成为一类引人注目的治疗靶点。随着结构生物学的进展，计算方法，尤其是机器学习和深度学习，已改变了对 RNA-小分子相互作用的系统性分析。本文对 RNA-小分子相互作用预测的计算方法进行了全面综述，重点关注三项核心任务：结合位点预测、结合偏好预测和结合构象（pose）预测。我们首先总结了支持这些任务常用的数据资源，并概述了能够刻画 RNA 结构特征和小分子化学性质的分子表示方法。随后，我们针对上述三项任务，综述了从统计方法、传统机器学习到深度学习的一系列计算方法。我们进一步评估了各任务的代表性方法，阐明其各自的优势与局限。最后，我们指出了当前 RNA-小分子相互作用研究中尚未解决的挑战，包括数据可得性有限、模型的黑箱性质以及对生成式建模日益增长的需求。我们讨论了数据增强、模型可解释性和 RNA 靶向小分子设计等新兴方向，它们是应对这些挑战、推进合理的 RNA 靶向药物发现的有前景的途径。

title: Too good to be true? AI performance in CT-based urinary stone detection and classification: EAU endourology systematic review and diagnostic accuracy meta-analysis.
zh_title: CT尿路结石AI检测与分类的系统综述和荟萃分析
summary: EAU系统综述与诊断准确性荟萃分析，纳入14项研究，评估AI在CT尿路结石检测与分类中的汇总表现及方法学影响因素。
key_points: 已在PROSPERO注册，检索至2026年3月
纳入14项研究，5项检测、9项分类
采用双变量随机效应模型与QUADAS-AI评估偏倚
reason: 系统综述/荟萃分析，纳入研究数量有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [World journal of urology] To evaluate pooled performance of artificial intelligence (AI) in computed tomography (CT)-based urinary stone detection and classification and identify methodological factors influencing results. This review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261319940). A systematic search of PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar was conducted up to March 15, 2026. Studies evaluating AI-based detection or classification of urolithiasis on CT with available validation/test cohort data (sensitivity/specificity or 2 × 2 tables) were included. A bivariate random-effects model generated pooled sensitivity, specificity, and hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) curves. Meta-regression explored moderators related to dataset composition and AI pipelines. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-AI. 14 studies (five detection-based, nine classification-based) were included. Overall pooled sensitivity and specificity were 0.967 and 0.979 (AUC 0.987). Classification studies demonstrated higher pooled sensitivity (0.977) and specificity (0.990) compared with detection studies (0.935 and 0.919; AUC 0.945). Significant heterogeneity was observed and influenced by training sample size, class imbalance, presence of bladder stones or other pathologies, and architectural choices. Most studies had high risk of bias, lacked external validation, and frequently used slice-level or pre-selected datasets, potentially overestimating performance. Substantial methodological heterogeneity and high risk of bias limit clinical generalizability. Detection studies better reflect real-world workflows and show lower performance. Current evidence does not support routine clinical implementation without standardized reporting and robust external validation.
zh_abstract: [World journal of urology] 旨在评估人工智能（AI）在基于CT的泌尿系结石检测与分类中的合并性能，并识别影响结果的方法学因素。本综述已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420261319940）。系统检索了PubMed、Cochrane Library和Google Scholar，检索截至2026年3月15日。纳入评估基于AI的CT尿路结石检测或分类、且可获得验证/测试队列数据（敏感度/特异度或2×2表）的研究。采用双变量随机效应模型生成合并敏感度、合并特异度及分层汇总受试者工作特征（HSROC）曲线。通过meta回归探讨与数据集构成和AI流程相关的调节因素。采用QUADAS-AI评估偏倚风险。共纳入14项研究（5项基于检测，9项基于分类）。总体合并敏感度和特异度分别为0.967和0.979（AUC 0.987）。分类研究的合并敏感度（0.977）和特异度（0.990）高于检测研究（0.935和0.919；AUC 0.945）。研究间存在显著异质性，受训练样本量、类别不平衡、是否存在膀胱结石或其他病变以及网络架构选择的影响。大多数研究存在高偏倚风险，缺乏外部验证，且常使用切片层面或预先筛选的数据集，可能高估了性能。显著的方法学异质性和高偏倚风险限制了临床推广应用。检测研究更能反映真实世界的工作流程，其性能较低。在缺乏标准化报告和可靠外部验证的情况下，现有证据不支持常规临床应用。

title: Evaluation of large language models for guideline-based clinical questions in muscle-invasive and non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer and upper tract urothelial carcinoma: a multidisciplinary Delphi study.
source: PubMed · Journal of comparative effectiveness research
zh_title: 大语言模型回答膀胱癌与上尿路尿路上皮癌指南问题的Delphi评估
summary: 专家组以改良Delphi法评估Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT对EAU指南问题的回答，NMIBC共识率分别为88%、100%、96%。
key_points: 三种LLM各答每类25题

abstract: [Journal of comparative effectiveness research] Aim: To assess expert panel agreement with responses from three large language models, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, to questions based on guidelines for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) and upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC). Materials & methods: The 2025 European Association of Urology (EAU) guidelines were provided to Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-4.1-mini. Figures and tables were converted into plain language text. Each model answered 25 questions per entity. Panels of 7-10 experts rated responses on a 9-point scale using a modified Delphi process with two rounds. Outcomes were consensus in agreement and median expert panel score ≥7. Results: For Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, respectively, consensus in agreement was achieved for 88%, 100% and 96% of NMIBC responses (p = 0.097); 92%, 100% and 96% of MIBC responses (p = 0.223); and 56%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses (p < 0.001). For UTUC, significantly fewer Claude responses achieved consensus in agreement than Gemini or ChatGPT responses. Across all questions, consensus in agreement was achieved for 59/75 Claude responses (78.7%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%), and 72/75 ChatGPT responses (96%) (p < 0.001). Median scores ≥7 were achieved for 88%, 100% and 100% of NMIBC responses; 96%, 100% and 100% of MIBC responses; and 68%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses. In UTUC, Claude had significantly fewer such responses than Gemini, but the difference from ChatGPT was not statistically significant. Overall, median scores ≥7 were achieved for 63/75 Claude responses (84%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%) and 74/75 ChatGPT responses (98.7%) (p < 0.001). Conclusion: Under the study conditions, large language model responses frequently achieved expert panel agreement, particularly for Gemini and ChatGPT, supporting the potential of these models for guideline interpretation. Further validation is required to establish clinical utility and safety.

title: CasanovoGUI: A Cross-Platform Desktop Application for Deep Learning-Based De Novo Peptide Sequencing with Casanovo.

abstract: [Journal of proteome research] De novo peptide sequencing detects peptides directly from tandem mass spectra without a protein sequence database, and deep learning has substantially advanced its performance. Casanovo, one such widely used model, is distributed as a Python command-line program. Consequently, installation, GPU and dependency configuration, and manual parametrization can be challenging for many bench scientists and are a recurring source of errors. Interpreting and validating the resulting predictions poses a further challenge. We present CasanovoGUI, an open-source Java-based desktop application that makes all of Casanovo's main analysis functions available through a point-and-click interface on Windows, macOS, and Linux. On first use, CasanovoGUI automatically installs a private Python environment and Casanovo with a GPU-matched build, requiring no prior software setup. The GUI provides access to Casanovo's analysis functions and configuration parameters, streams live progress, and integrates results interpretation: annotated spectra with per-residue confidence scores in the PDV viewer and mismatch-tolerant mapping of de novo peptides back to a reference proteome. CasanovoGUI is available at https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI.
zh_abstract: [Journal of proteome research] 从头肽段测序（De novo peptide sequencing）无需蛋白质序列数据库，即可直接从串联质谱中检测肽段，而深度学习已显著提升了其性能。Casanovo 是此类模型中被广泛使用的一种，以 Python 命令行程序的形式发布。因此，对许多实验室科研人员而言，安装、GPU 与依赖项配置以及手动设置参数可能颇具挑战，并且是反复出现的错误来源。解读和验证所得预测结果则构成另一项挑战。我们提出了 CasanovoGUI，这是一款基于 Java 的开源桌面应用程序，可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上通过点击式界面使用 Casanovo 的全部主要分析功能。首次使用时，CasanovoGUI 会自动安装私有的 Python 环境以及与 GPU 匹配的 Casanovo 版本，无需事先进行任何软件设置。该图形界面可调用 Casanovo 的分析功能和配置参数，实时显示运行进度，并整合了结果解读功能：在 PDV 查看器中显示带有逐残基置信度评分的注释谱图，以及将从头测序得到的肽段以容许错配的方式映射回参考蛋白质组。CasanovoGUI 可从 https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI 获取。

title: HelixWings enables AI-driven enzyme engineering for biomimetic cofactor utilization.
zh_title: HelixWings：AI驱动的酶工程用于仿生辅因子利用
summary: HelixWings整合构象动力学与静态微环境分析筛选酶变体，应用于P450BM3，获得对仿生辅因子催化效率提高404%的变体。
key_points: 面向NMNH等低成本仿生辅因子
整合构象动力学与静态微环境分析

abstract: [iScience] Biomimetic nicotinamide cofactors, such as nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMNH), can substantially reduce synthesis costs compared with natural cofactors like nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH). However, natural enzymes generally exhibit poor activity with these alternative cofactors. Existing engineering approaches, including directed evolution and rational design, remain limited by experimental uncertainty or computational complexity. Here, we developed HelixWings, an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven screening platform that integrates conformational dynamics analysis with static microenvironment analysis to identify enzyme variants compatible with biomimetic cofactors. Applied to P450BM3, a widely used biocatalyst for chiral synthesis and pharmaceutical precursor production, HelixWings identified a variant with a 404% improvement in catalytic efficiency toward cytochrome c under NMNH-supported conditions. The platform was further validated with CYP116B46, achieving a 217% improvement in NMNH utilization efficiency. HelixWings reduced screening time by 23-fold compared with rational design.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 仿生烟酰胺辅因子（如烟酰胺单核苷酸，NMNH）与天然辅因子（如还原型烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸，NADPH）相比，可显著降低合成成本。然而，天然酶通常对这些替代辅因子活性较差。现有的工程化方法，包括定向进化和理性设计，仍受限于实验的不确定性或计算复杂性。在此，我们开发了HelixWings，一个由人工智能（AI）驱动的筛选平台，整合构象动力学分析与静态微环境分析，以识别与仿生辅因子相容的酶变体。将其应用于P450BM3（一种广泛用于手性合成和药物前体生产的生物催化剂），HelixWings鉴定出一个变体，在NMNH支持条件下，其对细胞色素c的催化效率提高了404%。该平台进一步在CYP116B46上得到验证，NMNH利用效率提高了217%。与理性设计相比，HelixWings将筛选时间缩短了23倍。

title: Biological state-guided oncology: a framework for dynamic precision cancer care through oncological state transitions.
source: PubMed · Expert review of anticancer therapy
zh_title: 生物状态导向肿瘤学：基于肿瘤状态转换的动态精准诊疗框架
summary: 综述提出肿瘤状态转换框架，探讨液体活检、多组学、数字病理、AI 与数字孪生在动态评估中的潜在作用。

涉及多组学、数字病理与数字孪生
讨论临床验证与实施挑战

abstract: [Expert review of anticancer therapy] Precision oncology has transformed cancer treatment through molecular profiling, but clinical decisions remain largely anchored to baseline assessments that incompletely capture evolving tumor biology and host conditions. This review proposes the Oncological State Transition (OST) framework as a conceptual approach to cancer as a dynamic process of evolving tumor and host biological states. We examine the biological basis of state transitions and the potential roles of longitudinal liquid biopsy, multi-omics, functional imaging, digital pathology, artificial intelligence, and digital twins in multimodal state assessment. Potential applications across prevention, surgery, systemic therapy, minimal residual disease surveillance, therapeutic resistance, and survivorship are discussed, together with challenges in clinical validation and implementation. OST provides a testable framework for integrating longitudinal multimodal information to estimate current biological states and potential future transitions. It emphasizes probabilistic state estimation and the distinction between biological and actionable transitions. Rather than replacing conventional staging or molecular classification, OST may complement precision oncology by supporting dynamic state assessment and adaptive decision-making. Prospective studies and randomized comparisons are required to establish its clinical utility. OST therefore represents a potential foundation for Dynamic Precision Oncology, but remains a conceptual framework rather than a validated clinical system.
zh_abstract: [Expert review of anticancer therapy] 精准肿瘤学通过分子谱分析改变了癌症治疗，但临床决策在很大程度上仍以基线评估为依据，而基线评估并不能完整反映不断演变的肿瘤生物学和宿主状况。本综述提出肿瘤状态转换（OST）框架，作为一种将癌症视为肿瘤与宿主生物学状态不断演变的动态过程的概念性方法。我们探讨了状态转换的生物学基础，以及纵向液体活检、多组学、功能成像、数字病理、人工智能和数字孪生在多模态状态评估中的潜在作用。文中讨论了其在预防、手术、全身治疗、微小残留病灶监测、治疗耐药和生存期管理等方面的潜在应用，以及临床验证与实施中的挑战。OST提供了一个可检验的框架，用于整合纵向多模态信息，以估计当前生物学状态和潜在的未来转换。它强调概率性状态估计，以及生物学转换与可干预转换之间的区别。OST并非取代传统分期或分子分型，而是可通过支持动态状态评估和适应性决策来补充精准肿瘤学。要确立其临床实用性，尚需前瞻性研究和随机对照比较。因此，OST代表了动态精准肿瘤学的潜在基础，但仍是一个概念性框架，而非经过验证的临床系统。

title: Prompting Strategies for Readability Alignment Between User-Generated Ophthalmology Questions and Large Language Model Answers: Comparative Evaluation Study.

abstract: [JMIR formative research] Accessible health communication is essential for effective patient education, yet most medical information remains written at a level above the general population's recommended reading level. Large language models (LLMs) can simplify complex medical information, but it remains unclear whether responses can be automatically adapted to match the linguistic complexity of user-generated questions seeking medical information. To evaluate whether the LLM-generated responses to user-generated ophthalmology questions align with their readability and to compare different prompting strategies for readability control across multiple LLM architectures, including their impact on response quality as well as computational cost and efficiency. A total of 400 user-generated ophthalmology questions collected from public YouTube comments were categorized into 3 readability tiers based on the Flesch Reading Ease Score. A controlled comparative evaluation of responses generated by 4 LLMs (GPT 5.2, Gemini 3, Claude Opus 4.5, and OSS-20b) was performed under 4 prompting conditions: Baseline (no readability control), Formula-Informed Readability Prompt, Semantic Readability Inference, and External Calculator-Guided Prompt. Agreement between question and response readability was assessed using quadratic-weighted Cohen kappa. Response quality was evaluated using BERTScore and LLM-as-a-judge assessments. Computational efficiency was evaluated through token usage, estimated cost per response, and latency. The external calculator-guided strategy produced the strongest alignment in readability across models, achieving the highest agreement (Gemini 3: κ=0.94; GPT 5.2: κ=0.90), while maintaining favorable computational efficiency. Formula-informed prompting showed intermediate performance, whereas semantic inference demonstrated poor agreement due to unreliable readability estimation. Semantic similarity remained high across models (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers Score [BERTScore] F1>0.87). zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 【背景】易于理解的健康沟通对有效的患者教育至关重要，但大多数医学信息的书写水平仍高于普通人群的推荐阅读水平。大语言模型（LLM）可以简化复杂的医学信息，但尚不清楚其回答能否自动调整，以匹配用户生成的、寻求医学信息的问题的语言复杂度。【目的】评估 LLM 针对用户生成的眼科问题所生成的回答在可读性上是否与问题一致，并比较多种 LLM 架构下用于可读性控制的不同提示策略，包括其对回答质量以及计算成本和效率的影响。【方法】从公开的 YouTube 评论中收集了 400 个用户生成的眼科问题，并根据 Flesch Reading Ease Score 分为 3 个可读性层级。在 4 种提示条件下，对 4 种 LLM（GPT 5.2、Gemini 3、Claude Opus 4.5 和 OSS-20b）生成的回答进行了对照比较评估：基线（无可读性控制）、公式告知式可读性提示、语义可读性推断以及外部计算器引导提示。问题与回答可读性之间的一致性采用二次加权 Cohen kappa 评估。回答质量采用 BERTScore 和 LLM-as-a-judge 评估。计算效率通过 token 使用量、每条回答的估算成本和延迟进行评估。【结果】外部计算器引导策略在各模型中产生了最强的可读性一致性，达到最高一致性（Gemini 3：κ=0.94；GPT 5.2：κ=0.90），同时保持了良好的计算效率。公式告知式提示表现居中，而语义推断由于可读性估计不可靠，一致性较差。高性能模型（GPT 5.2 和 Gemini 3）在各策略下均保持很高的事实准确率（>98%），表明可读性控制并未显著降低正确性。相比之下，开源的 OSS-20b 模型准确率较低（83.75%–90%），且对可读性约束更敏感。各模型的语义相似度均保持较高水平（Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers Score [BERTScore] F1>0.87）。较长的问题与略低的准确率相关，尤其是在性能较低的配置中。【结论】使 LLM 回答与用户……的可读性相一致（原文摘要至此截断）

title: Applications, Technical Characteristics, and Evaluation Approaches of Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Nursing: Scoping Review.
source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research
zh_title: 护理领域检索增强生成的应用、技术特征与评估：范围综述
summary: 依据Arksey和O'Malley框架，梳理RAG在护理中的应用、研究特征与空白。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) show great potential for widespread application in the field of nursing; however, their limitations include hallucinations, insufficient domain knowledge, and delays in updating evidence. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), by combining external knowledge retrieval with text generation, holds promise for optimizing model outputs. However, current evidence on the use of RAG in nursing remains fragmented and has not been systematically synthesized. This scoping review aims to map the applications of RAG in the nursing field, identify current research characteristics and gaps, and provide a foundational evidence base to inform future research and development of intelligent tools for nursing practice. This study adopted the Arksey and O'Malley scoping review framework and followed PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews) reporting standards. We systematically searched 9 databases-PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, CNKI, VIP Database, Wanfang Database, and Sinomed-from inception to September 2026. Backward and forward citation searches were also conducted to identify additional eligible studies. Eligible publications were restricted to those in English or Chinese during study selection. Two independent reviewers completed study screening and data extraction, and descriptive synthesis was performed for all eligible records. A total of 28 studies published between 2024 and 2026 were included. The application of RAG in nursing primarily focused on 4 scenarios: patient education (n=9), nursing informatics (n=8), clinical decision support (n=7), and nursing education (n=4). The base LLMs included the GPT series, LLaMA, ChatGLM, and Doubao, among others, while the knowledge bases primarily integrated literature, clinical guidelines, institutional resources, and clinical data. Most studies relied on dense retrieval, while some incorporated hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, and reranking to achieve optimization. Generation and task-output evaluations were reported in 27 studies, whereas retrieval evaluation, safety and reliability evaluations, and implementation or outcome evaluations were less frequently reported. Only 4 studies were conducted in real-world clinical settings. zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 大语言模型（LLM）在护理领域具有广泛应用的巨大潜力；然而，其局限性包括幻觉、领域知识不足以及证据更新滞后。检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部知识检索与文本生成相结合，有望优化模型输出。然而，目前关于 RAG 在护理中应用的证据仍较为零散，尚未得到系统综合。本范围综述旨在梳理 RAG 在护理领域的应用，识别当前研究特征与空白，并为未来护理实践智能工具的研究与开发提供基础性证据。本研究采用 Arksey 和 O'Malley 范围综述框架，并遵循 PRISMA-ScR（系统评价和荟萃分析扩展版：范围综述报告条目）报告规范。我们系统检索了9个数据库——PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Scopus、CNKI、维普数据库、万方数据库和 SinoMed——检索时间自建库至2026年9月。同时进行了向前和向后的引文检索以识别其他符合条件的研究。研究选择时，纳入的文献限于英文或中文。两名独立评审员完成研究筛选和数据提取，并对所有符合条件的记录进行描述性综合。共纳入2024年至2026年发表的28项研究。RAG 在护理中的应用主要集中于4种场景：患者教育（n=9）、护理信息学（n=8）、临床决策支持（n=7）和护理教育（n=4）。基础 LLM 包括 GPT 系列、LLaMA、ChatGLM 和豆包（Doubao）等，知识库主要整合文献、临床指南、机构资源和临床数据。多数研究依赖稠密检索，部分研究结合混合检索、知识图谱和重排序以实现优化。27项研究报告了生成和任务输出评估，而检索评估、安全性和可靠性评估以及实施或结局评估的报告较少。仅有4项研究在真实临床环境中开展。总体而言，RAG 显示出在特定护理任务中提高 LLM 生成输出的准确性和可靠性的潜力；然而，大多数研究仅在模拟环境中进行了验证（原文此处截断）。

title: Characterization of local linearity in deep learning CT denoising networks.
zh_title: 深度学习CT去噪网络的局部线性特征分析
summary: 提出局部线性化方法，用以刻画并分析CT去噪深度网络的行为，并扩展至GELU与Transformer架构。
key_points: 定义ReLU激活模式一致的严格局部线性区域
分析经典CNN去噪架构
扩展到GELU与Transformer结构

abstract: [Medical physics] Deep learning algorithms for image processing have been proposed for a wide range of applications. In particular, deep learning CT denoising has demonstrated superior ability to reduce noise compared to conventional methods. However, the nonlinear nature of these algorithms makes it difficult to inspect and visualize how the model accomplishes the denoising task. We propose a local linearization approach to characterize and analyze the behavior of deep learning algorithms. Example analysis was performed for a classic denoising architecture with convolutional neural network and ReLU activation functions, and was extended to GELU activation and a transformer-based architecture. We defined strictly local linear regions as the input space over which the activation patterns of all ReLU activation functions are the same. The extent of these regions was investigated by perturbing clinically relevant features of a lung lesion. We further defined approximately local linear regions as the input space where Jacobians are similar and linear approximation results in small error. We developed an algorithm to partition input space over a range of lesion and background features into approximately local linear regions, and separately quantified the contribution of the noise realization and anatomical background to this approximation error. The behavior of networks trained with different levels of denoising, as well as alternative architectures, was compared. The extent of strictly local linear regions was found to be very small. Perturbations on the scale of 10 - 8 mm - 1 were enough to push the network to a neighboring strictly local linear region. However, the Jacobians over a large number of strictly local linear regions were found to be highly similar, which suggests that the network behaves approximately as a piecewise linear system. The partitioning algorithm identified a small number of approximately local linear regions within input spaces characterized by clinically relevant features; this number was similar for the GELU variant but increased for networks trained with more aggressive noise reduction and for a transformer-based architecture, while Jacobians transferred across anatomical backgrounds also increased approximation error. The local linearity analysis framework can be a useful tool for elucidating the behavior of neural networks that are traditionally considered as "black-boxes." zh_abstract: [Medical physics] 用于图像处理的深度学习算法已被提出应用于广泛的场景。特别是，深度学习 CT 去噪在降低噪声方面已显示出优于传统方法的能力。然而，这些算法的非线性特性使得难以检查和可视化模型如何完成去噪任务。我们提出一种局部线性化方法，用于刻画和分析深度学习算法的行为。我们以采用卷积神经网络和 ReLU 激活函数的经典去噪架构为例进行了分析，并扩展到 GELU 激活函数及基于 Transformer 的架构。我们将严格局部线性区域定义为所有 ReLU 激活函数的激活模式均相同的输入空间。通过扰动肺部病灶的临床相关特征来研究这些区域的范围。我们进一步将近似局部线性区域定义为雅可比矩阵相似且线性近似误差较小的输入空间。我们开发了一种算法，可在一系列病灶和背景特征范围内将输入空间划分为近似局部线性区域，并分别量化噪声实现和解剖背景对该近似误差的贡献。比较了以不同去噪强度训练的网络以及替代架构的行为。结果发现严格局部线性区域的范围非常小。10⁻⁸ mm⁻¹ 量级的扰动即足以使网络进入相邻的严格局部线性区域。然而，大量严格局部线性区域上的雅可比矩阵高度相似，提示该网络的行为近似于分段线性系统。划分算法在以临床相关特征为特征的输入空间内识别出少量近似局部线性区域；GELU 变体的该数量相近，但对于去噪更强的网络以及基于 Transformer 的架构，该数量增加，而跨解剖背景迁移雅可比矩阵也会增加近似误差。该局部线性分析框架可成为阐明传统上被视为“黑箱”的神经网络行为的有用工具。初步结果提示，该框架可应用于其他不同的（原文此处截断）。

title: Application of topological deep learning in staging liver fibrosis based on hepatobiliary phase MR images.

abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Early-stage liver fibrosis is reversible; thus, accurate staging of liver fibrosis is of great importance.. Liver biopsy is the gold standard for the diagnosis of liver fibrosis; however, its invasive nature limits its clinical application. Accurate noninvasive staging of liver fibrosis remains challenging. Thus, there is an urgent need for a precise and reliable noninvasive diagnostic approach. A topological deep learning model combining topological data analysis and EfficientViT framework (TopoEfficientViT) was developed to effectively capture global contextual relationships in hepatobiliary phase MR images for assessment of staging liver fibrosis. Our retrospective study included patients with chronic liver diseases from June 2018 to July 2025, which was approved by our Institutional Review Board. Our data from a hospital site (Site A) in our institution were divided into a training set (n = 275) and a validation set (n = 75). The test set (n=65) was composed of data from a separate hospital site (Site B) in the same institution. A total of 415 patients (323 males, mean age 56.52±9.54 years; 92 females, mean age 58.86±9.68 years) were enrolled in the study. In the training set, the AUC and accuracy of TopoEfficientViT for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.942 and 0.906, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.957 and 0.891, respectively. In the validation set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.849 and 0.76, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.861and 0.813, respectively. In the test set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.829 and 0.769, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.791 and 0.785, respectively. The TopoEfficientViT model had high predictive performance for staging liver fibrosis by integrating multi-scale persistent homology topology with convolutional networks.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 早期肝纤维化是可逆的，因此准确分期肝纤维化至关重要。肝活检是诊断肝纤维化的金标准，但其有创性限制了临床应用。无创、准确地对肝纤维化进行分期仍具挑战性，因此迫切需要一种精确可靠的无创诊断方法。本研究开发了一种将拓扑数据分析与 EfficientViT 框架相结合的拓扑深度学习模型（TopoEfficientViT），以有效捕获肝胆期 MR 图像中的全局上下文关系，用于评估肝纤维化分期。我们的回顾性研究纳入了 2018 年 6 月至 2025 年 7 月的慢性肝病患者，并获得本机构伦理审查委员会批准。来自本机构某医院院区（Site A）的数据被分为训练集（n = 275）和验证集（n = 75）。测试集（n = 65）由同一机构另一医院院区（Site B）的数据组成。共有 415 例患者入组（男性 323 例，平均年龄 56.52±9.54 岁；女性 92 例，平均年龄 58.86±9.68 岁）。在训练集中，TopoEfficientViT 区分肝纤维化 F1-2 与 F3-4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.942 和 0.906；区分 F1-3 与 F4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.957 和 0.891。在验证集中，区分 F1-2 与 F3-4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.849 和 0.76；区分 F1-3 与 F4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.861 和 0.813。在测试集中，区分 F1-2 与 F3-4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.829 和 0.769；区分 F1-3 与 F4 的 AUC 和准确率分别为 0.791 和 0.785。TopoEfficientViT 模型通过将多尺度持续同调拓扑与卷积网络相结合，对肝纤维化分期具有较高的预测性能。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) remains essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease, while the focus has moved from stenosis to plaque burden. Current workflows either need manual adjustments that limit consistency and efficiency, or they lack segment-specific precision. This study evaluated the effectiveness and reliability of a fully automated deep learning-based plaque quantification method using CCTA. DVPlaque workflow, a fully automated deep learning model, was developed to quantify segment-specific plaque volume. A total of 271 CCTA scans were included. Plaque quantification was performed by the expert and DVPlaque model, respectively. Reliability was measured through interclass correlation coefficient (ICC) analysis and Bland-Altman plots. DVPlaque workflow cost less time than expert measurement (p 0.90, and per-segment ICCs were > 0.90 except for mid-LAD NCP (0.887). DVPlaque scheme was capable of quantifying plaque volume with excellent efficiency. The automated quantification of CP and NCP exhibited strong reliability even on a per-segment level, facilitating clinical application.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 冠状动脉计算机断层血管成像（CCTA）仍是诊断冠状动脉疾病的重要手段，而关注点已从狭窄转向斑块负荷。目前的工作流程要么需要手动调整，从而限制了一致性和效率，要么缺乏节段特异性的精确度。本研究评估了一种基于深度学习、使用 CCTA 的全自动斑块定量方法的有效性和可靠性。开发了 DVPlaque 工作流程，这是一种全自动深度学习模型，用于量化节段特异性斑块体积。共纳入 271 例 CCTA 扫描。分别由专家和 DVPlaque 模型进行斑块定量。通过组内相关系数（ICC）分析和 Bland-Altman 图衡量可靠性。DVPlaque 工作流程比专家测量耗时更少（p 0.90，且各节段 ICC 均 > 0.90，仅左前降支（LAD）中段 NCP（0.887）除外。DVPlaque 方案能够以出色的效率量化斑块体积。CP 和 NCP 的自动定量即使在各节段水平上也表现出很强的可靠性，有利于临床应用。

title: Digital and artificial intelligence-assisted medication management for older adults with chronic diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

summary: 综合RCT证据，评估数字及AI/ML用药管理能否为患有慢性病的老年人带来可测量的临床改善。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to synthesize the results of randomized controlled trials to determine whether medication management approaches based on digital technologies and artificial intelligence/machine learning can indeed bring measurable clinical improvements in older adults with at least one chronic diseases. To identify relevant RCTs, we performed a systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, CNKI, Wanfang, and other databases from their inception through June 30, 2026, for studies of digital and AI/ML-based medication management in older adults with at least one chronic diseases. All stages of study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment were conducted independently by two reviewers, applying the Cochrane RoB 2.0 tool. Meta-analytic pooling was conducted via RevMan 5.4. Nineteen RCTs met the inclusion criteria, of which 6 were included in the meta-analysis and 13 in the descriptive synthesis. For medication adherence, three studies reported highly heterogeneous results (I 2 = 97%), and because of this heterogeneity and the small number of studies, the data were not pooled; the individual study estimates ranged from SMD = -0.28-SMD = 1.89. For PIMs, only one study reported a comparable outcome; no pooled estimate was calculated. For hospitalization and mortality, the two included studies used different effect measures (HR and OR) and were therefore presented separately: Blum et al. reported an HR of 0.95 (95% CI 0.77-1.17), and Rieckert et al. reported an OR of 0.88 (95% CI 0.73-1.07). The current body of evidence does not establish clinically meaningful benefits of digital or AI/ML-based medication management on hard endpoints such as hospitalization and mortality among older adults with at least one chronic diseases. For medication adherence, the evidence remains inconclusive and highly heterogeneous, and no reliable pooled estimate could be obtained. Given the pronounced heterogeneity and the limited pool of high-quality RCTs, current evidence is insufficient to establish clinical benefit for the routine implementation of digital or AI/ML-based medication management systems in geriatric care and further rigorously designed studies are warranted. CRD420261460445.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在综合随机对照试验的结果，以确定基于数字技术及人工智能/机器学习的用药管理方法是否确实能为至少患有一种慢性病的老年人带来可测量的临床改善。为识别相关 RCT，我们系统检索了 PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library、CNKI、万方等数据库（自建库至 2026 年 6 月 30 日），纳入针对至少患有一种慢性病的老年人开展的数字及基于 AI/ML 的用药管理研究。研究筛选、数据提取和偏倚风险评估的所有阶段均由两名评价者独立完成，采用 Cochrane RoB 2.0 工具。荟萃分析合并通过 RevMan 5.4 进行。19 项 RCT 符合纳入标准，其中 6 项纳入荟萃分析，13 项纳入描述性综合。对于用药依从性，三项研究报告的结果异质性很高（I² = 97%），由于这种异质性及研究数量少，未对数据进行合并；各研究的效应估计值范围为 SMD = -0.28 至 SMD = 1.89。对于潜在不适当用药（PIMs），仅有一项研究报告了可比的结局，未计算合并估计值。对于住院和死亡率，纳入的两项研究使用了不同的效应量（HR 和 OR），因此分别呈现：Blum 等报告 HR 为 0.95（95% CI 0.77–1.17），Rieckert 等报告 OR 为 0.88（95% CI 0.73–1.07）。现有证据尚不能证明数字或基于 AI/ML 的用药管理对至少患有一种慢性病的老年人的住院和死亡率等硬终点具有有临床意义的获益。对于用药依从性，证据仍无定论且异质性很高，无法获得可靠的合并估计值。鉴于明显的异质性以及高质量 RCT 数量有限，现有证据不足以证明在老年医疗中常规实施数字或基于 AI/ML 的用药管理系统具有临床获益，仍需开展设计严谨的进一步研究。CRD420261460445。

title: A Lightweight EEG-Based Alzheimer's Disease Detection Framework on an Edge-Computing Platform Toward Future Intelligent Digital Twin Systems.
zh_title: 面向边缘计算的轻量EEG阿尔茨海默病检测框架
summary: 提出轻量扩张混合深度学习模型并结合通道选择，用于边缘设备上基于EEG的阿尔茨海默病检测。
