title: FateDriver: Weakly supervised dual-view graph learning for transition-specific prioritization of candidate regulators in cellular reprogramming
zh_title: FateDriver：细胞重编程中转变特异候选调控因子的弱监督双视图图学习
summary: 预印本提出弱监督双视图图神经网络，基于单细胞转录组，将递送因子作稀疏标签，在正例-未标注框架下排序转变相关调控基因。
key_points: 在两个OSKM和一个GMT数据集评测
与六种方法比较，排名第一或第二
将递送因子作为基因级稀疏标签
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Cellular reprogramming supports regenerative medicine, yet the endogenous regulators of a specified source-to-target transition remain incompletely defined. Existing computational methods rank candidate regulators from network topology, trajectory dynamics, or cell-state labels, leaving unused the factors experimentally delivered to induce the transition. We present FateDriver, a weakly supervised dual-view graph neural network that jointly represents cells and genes from single-cell transcriptomes, treats the delivered factors as sparse gene-level labels, and ranks the remaining genes for a specified transition under a positive--unlabeled formulation. Across two OSKM datasets and one GMT dataset, FateDriver ranked first or second among six methods in recovering externally curated reference genes, exceeded a supervision-matched non-graph model despite weaker co-expression with the delivered factors, and achieved the highest recovery of protein targets of pluripotency-inducing chemical cocktails in both OSKM datasets. Holding either the source or the endpoint fixed yielded distinct candidate programs, including a DDX58--interferon axis associated with cells lacking endogenous pluripotency markers. Applying the same framework to candidate source--target pairs prioritized distinct candidate origins for two in vivo partially reprogrammed intestinal populations. FateDriver converts sparse experimental knowledge into transition-specific hypotheses for regulator prioritization from single-cell trajectories.
zh_abstract: 细胞重编程支持再生医学，但针对特定起始细胞到目标细胞转变的内源性调控因子仍未被完全阐明。现有计算方法基于网络拓扑、轨迹动力学或细胞状态标签对候选调控因子进行排序，而未利用实验中为诱导该转变所递送的因子。我们提出 FateDriver，一种弱监督的双视图图神经网络，可从单细胞转录组中联合表征细胞和基因，将所递送的因子视为稀疏的基因水平标签，并在正例-未标注（positive–unlabeled）框架下对特定转变中其余基因进行排序。在两个 OSKM 数据集和一个 GMT 数据集中，FateDriver 在恢复外部整理的参考基因方面，在六种方法中排名第一或第二；尽管与所递送因子的共表达较弱，其表现仍超过监督条件匹配的非图模型；并且在两个 OSKM 数据集中，其对诱导多能性的化学鸡尾酒蛋白靶点的恢复率最高。固定起始细胞或终点之一，可得到不同的候选程序，包括与缺乏内源性多能性标志物的细胞相关的 DDX58–干扰素轴。将同一框架应用于候选的起始–目标细胞对，为两个体内部分重编程的肠道细胞群体优先给出了不同的候选起源。FateDriver 将稀疏的实验知识转化为针对特定转变的假说，用于基于单细胞轨迹的调控因子优先排序。

title: LIMBER: A Hybrid RNA Foundation Model for Predicting and Understanding RNA Structure and Function
zh_title: LIMBER：用于RNA结构与功能预测的混合RNA基础模型
summary: LIMBER结合双向自注意力与选择性状态空间模型，在4050万条非编码RNA序列上预训练，并用于结构与功能预测及可解释性评估。
key_points: 混合注意力与Mamba架构
预训练于4050万条ncRNA序列
二级结构预测与ncRNA分类表现领先
reason: 新颖基础模型预印本，有基准对比；未经评审，无外部验证信息
abstract: RNA foundation models offer a promising route to decoding the relationships between RNA sequence, structure and function, yet how model shapes the acquisition and organization of biological information remains poorly understood. Here we introduce Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA (LIMBER), a hybrid foundation model integrating bidirectional self-attention with selective state-space modeling, pretrained on 40.5 million non-coding RNA sequences. Through task-specific fine-tuning, LIMBER achieves leading performance on secondary-structure prediction and non-coding RNA classification benchmarks, while demonstrating strong transferability to translation-related tasks and RNA--small-molecule interaction prediction. Beyond model development, we establish a unified, task-agnostic framework to systematically evaluate and interpret the biological knowledge intrinsically acquired by RNA foundation models. This framework validates LIMBER's strong capabilities in recovering RNA structures and predicting mutational effects, while uncovering a hierarchical, task-dependent organization of different biological information across model layers. By further systematically training and evaluating a broad panel of model variants spanning model capacity, training duration and dataset size, we uncover distinct scaling behaviors across structural, evolutionary and functional capabilities. Together, these findings establish LIMBER as a versatile RNA foundation model and provide broader insights into how architectural design, internal representations and scaling shape the learning of RNA sequence-structure-function relationships.
zh_abstract: RNA基础模型为解码RNA序列、结构与功能之间的关系提供了一条有前景的途径，然而模型如何塑造生物学信息的获取与组织方式，仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出 Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA（LIMBER），这是一种将双向自注意力与选择性状态空间建模相结合的混合基础模型，在4050万条非编码RNA序列上进行了预训练。通过针对特定任务的微调，LIMBER 在二级结构预测和非编码RNA分类基准上取得了领先的性能，同时在翻译相关任务和RNA–小分子相互作用预测上表现出很强的可迁移性。除模型开发之外，我们还建立了一个统一的、与任务无关的框架，用于系统评估和解读RNA基础模型内在获得的生物学知识。该框架验证了 LIMBER 在还原RNA结构和预测突变效应方面的强大能力，同时揭示了不同生物学信息在模型各层之间呈现出层级性、依赖于任务的组织方式。通过进一步系统地训练和评估涵盖模型容量、训练时长和数据集规模的一系列模型变体，我们发现结构、进化和功能能力具有各不相同的缩放行为。总之，这些发现确立了 LIMBER 作为一种多功能RNA基础模型，并为架构设计、内部表征和缩放如何塑造RNA序列–结构–功能关系的学习提供了更广泛的见解。

title: Advances in artificial intelligence for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis of neurological diseases: a systematic literature review.
zh_title: 脑影像AI与神经疾病计算机辅助诊断：系统文献综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020对2020年1月至2026年6月的研究进行综述，检索到1,078条记录，涵盖方法、模态、数据集与验证实践。
key_points: 检索8个来源，得1,078条记录
评估方法、模态、数据集与验证实践
关注转化落地的局限
reason: 系统综述，规模较大但属综述类，值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] Brain imaging is central to the structural, functional, metabolic, and neurophysiological characterization of neurological disease, yet interpretation remains constrained by heterogeneity in acquisition, annotation, expertise, and clinical context. This systematic literature review evaluates recent artificial intelligence approaches for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis, with emphasis on methods, modalities, neurological diseases, diagnostic tasks, datasets, validation practices, and translational limitations. The review followed PRISMA 2020 and covered peer-reviewed English-language studies published from January 2020 through June 2026. Eight information sources were searched using database-specific terms for artificial intelligence, neuroimaging, neurological disease, and diagnostic analysis. The search identified 1,078 records; 236 duplicates were removed, 842 unique records were screened, 258 full texts were assessed, and 123 studies were included after a record-level eligibility re-audit. Heterogeneous evidence was synthesized narratively and by descriptive mapping rather than meta-analysis. MRI was frequently represented in the included studies and auxiliary mapping data; CT was commonly used in acute stroke and intracranial hemorrhage; PET supported selected molecular and differential-diagnosis studies; fMRI and diffusion imaging were used for network and white-matter analysis; and EEG extended the scope to neurophysiological diagnosis. CNN and three-dimensional networks were commonly reported, while attention, Transformer, graph, self-supervised, generative, multimodal, and foundation-model approaches appeared in selected recent studies. Stroke, dementia, and brain tumors were frequently represented, but heterogeneous populations, outcomes, and incomplete validation extraction precluded ranking diseases, modalities, architectures, or validation strategies. The evidence suggests movement from task-specific pattern recognition toward multimodal and context-rich decision support in selected settings, but it does not establish uniform methodological superiority or clinical maturity. Dependable translation requires patient-level data governance, transparent reporting, uncertainty estimation, independent multicenter testing, prospective workflow evaluation, and clinically meaningful endpoints.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] 脑成像在神经系统疾病的结构、功能、代谢和神经生理学特征描述中处于核心地位，但其解读仍受到采集、标注、专业经验和临床背景异质性的制约。本系统文献综述评估了近期用于脑成像和计算机辅助诊断的人工智能方法，重点关注方法、模态、神经系统疾病、诊断任务、数据集、验证实践和转化局限。本综述遵循 PRISMA 2020，涵盖 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月发表的经同行评议的英文研究。使用针对各数据库的检索词（涉及人工智能、神经影像、神经系统疾病和诊断分析），检索了八个信息来源。检索共获得 1,078 条记录；去除 236 条重复记录，筛选 842 条唯一记录，评估 258 篇全文，在记录层面的纳入资格复核后最终纳入 123 项研究。异质性证据采用叙述性综合和描述性图谱的方式进行整合，而非荟萃分析。MRI 在纳入研究及辅助图谱数据中出现频率较高；CT 常用于急性卒中和颅内出血；PET 支持部分分子层面及鉴别诊断研究；fMRI 和扩散成像用于网络和白质分析；脑电图（EEG）则将范围扩展至神经生理学诊断。CNN 和三维网络被普遍报道，而注意力机制、Transformer、图、自监督、生成式、多模态和基础模型方法则出现在部分近期研究中。卒中、痴呆和脑肿瘤的出现频率较高，但由于人群、结局的异质性以及验证信息提取不完整，无法对疾病、模态、架构或验证策略进行排序。证据提示，在部分场景中，研究正从特定任务的模式识别转向多模态且富含情境信息的决策支持，但并不能确立统一的方法学优越性或临床成熟度。可靠的转化需要患者层面的数据治理、透明的报告、不确定性估计、独立的多中心检验、前瞻性工作流程评估以及具有临床意义的终点。

title: MATS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Controllable and Reflective Tumor Synthesis
zh_title: MATS：可控且可反思的多智能体肿瘤合成框架
summary: 提出多智能体框架，通过文本控制的两阶段扩散跨器官合成肿瘤，并以闭环反思校验质量，缓解临床AI数据稀缺（预印本）。
key_points: 按形态属性分布规划，放大欠代表亚型
定位器官、放置肿瘤，两阶段扩散生成掩码与纹理
带闭环反思质量验证模块
reason: 新颖方法预印本，智能体+影像生成；摘要未见充分验证
abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.
zh_abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真的肿瘤有助于解决临床AI面临的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有基于扩散模型的方法缺乏细粒度的属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态学模式代表性不足的感知。我们提出了MATS，一种用于文本可控的跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS首先在涵盖肿瘤几何形态和外观的细粒度属性空间中刻画其形态学分布，并构建一个生成计划，在保持常见亚型占主导的同时，增加代表性不足亚型的比例。随后，它定位目标器官，提出符合解剖学的放置位置，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩膜并渲染纹理，每一阶段均以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在整个合成过程中的三个检查点验证属性对齐情况，并在发现不一致时提供有针对性的反馈以指导重新生成。MATS仅在单一来源的胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤数据集上训练，即可在域内以及LiTS、KiTS和MSD-Pancreas基准上持续提升下游分割性能，而大多数既往生成式数据增强方法的表现低于仅使用真实数据的训练。

title: Can Personal Requirements Become Supervision for Planning?
zh_title: 个人需求能否成为规划的监督信号？
summary: 针对多重慢病饮食规划，提出Noura，将LLM规划与由临床指南和个人档案生成的可执行个人规范结合；13个模型直接生成通过率低于3%（预印本）。
key_points: 基于NHANES、营养师认可的每周规划评测
直接生成完整方案通过率不足3%
可执行规范约束食物与份量以满足要求
reason: 有新意的智能体预印本，基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Managing multiple chronic conditions through diet requires satisfying disease- and medication-specific requirements jointly across meals and days while preserving established eating habits. These requirements are public in clinical guidelines and drug labels, yet turning them into a feasible plan for one person remains difficult for language-model agents. In our dietitian-approved weekly planning evaluation built from NHANES, thirteen models, from medically fine-tuned 8B models to GPT-6.1 Sol, pass fewer than 3% of complete plans through direct generation. Explicit rules, higher reasoning effort, or model-directed tools leave GPT-6.1 Sol at no more than 8%. We present Noura, which pairs LLM planning with executable personal specifications instantiated from public clinical guidance and individual health and dietary profiles. During planning, the specification grounds foods, optimizes portions, checks the complete multi-day plan, and guides revision. Our key insight is that a specification that rejects a plan can also determine what to learn from it. Noura turns executed plans and contextually credited revisions into supervision for compact models, recovering targets even from trajectories that never achieve complete success. The same specification supplies supervised targets, preferences, and rewards for post-training. On 4,993 held-out participants, Noura-SFT raises Qwen3-14B's complete-plan pass rate from 24.0% to 72.5% within the same execution loop, cuts rule violations by 97.5% with no observed critical failures, and improves dietary quality. The locally hosted 14B planner incurs fewer rule violations than its GPT-6 Luna teacher. A matched comparison shows that executed targets reduce rule violations by 41% over model-written proposals. Across four Qwen, Phi, and Llama backbones, self-training alone reduces rule violations by 41-61% on a 1,249-person population subset.
zh_abstract: 通过饮食管理多种慢性病，需要在各餐次和各日之间共同满足针对疾病和药物的特定要求，同时保留既有的饮食习惯。这些要求在临床指南和药品说明书中是公开的，但将其转化为适合个体的可行方案，对语言模型智能体而言仍然困难。在我们基于NHANES构建、经营养师认可的每周饮食计划评估中，13个模型（从经医学微调的8B模型到GPT-6.1 Sol）通过直接生成得到的完整计划，通过率均低于3%。使用明确规则、更高的推理强度或由模型指导的工具，GPT-6.1 Sol的通过率也不超过8%。我们提出了Noura，它将大语言模型（LLM）规划与可执行的个人规范相结合，这些规范由公开的临床指导意见以及个人健康和饮食档案实例化而来。在规划过程中，该规范用于确定食物、优化份量、检查完整的多日计划并指导修订。我们的关键见解是：能够否决某一计划的规范，同样可以确定应从该计划中学习什么。Noura将已执行的计划以及结合上下文给予认可的修订转化为对紧凑模型的监督信号，即使是从从未完全成功的轨迹中也能恢复目标。同一规范还为后训练提供监督目标、偏好和奖励。在4,993名留出参与者中，Noura-SFT在相同的执行循环内将Qwen3-14B的完整计划通过率从24.0%提高到72.5%，将规则违反减少97.5%，且未观察到严重失败，并改善了饮食质量。本地部署的14B规划器产生的规则违反少于其教师模型GPT-6 Luna。一项匹配比较显示，与模型撰写的方案相比，已执行的目标使规则违反减少41%。在四个Qwen、Phi和Llama骨干模型上，仅自我训练即可在1,249人的人群子集上将规则违反减少41-61%。

title: Segment Anything Pancreas: A Unified MRI Segmentation Model for Pancreatic Cancer Radiotherapy
zh_title: Segment Anything Pancreas：胰腺癌放疗的统一MRI分割模型
summary: 提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，在单个MRI体数据上统一分割胰腺及亚区、肿瘤和周围危及器官，并用标注感知损失处理部分标注数据。
key_points: 共享MedNeXt编码器-解码器，三个输出头
标注感知损失可训练部分标注数据
在PANTHER、Cyst-X、AMOS等数据评估
reason: 预印本，多数据集评估，对放疗有实用性，但样本量有限
abstract: Background: Limited tumor annotations and incomplete labels across MRI datasets hinder unified segmentation of pancreatic tumors and organs at risk (OARs) for MRI-guided radiotherapy. Purpose: We propose Pancreas-MedNeXt, a unified model that segments the whole pancreas, its subregions, tumors, and surrounding OARs from one MRI volume. Methods: The model uses a shared MedNeXt encoder-decoder with supervised whole-pancreas and subregion pretraining, followed by multitask fine-tuning. Three output heads predict the pancreatic subregions, tumor, and OARs (stomach, duodenum, kidneys). An annotation-aware loss allows training on partially labeled data without treating unannotated structures as background. Pancreas and tumor were evaluated by three-fold cross-validation on 142 PANTHER patients (92 diagnostic, 50 MR-Linac), subregions and OARs on Cyst-X and AMOS test sets, and pancreas and OARs on 33 external T1-weighted TotalSegmentator scans. Comparisons with nnU-Net, MedNeXt, VISTA3D, and Swin UNETR used the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with paired bootstrap 95% CIs. Results: Pancreas-MedNeXt achieved the highest mean pancreas and tumor DSC on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI. Tumor DSC was 58.41% and 42.55%, exceeding task-specific MedNeXt by 4.94 (95% CI: 0.28-9.45) and 5.89 (95% CI: 2.37-9.72) percentage points, respectively. Whole-pancreas DSC was 85.73% and 70.66%. Pretraining improved head, body, and tail DSC by 2.01, 3.00, and 3.78 percentage points over training from scratch. It also achieved the highest DSC for the pancreas, duodenum, and right kidney on AMOS, and for all five organs on external MRI, exceeding the next-best method by 4.92-8.85 percentage points.Conclusion: A single Pancreas-MedNeXt model segments tumors, pancreatic subregions, and OARs on diagnostic and MR-Linac MRI, which could streamline contouring for pancreatic cancer radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: 【背景】MRI数据集中肿瘤标注有限且标签不完整，阻碍了用于MRI引导放疗的胰腺肿瘤和危及器官（OAR）的统一分割。【目的】我们提出Pancreas-MedNeXt，一种可从单个MRI容积中分割整个胰腺及其亚区、肿瘤和周围OAR的统一模型。【方法】该模型采用共享的MedNeXt编码器-解码器，先进行有监督的全胰腺及亚区预训练，再进行多任务微调。三个输出头分别预测胰腺亚区、肿瘤和OAR（胃、十二指肠、肾脏）。一种标注感知损失函数使模型可在部分标注数据上训练，而不会将未标注结构视为背景。胰腺和肿瘤通过对142例PANTHER患者（92例诊断性MRI，50例MR-Linac）进行三折交叉验证来评估，亚区和OAR在Cyst-X和AMOS测试集上评估，胰腺和OAR在33例外部T1加权TotalSegmentator扫描上评估。与nnU-Net、MedNeXt、VISTA3D和Swin UNETR的比较采用Dice相似系数（DSC）及配对bootstrap 95% CI。【结果】Pancreas-MedNeXt在诊断性MRI和MR-Linac MRI上获得了最高的平均胰腺和肿瘤DSC。肿瘤DSC分别为58.41%和42.55%，分别比任务专用MedNeXt高4.94个百分点（95% CI：0.28-9.45）和5.89个百分点（95% CI：2.37-9.72）。全胰腺DSC分别为85.73%和70.66%。预训练使胰头、胰体和胰尾的DSC较从头训练分别提高了2.01、3.00和3.78个百分点。在AMOS上，该模型在胰腺、十二指肠和右肾方面也取得了最高DSC；在外部MRI上，五个器官的DSC均为最高，比次优方法高4.92-8.85个百分点。【结论】单一的Pancreas-MedNeXt模型即可在诊断性MRI和MR-Linac MRI上分割肿瘤、胰腺亚区和OAR，有望简化胰腺癌放疗的勾画工作。

title: Single-Annotation, Multi-Hypothesis Segmentation with Semantic-Spatial Residual Banks
zh_title: 单标注多假设分割：语义-空间残差库
summary: 预印本：针对每图仅有一个标注的训练集，提出SSRB，在五个医学终点上提升对留出标注的覆盖度，优于Probabilistic U-Net。
key_points: 训练仅用单一掩码，测试需覆盖多位标注者
冻结语义库并学习图像残差
五个医学终点上K=8覆盖度提升
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Multi-rater segmentation datasets show that a single image can admit several valid masks, yet most training sets expose only one annotation per image. We study single-annotation multi-hypothesis segmentation: each training image exposes one fixed mask, while the model must return a finite bank that covers held-out human annotations at test time. Our experiments reveal a representation tradeoff. Banks learned directly from images recover variations in local boundaries and extent but lose structural hypotheses, whereas frozen semantic features preserve structural grouping but underrepresent spatial variation. We introduce the Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank (SSRB), which freezes a semantic bank trained with balanced assignments and learns a residual from the image for each hypothesis. Across five medical endpoints, SSRB improves coverage of held-out masks at $K=8$ over a Probabilistic U-Net under the same one-mask constraint. On LIDC and LIDC-hard, it also produces substantially more distinct useful masks. On BSDS, it preserves the semantic bank's performance in grouping regions. Its advantage grows as more masks are returned, showing that residuals learned for corresponding heads improve coverage of local annotation variation while preserving how regions are grouped.
zh_abstract: 多评审者分割数据集表明，单张图像可以对应多个有效的分割掩码，但大多数训练集中每张图像只提供一个标注。我们研究单标注多假设分割：每张训练图像仅提供一个固定掩码，而模型在测试时必须返回一个有限的掩码集合（bank），以覆盖留出的人工标注。我们的实验揭示了一种表征上的权衡。直接从图像学习得到的掩码集合能够恢复局部边界和范围上的变化，但会丢失结构性假设；而冻结的语义特征保留了结构性分组，但对空间变化的表达不足。我们提出语义-空间残差库（Semantic-Spatial Residual Bank，SSRB），它冻结一个以均衡分配方式训练的语义库，并针对每个假设从图像中学习一个残差。在五个医学终点任务上，在相同的单掩码约束下，SSRB 在 $K=8$ 时对留出掩码的覆盖率优于概率 U-Net（Probabilistic U-Net）。在 LIDC 和 LIDC-hard 上，它还能产生明显更多彼此不同且有用的掩码。在 BSDS 上，它保持了语义库在区域分组方面的性能。随着返回掩码数量的增加，其优势不断扩大，这表明针对相应头（head）学习的残差在保留区域分组方式的同时，提高了对局部标注变化的覆盖。

title: LAPIS: Clinically Constrained Patient-Identity Residual Learning for Chest X-Ray Anonymization
zh_title: LAPIS：胸片匿名化的临床约束患者身份残差学习
summary: 提出在潜空间中将身份信息集中于可替换残差通道的胸片匿名化方法，在ChestX-ray14上以适配攻击者评估（预印本）。
key_points: 半正交基定义身份残差，对抗抑制泄漏
替换感知训练，用供体残差混合替换
在患者不重叠划分上评估再识别攻击
reason: 隐私新方法预印本，有攻击者评估，单数据集
abstract: Biometric information in chest radiographs limits their release for research, as patients can be re-identified. We propose LAPIS, which jointly adapts a spatial chest-radiograph latent space so that patient-discriminative information concentrates in a compact, replaceable channel residual while most clinically relevant content stays in the complement. The residual is defined by an exactly semi-orthogonal basis, a spatial adversary suppresses identity leakage from the complement, and replacement-aware training teaches the decoder cross-patient residual swaps under output identity, clinical and realism constraints, so that replacing the residual yields a valid image. At release, the residual is replaced by a mixture of donor residuals. On patient-disjoint model, release and test sets from ChestX-ray14, we evaluate attackers adapted to the anonymized setting, a structural source-retrieval attack, and pathology classifiers trained on released images and tested on real ones. LAPIS reduces worst-case cross-study linkability from 0.961 to 0.791 AUC at a macro AUROC cost of 0.012 relative to reconstruction; a deformation-based baseline, however, remains better at structural source retrieval.
zh_abstract: 胸部X线片中的生物特征信息会导致患者可被重新识别，从而限制了其用于研究的公开发布。我们提出LAPIS，该方法联合调整胸部X线片的空间潜在空间，使具有患者区分性的信息集中于一个紧凑、可替换的通道残差中，而大部分临床相关内容保留在其补空间中。该残差由一个精确半正交基定义，空间对抗器抑制补空间中的身份信息泄露，并通过感知替换的训练使解码器在输出身份、临床及真实感约束下学习跨患者残差互换，从而使替换残差后得到有效图像。发布时，残差被替换为多个供体残差的混合。在ChestX-ray14中患者互不重叠的模型集、发布集和测试集上，我们评估了适应匿名化场景的攻击者、结构性来源检索攻击，以及在发布图像上训练、在真实图像上测试的病理分类器。相对于重建方法，LAPIS将最坏情况下的跨研究可关联性AUC从0.961降至0.791，宏平均AUROC代价为0.012；然而，基于形变的基线方法在结构性来源检索方面仍表现更好。

title: CS-LDM: Clinically Guided Structure-Aware Latent Diffusion for Knee Radiographic Forecasting
zh_title: CS-LDM：临床引导的结构感知潜在扩散膝关节X线预测
summary: 提出CS-LDM，根据当前X线片和KL分级生成患者未来膝关节X线，用LoRA、分级条件和冻结教师诊断蒸馏保证形态可靠。
key_points: 针对膝骨关节炎进展的影像预测
采用LoRA适配与当前分级条件
以诊断蒸馏约束生成结构的可靠性
reason: 预印本，生成式预后预测有新意，摘要无具体结果与外部验证
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a leading cause of physical disability and currently has no curative clinical treatment. Early diagnosis and accurate prognosis are therefore vital for managing its progression. Existing methods mainly predict future severity grades and provide limited visual explanation of structural change. Recent generation-guided approaches synthesize follow-up radiographs for progression assessment, but generated images are often judged by predictive accuracy or image realism, so they may satisfy a grading model while remaining morphologically unreliable. We therefore propose CS-LDM, a clinically guided, structure-aware latent diffusion framework that forecasts patient-specific future knee radiographs from the current X-ray and clinically available current KL grade, using LoRA adaptation, current-grade conditioning, and frozen-teacher diagnostic distillation. Experiments on the public Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) dataset show that CS-LDM improves future severity-grade consistency while maintaining competitive image fidelity. Further ordinal, OARSI, ROI-level, and stable/progressed analyses show that radiographic forecasting should be evaluated by balancing diagnostic consistency, anatomical plausibility, and structural preservation.

title: DiffUltra: Task-Guided Pathology Synthesis for Large-Scale Real-World Lung Ultrasound Data
zh_title: DiffUltra：面向真实肺超声数据的任务引导病理合成
summary: 提出任务引导的潜在扩散流程，基于结构掩码生成肺超声病变图像，并用仅在真实数据上训练的过滤器筛选合成图像（预印本）。
key_points: 按无回声/低回声/高回声子区域的结构掩码条件生成
两种放置策略：插入无病变背景或替换已有病变
用真实数据训练的过滤器筛选下游可用图像
reason: 新颖的超声合成方法，但摘要证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Despite their scale, large medical imaging datasets may underrepresent clinically relevant pathological presentations. Synthetic data can expand coverage, but findings must remain compatible with surrounding anatomy. This is challenging in ultrasound, where findings resemble surrounding tissue and must be positioned relative to anatomical landmarks. We propose DiffUltra, a task-guided latent diffusion pipeline that models pathological structure and spatial context, and screens synthetic images for downstream utility. DiffUltra conditions generation on structural masks decomposing findings into anechoic, hypoechoic, and hyperechoic subregions. Two placement strategies insert findings into pathology-absent backgrounds or replace existing findings with structurally matched pathology from other patients. A filter trained exclusively on real data retains images whose predictions agree spatially with target boxes. We evaluate DiffUltra for lung ultrasound detection of pleural effusion and consolidation, using over 700,000 expert-annotated frames from 598 patients at 12 sites. Averaged across three real-data scales, synthetic insertion significantly improved video-level AUROC for both pleural effusion (p = 0.017) and consolidation (p < 0.01). For pleural effusion, frame-level average precision improved by 4.5 percentage points on average and by 6.1 points using only 10% of real data (p < 0.01 for both). Synthetic insertion also yielded larger average precision gains than an existing diffusion-based lesion-insertion method at every scale. At full scale, targeted synthesis improved AUROC for both pathologies by 1.1-3.9 points in an underrepresented anatomical zone and on a held-out acquisition system. These results suggest that anatomically constrained, task-guided synthesis can help address coverage gaps in ultrasound training data.

title: Report-Derived Labels, an Image Teacher and the Gap to Expert Labels in Knee MRI: An Analysis of One Entry to the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection Challenge
zh_title: 膝关节MRI：报告标签、图像教师与专家标签的差距
summary: 在RSNA 2026膝关节异常检测挑战中，比较LLM读报告生成的标签与图像模型预测对专家标签的一致性，二者宏AUC相近但失败的发现不同（预印本）。
key_points: 仅58/4407例有专家标签
报告标签与图像模型宏AUC为0.892与0.896
两者在不同病变上各有优劣
reason: 弱监督标签分析有参考价值，但为单一挑战条目、数据小
abstract: In the RSNA 2026 Knee Abnormality Detection challenge, 58 of 4,407 training studies have expert labels for 12 findings, and the rest have only a radiology report. We compare training targets built from a language-model reading of the reports and from a public image model against two references: the expert labels and the 39,248 study-finding cells that the reports state as present or absent. The report labels and the out-of-fold predictions of the image model reach similar agreement with the expert labels (macro AUC 0.892 and 0.896) but fail on different findings. The report is better for ligament tears and patellofemoral osteoarthritis, which it never calls present when the experts do not; the image model is better for effusion, Baker's cyst, contusion, and synovitis, where the reports call the finding absent, leave it out, or call it present more often than the experts. Their equal mixture reaches 0.927 (gain over the report labels 0.035, 95% interval 0.019 to 0.052), also after removing the studies whose knee side was handled inconsistently. We did not observe a model-level gain from this better target: a 2.5D ResNet50 trained on the report labels alone scored 0.877 on the private leaderboard, after the deadline, against 0.872 for the same model trained on the mixture, and the out-of-fold advantage of the mixture is confounded by a change of code and by possible leakage through the image model's folds. A scanner prevalence prior raised agreement with the reports but not with the experts, so a report-derived reference can reward reporting habits. A rank correction for co-occurring findings gave small out-of-fold gains and no visible leaderboard effect. Our entry, a forked public ensemble with that correction, was displayed at rank 582 of 6,299 on the private leaderboard (0.943, a score shared by 287 teams). All results are exploratory; none of the models is meant for clinical use.

title: TheseusSyn: Unified Medical Image Synthesis via Context-Conditioned Masked Autoregression
zh_title: TheseusSyn：基于上下文条件掩码自回归的统一医学图像合成
summary: 预印本：提出多码本离散分词器加掩码自回归模型，以全局上下文为条件，通过迭代内容替换合成医学图像。
key_points: 多码本离散分词器将图像转为token序列
以全局表示token作为上下文约束
通过逐步替换内容生成完整图像
reason: 有新意的生成方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比与外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: High-fidelity medical image synthesis is promising for data-efficient learning and privacy-preserving model development. However, most existing approaches rely on symbolic or label-based conditioning, which constrains generative diversity and limits case-specific contextual fidelity. Inspired by the Ship of Theseus paradox, we propose TheseusSyn, a novel context-conditioned synthesis paradigm that generates images through iterative content replacement. Our framework employs a multi-codebook discrete tokenizer to convert medical images into sequences of token indices, extracted with a global representation token that serves as a contextual constraint. A masked autoregressive generative model then iteratively masks and predicts tokens conditioned on both local neighborhoods and the global context. By progressively replacing image content until the entire token sequence is renewed, TheseusSyn produces synthetic samples that preserve anatomical coherence and semantic consistency while introducing controlled diversity. We evaluate the proposed framework on multiple datasets from MedMNIST by constructing synthetic datasets with varying masking strategies and training ResNet-18 classifiers exclusively on either real or synthetic data. Experimental results demonstrate that classifiers trained on TheseusSyn-generated images achieve competitive performance on official test sets, indicating that the synthesized data preserve diagnostically relevant features and semantic consistency. Systematic analysis of masking strategies reveals their impact on structural fidelity and downstream classification accuracy. These results suggest that context-conditioned masked autoregression provides an effective and generalizable solution for label-free medical image synthesis, offering a scalable alternative to conventional data augmentation and class-conditioned generative models in medical imaging applications.
zh_abstract: 高保真医学图像合成对于数据高效学习和保护隐私的模型开发具有前景。然而，现有大多数方法依赖符号或基于标签的条件，这限制了生成多样性，并削弱了针对具体病例的上下文保真度。受忒修斯之船悖论的启发，我们提出 TheseusSyn，这是一种新颖的上下文条件合成范式，通过迭代的内容替换生成图像。我们的框架采用多码本离散分词器将医学图像转换为词元索引序列，并提取一个全局表示词元作为上下文约束。随后，掩码自回归生成模型在局部邻域和全局上下文的共同条件下，迭代地掩蔽并预测词元。通过逐步替换图像内容直至整个词元序列被更新，TheseusSyn 生成的合成样本在引入可控多样性的同时，保持了解剖结构的连贯性和语义一致性。我们在 MedMNIST 的多个数据集上评估了所提框架：采用不同的掩码策略构建合成数据集，并仅使用真实数据或合成数据训练 ResNet-18 分类器。实验结果表明，在 TheseusSyn 生成图像上训练的分类器在官方测试集上取得了具有竞争力的性能，说明合成数据保留了具有诊断意义的特征和语义一致性。对掩码策略的系统分析揭示了其对结构保真度和下游分类准确率的影响。这些结果表明，上下文条件掩码自回归为无标签医学图像合成提供了一种有效且可推广的解决方案，为医学影像应用中的传统数据增强和类别条件生成模型提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Three-Dimensional Preoperative Planning for Total Knee Arthroplasty in End-Stage Knee Osteoarthritis​.
source: PubMed · Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE
zh_title: AI三维术前规划用于终末期膝骨关节炎全膝置换
summary: 单中心回顾性初步研究，评估AIKNEE系统预测假体尺寸和部件位置的可靠性，纳入24例患者28膝。
key_points: 主要结局为计划与实际假体尺寸一致性
次要结局含HKA角与HSS评分
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] Accurate preoperative templating for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in patients with end-stage knee osteoarthritis (KOA) remains challenging, and the accuracy of conventional planning methods is variable. This preliminary, retrospective, single-center study evaluated the reliability of a robot-independent, artificial intelligence (AI)-based, three-dimensional (3D) preoperative planning system (AIKNEE) for predicting prosthesis size and component position in patients undergoing TKA for end-stage KOA. Twenty-eight knees from 24 patients with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4 KOA were included. The primary outcome was the agreement between the planned and implanted prosthesis sizes. Secondary outcomes included correction of the coronal hip-knee-ankle (HKA) angle, improvement in Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) knee scores, and early postoperative complications. The planned size matched the implanted size exactly in 53.57% of femoral components (15/28; 95% confidence interval [CI], 35.8%-70.5%) and 46.43% of tibial components (13/28; 95% CI, 29.5%-64.2%). Agreement within ±1 size was 85.71% for femoral components (24/28; 95% CI, 68.5%-94.3%) and 96.43% for tibial components (27/28; 95% CI, 82.3%-99.4%), giving an overall matching rate of 91.07% (51/56; 95% CI, 80.7%-96.1%). The postoperative HKA angle improved from 173.0° ± 3.9° to 178.2° ± 1.2° (P < 0.001), and the HSS score increased from 39.7 ± 2.2 preoperatively to 80.8 ± 1.3 at the 1-month follow-up (P < 0.001). No major early complications, including infection, dislocation, or deep venous thrombosis, were observed. Within this preliminary cohort, the AIKNEE system predicted prosthesis size with a reliability comparable to that reported for existing AI templating tools. Because the study was retrospective, single-arm, unblinded, and limited to 1 month of follow-up, these data characterize planning accuracy only and do not demonstrate clinical effectiveness; adequately powered, controlled studies with long-term follow-up are required.
zh_abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments:JoVE] 对终末期膝骨关节炎(KOA)患者进行全膝关节置换术(TKA)的术前精确模板测量仍具挑战,传统规划方法的准确性不一。这项初步的回顾性单中心研究评估了一种不依赖机器人的、基于人工智能(AI)的三维(3D)术前规划系统(AIKNEE)在预测终末期KOA患者TKA假体尺寸和部件位置方面的可靠性。纳入24例患者的28个膝关节,Kellgren-Lawrence分级为3-4级。主要结局为规划假体尺寸与实际植入假体尺寸的一致性。次要结局包括冠状面髋-膝-踝(HKA)角的矫正、特种外科医院(HSS)膝关节评分的改善以及术后早期并发症。规划尺寸与实际植入尺寸完全一致的比例,股骨部件为53.57%(15/28;95%置信区间[CI],35.8%-70.5%),胫骨部件为46.43%(13/28;95% CI,29.5%-64.2%)。在±1个尺寸范围内一致的比例,股骨部件为85.71%(24/28;95% CI,68.5%-94.3%),胫骨部件为96.43%(27/28;95% CI,82.3%-99.4%),总体匹配率为91.07%(51/56;95% CI,80.7%-96.1%)。术后HKA角由173.0° ± 3.9°改善至178.2° ± 1.2°(P < 0.001),HSS评分由术前39.7 ± 2.2升至术后1个月随访时的80.8 ± 1.3(P < 0.001)。未观察到包括感染、脱位或深静脉血栓形成在内的严重早期并发症。在这一初步队列中,AIKNEE系统预测假体尺寸的可靠性与已报道的现有AI模板测量工具相当。由于本研究为回顾性、单臂、非盲法,且随访仅限于1个月,这些数据仅反映规划准确性,并不能证明临床有效性;需要有充分检验效能、含对照且长期随访的研究。

title: Advancing Perioperative Medicine With AI: Current Landscape and Research Priorities.
zh_title: 围手术期医学中的AI：现状与研究重点
summary: JMIR Perioperative Medicine 网络研讨会配套社论，从临床视角讨论AI在术前、术中、术后的应用机会、现有证据与待补缺口。
key_points: 涵盖术前风险评估与优化
涉及术中智能决策支持与手术数字孪生
讨论术后恢复、监测与恶化预测
reason: 社论观点类，无原始数据，属增量档并受观点上限约束
abstract: [JMIR perioperative medicine] AI is increasingly being applied across the perioperative continuum. AI should be viewed as a technology that can reduce cognitive burden, collate fragmented data into clinically meaningful information, support decision-making, and extend precision education to clinicians and patients. This editorial accompanies the JMIR Perioperative Medicine webinar held in May 2026 and presents our perspectives-informed by our clinical experience-on where AI can assist perioperative clinicians and surgical patients, the evidence available today, what is still needed, and how clinicians can prepare to practice alongside AI tools. We consider opportunities in preoperative risk assessment and optimization; intraoperative intelligent decision support; emerging technologies, such as surgical digital twins; and postoperative recovery, monitoring, and prediction of clinical deterioration. Most AI applications remain early and require large-scale, prospective validation across diverse populations and resource settings. Realizing their potential also requires confronting substantial challenges, including limited and fragmented training data, the specialized models needed to interpret the large volumes of data captured in operative videos and during physiological monitoring, biases embedded in data and algorithms or biases inherent in human-AI interactions, and the determination of where human oversight is essential and where it is not feasible. When used responsibly, with human judgment remaining paramount, AI offers an unprecedented opportunity to advance perioperative care.
zh_abstract: [JMIR围手术期医学] 人工智能（AI）在围手术期全程的应用日益广泛。AI应被视为这样一种技术：它可以减轻认知负担，将零散的数据整合为具有临床意义的信息，支持决策，并将精准教育扩展至临床医生和患者。本社论配合2026年5月举办的JMIR Perioperative Medicine网络研讨会，基于我们的临床经验，阐述了我们的观点：AI可在哪些方面协助围手术期临床医生和手术患者、目前已有哪些证据、仍需要哪些证据，以及临床医生如何做好准备以与AI工具协同工作。我们探讨了以下方面的机遇：术前风险评估与优化；术中智能决策支持；手术数字孪生等新兴技术；以及术后康复、监测和临床恶化预测。大多数AI应用仍处于早期阶段，需要在不同人群和不同资源条件下开展大规模前瞻性验证。要实现其潜力，还必须应对诸多重大挑战，包括训练数据有限且分散、解读手术视频和生理监测所获海量数据所需的专用模型、数据和算法中固有的偏倚或人机交互中固有的偏倚，以及确定何处必须有人工监督、何处无法实现人工监督。若能负责任地使用，并始终以人的判断为首要，AI为推进围手术期医疗提供了前所未有的机遇。

title: Multimodal Biosensing for Liquid Biopsy: A Critical Analysis of Signal Complementarity, Data Fusion, Artificial Intelligence, and Clinical Translation.
source: PubMed · Critical reviews in analytical chemistry
zh_title: 液体活检多模态生物传感：信号互补、数据融合与AI转化
summary: 综述评估液体活检多模态生物传感在信号、信息和计算决策层面的融合，并讨论分析验证与临床转化。
key_points: 关注额外模态是否提供非冗余信息
涵盖材料、信号工程与计算方法
讨论基质效应、重复性与外部验证
reason: 综述类，AI相关性较弱，受综述上限约束，属增量档
abstract: [Critical reviews in analytical chemistry] Liquid biopsy provides minimally invasive access to diverse tumor-derived biomarkers, but their low abundance, biological variability, and complex matrices limit the reliability of single-mode biosensing. Multimodal biosensors address these challenges by combining complementary sensing mechanisms; however, multiple signals do not necessarily constitute meaningful data fusion or clinical benefit. This review critically evaluates multimodal liquid-biopsy biosensing at the signal, information, and computational/decision levels, focusing on whether additional modalities provide non-redundant analytical information. Molecular recognition, functional materials, signal engineering, integrated architectures, and computational methods are assessed alongside analytical validation, matrix effects, reproducibility, clinical-sample evidence, external validation, and AI maturity. A complementary framework distinguishes analytical, clinical, computational, and deployment readiness. Overall, most platforms remain at proof-of-concept or early validation stages, with limited evidence of externally validated data fusion or clinical utility. The review identifies the conditions required for multimodality to deliver genuine analytical value and outlines the methodological, computational, and clinical requirements for advancing toward reliable liquid-biopsy decision systems.
zh_abstract: [分析化学评论] 液体活检可通过微创方式获取多种肿瘤来源的生物标志物，但这些标志物丰度低、生物学变异大且基质复杂，限制了单一模式生物传感的可靠性。多模态生物传感器通过结合互补的传感机制来应对这些挑战；然而，多重信号并不必然意味着有意义的数据融合或临床获益。本综述在信号、信息以及计算/决策三个层面上，对多模态液体活检生物传感进行了批判性评估，重点关注额外的模态是否提供了非冗余的分析信息。本文评估了分子识别、功能材料、信号工程、集成架构和计算方法，同时评估了分析验证、基质效应、可重复性、临床样本证据、外部验证以及人工智能（AI）成熟度。一个互补性框架区分了分析、临床、计算和部署层面的就绪程度。总体而言，大多数平台仍处于概念验证或早期验证阶段，经外部验证的数据融合或临床效用的证据有限。本综述明确了多模态真正带来分析价值所需的条件，并概述了推进可靠的液体活检决策系统所需满足的方法学、计算和临床要求。

title: From Theory to Evaluation: Deriving the Transcultural Nurse-AI Synergy Model for Systematic Assessment of AI Outputs.
source: PubMed · Journal of transcultural nursing : official journal of the Transcultural Nursing Society
zh_title: 跨文化护理-AI协同模型：AI输出的系统评估
summary: 采用理论衍生法构建跨文化护理-AI协同模型及AI输出评估量表，用于评估AI生成内容的文化相关性与伦理。
key_points: 基于翻译效度指数衍生模型
概念化为评估、情境化、优化的迭代过程
配套AI输出评估量表
reason: 理论框架类，无实证验证，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of transcultural nursing : official journal of the Transcultural Nursing Society] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into nursing education, research, and practice, raising concerns about cultural relevance, ethical integrity, and preservation of human-centered care. To address these challenges, the Transcultural Nurse-Artificial Intelligence (TCN-AI) Synergy Model was developed. Using Walker and Avant's theory derivation method, the model was derived from the Translation Validity Index. Core concepts were identified, redefined, and extended to explain the interaction between AI-generated outputs and transcultural nursing expertise. The model conceptualizes this interaction as an iterative process of appraisal, contextualization, and refinement. Also, the accompanying AI Output Evaluation Rubric was developed to systematically assess AI-generated content for cultural relevance, conceptual validity, ethical integrity, and clinical relevance across nursing education, research, and practice. The TCN-AI Synergy Model advances transcultural nursing theory, education, research, and practice by providing a practical framework for critically evaluating AI-generated outputs. The accompanying rubric potentially enables efficient, systematic assessment while supporting informed decision-making in academic, research, and clinical settings.
zh_abstract: [Journal of transcultural nursing : official journal of the Transcultural Nursing Society] 人工智能（AI）日益融入护理教育、研究和实践，引发了对文化相关性、伦理完整性以及以人为本的照护能否得以保留的担忧。为应对这些挑战，研究者构建了跨文化护士-人工智能协同（TCN-AI Synergy）模型。该模型采用 Walker 和 Avant 的理论推导法，由翻译效度指数（Translation Validity Index）推导而来。研究识别、重新界定并拓展了核心概念，以解释 AI 生成内容与跨文化护理专业知识之间的相互作用。该模型将这种相互作用概念化为一个包含评估、情境化和完善的迭代过程。此外，研究还开发了配套的 AI 输出评估量表（AI Output Evaluation Rubric），用于系统评估 AI 生成内容在护理教育、研究和实践中的文化相关性、概念效度、伦理完整性和临床相关性。TCN-AI 协同模型通过提供一个对 AI 生成内容进行批判性评估的实用框架，推进了跨文化护理的理论、教育、研究和实践。配套量表有望实现高效、系统的评估，并为学术、研究和临床环境中的知情决策提供支持。

title: Artificial intelligence-assisted spectral microbiology for rapid microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction: advances, challenges, and future perspectives.
source: PubMed · Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease
zh_title: AI辅助光谱微生物学：快速菌种鉴定与耐药预测综述
summary: 综述AI与MALDI-TOF质谱、拉曼、红外、高光谱成像及菌落成像结合，用于微生物鉴定与耐药预测的进展与挑战。
key_points: 涵盖多种光谱与成像技术
关注光谱预处理、特征工程与机器学习
面向精准诊断与抗菌药物管理
reason: 领域综述，信息有限，属增量档且受综述上限约束
abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Rapid microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction are fundamental to precision diagnostics, effective infection control, and antimicrobial stewardship. Artificial intelligence-assisted spectral microbiology is increasingly being investigated to convert complex spectral and imaging data into rapid microbiological identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction outputs. This review critically examines the integration of AI with matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry, Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, ultraviolet-visible-near-infrared spectroscopy, hyperspectral imaging, and automated colony imaging for microbial identification, strain discrimination, and AMR prediction. This work focuses on spectral preprocessing, feature engineering, machine-learning architectures, interpretability, validation, and clinical translation. Emerging evidence shows substantial potential to accelerate diagnostics while improving analytical precision and scalability. Nevertheless, dataset heterogeneity, instrument-dependent variability, limited external validation, and insufficient model transparency continue to constrain real-world adoption. Future integration of multimodal spectral, genomic, and clinical data could deliver robust, explainable, and interoperable diagnostic systems. It may support precision microbiology and antimicrobial-resistance surveillance, provided standardized acquisition, external validation, quality control, and uncertainty-aware interpretation are in place.
zh_abstract: [诊断微生物学与传染病] 快速微生物鉴定和抗菌药物耐药性预测是精准诊断、有效感染控制和抗菌药物管理的基础。人工智能辅助的光谱微生物学正日益受到研究，旨在将复杂的光谱和成像数据转化为快速的微生物鉴定和抗菌药物耐药性预测结果。本综述批判性地审视了AI与基质辅助激光解吸电离飞行时间质谱、拉曼光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、紫外-可见-近红外光谱、高光谱成像及自动化菌落成像相结合，用于微生物鉴定、菌株区分和耐药性（AMR）预测的情况。本文重点关注光谱预处理、特征工程、机器学习架构、可解释性、验证以及临床转化。新近证据显示，其在加速诊断的同时提高分析精度和可扩展性方面具有巨大潜力。然而，数据集异质性、仪器依赖性变异、外部验证有限以及模型透明度不足，仍制约其在真实世界中的应用。未来整合多模态光谱、基因组和临床数据，有望构建稳健、可解释且可互操作的诊断系统。只要具备标准化采集、外部验证、质量控制和考虑不确定性的解读，它就可能支持精准微生物学和抗菌药物耐药性监测。

title: Support Vector Machine (SVM)-Based Review of RNA-RNA Interaction Prediction Methods.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: 基于SVM的RNA-RNA相互作用预测方法综述
summary: 书章综述SVM在RNA-RNA相互作用预测中的方法与工具，并讨论其在癌症研究中的相关性。
key_points: 回顾代表性SVM工具与策略
讨论当前挑战
关联癌症标志物与靶点发现
reason: 传统方法的泛泛综述，增量档
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA interactions (RRIs) play a vital role in cellular processes including gene regulation, RNA editing, and translational control. Aberrant RRIs are increasingly recognized as contributors to cancer initiation, progression, and metastasis. Accurate computational prediction of RRIs therefore offers significant opportunities for cancer biomarker discovery, understanding tumor biology, and therapeutic target identification. Among machine learning approaches, support vector machines (SVMs) have been applied in RRI prediction due to their robustness in handling high-dimensional, nonlinear data and relatively small training datasets. This chapter reviews SVM-based methods for RRI prediction, highlights representative tools and strategies, and discusses current challenges and relevance to cancer application. Emerging trends that integrate SVMs with deep learning and experimental data augmentation are also outlined, pointing toward pathways for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA相互作用(RRI)在包括基因调控、RNA编辑和翻译调控在内的细胞过程中发挥重要作用。异常的RRI日益被认为与癌症的发生、进展和转移有关。因此,对RRI进行准确的计算预测,为癌症生物标志物发现、理解肿瘤生物学和识别治疗靶点提供了重要机遇。在机器学习方法中,支持向量机(SVM)因其在处理高维、非线性数据以及相对较小训练数据集方面的稳健性,已被应用于RRI预测。本章回顾了基于SVM的RRI预测方法,重点介绍了代表性工具和策略,并讨论了当前的挑战及其与癌症应用的相关性。本章还概述了将SVM与深度学习和实验数据增强相结合的新兴趋势,指出了通往临床转化的途径。

title: Interpreting graph neural networks reveals microbial association patterns in inflammatory bowel diseases
zh_title: 图神经网络解读揭示炎症性肠病微生物关联模式
summary: 预印本基于HMP2的106人纵向宏基因组构建个体微生物关联网络训练GNN，GNN表现低于随机森林，但解读揭示拟杆菌目共丰度模块。
key_points: 106人纵向数据，GNN与RF对比
RF的AUPRC约0.59，GNN为0.446
GNN依赖共丰度拟杆菌目模块
reason: 预印本，样本小，性能低于基线，无外部验证
abstract: Traditional machine learning models trained on gut microbiome abundance profiles can distinguish individuals with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) from non-IBD individuals. However, their interpretation typically considers taxa in isolation, making it difficult to understand how associations between taxa contribute to predictions. Here, we inferred individual-specific microbial association networks from longitudinal metagenomics data of 106 individuals in HMP2/iHMP and used them to train and interpret graph neural network (GNN) models, which we compared with abundance-based models such as Random Forest (RF). Although RF achieved higher predictive performance (AUPRC ~0.59 vs 0.446), interpreting the GNNs revealed that their predictions relied on a densely connected module of co-abundant Bacteroidales species. Unlike the taxa prioritized by RF, these species were not differentially abundant between conditions. In an independent cohort, this module carried most of the predictive signal, and removing its associations reduced performance to near chance. These results show that coordinated association structure, rather than abundance shifts alone, is a feature of the IBD gut microbiome, and that interpreting GNNs can uncover such patterns that complement abundance-based analyses.
zh_abstract: 基于肠道微生物组丰度谱训练的传统机器学习模型可以区分炎症性肠病（IBD）患者与非 IBD 个体。然而，其解释通常孤立地考虑各个分类单元，难以理解分类单元之间的关联如何对预测产生贡献。在此，我们从 HMP2/iHMP 中 106 名个体的纵向宏基因组学数据推断出个体特异性的微生物关联网络，并用其训练和解释图神经网络（GNN）模型，同时将其与随机森林（RF）等基于丰度的模型进行比较。尽管 RF 取得了更高的预测性能（AUPRC 约 0.59 对 0.446），但对 GNN 的解释显示，其预测依赖于一个由共丰度的拟杆菌目（Bacteroidales）物种构成的紧密连接模块。与 RF 所优先选择的分类单元不同，这些物种在不同状态之间并无丰度差异。在一个独立队列中，该模块承载了大部分预测信号，去除其关联后性能降至接近随机水平。这些结果表明，协同的关联结构而不仅仅是丰度变化，是 IBD 肠道微生物组的一个特征，而对 GNN 的解释能够揭示此类模式，从而补充基于丰度的分析。

title: Artificial Cells and Biomimetic Cells: Intelligent Systems Driving a Paradigm Shift in Drug Discovery and Delivery.
zh_title: 人工细胞与仿生细胞：药物发现与递送的范式转变
summary: 综述评估人工细胞与仿生细胞平台，涵盖膜工程、无膜细胞器、多区室、原细胞通讯及虚拟细胞，并提及AI辅助筛选与毒性预测。

abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] The convergence of synthetic biology, materials science, and artificial intelligence drives a transformative shift in biopharmaceutical research, advancing from passive drug carriers to intelligent, programmable therapeutics. This review evaluates artificial and biomimetic cells as a framework that connects fundamental biological discovery with clinical translation. It examines five key technological pathways: membrane-engineered artificial cells, membraneless organelle (MLO) systems, multicompartmental artificial cells, protocell communication networks, and virtual cells. These platforms enable precise regulation of drug stability, targeting, biosynthesis, and adaptive responsiveness. Recent progress includes microenvironment-triggered release, logic-gated intercellular communication, and virtual cell-assisted high-throughput screening and toxicity prediction. Despite these advances, challenges remain in scalable manufacturing, long-term stability, and regulatory adaptation. The integration of closed-loop learning, interpretable models, and advanced biomanufacturing will be essential to position artificial and biomimetic cell systems at the forefront of next-generation precision medicine.
zh_abstract: [Advanced healthcare materials] 合成生物学、材料科学与人工智能的融合推动了生物制药研究的变革性转变，使其由被动的药物载体发展为智能、可编程的治疗手段。本综述将人工细胞和仿生细胞作为连接基础生物学发现与临床转化的框架进行评述。文中探讨了五条关键技术路径：膜工程化人工细胞、无膜细胞器（MLO）系统、多区室人工细胞、原始细胞（protocell）通讯网络和虚拟细胞。这些平台可实现对药物稳定性、靶向性、生物合成和适应性响应的精确调控。近期进展包括微环境触发释放、逻辑门控的细胞间通讯，以及虚拟细胞辅助的高通量筛选和毒性预测。尽管取得了这些进展，在可规模化生产、长期稳定性和监管适应方面仍存在挑战。整合闭环学习、可解释模型和先进的生物制造技术，对于使人工细胞和仿生细胞系统处于下一代精准医学的前沿将至关重要。

title: Histopathological Imaging and Artificial Intelligence for Cancer Diagnosis and Gleason Grading: A Brief Review of Prostate Cancer.
source: PubMed · Journal of clinical practice and research

summary: 综述 2021–2025 年基于组织病理图像、利用机器学习和深度学习进行前列腺癌诊断与分级的研究，含预处理、特征提取和分类器分析。

abstract: [Journal of clinical practice and research] Prostate cancer, one of the most common cancers affecting men's health worldwide, ranks second among cancer-related deaths. Therefore, it represents a critical health issue, and early diagnosis is crucial. Several imaging and analytical methods are used to diagnose this condition. This study focuses on research conducted between 2021 and 2025 that analyzes, diagnoses, and grades prostate cancer based on histopathological images using machine learning and deep learning algorithms. In this context, the reviewed studies also include an analysis of findings related to preprocessing and feature extraction methods that may aid in prostate cancer detection, as well as the classifiers used. According to the findings of the reviewed studies, artificial intelligence-supported prostate cancer detection systems demonstrate high clinical performance and significantly improve the diagnostic accuracy of pathologists by enabling rapid diagnosis. The presented research findings indicate a need for comprehensive studies focusing on prostate cancer using histopathological images. The integration of artificial intelligence is transforming prostate cancer pathology from a traditional and subjective process into a data-driven and standardized framework. This systematic analysis of histopathological images will make significant contributions to future prostate cancer research, help achieve more reliable results in clinical decision-making processes, and lay the groundwork for personalized medicine.
zh_abstract: [临床实践与研究杂志] 前列腺癌是影响全球男性健康的最常见癌症之一，在癌症相关死亡中位居第二。因此，它是一个关键的健康问题，早期诊断至关重要。目前有多种影像学和分析方法用于诊断该疾病。本研究聚焦于2021年至2025年间开展的、基于组织病理学图像并利用机器学习和深度学习算法对前列腺癌进行分析、诊断和分级的研究。在此背景下，所纳入综述的研究还包括对可能有助于前列腺癌检测的预处理和特征提取方法以及所用分类器相关发现的分析。根据所综述研究的结果，人工智能支持的前列腺癌检测系统表现出较高的临床性能，并可通过实现快速诊断显著提高病理医师的诊断准确性。所呈现的研究结果表明，需要开展以组织病理学图像为基础、聚焦前列腺癌的全面研究。人工智能的整合正在将前列腺癌病理学从传统且主观的过程转变为数据驱动的标准化框架。对组织病理学图像的这一系统性分析将为未来前列腺癌研究做出重要贡献，有助于在临床决策过程中获得更可靠的结果，并为个体化医疗奠定基础。

title: Circulating Biomarkers with Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Risk Assessment and Therapeutic Monitoring: Evidence, Limitations, and Translation.
source: PubMed · Therapeutics and clinical risk management
zh_title: 循环生物标志物结合AI用于临床风险评估与治疗监测：综述
summary: 综述循环生物标志物（尤其cfDNA）与AI/机器学习结合在风险评估和治疗监测中的进展、局限与转化。
key_points: 聚焦cfDNA等循环生物标志物

abstract: [Therapeutics and clinical risk management] Circulating biomarkers, particularly cell-free DNA (cfDNA), are transforming contemporary medicine through their capacity to provide dynamic, minimally invasive assessments of disease dynamics. Their clinical utility has broadened substantially to include oncology, cardiovascular conditions, transplant monitoring, infectious diseases, and persistent inflammatory disorders. Nevertheless, the increasing complexity and volume of biomarker-related data pose substantial challenges, necessitating the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning methodologies for improved data interpretation, risk assessment, and clinical decision-making. This review presents a thorough examination of recent progress in the integration of circulating biomarkers with AI within therapeutic contexts and clinical risk management. It outlines the translational trajectory from molecular signatures to precision medicine, addresses present constraints, and explores prospective developments. The objective of this review is to serve as a systematic resource for both clinical practice and research, thereby promoting the evolution of personalized medicine through innovative, biomarker-driven strategies supported by AI.
zh_abstract: [治疗与临床风险管理] 循环生物标志物，尤其是游离DNA（cfDNA），因其能够对疾病动态提供动态、微创的评估，正在改变当代医学。其临床应用已大幅扩展至肿瘤学、心血管疾病、移植监测、感染性疾病和持续性炎症性疾病。然而，生物标志物相关数据日益增长的复杂性和数量带来了重大挑战，需要整合人工智能（AI）和机器学习方法，以改进数据解读、风险评估和临床决策。本综述全面考察了在治疗情境和临床风险管理中循环生物标志物与AI整合的最新进展。文章概述了从分子特征到精准医学的转化路径，论述了目前的局限性，并探讨了未来的发展。本综述旨在为临床实践和研究提供系统性的参考资源，从而通过由AI支持的、以生物标志物为驱动的创新策略，推动个体化医学的发展。

title: Next-generation analytical platforms for neurochemical sensing: from conventional biosensors to intelligent brain interfaces.
zh_title: 神经化学传感新一代平台：从传统生物传感器到智能脑接口
summary: 综述83项代表性研究，涵盖电化学、植入式、可穿戴及基因编码传感，指出仅9.6%包含明确的AI/ML数据分析。
key_points: 68.7%基于电化学或电学传感
仅9.6%明确采用AI/ML分析
受限于选择性、稳定性与临床转化
reason: AI仅占次要部分的传感综述，增量档
abstract: [Talanta] Neurochemical sensing is central to understanding brain function, neurological disorders, and precision neurotherapeutics. Despite advances in electrochemical, optical, implantable, wearable, and genetically encoded technologies, current platforms remain limited by molecular selectivity, long-term stability, biofouling, complex data interpretation, and clinical translation. This review critically examines 83 representative studies encompassing nanomaterial-enabled electrochemical sensors, implantable and wearable devices, genetically encoded and CRISPR-engineered systems, AI-assisted analytical frameworks, and multimodal bioelectronic interfaces. Among the reviewed platforms, 68.7% were based on electrochemical or electrical sensing, whereas only 9.6% incorporated explicit AI/ML-assisted data analysis, indicating that intelligent analytical functionalities remain relatively limited. AI-assisted platforms have shown promising capabilities for signal discrimination, quantitative analysis, and enhanced analytical performance across diverse neurochemical sensing modalities, but their reported performance remains highly dependent on the sensing architecture, experimental conditions, and level of validation. Rather than providing a conventional technology-centered survey, this review establishes a unified framework for evaluating neurochemical sensing across five dimensions: molecular selectivity, spatiotemporal resolution, operational stability, intelligent data interpretation, and translational readiness. The reviewed evidence indicates a transition from conventional single-modality sensing toward integrated platforms incorporating multimodal detection and intelligent data interpretation, with adaptive and closed-loop interfacing emerging as future directions. By connecting advances in molecular recognition, functional materials, bioelectronics, and AI, this review identifies key design principles, persistent bottlenecks, and realistic priorities for translating next-generation neurochemical sensing platforms into reliable and clinically relevant intelligent interfaces.
zh_abstract: [Talanta] 神经化学传感对于理解脑功能、神经系统疾病和精准神经治疗至关重要。尽管电化学、光学、植入式、可穿戴和基因编码技术已取得进展，但现有平台仍受限于分子选择性、长期稳定性、生物污损、复杂的数据解读以及临床转化。本综述对 83 项具有代表性的研究进行了批判性审视，涵盖纳米材料赋能的电化学传感器、植入式和可穿戴设备、基因编码和 CRISPR 工程化系统、AI 辅助分析框架以及多模态生物电子接口。在所纳入综述的平台中，68.7% 基于电化学或电学传感，而仅有 9.6% 明确采用了 AI/ML 辅助的数据分析，表明智能分析功能仍相对有限。AI 辅助平台在多种神经化学传感模式中已显示出在信号区分、定量分析和提升分析性能方面的良好能力，但其报告的性能在很大程度上取决于传感架构、实验条件和验证水平。本综述并非提供传统以技术为中心的概述，而是建立了一个统一框架，从五个维度评估神经化学传感：分子选择性、时空分辨率、运行稳定性、智能数据解读和转化成熟度。已综述的证据表明，该领域正从传统的单模态传感向整合多模态检测与智能数据解读的集成平台转变，自适应和闭环接口正成为未来的发展方向。通过将分子识别、功能材料、生物电子学和 AI 方面的进展联系起来，本综述明确了关键设计原则、长期存在的瓶颈，以及将新一代神经化学传感平台转化为可靠且具有临床意义的智能接口的现实优先事项。

title: Zonal-Aware Prostate Cancer Detection and Classification via Hadamard-Fused Mamba-UNet
zh_title: ZH-Mamba：分区感知的前列腺癌MRI检测与分类
summary: 提出两阶段H-Mamba UNet框架，结合前列腺分区分割、病灶定位与解剖感知分类器，用于MRI中临床显著前列腺癌检测。
key_points: 两个H-Mamba UNet分别做分区分割与病灶定位
基于可学习Hadamard变换进行特征融合
后接解剖感知CNN做csPCa分类
reason: 预印本新方法，摘要未给出定量结果与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Accurate clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection from prostate MRI requires a detailed understanding of the prostate anatomical context. Deep learning approaches have achieved promising results in zonal and lesion segmentation; however, the joint analysis of prostate zonal anatomy and lesion morphology in a unified framework remains relatively underexplored. In this work, we propose ZH-Mamba, a multi-stage zonal-aware csPCa detection framework consisting of two H-Mamba UNets models for prostate zonal segmentation and lesion localization, followed by an anatomy-aware Convolutional Neural Network classifier for csPCa detection. The proposed model leverages a learnable Hadamard Transform-based fusion mechanism to enhance zonal and lesion feature representations without increasing computational complexity. The learned fusion patterns consistently emphasize prostate regions, suggesting that the proposed fusion captures anatomically relevant feature representations. We demonstrate a strong zonal segmentation performance on the PI-CAI dataset, reaching Dice scores of $\textbf{0.95}$, $\textbf{0.85}$, and $\textbf{0.95}$ for whole gland (WG), peripheral zone (PZ), and transition zone (TZ), respectively, providing robust anatomical priors for downstream csPCa detection. Experimental results on an independent internal dataset confirm the generalization capability of the proposed zonal segmentation model. For lesion localization, the H-Mamba UNet achieves a competitive Dice score of $\textbf{0.70}$. Integrating the zonal masks and lesion localization, the proposed ZH-Mamba framework achieves an AUC of $\textbf{0.86}$, Average Precision ($\mathrm{AP}_{\mathrm{Patient}}$) of $\textbf{0.72}$, and F1 score of $\textbf{0.76}$, demonstrating the effectiveness of zonal-aware csPCa detection.
zh_abstract: 通过前列腺MRI准确检测临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）需要详细了解前列腺的解剖背景。深度学习方法在分区和病灶分割方面已取得有前景的结果；然而，在统一框架中联合分析前列腺分区解剖与病灶形态仍相对缺乏探索。在本工作中，我们提出ZH-Mamba，一种多阶段、分区感知的csPCa检测框架，由两个H-Mamba UNet模型（分别用于前列腺分区分割和病灶定位）以及随后的解剖感知卷积神经网络分类器（用于csPCa检测）组成。所提模型利用基于可学习Hadamard变换的融合机制，在不增加计算复杂度的情况下增强分区和病灶特征表示。所学融合模式始终强调前列腺区域，提示该融合捕获了与解剖相关的特征表示。我们在PI-CAI数据集上展示了出色的分区分割性能，全腺体（WG）、外周带（PZ）和移行带（TZ）的Dice分数分别达到0.95、0.85和0.95，为下游csPCa检测提供了稳健的解剖先验。在独立内部数据集上的实验结果证实了所提分区分割模型的泛化能力。在病灶定位方面，H-Mamba UNet取得了具有竞争力的Dice分数0.70。整合分区掩模与病灶定位后，ZH-Mamba框架的AUC为0.86，平均精度（AP_Patient）为0.72，F1分数为0.76，证明了分区感知csPCa检测的有效性。

title: Cross-Device Transfer of a Hospital-Trained Fetal Head Circumference Model to a Low-Cost Handheld Ultrasound Probe
zh_title: 医院训练的胎儿头围模型向低成本手持超声探头的跨设备迁移
summary: 预印本：在HC18上训练的轻量分割模型直接用于手持探头（18例），误差由2.34 mm增至16.12 mm，预处理方式影响显著。
key_points: 域内误差2.34 mm，手持图像16.12 mm，退化6.9倍
直接缩放49.45 mm，保持长宽比16.12 mm
仅18例患者，微调数据效率曲线另有分析
reason: 小样本（18例）预印本，有跨设备泛化的实用发现，未经评审，属增量档
abstract: Automated fetal head circumference (HC) measurement reaches near-expert accuracy on the HC18 benchmark, but published models are trained and evaluated on hospital-grade equipment. We quantify what happens when such a model is carried to a low-cost handheld probe. A lightweight segmentation network (CSM, 0.13M parameters) was trained on HC18 across five independent runs and applied without modification to images from a $1,350 handheld probe (SonoQue C3), acquired at the same visit as the reference hospital scan in 18 patients. In-domain accuracy was 2.34 +/- 0.43 mm; on handheld images the same model gave 16.12 mm against the hospital record, a 6.9-fold degradation. Input preprocessing, a choice rarely reported, accounted for about a third of that gap: direct resizing gave 49.45 mm against 16.12 mm for an aspect-preserving pipeline. A leave-one-out data-efficiency curve showed that fine-tuning on two images significantly worsened accuracy, and that from four images upward error fell by 0.75 mm per doubling of the local dataset (p = 0.0045), although no training-set size up to 27 images significantly improved on the unmodified model. Much of the residual gap belongs to the reference rather than the model: scored against a manual tracing of the same image the model was already within 10.48 mm, and its disagreement with sonographer calipers on the same frame was a near-constant offset, negative in 10 of 10 cases. A single calibration constant estimated leave-one-out reduced that disagreement from 8.12 mm to 3.49 mm, reaching the intraobserver reproducibility reported for experienced sonographers, but did not improve agreement with the hospital record. Cross-device evaluations should therefore report the input preprocessing used and characterise the precision of their reference standard.
zh_abstract: 胎儿头围（HC）自动测量在 HC18 基准上已达到接近专家的准确度，但已发表的模型均在医院级设备上训练和评估。我们量化了将此类模型应用于低成本手持式探头时会发生什么。我们在 HC18 上以五次独立运行训练了一个轻量级分割网络（CSM，0.13M 参数），并将其不作任何修改地应用于一款价格为 1,350 美元的手持式探头（SonoQue C3）所获取的图像，这些图像与 18 名患者的参考医院扫描在同一次就诊中采集。域内准确度为 2.34 ± 0.43 mm；在手持设备图像上，同一模型相对于医院记录的误差为 16.12 mm，退化 6.9 倍。输入预处理这一很少被报告的选择约占该差距的三分之一：直接缩放的误差为 49.45 mm，而保持纵横比的流程为 16.12 mm。留一法数据效率曲线显示，用两幅图像微调会使准确度显著变差；从四幅图像起，局部数据集每翻一倍，误差下降 0.75 mm（p = 0.0045），但在不超过 27 幅图像的任何训练集规模下，均未较未修改模型显著改善。残余差距中有很大一部分源于参照标准而非模型：以同一图像的手工描记为标准评分时，该模型的误差已在 10.48 mm 以内，而它与超声医师在同一帧上用卡尺测量结果之间的差异是近乎恒定的偏移，在 10 例中有 10 例为负值。以留一法估计的单一校准常数将该差异由 8.12 mm 降至 3.49 mm，达到了经验丰富的超声医师所报告的观察者内可重复性水平，但并未改善与医院记录的一致性。因此，跨设备评估应报告所使用的输入预处理方式，并刻画其参照标准的精确度。

abstract: [Orthopedic reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly changing the tasks performed by physicians, raising questions about how graduate medical education should prepare trainees for future practice and whether residency workforce planning should change as AI adoption expands. This brief review examines the implications of AI for residency education and physician workforce planning, using radiology as an early model of technology-driven task transformation while considering broader effects across diagnostic, procedural, and relationship-based specialties. AI is already being used for clinical documentation, image interpretation, predictive analytics, administrative workflows, and large-scale data analysis. AI-assisted scribing has particular relevance to chronic pain and other documentation-intensive specialties, where it may reduce clerical burden and preserve clinician attention for patient care. However, current evidence more strongly supports task redistribution and physician augmentation than complete replacement. Specialties built around standardized digital information may experience earlier automation, whereas procedural skill, complex communication, longitudinal judgment, and responsibility for final clinical decisions remain difficult to substitute. At present, broad reductions in residency positions based only on anticipated AI capabilities seem premature. Residency programs should adapt curricula now by incorporating AI literacy, verification skills, data interpretation, and safeguards against deskilling. Changes in residency position numbers should occur more cautiously and should be based on durable, specialty-specific workforce evidence, including hiring patterns, patient access, workload, productivity, and regional need. The goal should be to train physicians who can safely supervise and integrate AI while preserving the human expertise that remains central to high-quality care.
zh_abstract: [Orthopedic reviews] 人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变医生所承担的任务，这引发了关于研究生医学教育应如何让受训者为未来执业做好准备，以及随着AI应用的扩大，住院医师培训的人力规划是否应当改变的问题。本简要综述探讨了AI对住院医师教育和医师人力规划的影响，以放射学作为技术驱动的任务转型的早期范例，同时考虑其对诊断类、操作类和以医患关系为基础的各专科的更广泛影响。AI目前已用于临床文书记录、影像判读、预测分析、行政工作流程和大规模数据分析。AI辅助记录对慢性疼痛及其他文书工作繁重的专科尤其具有意义，可减轻文书负担，使临床医生能将注意力集中于患者诊疗。然而，目前的证据更有力地支持任务的重新分配和对医生的增强，而非完全取代。以标准化数字信息为核心的专科可能较早实现自动化，而操作技能、复杂沟通、长期判断以及对最终临床决策的责任仍难以被替代。目前，仅基于对AI能力的预期而大幅削减住院医师名额似乎为时过早。住院医师培训项目现在就应调整课程，纳入AI素养、核查技能、数据解读以及防止技能退化的保障措施。住院医师名额数量的变动应更为审慎，并应基于持久的、针对具体专科的人力证据，包括招聘模式、患者就医可及性、工作量、生产力和区域需求。目标应是培养能够安全地监督并整合AI、同时保留对高质量医疗仍至关重要的人类专业能力的医生。

title: Nedimo: An Evidence-Grounded Multilingual Pipeline for AI-Generated Sleep Stories

summary: 针对睡眠场景提出保守的多语言睡前故事生成与朗读流程，将LLM生成与确定性规划分离并加入校验（预印本）。
key_points: 已有成人睡前音频证据不一致
四阶段注意力渐降并校验结构与词汇

abstract: Generative audio systems can produce large libraries of personalized bedtime content, but ordinary media objectives (retention, completion, and novelty) are poorly aligned with the goal of supporting a transition toward sleep. Direct evidence for narrated bedtime audio in adults is mixed, and a recent active-controlled trial did not support such audio as a standalone treatment for sleep disturbance. We translate this uncertain evidence into conservative engineering requirements and present a multilingual pipeline for generating and narrating low-arousal sleep stories. The implemented prototype separates deterministic planning from large language model generation, represents content and delivery parameters explicitly, shapes each script through a four-phase attention taper, validates structural and lexical constraints, performs a bounded error-aware retry, and quarantines unresolved outputs. Provider-agnostic text-to-speech synthesis is followed by paragraph-aware joining, two-pass loudness normalization, and a publication gate that re-measures the saved, encoded file against fixed loudness, loudness-range, and true-peak limits. The product data model records stop position, replay, early abandonment, and completion while treating these events as ambiguous behavioral proxies rather than clinical outcomes. We contribute an evidence-to-requirement mapping, a traceable guardrail architecture with explicit acceptance thresholds, technical evaluation criteria, and a prospective protocol for testing sleep-onset effects. No clinical efficacy is claimed; the system is positioned as a relaxation and attentional-support tool whose benefit and possible reliance must be evaluated empirically.
zh_abstract: 生成式音频系统可以产出大量个性化的睡前内容，但常规的媒体目标（留存、完播和新颖性）与支持向睡眠过渡这一目标并不契合。针对成人叙述式睡前音频的直接证据并不一致，且近期一项设有主动对照的试验不支持将此类音频作为睡眠障碍的独立治疗手段。我们将这一不确定的证据转化为保守的工程要求，并提出一条用于生成和朗读低唤醒度睡眠故事的多语言流水线。所实现的原型将确定性规划与大语言模型生成分离，显式表示内容与表达参数，通过四阶段注意力递减结构塑造每份脚本，验证结构与词汇约束，执行有界的、感知错误的重试，并将未能解决的输出隔离。在与服务商无关的文本转语音合成之后，依次进行段落感知的拼接、两遍响度归一化，以及发布关卡，该关卡对已保存、已编码的文件重新测量，并依据固定的响度、响度范围和真峰值限值进行把关。产品数据模型记录停止位置、重播、早期放弃和完成情况，同时将这些事件视为含义模糊的行为代理指标，而非临床结局。我们的贡献包括：证据到需求的映射、带有明确验收阈值的可追溯护栏架构、技术评估标准，以及用于检验入睡效应的前瞻性方案。我们不声称具有任何临床疗效；该系统定位为放松与注意力支持工具，其获益及可能的依赖性须通过实证评估。

title: External validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models: a systematic review.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 临床预测模型外部验证与落地的系统综述
summary: 对1072个2017-2019年机器学习临床预测模型的元流行病学分析显示，88.1%缺乏后续转化，仅9.9%做过外部验证，5.2%进入临床实施。
key_points: 代码公开与TRIPOD依从性更高者转化概率更高
仅9.9%经外部验证，5.2%达临床实施
评估外部验证与实施是否为连续阶段
reason: 大样本元研究、证据标准有价值，但属综述类上限6分
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To assess whether external validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models reflect sequential or distinct stages of a translational pathway. This cross-sectional meta-epidemiologic study analyzed 1072 machine learning-based clinical prediction models published across clinical domains (2017-2019). We assessed downstream external validation and clinical implementation via citation screening through August 2025. Evaluated exposures included public code availability, TRIPOD adherence, multicenter design, and sample size. Secondary outcomes included investigator overlap. Among 1072 studies, 88.1% lacked translational follow-up. Only 9.9% underwent external validation, and 5.2% reached clinical implementation. Code availability (odds ratio [OR] 3.04; 95% CI, 1.91-4.84) and higher TRIPOD adherence (OR 2.68 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 2.04-3.52) were significantly associated with external validation, but not consistently with clinical implementation. Notably, 39% of implemented models lacked prior external validation. Independent groups predominantly conducted external validation (72.6%), whereas implementation frequently involved original development teams. Findings indicate a divergence in algorithmic translation. Characteristics emphasizing evaluability (code availability, reporting transparency) facilitate external validation but do not ensure clinical implementation. The frequent bypass of independent validation before implementation highlights a reliance on institutional and operational factors rather than generalizable methodology. External validation and clinical implementation appear to represent distinct translational processes rather than sequential stages influenced by a uniform set of factors. Current practices facilitate validation but inadequately address operational requirements for real-world deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 旨在评估临床预测模型的外部验证与临床实施，是反映转化路径的先后阶段，还是相互独立的不同阶段。这项横断面元流行病学研究分析了2017—2019年间发表于各临床领域的1072个基于机器学习的临床预测模型。我们通过截至2025年8月的引文筛查，评估其后续的外部验证和临床实施情况。评估的暴露因素包括公开代码的可获得性、TRIPOD依从性、多中心设计和样本量。次要结局包括研究者重叠情况。在1072项研究中，88.1%缺乏转化后续。仅9.9%进行了外部验证，5.2%达到临床实施。代码可获得性（比值比[OR] 3.04；95% CI，1.91–4.84）和更高的TRIPOD依从性（每提高10%，OR 2.68；95% CI，2.04–3.52）与外部验证显著相关，但与临床实施的相关性并不一致。值得注意的是，39%已实施的模型此前未经外部验证。外部验证主要由独立团队开展（72.6%），而临床实施则常有原始开发团队参与。研究结果表明算法转化存在分化。强调可评估性的特征（代码可获得性、报告透明度）有利于外部验证，但并不能保证临床实施。实施前频繁绕过独立验证，凸显出对机构因素和运营因素而非可推广方法学的依赖。外部验证与临床实施似乎代表不同的转化过程，而非受同一组因素影响的先后阶段。当前的做法有利于验证，但未能充分满足真实世界部署的运营需求。

title: Subgroup deployment-readiness audit of calibration and clinical utility in perioperative infection prediction.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 围手术期感染预测模型的亚组校准与临床效用部署就绪审计
summary: 对术后感染预测模型按性别、年龄等亚组审计区分度、校准与决策曲线净获益，并比较重校准策略，总体AUROC为0.876。
key_points: 10719例手术、504例感染事件
比较通用与分组交叉拟合保序重校准
含去SMOTE重拟合与时间留出分析
reason: 规范回顾性亚组审计，含时间留出但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] We audited deployment readiness of an end-of-surgery postoperative infection model across clinically relevant subgroups and assessed mitigation of subgroup miscalibration. We analyzed out-of-fold predictions from 10 719 procedures (2014-2022) with 504 present-on-admission (POA)-coded postoperative infection events across recorded sex, age, and a clinical physiological-reserve proxy. We assessed discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific errors, and decision-curve net benefit, treating t = 0.10 as a reference anchor. We compared no recalibration with common and group-specific cross-fitted isotonic recalibration, evaluated a refit without the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and performed a temporal-holdout analysis. Overall area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.876, with similar sex-marginal discrimination in women and men (0.878 vs 0.875). Calibration-in-the-large was -1.02 overall, -0.86 in frail, and -1.34 in prefrail patients; the 6-event nonfrail stratum was not estimable. At t = 0.10, net benefit was positive in frail and negative in prefrail patients in the source cohort, but negative prefrail utility did not persist in the ascertainable-period (2018-2022) and temporal analyses. Common recalibration moved overall calibration-in-the-large from -1.020 to -0.007. Removing SMOTE shifted overall calibration but did not reduce the reserve gradient. Temporal-holdout AUROC was 0.851 with persistent overprediction. Present-on-admission coding was effectively absent before 2018; prevalence-dependent results were therefore additionally reported for the ascertainable 2018-2022 period, and ascertainment differed by physiological reserve. Discrimination-only or sex-marginal evaluation would have missed deployment-relevant subgroup heterogeneity, while endpoint ascertainment affected prevalence-dependent interpretation. Joint subgroup evaluation can identify deployment-relevant limitations missed by aggregate metrics. Prospective validation with comparable outcome ascertainment remains necessary before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 我们审核了一种术毕术后感染预测模型在临床相关亚组中的部署就绪程度，并评估了亚组校准偏差的缓解方法。我们分析了10 719例手术（2014–2022年）的折外预测结果，其中包含504例入院时存在（POA）编码的术后感染事件，并按记录的性别、年龄以及一项临床生理储备代理指标进行分析。我们评估了区分度、校准度、特定阈值下的错误率以及决策曲线净获益，并将 t = 0.10 作为参考锚点。我们比较了不进行重新校准、通用的以及分组特异性的交叉拟合保序重新校准，评估了不使用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）的重新拟合，并进行了时间留出分析。总体受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.876，女性与男性按性别边际计算的区分度相近（0.878 对 0.875）。总体的整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）为 -1.02，衰弱患者为 -0.86，衰弱前期患者为 -1.34；仅有6例事件的非衰弱层无法估计。在 t = 0.10 时，源队列中衰弱患者的净获益为正，衰弱前期患者为负，但衰弱前期的负效用在可确证期（2018–2022年）分析和时间分析中并未持续存在。通用重新校准使总体整体校准从 -1.020 变为 -0.007。去除SMOTE改变了总体校准，但未减小生理储备梯度。时间留出AUROC为0.851，且持续存在高估。2018年之前入院时存在编码实际上缺失；因此，对依赖患病率的结果另行报告了可确证的2018–2022年期间，并且不同生理储备患者的事件确证情况存在差异。仅评估区分度或按性别边际评估会遗漏与部署相关的亚组异质性，而终点确证情况影响了对依赖患病率结果的解读。联合亚组评估可以发现被汇总指标遗漏的与部署相关的局限性。在临床部署之前，仍需在结局确证方式可比的条件下进行前瞻性验证。

title: A Large Language Model Framework for Seed Implant Brachytherapy: Adaptive Weight Optimization via Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
source: PubMed · Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
zh_title: 用于粒子植入近距离放疗的大语言模型框架：基于RAG的自适应权重优化
summary: 研究提出由本地部署DeepSeek-R1驱动的SIBT计划权重自适应优化框架，结合自动计划算法与基于RAG的临床知识库迭代优化。

LLM评估计划质量并推荐新权重
