abstract: [Experimental hematology & oncology] Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is a well-established oncogenic driver in multiple solid tumors, most prominently in breast and gastric cancers. Beyond gene amplification-driven signaling through canonical PI3K/AKT and RAS/MAPK pathways, emerging evidence reveals that HER2 functions within a highly dynamic and context-dependent tumor ecosystem. Interactions between HER2-positive tumor cells and immune and stromal compartments actively shape the tumor microenvironment, contributing to immune evasion, therapeutic resistance and disease progression. A central challenge in the clinical management of HER2-altered cancers is pronounced spatial and temporal heterogeneity, which undermines both diagnostic accuracy and the durability of targeted therapies. In response, advances in multi-omics profiling, liquid biopsy technologies and artificial intelligence-assisted analytics are redefining HER2 assessment, shifting it from static tissue-based classification towards dynamic, minimally invasive monitoring. In parallel, the therapeutic landscape has evolved from single-agent HER2 blockade to rational combination strategies. In particular, antibody-drug conjugates have emerged as a transformative modality, extending the therapeutic reach of HER2 targeting beyond traditional indications and offering new opportunities to overcome heterogeneity and drug resistance. This review synthesizes current insights into the molecular and microenvironmental biology of HER2-altered solid tumors and discusses how these advances are reshaping next-generation precision oncology.
zh_abstract: [Experimental hematology & oncology] 人表皮生长因子受体 2（HER2）是多种实体瘤（以乳腺癌和胃癌最为突出）中公认的致癌驱动因子。除基因扩增通过经典的 PI3K/AKT 和 RAS/MAPK 通路驱动信号传导外，新近证据表明，HER2 在一个高度动态且依赖于具体情境的肿瘤生态系统中发挥作用。HER2 阳性肿瘤细胞与免疫和基质成分之间的相互作用积极塑造肿瘤微环境，促进免疫逃逸、治疗耐药和疾病进展。HER2 改变型癌症临床管理的核心挑战是显著的空间和时间异质性，这削弱了诊断的准确性以及靶向治疗的持久性。对此，多组学分析、液体活检技术和人工智能辅助分析方面的进展正在重新定义 HER2 评估，使其从静态的基于组织的分类转向动态、微创的监测。与此同时，治疗格局已从单药 HER2 阻断发展为合理的联合策略。尤其是抗体偶联药物已成为一种变革性的治疗方式，将 HER2 靶向治疗的适用范围扩展到传统适应证之外，并为克服异质性和耐药性提供了新的机会。本综述归纳了目前对 HER2 改变型实体瘤分子生物学和微环境生物学的认识，并讨论了这些进展如何重塑下一代精准肿瘤学。

title: Artificial intelligence-supported revision of nursing care plans in a standardised newborn vignette: a one-group pretest-posttest study.
source: PubMed · Journal of research in nursing : JRN
zh_title: 生成式AI辅助修订护理计划：新生儿案例前后测研究
summary: 40名菲律宾护生在标准化新生儿案例中用AI辅助流程修订护理计划，盲评显示文档质量各维度均有提升。
key_points: 40名二年级护生，单组前后测
两名盲法护理教师评分
各维度质量提升，诊断表述增益最大
reason: 单组、小样本教育研究、无对照，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of research in nursing : JRN] Nursing students often produce care plans that are plausible yet generic, with weak linkage among diagnoses, interventions and outcomes. Teacher-mediated, bounded generative AI may support revision while preserving clinical judgement. To assess whether an AI-supported Reflect-Compare-Revise workflow improves nursing care plan quality and diagnosis-intervention-outcome alignment using a standardised newborn vignette. A one-group pretest-posttest study involved 40 second-year nursing students at a public university in the Philippines. Students wrote an unaided care plan, then revised it using the structured workflow. Two blinded nurse-educator raters scored paired plans using the Quality of Diagnoses, Interventions and Outcomes instrument. Post-revision documentation quality improved across all domains, with the largest raw gains in diagnostic formulation and nursing-sensitive outcomes. Interventions and outcomes remained the weaker downstream domains, with outcomes lowest at posttest. Diagnosis-intervention-outcome alignment and specificity increased, although explicit cross-linking remained inconsistent. This study adds preliminary evidence for nursing education: higher scores after guided AI-supported revision were associated with clearer and more coherent clinical reasoning in care planning. Policy recommendations are to permit bounded AI use with standardised prompts, revision logs/checklists, rubric-based feedback and verification safeguards to protect documentation integrity and patient safety.
zh_abstract: [Journal of research in nursing : JRN] 护理专业学生撰写的护理计划往往看似合理但内容泛泛，诊断、干预与结局之间的关联薄弱。由教师介导、有边界的生成式人工智能可能在保留临床判断的同时辅助修订。本研究旨在使用标准化新生儿案例，评估人工智能支持的“反思-比较-修订”（Reflect-Compare-Revise）工作流程是否能提高护理计划质量以及诊断-干预-结局的一致性。这项单组前后测研究纳入了菲律宾一所公立大学的 40 名二年级护理专业学生。学生先撰写无辅助的护理计划，然后使用结构化工作流程对其进行修订。两名设盲的护理教育者评分员使用“诊断、干预和结局质量”（Quality of Diagnoses, Interventions and Outcomes）量表对配对的计划进行评分。修订后，文书质量在所有维度上均有所提高，其中诊断表述和护理敏感结局的原始分增幅最大。干预和结局仍是较弱的下游维度，结局在后测时得分最低。诊断-干预-结局的一致性和具体性有所提高，但明确的相互关联仍不一致。本研究为护理教育提供了初步证据：在有指导的人工智能支持修订后得分更高，与护理计划中更清晰、更连贯的临床推理相关。政策建议是允许在有边界的前提下使用人工智能，配合标准化提示语、修订日志/核查清单、基于评分标准的反馈以及核实保障措施，以保护文书的完整性和患者安全。

title: Mechanistic gene-regulation-based trajectory inference with bowside
zh_title: bowside：基于基因调控机制的轨迹推断
summary: 提出浅层神经随机分化模型bowside，对基因调控进行机制建模，可同时推断单细胞分化轨迹并重建调控网络。
key_points: 同时完成轨迹推断与调控网络重建
在造血与iPSC重编程数据上演示
可找回已知命运决定网络模体
reason: 方法新颖的预印本，但摘要证据有限、未见对比
abstract: While single-cell RNA sequencing enables the in-depth study of differentiation processes, simultaneous trajectory inference and gene regulatory network reconstruction remain challenging. We propose bowside, a shallow neural stochastic differentiation model that mechanistically models gene regulation. Our method successfully recovers gene expression trends and the underlying regulatory interactions. We demonstrate bowside on hematopoiesis and induced pluripotent stem cell reprogramming data, retrieving known fate-determining network motifs.
zh_abstract: 虽然单细胞RNA测序使得对分化过程的深入研究成为可能，但同时进行轨迹推断和基因调控网络重建仍具挑战性。我们提出了bowside，这是一种浅层神经随机分化模型，可对基因调控进行机制性建模。我们的方法成功恢复了基因表达趋势及其潜在的调控相互作用。我们在造血和诱导多能干细胞重编程数据上展示了bowside，检索出已知的决定细胞命运的网络基序。

title: Task-Dependent Performance of GNNs and Pretrained Models in ADMET Prediction
zh_title: ADMET预测中GNN与预训练模型的任务依赖表现
summary: 在六个TDC ADMET终点上以骨架划分，对GNN、冻结预训练模型和指纹基线做匹配调参预算的公平比较。
key_points: 各模型统一50次验证选择的调参预算
报告十个随机种子的中位数
仅用验证集选架构与超参
reason: 设计规范的基准比较，但为预印本且增量有限
abstract: Structure-based prediction of ADMET (absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity) properties promises fast, low-cost screening of drug candidates, yet model selection remains unclear because published comparisons of molecular representations often use unmatched tuning budgets and leakage-prone evaluation protocols, producing performance differences that may not reflect model quality. To address this gap, we benchmark graph neural networks (GNNs), frozen pretrained models (ChemBERTa, MolCLR), and fingerprint baselines across six Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET endpoints under scaffold-split evaluation. To make it really fair we gave every model family a matched 50-trial, validation-selected tuning budget and reported the median over ten seeds; architecture and hyperparameter selection use validation data only, with the held-out test split reserved for final performance estimation. Under this fair comparison protocol, emph{no model family dominates} and the differences between families fall within the seed-to-seed range on most endpoints. The GNN is clearly best only on Caco-2 permeability (R$^2 approx 0.48$), and a controlled ablation shows this advantage comes entirely from auxiliary physicochemical descriptors rather than the graph representation; Morgan fingerprints are competitive on hERG (AUC $approx 0.77$) and give the best median on both clearance endpoints, while MolCLR is best on Tox21. For hepatocyte clearance and half-life, all models yield near-zero or negative R$^2$. No single hyperparameter-optimization strategy, among seven evaluated, consistently outperforms random search at this budget, and we show that selecting the optimizer using test-set performance or reporting only single best-trial runs can substantially inflate a favored model's apparent advantage. Reliable ADMET modeling therefore requires endpoint-specific model selection together with fair, leakage-controlled, seed-averaged evaluation, offering more trustworthy decision support for early-stage drug candidate prioritization.
zh_abstract: 基于结构的ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性）性质预测有望实现快速、低成本的候选药物筛选，但模型选择仍不明确，因为已发表的分子表示比较常采用不匹配的调参预算和易发生数据泄漏的评估方案，导致的性能差异可能并不反映模型的真实质量。为弥补这一不足，我们在骨架划分评估下，针对六个Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET终点，对图神经网络（GNN）、冻结的预训练模型（ChemBERTa、MolCLR）和指纹基线进行了基准测试。为确保真正公平，我们为每个模型家族提供了匹配的、经验证集选择的50次试验调参预算，并报告十个随机种子的中位数；架构和超参数的选择仅使用验证数据，保留的测试集仅用于最终性能估计。在这一公平比较方案下，没有任何模型家族占据主导地位，在大多数终点上，各家族之间的差异落在不同随机种子之间的波动范围内。GNN仅在Caco-2渗透性上明显最优（R$^2 \approx 0.48$），而对照消融实验表明，这一优势完全来自辅助的理化描述符，而非图表示；Morgan指纹在hERG上具有竞争力（AUC $\approx 0.77$），并在两个清除率终点上给出最佳中位数，而MolCLR在Tox21上最优。对于肝细胞清除率和半衰期，所有模型的R$^2$均接近零或为负。在所评估的七种超参数优化策略中，没有任何一种在此预算下始终优于随机搜索；我们还表明，使用测试集性能来选择优化器，或仅报告单次最佳试验的结果，会显著夸大某个受偏爱模型的表观优势。因此，可靠的ADMET建模需要针对具体终点选择模型，并配合公平、控制数据泄漏、按随机种子平均的评估，从而为早期候选药物的优先排序提供更可信的决策支持。

title: Attitudes and perceptions toward artificial intelligence among practicing rheumatologists in Iraq: a cross-sectional web-based survey.
zh_title: 伊拉克风湿科医生对人工智能的态度：横断面调查
summary: 2025年10月至2026年1月开展网络问卷调查，评估伊拉克执业风湿科医生对AI的态度及其与人口学、职业特征的关联。
key_points: 四个月网络横断面调查
问卷经专家审阅与预试验
分析态度与人口学、职业特征关联
reason: 区域性问卷调查，无技术或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of healthcare, particularly in rheumatology, where clinicians must integrate complex clinical, laboratory, and imaging data. Physicians' perceptions of AI may substantially influence the extent to which it is implemented responsibly in routine clinical practice. This study aimed to assess the attitudes of practicing rheumatologists in Iraq toward artificial intelligence and to examine their association with demographic and professional characteristics. A four-month web-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from October 2025 to January 2026. A questionnaire adapted from previous studies was refined through expert review and pilot testing before distribution. The questionnaire comprised demographic information, attitude statements measured on a five-point Likert scale, and items assessing general perceptions of artificial intelligence. Composite attitude scores were categorized using modified Bloom's cutoff criteria. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS and R. A total of 162 complete responses were collected. Most respondents were aged 35-44 years (42.0%), male (56.8%), and specialists (67.9%). Overall, 61.7% reported familiarity with AI and 69.1% had already used AI in rheumatology practice. Most participants 56.8% exhibited a poor attitude, 32.1% a moderate attitude, and 11.1% a good attitude toward AI. Bivariate analysis identified familiarity with AI ( p = 0.003 ) and involvement in research ( p = 0.009 ) as significantly associated with more favorable attitudes. Iraqi rheumatologists demonstrate cautious engagement with artificial intelligence, with the majority displaying poor-to-moderate overall attitude scores on the standardized composite scale. Greater familiarity with AI and research involvement were associated with more favorable attitudes, highlighting the importance of targeted digital literacy and specialty-specific education to support effective AI adoption in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 人工智能在医疗保健中的地位日益重要，尤其是在风湿病学领域，临床医生必须整合复杂的临床、实验室和影像数据。医生对人工智能的看法可能在很大程度上影响其在常规临床实践中被负责任地应用的程度。本研究旨在评估伊拉克执业风湿病医生对人工智能的态度，并探讨其与人口统计学和职业特征的关联。2025年10月至2026年1月开展了为期四个月的网络横断面调查。改编自既往研究的问卷经专家评审和预试验完善后发放。问卷包括人口统计学信息、采用五点李克特量表测量的态度陈述，以及评估对人工智能总体看法的条目。综合态度得分采用改良Bloom临界标准进行分类。使用SPSS和R进行统计分析。共收集到162份完整问卷。大多数受访者年龄为35-44岁（42.0%）、男性（56.8%）、专科医生（67.9%）。总体上，61.7%报告熟悉人工智能，69.1%已在风湿病学实践中使用过人工智能。多数参与者（56.8%）对人工智能态度较差，32.1%态度中等，11.1%态度良好。双变量分析发现，熟悉人工智能（p = 0.003）和参与研究（p = 0.009）与更积极的态度显著相关。伊拉克风湿病医生对人工智能的参与持谨慎态度，在标准化综合量表上，大多数人的总体态度得分为较差至中等。对人工智能更熟悉和参与研究与更积极的态度相关，这凸显了开展有针对性的数字素养和专科特定教育对支持人工智能在临床实践中有效应用的重要性。

title: Artificial intelligence in health insurance fraud detection: a global and regional systematic review.
zh_title: AI用于医保欺诈检测的全球与区域系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020检索2016-2025年文献，综述AI在医保欺诈检测中的方法、性能评估与落地挑战。
key_points: 检索七个数据库，覆盖2016-2025年
关注方法路径、性能评价与实施挑战
采用Silvi AI平台辅助筛选
reason: 系统综述，主题偏医保管理，与临床关系较弱，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Health insurance fraud imposes substantial financial burdens on healthcare systems and reduces the efficiency of healthcare resource utilization worldwide. Traditional fraud detection approaches often struggle to analyse large and complex healthcare claims data, making artificial intelligence (AI) an increasingly important tool for identifying fraudulent activities. This study systematically reviews global and regional evidence on AI applications in health insurance fraud detection, with particular emphasis on methodological approaches, performance evaluation, and implementation challenges. This systematic review followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Seven electronic databases were searched for studies published between 2016 and 2025. Titles and abstracts were screened using the Silvi AI platform, followed by eligibility assessment according to pre-defined inclusion and exclusion criteria. Data were extracted using a standardized framework, and methodological quality was assessed using the Drummond 10-item checklist. From 450 identified records, 33 studies met the eligibility criteria. The included studies demonstrated substantial heterogeneity in datasets, AI methodologies, fraud types, and performance evaluation metrics. Machine learning was the most frequently applied approach, followed by deep learning, graph-based learning, and hybrid AI frameworks. Although AI-based methods consistently improved fraud detection performance, challenges related to dataset imbalance, standardized reporting, interpretability, external validation, and economic evaluation remain significant barriers to widespread implementation. AI demonstrates considerable potential for improving health insurance fraud detection. However, future research should prioritize standardized evaluation frameworks, explainable AI, external validation across diverse healthcare systems, and economic assessment to support the responsible and scalable deployment of AI-enabled fraud detection systems.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 医疗保险欺诈给全球医疗系统带来沉重的经济负担，并降低医疗资源的利用效率。传统的欺诈检测方法往往难以分析庞大而复杂的医疗理赔数据，使人工智能（AI）成为识别欺诈行为日益重要的工具。本研究系统综述了 AI 在医疗保险欺诈检测中应用的全球和区域证据，特别关注方法学途径、性能评估和实施挑战。本系统评价遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南。检索了七个电子数据库中 2016 年至 2025 年发表的研究。使用 Silvi AI 平台筛选标题和摘要，随后依据预先设定的纳入和排除标准进行资格评估。采用标准化框架提取数据，并使用 Drummond 10 项清单评估方法学质量。在 450 条检索记录中，33 项研究符合纳入标准。纳入研究在数据集、AI 方法、欺诈类型和性能评估指标方面存在显著异质性。机器学习是应用最频繁的方法，其次是深度学习、基于图的学习和混合 AI 框架。尽管基于 AI 的方法持续提升了欺诈检测性能，但数据集不平衡、报告标准化、可解释性、外部验证和经济学评价等方面的挑战，仍是广泛实施的重要障碍。AI 在改善医疗保险欺诈检测方面显示出相当大的潜力。然而，未来研究应优先考虑标准化评估框架、可解释 AI、跨不同医疗系统的外部验证以及经济学评估，以支持 AI 驱动的欺诈检测系统的负责任和可扩展部署。

title: Machine Learning Based Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease using Full Blood Count from a Ghanaian Hospital Population with an Integrated Web Application
zh_title: 基于全血细胞计数的机器学习检测慢性肾病：加纳医院人群与网页应用
summary: 用155例加纳患者的全血细胞计数训练模型检测CKD，并考察SMOTE应用位置对性能的影响，随机森林准确率83.9%。
key_points: 155例患者，43例CKD
比较11种算法与6种重采样策略
SMOTE在划分前使用，性能可能被高估
reason: 单中心小样本预印本，仅交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is usually silent until advanced, and the tests confirming it are frequently unaffordable in sub-Saharan Africa, whereas the full blood count (FBC) is inexpensive and widely performed. We assessed whether machine learning applied to the FBC can detect CKD, and how far its reported performance depends on where synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) is applied. Records of 155 patients at the Ho Technical University Hospital, Ghana, 43 (27.7%) with CKD, yielded ten features: age, cardiovascular disease and eight raw FBC parameters. Eleven algorithms, six resampling strategies and thirteen ensembles were compared under repeated stratified cross-validation. With SMOTE applied before the train-test split, the protocol under which the deployed models were fitted, Random Forest and Extra Trees both reached an accuracy of 83.9%, with sensitivities of 0.893 and 0.857 and areas under the curve (AUC) of 0.925 and 0.939; repeated cross-validation gave an accuracy of 0.809 {+/-} 0.051 and an AUC of 0.897. With resampling confined to the training folds, the same features gave a held-out accuracy of 61.5% and an AUC of 0.604 in 39 unseen patients. Age was the only variable separating the groups after correction for multiple testing (median 64 versus 47 years, adjusted p = 0.0026). The models are deployed as NephroScan GH (https://nephroscangh.com), which explains every prediction. The FBC carries a real but moderate signal for CKD, and the 22.4 point gap between the two protocols quantifies how far a single preprocessing decision can move a reported accuracy.
zh_abstract: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）在晚期之前通常无症状，而在撒哈拉以南非洲，确诊所需的检测往往难以负担，相比之下全血细胞计数（FBC）价格低廉且被广泛开展。我们评估了应用于FBC的机器学习能否检测CKD，以及其报告的性能在多大程度上取决于合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）的应用位置。加纳霍技术大学医院155例患者的记录（其中43例[27.7%]患有CKD）提供了十个特征：年龄、心血管疾病和八项原始FBC参数。我们在重复分层交叉验证下比较了11种算法、6种重采样策略和13种集成方法。当SMOTE在训练-测试划分之前应用时（即已部署模型所采用的方案），随机森林和极端随机树的准确率均为83.9%，敏感性分别为0.893和0.857，曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.925和0.939；重复交叉验证得到的准确率为0.809 ± 0.051，AUC为0.897。当重采样仅限于训练折时，相同特征在39例未见患者中的留出准确率为61.5%，AUC为0.604。在多重检验校正后，年龄是唯一区分两组的变量（中位数64岁对47岁，校正后 p = 0.0026）。这些模型已作为 NephroScan GH（https://nephroscangh.com）部署，可解释每一项预测。FBC对CKD携带真实但中等程度的信号，两种方案之间22.4个百分点的差距量化了单一预处理决策能在多大程度上改变所报告的准确率。

title: Barriers and facilitators to healthcare artificial intelligence adoption in Wales: findings from focus groups.
zh_title: 威尔士医疗AI应用的障碍与促进因素：焦点小组
summary: 四个焦点小组共21人，经主题分析探讨公众、医护等群体对医疗AI采用的障碍与促进因素，供政策参考。
key_points: 四组：公众、医护、六年级学生、退休人员
共21名参与者，归纳主题分析
结果用于威尔士政策制定
reason: 小样本定性研究，政策参考价值有限，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Building on a previous Wales-wide survey, this study aimed to provide more in-depth exploration of the barriers and facilitators to healthcare artificial intelligence adoption in Wales. The study aimed to explore these barriers and facilitators among various social groups, to inform policy development in Wales. Four focus groups were conducted with a group of members of the public and a group of healthcare professionals (both groups recruited from a previous survey), as well as a group Sixth Form students and a group of retired adults. Inductive thematic analysis was used to generate themes and to compare the issues raised by the various groups. Contiguity-based analysis was undertaken to underscore how themes related with each other. A total of 21 individuals participated in the focus groups (healthcare professionals=6, members of the public=6, sixth-form students=5, retirees=4). Seven thematic networks were identified. Across groups, seven themes were identified in the healthcare professional group, six in the general members of the public group, seven in the sixth form student group, and seven in the retiree group. All groups voiced concerns about data privacy and highlighted the importance of human oversight of AI and human contact during the clinical encounter as they expressed more trust in human practitioners. There were though differences between groups, such as greater trust in black-box systems by healthcare professionals, and between individual participants in regard to trust in private organisations developing AI for healthcare organisations. All groups were concerned with information security and expressed a preference for human contact during the clinical encounter and a human-in-the-loop approach. There were differences between the groups, such as in attitudes towards black-box AI technologies and trust in clinicians. No additional barriers or facilitators were identified for proxy consent.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] 本研究在此前一项威尔士全境调查的基础上，旨在更深入地探讨威尔士医疗人工智能应用的障碍与促进因素。本研究旨在探索不同社会群体中的这些障碍与促进因素，为威尔士的政策制定提供参考。共开展了四个焦点小组，分别为一组公众成员和一组医疗专业人员（两组均从此前的调查中招募），以及一组高中高年级（Sixth Form）学生和一组退休成年人。采用归纳式主题分析生成主题，并比较各群体提出的问题。采用基于邻近性的分析来突出主题之间的相互关系。共有21人参加焦点小组（医疗专业人员=6人，公众成员=6人，高中高年级学生=5人，退休人员=4人）。共确定了七个主题网络。各群体中，医疗专业人员组确定了七个主题，一般公众组六个，高中高年级学生组七个，退休人员组七个。所有群体都表达了对数据隐私的担忧，并强调人工智能需要有人工监督、临床诊疗过程中需要有人际接触，因为他们对人类从业者表达了更多信任。不过，各群体之间存在差异，例如医疗专业人员对黑箱系统的信任度更高；个体参与者之间在是否信任为医疗机构开发医疗人工智能的私营组织方面也存在差异。所有群体都关注信息安全，并表示更倾向于在临床诊疗过程中有人际接触以及采用人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的方式。各群体之间存在差异，例如对黑箱人工智能技术的态度以及对临床医生的信任。未发现针对代理同意的其他障碍或促进因素。

summary: AnySleep可对任意EEG/EOG数据按可调时间分辨率进行睡眠分期，在28个数据集、超2万条整夜记录上训练和验证，表现达到或优于现有方法。

abstract: Sleep is essential for health, yet studying its dynamics requires manual sleep staging, a labor-intensive step in research and clinical care. Across centers, polysomnography (PSG) recordings are traditionally scored in 30-s epochs for pragmatic, not physiological, reasons and vary in electrode count, montage, and subject characteristics. These constraints challenge harmonized multi-center studies and the discovery of robust biomarkers on shorter timescales. We present AnySleep, a deep neural network that scores sleep from any electroencephalography (EEG) or electrooculography (EOG) data at adjustable temporal resolutions. We trained and validated the model on over 20,000 overnight recordings (>200,000 h of EEG and EOG) from 28 datasets across multiple clinics to promote robust generalization across sites. The model attains state-of-the-art performance and surpasses or equals established baselines at 30-s epochs. Performance improves with more channels, yet remains strong when EOG is absent, or only EOG or single EEG derivations (frontal, central, or occipital) are available. On sub-30-s timescales, the model captures short wake intrusions consistent with arousals and improves the prediction of pathophysiological conditions (obstructive sleep apnea, narcolepsy type 1, insomnia) over 30-s scoring. We make the model publicly available to facilitate large-scale studies with heterogeneous electrode setups and accelerate biomarker discovery in sleep.

abstract: Missed specialist referrals in primary care pose substantial health and medico-legal risks, yet remain poorly understood. We developed an AI-supported safety system (MR-AI) to identify missed referrals from consultation notes, evaluated in a quasi-experimental study across seven primary care clinics in Singapore. MR-AI scanned ~25,000 notes weekly for referral intent without a corresponding order, achieving an estimated sevenfold increase in weekly missed referral detection (4.7 percentage point level increase; 95% CI 0.024–0.069; p < 0.001). Of 428 cases flagged, 225 were clinician-verified, alongside 31 patient-reported cases, yielding 256 total detections. MR-AI demonstrated 99.9% specificity and 48.8% sensitivity. In a blinded one-week comparison against seven physician reviewers, MR-AI achieved a PPV of 61.8% versus a human confirmation rate of 51.8% across 83 flagged cases, while requiring approximately 41 fewer projected staff-hours. AI-enabled surveillance substantially assisted in missed referral detection, though sustainable improvement will require complementary preventive workflow changes and future cost-effectiveness assessment.
zh_abstract: 基层医疗中漏转专科会诊带来重大的健康风险和医疗法律风险，但目前对其了解仍十分有限。我们开发了一种人工智能辅助的安全系统（MR-AI），可从诊疗记录中识别漏转诊，并在新加坡七家基层医疗诊所开展了一项准实验研究对其进行评估。MR-AI 每周扫描约 25,000 份诊疗记录，查找存在转诊意图但无相应转诊医嘱的情况，估计使每周漏转诊的检出量提高了七倍（水平上升 4.7 个百分点；95% CI 0.024–0.069；p < 0.001）。在 428 例被标记的病例中，225 例经临床医生核实，另有 31 例由患者报告，共检出 256 例。MR-AI 的特异度为 99.9%，敏感度为 48.8%。在与七名医师审阅者进行的为期一周的盲法比较中，针对 83 例被标记病例，MR-AI 的阳性预测值（PPV）为 61.8%，而人工确认率为 51.8%，同时预计可减少约 41 个工时的人力投入。人工智能支持的监测显著促进了漏转诊的发现，但要实现可持续的改善，仍需配合预防性的工作流程调整，并有待未来开展成本效益评估。

title: Interpretable graph learning of spatial TME patterns in digital pathology for gastric cancer prognosis

abstract: Current gastric cancer (GC) risk stratification, based on TNM staging and molecular subtypes, often fails to capture intratumoral heterogeneity driving variable outcomes. Although the tumor microenvironment (TME) spatial architecture within histopathological images holds critical prognostic value, quantifying these interactions remains challenging. We present the Graph-based Tumor Microenvironment Aggregation (GTMA) framework, an interpretable deep learning approach modeling whole-slide images as spatial graphs to decipher tissue interactions. Validated in a large cohort ( n = 1871) and TCGA-STAD dataset ( n = 213), the GTMA-derived Risk Score (RS) provided prognostic information complementary to TNM staging and clinical models. Notably, the RS stratified patients into distinct risk groups within identical TNM stages and molecular subtypes, identifying high-risk patients traditionally overlooked. Integrative analysis revealed high-RS tumors feature a fibroblast-dominant, immune-excluded phenotype and distinct stromal spatial patterns. By linking digital pathology to biological TME patterns, GTMA offers a robust, interpretable AI tool for individualized prognostic risk stratification and precision oncology in GC.
zh_abstract: 目前基于TNM分期和分子亚型的胃癌（GC）风险分层，往往无法反映导致预后差异的肿瘤内异质性。尽管组织病理图像中肿瘤微环境（TME）的空间结构具有重要的预后价值，但对这些相互作用进行量化仍具挑战。我们提出了基于图的肿瘤微环境聚合（Graph-based Tumor Microenvironment Aggregation，GTMA）框架，这是一种可解释的深度学习方法，将全切片图像建模为空间图，以解析组织间的相互作用。在一个大型队列（n = 1871）和TCGA-STAD数据集（n = 213）中验证表明，GTMA衍生的风险评分（RS）可提供与TNM分期及临床模型互补的预后信息。值得注意的是，RS可在相同TNM分期和分子亚型内将患者分为不同的风险组，识别出传统上被忽视的高风险患者。整合分析显示，高RS肿瘤具有成纤维细胞占主导、免疫排斥的表型以及独特的基质空间模式。通过将数字病理与TME的生物学模式相联系，GTMA为胃癌个体化预后风险分层和精准肿瘤学提供了一种稳健、可解释的人工智能工具。

abstract: Recruiting participants for clinical trials is a challenge, often limited by inefficient methods for identifying eligible candidates. Clinical trial recruitment support systems (CTRSS) can enhance recruitment efficiency by leveraging data from electronic health records (EHR). We evaluated two CTRSS-recruIT and KAS+-to quantify their real-world impact on enrollment. Within the German MIRACUM consortium, we conducted a multicenter segmented interrupted time-series (ITS) evaluation across six university hospitals. Twenty-nine trials contributed 814 observation weeks spanning a control phase (usual practice) and an intervention phase (CTRSS active). Weekly enrollments were compared using segmented negative binomial mixed models estimating level and slope changes at implementation, complemented by Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. A criteria revision covariate captured iterative refinement of computable cohort definitions. In pooled ITS analyses, we observed neither a statistically significant immediate level change nor a statistically significant post-implementation slope change in weekly enrollments. Effects were highly heterogeneous across trials and specialties; implemented eligibility logic most often relied on diagnosis, age, and visit data, while laboratory values and structured observations were seldom available. Higher values of the criteria revision covariate were associated with higher recruitment in some settings, with the most exploratory signal observed at the single KAS+ site. Despite the potential benefits of CTRSS, their effectiveness depends on careful customization and implementation. Overall, our findings suggest that CTRSS impact is context-dependent and that measurable benefit is more likely driven by iterative computable phenotyping and local workflow fit rather than a simple "switch-on" effect. Context-specific adaptation and continual revision of eligibility logic appear critical to realizing benefit. Future studies should reduce trial heterogeneity, strengthen compliance incentives, and employ granular outcomes, such as identification-to-enrollment latency, to better capture workflow-mediated effects.

abstract: Immune-related adverse events (irAEs) affect up to 40% of patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors, yet identification requires laborious, inconsistent manual chart review. Here we show that agentic artificial intelligence coupled with human verification could enhance efficiency, performance and consistency for irAE assessment. We developed and evaluated an agentic large language model system to extract the presence, temporality, severity grade, attribution and certainty of six irAE types from clinical notes. Retrospectively, the system achieved a macro-averaged F1 of 0.92 for current-event detection and 0.66 for multi-class severity grading; self-consistency improved F1 by 0.14. The best-performing configuration cost approximately US$0.02 per note. In prospective silent deployment over 3 months, the binary F1 was 0.72–0.79. In a randomized crossover study of clinical trial staff, agentic assistance reduced annotation time by 2.71 min (P < 0.001), increased complete-match accuracy (odds ratio 1.45; 95% confidence interval 1.01–2.08; P = 0.045) and improved interannotator agreement (Krippendorff’s α from 0.22–0.51 to 0.82–0.85).
zh_abstract: 免疫相关不良事件（irAE）影响多达40%接受免疫检查点抑制剂治疗的患者，但其识别需要费力且不一致的人工病历审查。在此我们表明，智能体（agentic）人工智能结合人工核验可以提高irAE评估的效率、性能和一致性。我们开发并评估了一种智能体大语言模型系统，用于从临床记录中提取六种irAE类型的存在情况、时间性、严重程度分级、归因和确定性。回顾性分析中，该系统在当前事件检测上的宏平均F1为0.92，在多分类严重程度分级上为0.66；自一致性使F1提高了0.14。表现最佳的配置每份记录的成本约为0.02美元。在为期3个月的前瞻性静默部署中，二分类F1为0.72–0.79。在一项针对临床试验工作人员的随机交叉研究中，智能体辅助使标注时间减少了2.71分钟（P < 0.001），提高了完全匹配准确率（比值比1.45；95%置信区间1.01–2.08；P = 0.045），并改善了标注者间一致性（Krippendorff's α 由0.22–0.51提高到0.82–0.85）。

abstract: Foundation models trained on longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can predict clinical diagnoses years in the future, making them a potential tool for disease screening. We developed TRACER (Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations), a decoder-based foundation model pretrained on data from over 4.5 million patients from four health systems, and evaluated it on 16 incident diseases at 1-, 2-, and 5-year horizons in more than 2 million patients from two health systems excluded from model development. In contrast to typical evaluations that focus on global metrics (e.g., AUROC), we measured performance at the low false-positive rates that are realistic for screening. We found that TRACER retained its discrimination in external health systems, and at 95% specificity, the patients it flagged were up to eight times more likely to be diagnosed within a year than unselected patients. Evaluating at this operating point also revealed what global metrics alone did not: detection and false-alert burden varied across diseases and health systems, even when discrimination appeared stable. Our results illustrate the potential of foundation models for screening and underscore the need for evaluation in health systems excluded from development to assess disease detection and false-alert burden at levels appropriate for intended clinical use.}
zh_abstract: 基于纵向电子健康记录（EHR）训练的基础模型可以预测未来数年的临床诊断，使其成为疾病筛查的潜在工具。我们开发了 TRACER（Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations），这是一种基于解码器的基础模型，使用来自四个医疗系统的450多万名患者的数据进行预训练，并在两个未参与模型开发的医疗系统中的200多万名患者中，针对16种新发疾病在1年、2年和5年时间范围内进行了评估。与通常关注全局指标（如 AUROC）的评估不同，我们在筛查中现实可行的低假阳性率下衡量了性能。我们发现，TRACER 在外部医疗系统中保持了其区分能力；在95%特异度下，被其标记的患者在一年内被诊断的可能性最高可达未经选择患者的八倍。在该工作点进行评估还揭示了仅凭全局指标无法发现的情况：即使区分能力看似稳定，不同疾病和不同医疗系统之间的检出率和假警报负担也存在差异。我们的结果说明了基础模型用于筛查的潜力，并强调有必要在未参与开发的医疗系统中进行评估，以便在适合预期临床用途的水平上评估疾病检出情况和假警报负担。

abstract: [NPJ precision oncology] Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) with IDH1 mutations is amenable to targeted therapy, highlighting the need for reliable identification. We developed an attention-based multiple-instance learning model to predict IDH1 mutation status using bone marrow smear whole-slide images from 436 AML patients across four centers in Germany and the US, achieving a mean single pooled ROC-AUC of 0.81. abstract: Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 医学人工智能（AI）从医生记录的答案中学习，却很少从医生如何解读证据并得出这些答案的过程中学习。本文介绍PathCowork，这是一个将病理医生口述的阅片检查转化为视觉定位监督信号以及指导诊断AI智能体的流程的框架。同步的视线、口述和导航记录将视觉发现与其解读过程联系起来。在来自16位病理医生的48次会话中，该平台记录了1,028分钟的切片阅片。利用这些数据，我们训练了用于服务器部署的PathCowork-1T和用于本地部署的PathCowork-27B，其视觉定位能力有所提升。在五项器官特异性评估中，将这种定位能力与所记录的诊断流程相结合的智能体，其主要任务得分平均分别比Claude Code和Codex高17.9和24.1个百分点，同时处理时间更短、推理成本更低。与最先进的多实例学习（multiple-instance learning）AI相比，PathCowork智能体提出的区域在仅有有限切片标签的情况下取得了更高的前列腺分级得分。PathCowork还可帮助构建病理AI基准，其中源自这些记录的问题揭示了在识别观察情境和拒绝不适用前提方面的困难。总之，PathCowork提出了一种新范式，即通过诊断会话中透明的推理来扩大数据采集规模并训练病理AI，为直接从常规临床实践中学习的系统开辟了道路。

abstract: Digital mental health technologies hold promise, yet their integration into routine care remains challenging. This study reports findings from an implementation workshop conducted midway through an ongoing multi-site randomized controlled trial (RCT) evaluating a smartphone-based relapse prevention app for patients with schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder. Sixteen stakeholders, including developers, researchers, and clinicians, discussed experiences and barriers using a semi-structured agenda, incorporating prior feedback from three focus groups with people with lived experience, and analyzed the discussions using an adopted R(E)-AIM framework (Reach, Adoption, Implementation, and Maintenance). Findings highlight the need for structural, technical, and personnel adjustments to support sustainable implementation. Key recommendations include integrating digital tools into discharge planning, enhancing interdisciplinary collaboration, delegating digital responsibilities, and streamlining technical workflows to facilitate seamless adoption. These insights inform feasibility considerations and strategic requirements for digital interventions in severe mental illness, offering guidance for future RCTs and practice-oriented integration of digital therapeutics in psychiatric care.

abstract: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is aggressive, treatment-sensitive, and prone to relapse. This Review evaluates how generative AI, graph neural networks, molecular language and diffusion models, structure-based design, and multimodal learning can exploit SCLC dependencies for small-molecule discovery. It integrates biomarker-guided patient stratification, resistance, combination therapy, medicinal chemistry, pharmacology, safety, manufacturing, and clinical translation, emphasizing benchmarked, uncertainty-aware, prospectively validated design–build–test–learn workflows.

title: A Fast and Generalizable Deep Neural Network for the Detection of Atrial Fibrillation.
zh_title: 快速可泛化的房颤检测深度神经网络

key_points: 12导联10秒ECG二分类房颤检测
六个独立公开队列、逾125万条记录

reason: 同行评审，六个独立队列外部验证、超百万记录，属重要档
abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Atrial fibrillation (AFib) is the most prevalent sustained cardiac arrhythmia, yet most deep learning detectors are validated on a single cohort and few report uncertainty. We developed a compact 14M-parameter convolutional neural network for binary AFib classification from 10 s, 12-lead ECG at 500 Hz, trained exclusively on the HDXML dataset (67,432 ECGs; 9628 AFib) with on-the-fly augmentation for noise, drift and missing channels. Using one unchanged checkpoint, we evaluated six independently sourced public cohorts totaling over 1.25 million recordings, including MIMIC-IV critical care and two ambulatory Holter cohorts. All metrics are reported with 95% confidence intervals from a cluster bootstrap at the patient, recording or subject levels. ROC-AUC exceeded 0.95 in every cohort, from 0.960 (95% CI 0.956-0.963) on CODE-15 to 0.999 (0.998-0.999) on SPH, including 0.966 (0.965-0.967) on MIMIC-IV with 75.3% sensitivity and 97.7% specificity, 0.963 (0.929-0.987) on CPSC 2021 and 0.995 (0.988-0.999) on MIT-BIH. Performance was stable under progressive lead masking without retraining, and median inference took 110 ms per segment on a server-class CPU without a GPU. A compact network trained on one curated source can therefore generalize across hospitals, countries and recording hardware. This study is retrospective; prospective validation is required before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] 心房颤动（AFib）是最常见的持续性心律失常，但大多数深度学习检测器仅在单一队列中验证，且很少报告不确定性。我们开发了一种紧凑的、含1400万参数的卷积神经网络，用于对500 Hz、10秒、12导联心电图进行AFib二分类，仅在HDXML数据集（67,432份心电图；9628例AFib）上训练，并采用针对噪声、基线漂移和缺失通道的在线数据增强。我们使用同一个未作修改的检查点，评估了六个独立来源的公共队列，总计超过125万份记录，包括MIMIC-IV重症监护队列和两个动态（Holter）门诊队列。所有指标均报告基于患者、记录或受试者层面的聚类自助法（cluster bootstrap）得到的95%置信区间。所有队列的ROC-AUC均超过0.95，从CODE-15上的0.960（95% CI 0.956-0.963）到SPH上的0.999（0.998-0.999），其中MIMIC-IV上为0.966（0.965-0.967），敏感性为75.3%，特异性为97.7%；CPSC 2021上为0.963（0.929-0.987），MIT-BIH上为0.995（0.988-0.999）。在不重新训练的情况下，逐步遮蔽导联时性能保持稳定，且在无GPU的服务器级CPU上，每段推理时间中位数为110毫秒。因此，在单一精选数据来源上训练的紧凑网络可以在不同医院、国家和记录设备之间实现泛化。本研究为回顾性研究；临床使用前需进行前瞻性验证。

title: Rethinking Health Care Regulatory Sandboxes Under the European Union AI Act.
zh_title: 重新思考欧盟AI法案下的医疗监管沙盒
summary: 观点文章分析欧盟AI法案下医疗监管沙盒，并提出沙盒设计建议，包括记录模型压缩技术等。
key_points: 聚焦AI法案下的国家级监管沙盒
政策导向分析并给出设计建议
建议记录可能影响模型的压缩技术
reason: 监管政策观点，有参考价值但属观点上限
abstract: [JMIR AI] AI models have enabled substantial advances in health care. Since the entry into force of the European Union (EU) AI Act in 2024, these systems have become subject to a common regulatory framework in the EU intended to harmonize AI governance across all member states. One of the act's distinctive features is that it accommodates existing economic, technological, and regulatory differences among European countries by leaving certain implementation responsibilities to national authorities. This is evident in regulatory sandboxes, supervised environments for developing, testing, and validating AI systems before deployment. In this viewpoint, we provide a policy-oriented analysis of health care regulatory sandboxes under the EU AI Act and propose recommendations for their design. These recommendations address the need to document model compression techniques that may affect the classification of large high-risk systems above the 1025 floating point operations per second threshold, incorporate explainability into AI systems from the design stage, identify and document biases in health care datasets, clarify the treatment of federated learning parameter updates under the General Data Protection Regulation, and strengthen the oversight of AI agents in clinical environments. The implementation timeline makes this discussion particularly timely given the approaching deadline of August 2, 2027, by which all member states must have established at least one national regulatory sandbox.
zh_abstract: [JMIR AI] 人工智能（AI）模型已推动医疗保健领域取得实质性进展。自2024年欧盟（EU）《人工智能法案》生效以来，这些系统在欧盟范围内须遵守统一的监管框架，旨在协调所有成员国的AI治理。该法案的一个显著特点是，通过将某些实施职责交由各国主管部门承担，兼顾了欧洲各国在经济、技术和监管方面的现有差异。这一点体现在监管沙盒上，即在部署前用于开发、测试和验证AI系统的受监督环境。在这篇观点文章中，我们对欧盟《人工智能法案》下的医疗保健监管沙盒进行了面向政策的分析，并就其设计提出建议。这些建议涉及以下方面：需记录可能影响大型高风险系统是否超过10^25 每秒浮点运算次数阈值这一分类的模型压缩技术；从设计阶段起即将可解释性纳入AI系统；识别并记录医疗保健数据集中的偏倚；厘清联邦学习参数更新在《通用数据保护条例》下的处理方式；以及加强对临床环境中AI智能体的监督。鉴于各成员国须在2027年8月2日前至少建立一个国家级监管沙盒这一截止日期临近，实施时间表使这一讨论尤为及时。

title: SpaCut: Transcript-Aware Morphology Fusion for Robust Cell Segmentation in Subcellular Spatial Transcriptomics.
zh_title: SpaCut：融合转录本与形态的亚细胞空间转录组细胞分割
summary: 提出统一深度学习框架，将转录组特征学习与动态形态学引导结合，用于亚细胞空间转录组数据的细胞分割。
key_points: 针对转录本空间组织被忽视的问题
融合转录本特征与形态引导

reason: 同行评审的新方法，但摘要未见外部验证细节，属值得一看档
abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] Subcellular Spatial Transcriptomics (SST) offers unprecedented opportunities to decipher tissue architecture at subcellular resolution. Consequently, accurate cell segmentation is a fundamental prerequisite for analyzing SST data, as precise transcript assignment is essential for downstream single-cell interpretation. Existing methods often overlook the spatial organization of transcripts, rely on simplified geometric priors, or struggle to coordinate transcript-derived features with morphology-derived spatial guidance. This limitation restricts their adaptability to irregular cell shapes, often leading to transcript misassignment. To address this, we propose SpaCut, a unified deep learning framework designed to effectively integrate transcriptomic feature learning with dynamic morphological guidance. SpaCut comprises a Gene-Wise Attention (GWA) module and a Nuclei-Guided Attentive Fusion (NGAF) module. GWA encodes the high-dimensional transcript map and aggregates features across multiple depths. NGAF uses the encoded transcript features to modulate distance-based nuclear softmasks and refine nucleus-anchored cell boundaries through progressive training. Extensive evaluations across seven datasets from diverse platforms (including Xenium, CosMx, MERSCOPE, and Stereo-seq) demonstrate that SpaCut significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both segmentation accuracy and consistency with single-cell reference data. The source code is available at https://github.com/wenwenmin/SpaCut.
zh_abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] 亚细胞空间转录组学（Subcellular Spatial Transcriptomics，SST）为在亚细胞分辨率下解析组织结构提供了前所未有的机遇。因此，准确的细胞分割是分析 SST 数据的基本前提，因为精确的转录本归属对于下游单细胞层面的解读至关重要。现有方法往往忽视转录本的空间组织，依赖简化的几何先验，或难以协调由转录本衍生的特征与由形态学衍生的空间引导。这一局限限制了它们对不规则细胞形状的适应能力，常导致转录本误分配。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SpaCut，这是一个统一的深度学习框架，旨在有效整合转录组特征学习与动态形态学引导。SpaCut 包含基因级注意力（Gene-Wise Attention，GWA）模块和细胞核引导的注意力融合（Nuclei-Guided Attentive Fusion，NGAF）模块。GWA 对高维转录本图进行编码，并在多个深度上聚合特征。NGAF 利用编码后的转录本特征来调制基于距离的细胞核软掩膜，并通过渐进式训练优化以细胞核为锚点的细胞边界。在来自不同平台（包括 Xenium、CosMx、MERSCOPE 和 Stereo-seq）的七个数据集上进行的大量评估表明，SpaCut 在分割准确性以及与单细胞参考数据的一致性方面均显著优于最先进的方法。源代码可在 https://github.com/wenwenmin/SpaCut 获取。

abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.

title: Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records

summary: 预印本提出CEDAR智能体流程，利用2489例T2D和4018例T1D青少年多模态记录预测并发症，AUC高于传统机器学习。
