key_points: 面向S-ICD和EV-ICD的24小时筛查框架
AmpRatioNet直接处理ECG信号
首次完整评估P:R预测（作者声称）
reason: 预印本，摘要未见外部验证，方法增量
abstract: This paper studies two non-transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), namely the Subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and the Extravascular ICD (EV-ICD). Both avoid the complications of transvenous leads but are prone to oversensing, which can trigger inappropriate shocks associated with increased mortality. Oversensing risk is predicted by the ratio of T- or P-wave amplitude to R-wave amplitude (T:R, P:R), and these ratios vary over a 24-hour period. Yet S-ICD screening uses a single 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) segment, and the EV-ICD has no formal screening protocol whatsoever. We present a 24-hour ambulatory screening framework for both devices which includes the first T:R analysis in an EV-ICD cohort and the first full evaluation of P:R prediction. We introduce AmpRatioNet, a family of 1D convolutional neural network architectures operating directly on the ECG signal, and benchmark it against the best existing approach - based on 2D phase space reconstruction images. Evaluation uses 4,605 clinician-annotated 10-second segments from 89 patients, with patient-level 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap confidence intervals. AmpRatioNet-SE demonstrates superior performance on every metric in each setting with no device- or ratio-specific redesign. An explainability analysis against interpretable classical peak labelling algorithms shows that AmpRatioNet-SE's increase in error on oversensing-prone segments is up to 14 times smaller than theirs. Segment-level predictions are aggregated into a 24-hour timeline, extending S-ICD screening beyond 10 seconds and offering a plausible EV-ICD screening pathway pending device-level validation.
zh_abstract: 本文研究两种非经静脉植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD），即皮下ICD（S-ICD）和血管外ICD（EV-ICD）。二者均可避免经静脉电极导线的并发症，但易发生感知过度，进而可能触发与死亡率增加相关的不恰当电击。感知过度的风险可通过T波或P波振幅与R波振幅之比（T:R、P:R）进行预测，而这些比值在24小时内会发生变化。然而，S-ICD筛查仅使用单个10秒心电图（ECG）片段，而EV-ICD则完全没有正式的筛查方案。我们提出了一种适用于两种装置的24小时动态筛查框架，其中包括首次在EV-ICD队列中进行的T:R分析以及首次对P:R预测的全面评估。我们提出了AmpRatioNet，这是一类直接作用于ECG信号的一维卷积神经网络架构，并将其与现有最佳方法（基于二维相空间重构图像）进行比较。评估使用来自89例患者的4,605个经临床医生标注的10秒片段，采用患者水平的10折交叉验证和bootstrap置信区间。AmpRatioNet-SE在每种设置下的各项指标上均表现更优，且无需针对装置或比值进行专门的重新设计。与可解释的经典峰值标注算法相比，可解释性分析显示AmpRatioNet-SE在易发生感知过度的片段上的误差增幅最多比它们小14倍。片段水平的预测被汇总为24小时时间线，将S-ICD筛查延伸至10秒以上，并在待装置层面验证的前提下为EV-ICD提供了一条可行的筛查途径。

title: Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data
zh_title: 视觉断层成像：从视觉数据双向推断三维面部与颅骨
summary: 预印本提出Vision Tomography框架，从多种视觉模态重建成对的三维面部与颅骨几何，并支持联合编辑，构建了200余例CT配对数据集。
key_points: 提出便携、无辐射的颅骨几何获取思路
构建含CT颅骨、CT面部与纹理扫描的200余例数据集
提出稠密射线匹配配准方法
reason: 新颖方法预印本，数据集小，缺少临床验证
abstract: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM
zh_abstract: 传统计算机断层扫描（CT）可以获取成对的三维面部与颅骨几何结构，但其成本高昂、位置固定，并使患者暴露于辐射之下。对于远程诊断、数字医疗、法医身份识别、失踪人员调查和考古分析等应用，迫切需要一种便携、安全且易于获得的三维颅骨几何获取方案。在本工作中，我们提出了视觉断层成像（Vision Tomography，VT），这是一种能够从多种视觉模态重建成对三维面部-颅骨几何结构、并支持对三维面部和颅骨几何进行联合操控的概念与框架。为此，我们首先构建了一个包含 200 多个样本的数据集，其中每个病例包括一个基于 CT 的颅骨、一个基于 CT 的面部以及一个高保真带纹理的面部扫描。其次，我们提出了一种新颖的稠密射线匹配配准方法，可确保面部、颅骨及其组织对应关系之间的拓扑一致性。在该配准基础上，我们提出了三维双向面部-颅骨可变形模型（3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model，BFSM）作为 Vision Tomography 的基础，该模型通过共享系数空间实现面部与颅骨之间的形状推断，同时对组织厚度变化进行建模，以支持从同一颅骨进行一对多的面部重建，从而反映年龄或体脂等个体面部变化。最后，我们展示了 Vision Tomography 在多种法医和医学应用中的有效性，包括从图像或草图重建成对三维面部-颅骨，以及通过面部-颅骨联合编辑预测手术效果。大量实验证实了我们方法的稳健性和准确性。Vision Tomography 可在 https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM 获取。

title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 医疗从业者视角下的算法偏见
summary: 基于对医疗专业人员的问卷与访谈，研究算法偏见、感知公平与对机器学习算法接受/采用意愿之间的关系，发现看法因岗位角色等而异。
key_points: 问卷与访谈覆盖临床与行政等不同岗位
偏见成因、评估标准与缓解方式的看法因角色而异
作者指出仍需更多研究以保障公平
reason: 预印本，调查类研究，样本与验证信息有限，属增量档
abstract: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.
zh_abstract: 本文关注医疗信息系统中机器学习和人工智能应用的算法偏倚。基于对不同岗位角色（如临床与行政）的医疗专业人员进行的调查和访谈所得的定量数据和定性意见，本研究给出了算法偏倚、感知公平性与对机器学习算法及算法生成结果的预期接受和采纳之间关系的研究发现。结果表明，医疗专业人员对算法偏倚的成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性及偏倚缓解方法的看法，可能因其岗位角色、视角、任务以及算法特征而异。需要开展更多研究来探讨算法偏倚，以确保医疗中的公平与平等。

title: CARF: Context-Aware Reasoning Supervision for Scientific Evidence Screening
zh_title: CARF：面向科学证据筛选的上下文感知推理监督
summary: 提出人在回路框架CARF，利用专家对模型推理的反馈，使语言模型适应系统综述标题摘要筛选；在死因判定方法综述上表现有竞争力且保持高敏感度。
key_points: 专家反馈模型生成的推理以适配语境
评估对象为死因/口头尸检系统综述
筛选性能有竞争力并保持高敏感度
reason: 新方法预印本，领域较窄，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Systematic reviews synthesize biomedical evidence to inform clinical and public-health decision-making, but require domain experts to manually screen thousands of studies against detailed eligibility criteria. We investigate whether language models can assist with this bottleneck by learning from expert feedback on title and abstract screening decisions and model-generated reasoning. We introduce the Context-Aware Reasoning Framework (CARF), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses expert feedback on model-generated reasoning to adapt language models to context-dependent screening tasks. We evaluate CARF on systematic reviews of verbal autopsy and cause-of-death ascertainment methods used in global public health mortality surveillance. CARF shows competitive screening performance compared to evaluated models while retaining high sensitivity, and is more inclined to retain ambiguous, context-dependent studies for human review. Together, these findings suggest that expert-corrected reasoning is a promising supervision signal for context-dependent scientific screening, while retaining a role for human oversight.

title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
zh_title: 医学影像负责任量子机器学习：跨敏感亚组的公平性审计
summary: 在皮肤病变(DDI)与胸片(CheXpert)上审计经典与量子分类器的亚组公平性，并测试多种缓解方法，PanDerm、EVA-X作外部参照。
key_points: 比较SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN
测试EO正则、梯度反转等缓解
量子分类器总体有竞争力但仍存亚组差异
reason: 公平性审计有新意但为预印本，量子方法实用性有限
abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.
zh_abstract: 量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类中的探索日益增多，但其在亚组感知公平性标准下的表现仍研究不足。我们在假设QML并非天然公平的前提下，对用于医学影像的经典与量子分类器开展了实证公平性审计。评估了两种场景：DDI数据集上的皮肤病变（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）和基于CheXpert的数据上的胸部X线（敏感属性：年龄组）。基于ResNet-18嵌入，我们在基线及三种缓解设置下训练SVM、MLP、QSVM和QCNN：可微分均等化几率（EO）正则化、梯度反转学习（GRL）以及二者联合。基础模型（PanDerm、EVA-X）作为外部参照。量子分类器可能取得具有竞争力的总体性能，但仍存在亚组差异。由于较小的亚组AUC差距可能源于降低最优组的表现而非改善最差组，每种缓解方法还相对于其基线，针对预先设定的非劣效性界值进行了检验。在该标准下，若干差异最小的配置（尤其是DDI上采用GRL的QCNN）因整体判别能力下降而在临床上不可接受。在DDI上，采用GRL+EO的QSVM表现最佳，在性能/公平性权衡方面接近PanDerm；在CheXpert上，采用GRL的QCNN取得最高的总体性能，但差异增大，而EVA-X仍更强。公平性效应取决于模型和数据集，因此QML需要经验性的亚组感知评估。所有量子模型均在经典模拟中运行；我们不主张存在量子优势。

title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
zh_title: 决策模型与生成式大模型在医学选择题上的基准比较
summary: 在1273道MedQA四选一题上比较13个决策模型与15种生成式LLM配置，生成式配置准确率更高，决策模型在成本和延迟上有优势。
key_points: 高置信答案仍有1.71%–12.77%错误
reason: 选择题基准比较，无临床验证，预印本，增量档
abstract: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options. We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions. Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations. Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds). Decision-model probabilities distinguished correct from incorrect answers, but error rates among answers assigned probabilities of at least 0.90 ranged from 1.71% to 12.77%. Answer agreement across three runs ranged from 92.30% to 100%, while probability repeatability varied. Decision models offered resource advantages alongside lower peak accuracy; selecting models for medical workflows requires considering probability quality and repeatability together with accuracy and the resources needed to detect and correct errors.
zh_abstract: 医疗工作流程常常需要在预设选项中进行选择。我们在纯文本条件下，使用1,273道四选一MedQA题目，比较了13个决策模型与15种生成式大语言模型配置（包括不同的推理设置）。决策模型的准确率为67.71%至89.08%，生成式配置的准确率为78.32%至96.86%。在所测试的配置中，Mercury Decide的平均末次尝试成本最低（每1,000道题0.0069美元），Clef Omni的请求耗时中位数最短（0.291秒）。决策模型的概率可区分正确与错误答案，但在被赋予至少0.90概率的答案中，错误率为1.71%至12.77%。三次运行间的答案一致性为92.30%至100%，而概率的可重复性各不相同。决策模型在资源方面具有优势，但峰值准确率较低；为医疗工作流程选择模型时，需要将概率质量和可重复性，与准确率以及发现和纠正错误所需的资源一并考虑。

title: LLMs as Judges and Examinees for Medical Item Difficulty Prediction
zh_title: 以LLM为评判者与模拟考生预测医学试题难度
summary: 利用开源LLM在USMLE与PANCE试题上的难度评分及作答信号（正确性、概率、熵等），结合基线特征预测题目难度。
key_points: LLM分别担任难度评判者与模拟考生
提取正确性、选项概率、熵、概率间隔等信号
与基线题目特征结合用于下游预测
reason: 医学教育方向的预印本方法，证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Predicting medical item difficulty from item text alone remains challenging. Prior work has largely relied on linguistic features or text representations derived from general-purpose and domain-specific language models, but predictive performance has remained modest. This study takes a different approach by using difficulty-related signals that emerge when open-weight large language models (LLMs) interact with test items. Using USMLE and PANCE medical licensure examination items, we examined LLMs in two roles. As judges, the models provided absolute difficulty ratings and pairwise difficulty comparisons. As simulated examinees, they generated response-based signals including correctness, keyed-option probability, response entropy, and the probability margin between the top two options. We then combined the strongest judgment and response signals with baseline item features in downstream prediction models. Pairwise difficulty judgment was the most consistent individual LLM signal across both datasets, while simulated-examinee signals and absolute judgments provided complementary information in some feature combinations. The best configurations reached a Spearman correlation of $ρ$ = .447 on USMLE, exceeding the best system in the 2024 BEA shared task ($ρ$ = .25), and $ρ$ = .494 on PANCE. These results were comparable to direct absolute judgments from the proprietary frontier model Claude Opus 5 ($ρ$ = .443 and .488, respectively). Overall, judgment and response signals from open-weight LLMs captured difficulty-related information beyond text representations. Because these models can be deployed locally, the approach offers a practical option for predicting the difficulty of unreleased or high-security test items.

title: Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images
zh_title: 医学图像间最优传输的凸势函数学习
summary: 通过参数化凸势函数估计最优传输映射，保证无旋，在2D与3D医学影像数据集上传输误差更低、重建质量更高。
key_points: 参数化凸势函数，符合Brenier定理
映射构造上保证无旋
2D/3D数据集上误差更低、重建更优
reason: 方法类预印本，有对比但无临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.
zh_abstract: 计算医学图像之间的最优传输映射在形态学分析中具有基础性作用。然而，现有方法要么难以扩展到大型三维医学图像，要么依赖仅能提供近似传输映射的正则化形式。为提高下游医学图像分析的准确性，我们提出了一种通过对凸势函数进行参数化来估计最优传输映射的新方法。按照构造，所得传输映射保证无旋（curl-free），与 Brenier 定理一致。我们在二维和三维医学影像数据集上评估了所提方法。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，我们的方法传输估计误差更低，并能生成质量更高的图像重建结果。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
zh_title: 隐式神经表示元初始化加速可变形医学图像配准
summary: 研究用Reptile和STRAINER初始化加速基于INR的可变形配准，在OASIS-1上提升早期适应的Dice与HD95。
key_points: 以KAN-IDIR为基础INR模型
OASIS-1：364对训练、49对测试
迭代1500时Dice更高、HD95更低
reason: 方法有新意但单数据集，属增量偏上
abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.
zh_abstract: 用于可变形医学图像配准的隐式神经表示（INR）方法需要针对每一对新图像优化网络参数，因此适应速度成为实际应用中的限制。本研究探讨能否利用从一组已解决的配准任务中学得的初始化来加速早期适应。我们考察了两种方案：Reptile 元初始化，以及对坐标网络共享部分进行迁移的 STRAINER。KAN-IDIR 被用作基础 INR 位移场模型。实验在 OASIS-1 上进行，使用 364 个连续图像对进行训练，49 个图像对用于测试时适应。配准质量以平均 Dice 和 HD95 评估，并在第 1500 次迭代时评估雅可比行列式为负的体素所占比例。在所研究的配置中，两种方案在早期迭代时均比随机初始化获得更高的 Dice 和更低的 HD95。在较小的迭代预算下，Reptile 在数值上优于 STRAINER，尽管二者的预训练预算并不匹配。随着迭代次数增加，各方案之间的差异缩小。STRAINER 预训练耗时 39–40 分钟，而 Reptile 为 44.98 小时。

title: Using iterative agentic retrieval-augmented generation to refine the risk of infection from social contexts during the COVID-19 pandemic: Development and Evaluation Study
zh_title: 迭代式智能体RAG从社交情境细化COVID-19感染风险
summary: 基于鲁汶学生社群19,434条社交互动文本训练LSTM，并集成到Llama3驱动的迭代检索增强对话框架，用于预测并调整感染风险。
key_points: LSTM基于19,434条社交互动文本
对话式智能体收集个性化风险因素

abstract: Background: Contact tracing is crucial to limit pathogen transmission and to gather epidemiological data. However, despite machine learning optimizations, it remains time-consuming. Large language models have been used for infection risk prediction, but no existing application converses with a user to adapt its risk estimates. Objective: We aimed to develop an iterative retrieval-augmented generation conversational framework to predict coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) infection risk from textual social data. The conversational agent aims to gather personalized risk factors based on descriptions of social interactions. Methods: We trained a long short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the risk of COVID-19 infection from 19,434 textual descriptions of social interactions, collected during the pandemic in the Leuven student community, in Belgium. We integrated this model into a Llama3.3-based conversational framework that iteratively gathers additional social information that may represent a risk of infection. We evaluated the framework using large language model (LLM)-as-a-judge metrics and by comparing its risk assessment in different social contexts. Results: Based solely on social interaction data, a fine-tuned RobBERT model predicted infection risk with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.73. It performed similarly to an LSTM model and a logistic regression on term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) features, which both achieved a ROC AUC of 0.72. These three models slightly outperformed a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-fine-tuned Mistral NeMo model (ROC AUC = 0.69). Llama3.3 performed well in our framework: the predicted infection risk converged often, and it asked fewer redundant questions than the smaller models (Mistral 7B, Gemma3 12B). In addition, the framework showed the ability to stratify, by risk of infection, synthetic users who had different types of social interactions. Conclusions: Combining simple language models with large language models can refine individual infection risk from contact tracing data in a high-circulation context. Our conversational framework may help optimize contact tracing by highlighting social contexts with a high risk of infection.
zh_abstract: 【背景】接触者追踪对于限制病原体传播和收集流行病学数据至关重要。然而，尽管有机器学习优化，其仍然耗时。大语言模型已被用于感染风险预测，但尚无现有应用能够与用户对话以调整其风险估计。【目的】我们旨在开发一种迭代式检索增强生成对话框架，从文本社交数据中预测2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）感染风险。该对话智能体旨在根据对社交互动的描述收集个性化风险因素。【方法】我们训练了一个长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，根据19,434条社交互动文本描述预测COVID-19感染风险，这些描述采集于大流行期间比利时鲁汶学生群体。我们将该模型整合到基于Llama3.3的对话框架中，该框架迭代地收集可能代表感染风险的额外社交信息。我们使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的指标，并通过比较其在不同社交情境下的风险评估来评价该框架。【结果】仅基于社交互动数据，经微调的RobBERT模型预测感染风险的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC AUC）为0.73。其表现与LSTM模型以及基于词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）特征的逻辑回归相近，后两者的ROC AUC均为0.72。这三种模型略优于经量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调的Mistral NeMo模型（ROC AUC = 0.69）。Llama3.3在我们的框架中表现良好：预测的感染风险经常收敛，且其提出的冗余问题少于较小的模型（Mistral 7B、Gemma3 12B）。此外，该框架显示出能够按感染风险对具有不同类型社交互动的合成用户进行分层。【结论】在高传播背景下，将简单语言模型与大语言模型相结合，可以根据接触者追踪数据细化个体感染风险。我们的对话框架可通过突出感染风险高的社交情境，帮助优化接触者追踪。

abstract: Background: Accurate blood pressure (BP) measurement, essential for hypertension care, requires proper technique. Posture errors can raise systolic BP by more than 20 mm Hg, yet technique is rarely verified objectively. We aimed to develop and evaluate Coach-BP, a computer vision system that detects technique errors from video to support real-time coaching. Methods: We enrolled adults attending an academic cardiovascular prevention center between February and April 2026 and filmed BP measurements with front and side cameras. We analyzed 408 encounters from 225 participants. Coach-BP uses machine learning models trained on clinician labels to assess five American Heart Association criteria using pose, visual context, and audio-visual features. We evaluated its accuracy against expert clinician ratings by leave-one-participant-out cross-validation. We then examined robustness to simulated camera artifacts and interpreted the features important for each criterion. Findings: At baseline, 138 (62%) of 223 participants had at least one technique error and 54 (24%) two or more. Coach-BP achieved a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.93 (95% CI 0.90-0.94), with 0.97 (0.94-0.99) for legs uncrossed, 0.97 (0.93-1.00) for no talking, 0.92 (0.85-0.98) for back supported, 0.91 (0.86-0.95) for feet flat, and 0.86 (0.81-0.91) for arm supported at heart level. Mean balanced accuracy was 0.88 (0.85-0.90). Performance was robust to simulated camera shift, zoom, and rotation. Its models relied on features clinicians would assess, such as cuffed-hand height and foot position. One model classified back support similarly from either camera. Interpretation: Coach-BP accurately detected errors in the five guideline-recommended criteria of BP measurement technique from clinic video, enabling objective assessment of each criterion.
zh_abstract:
【背景】准确的血压（BP）测量对高血压诊疗至关重要，需要正确的操作技术。姿势错误可使收缩压升高超过20 mm Hg，但操作技术很少得到客观核查。我们旨在开发并评估 Coach-BP，这是一种通过视频检测操作技术错误以支持实时指导的计算机视觉系统。
【方法】我们纳入2026年2月至4月期间在一家学术性心血管预防中心就诊的成年人，并使用前侧两个摄像头拍摄血压测量过程。我们分析了来自225名参与者的408次测量过程。Coach-BP 使用基于临床医生标注训练的机器学习模型，利用姿态、视觉情境以及视听特征评估美国心脏协会的五项标准。我们通过留一参与者交叉验证，以专家临床医生评分为参照评估其准确性。随后检验了其对模拟摄像头伪影的稳健性，并解释了各项标准的重要特征。
【结果】基线时，223名参与者中有138名（62%）至少存在一项技术错误，54名（24%）存在两项或以上。Coach-BP 的受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）平均为0.93（95% CI 0.90-0.94），其中不交叉双腿为0.97（0.94-0.99），不说话为0.97（0.93-1.00），背部有支撑为0.92（0.85-0.98），双脚平放为0.91（0.86-0.95），手臂支撑于心脏水平为0.86（0.81-0.91）。平均平衡准确率为0.88（0.85-0.90）。在模拟摄像头移位、缩放和旋转下性能保持稳健。其模型依赖于临床医生会评估的特征，如袖带侧手的高度和脚的位置。一个模型对背部支撑的分类在任一摄像头下均相似。
【结论】Coach-BP 能够从门诊视频中准确检测血压测量技术中五项指南推荐标准的错误，从而可对每项标准进行客观评估。

abstract: Background: Existing environmental and health information systems typically provide isolated data streams, requiring users to interpret heterogeneous information sources without personalized guidance. Residents and health providers of urban regions with complex environmental conditions, such as the Salt Lake Valley, frequently seek timely, location-specific information about weather, air quality, and their associated health impacts, but may find it difficult to integrate this information in their decision-making, precluding the effective translation of valuable environmental health information into action. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline that delivers evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses to health-related environmental questions raised lay persons by dynamically orchestrating authoritative weather, neighborhood-scale environmental observations, air quality, and health-evidence resources. Methods: We developed an agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and OpenAI large language models to interpret natural language queries, select and invoke relevant external tools, retrieve real-time environmental data and evidence-based health guidance, and synthesize responses. The pipeline integrates multiple authoritative resources, including weather forecasts, air-quality observations, geospatial services, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module built from asthma-related clinical guidance. The system incorporates fallback mechanisms to improve robustness when external services are unavailable. We evaluated the pipeline using a curated benchmark of representative user questions, assessing tool-needed recognition, correct tool selection, avoidance of irrelevant tools, parameter mapping, analytic pathway selection, and incorporation of tool outputs into the final response. Results: The developed system successfully integrated heterogeneous environmental and health information sources into a unified conversational interface that produces evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses for the Salt Lake Valley. Evaluation demonstrated generally strong tool recognition, parameter mapping, and incorporation of retrieved information across diverse question types, supporting the pipeline's ability to retrieve and integrate authoritative environmental and health information consumable by lay persons and providing an important step for the T3 and T4 phases of the translational pipeline of exposu
zh_abstract: 【背景】现有的环境与健康信息系统通常只提供彼此孤立的数据流，用户需要在缺乏个性化指导的情况下自行解读异构的信息来源。在盐湖谷（Salt Lake Valley）等环境条件复杂的城市地区，居民和健康服务提供者经常需要及时获取特定地点的天气、空气质量及其相关健康影响的信息，但可能难以将这些信息整合用于决策，从而妨碍了有价值的环境健康信息转化为行动。【目的】本研究旨在开发并评估一种具有自主代理能力的人工智能（agentic AI）流程，通过动态调用权威的天气、邻里尺度环境观测、空气质量和健康证据资源，为非专业人士提出的与健康相关的环境问题提供有证据依据的、邻里尺度的回答。【方法】我们使用 LangGraph 和 OpenAI 大语言模型开发了一个 agentic AI 流程，用于理解自然语言查询、选择并调用相关外部工具、检索实时环境数据和循证健康指导，并综合生成回答。该流程整合了多种权威资源，包括天气预报、空气质量观测、地理空间服务，以及基于哮喘相关临床指南构建的检索增强生成（RAG）模块。系统设有回退机制，以在外部服务不可用时提高稳健性。我们使用一组经过整理的代表性用户问题基准对该流程进行评估，评估内容包括工具需求识别、正确的工具选择、避免调用无关工具、参数映射、分析路径选择，以及将工具输出纳入最终回答的情况。【结果】所开发的系统成功将异构的环境和健康信息来源整合到统一的对话界面中，可为盐湖谷生成有证据依据的邻里尺度回答。评估显示，在不同类型的问题上，系统总体上具有较强的工具识别、参数映射和检索信息整合能力，支持该流程检索并整合可供非专业人士使用的权威环境与健康信息，并为暴露研究转化流程的 T3 和 T4 阶段迈出了重要一步。（原文摘要在此处中断。）

abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Bacterial infections remain a major global health challenge, which are responsible for significant morbidity, mortality, and increasing antimicrobial resistance worldwide. Rapid and accurate identification of bacterial pathogens is therefore essential for guiding appropriate antimicrobial therapy, improving patient outcomes, and supporting effective infection control strategies. However, conventional microbiological diagnostic methods such as culture, microscopy, and biochemical testing are often time-consuming, labor-intensive, and dependent on expert interpretation. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly emerged as a powerful tool capable of transforming clinical microbiology by enabling rapid analysis of complex biomedical data. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the role of AI in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens and to discuss its current applications, advantages, limitations, and future perspectives. Key AI-assisted technologies, including machine learning and deep learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks, are increasingly applied to diagnostic platforms, including automated microscopy, next-generation genomic sequencing, MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry, and clinical data analysis systems. Current evidence indicates that AI-assisted diagnostic approaches can substantially improve the speed, accuracy, and automation of microbial pathogen detection while enabling large-scale analysis of microbiological and clinical datasets. In the future, AI-integrated microbiology laboratories, rapid diagnostic platforms, genomic surveillance systems, and AI-assisted clinical decision support tools are expected to further enhance infectious disease diagnostics and contribute to improved antimicrobial stewardship and global infection management.
zh_abstract: [诊断微生物学与传染病] 细菌感染仍是全球主要的健康挑战，在全球范围内造成严重的发病率和死亡率，并导致抗菌药物耐药性不断上升。因此，快速、准确地鉴定细菌病原体对于指导恰当的抗菌治疗、改善患者结局以及支持有效的感染控制策略至关重要。然而，培养、显微镜检查和生化检测等传统微生物诊断方法往往耗时、费力，并依赖专家判读。近年来，人工智能（AI）日益成为能够通过快速分析复杂生物医学数据来变革临床微生物学的有力工具。本综述旨在全面概述AI在细菌病原体诊断与鉴定中的作用，并讨论其当前应用、优势、局限性和未来前景。包括随机森林、支持向量机、人工神经网络和卷积神经网络等机器学习和深度学习算法在内的关键AI辅助技术，正日益应用于自动化显微镜、下一代基因组测序、MALDI-TOF质谱和临床数据分析系统等诊断平台。现有证据表明，AI辅助的诊断方法可显著提高微生物病原体检测的速度、准确性和自动化程度，同时能够对微生物学和临床数据集进行大规模分析。未来，整合AI的微生物实验室、快速诊断平台、基因组监测系统以及AI辅助的临床决策支持工具有望进一步提升传染病诊断水平，并有助于改善抗菌药物管理和全球感染管理。

abstract: [OTA international : the open access journal of orthopaedic trauma] Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an ascendant technical field with potential to revolutionize health care and orthopaedics. This paper highlights ways in which AI is already affecting members of the Orthopaedic Trauma Association (OTA), while identifying paths to clinical application, as presented at the 2025 OTA Annual Meeting's Basic Science Focus Forum. A report from the OTA AI Task Force shared some initial accomplishments, including the crafting of a position statement. Areas of AI application in orthopaedic trauma were discussed, including the prediction of fall risk in the elderly, capabilities for automated image-based diagnosis and outcome assessment, and efforts toward creating a framework for in silico clinical trials that rely upon virtual patient cohorts. Together these applications show how AI is emerging as a foundational tool in orthopaedic trauma research. Over the next few years, these products will be moving from the research laboratory to the clinic. For the tools to be of greatest benefit, a measured development approach using teams of data scientists partnered with orthopaedic trauma surgeons must be adopted. Academia and Industry are both progressing in this direction-the best path forward will likely involve shared development efforts. As these efforts progress, OTA members will undoubtedly be involved. Both they and their patients stand to be the primary beneficiaries of many of these developments.
zh_abstract: [OTA international：骨科创伤开放获取期刊] 人工智能（AI）是一个迅速崛起的技术领域，有可能彻底改变医疗保健和骨科。本文重点介绍了 AI 已经以何种方式影响骨科创伤学会（OTA）成员，并指出了临床应用的路径，内容源自 2025 年 OTA 年会基础科学焦点论坛的报告。OTA AI 工作组的一份报告分享了一些初步成果，包括起草了一份立场声明。会议讨论了 AI 在骨科创伤中的应用领域，包括老年人跌倒风险预测、基于影像的自动诊断和结局评估能力，以及为建立依赖虚拟患者队列的计算机模拟（in silico）临床试验框架所做的努力。这些应用共同表明，AI 正在成为骨科创伤研究中的基础性工具。未来几年，这些产品将从研究实验室走向临床。为使这些工具发挥最大效益，必须采用审慎的开发方式，由数据科学家与骨科创伤外科医生组成团队合作。学术界和产业界都在朝这一方向推进，最佳前进路径很可能涉及共同开发。随着这些工作的推进，OTA 成员无疑会参与其中。他们及其患者将成为许多此类进展的主要受益者。

abstract: [Advances in physiology education] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping physiology education, but the central challenge is epistemic, not technological. Learners are often more fluent with AI tools than their instructors, yet less fluent in the physiology those tools describe: a pattern this Perspective terms the reverse native-speaker problem. AI-generated explanations of physiological mechanisms are rarely overtly wrong. An interpretive framework proposed by means of this perspective states that explanations that appear plausible step by step may become become inconsistent when organ systems are considered together. It is therefore argued that the educator role is shifting from transmitting information to certifying coherence and proposes a classroom exercise, the error-hunt, for identifying seeded, systems-level inconsistencies in AI-generated explanations.
zh_abstract: [Advances in physiology education] 生成式人工智能（AI）正在重塑生理学教育，但核心挑战是认识论层面的，而非技术层面的。学习者往往比其教师更熟练地使用AI工具，却对这些工具所描述的生理学不够熟练：本观点文章将这一模式称为“反向母语者问题”。AI生成的生理机制解释很少有明显错误。本观点文章提出的一个解释性框架指出，逐步看来似乎合理的解释，在综合考虑各器官系统时可能变得前后不一致。因此，文章主张教育者的角色正从传递信息转变为确证连贯性，并提出一种课堂练习“找错”（error-hunt），用于识别AI生成解释中被植入的、系统层面的不一致之处。

abstract: Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage. In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.
zh_abstract: 大多数多模态分类器假定所有有用证据在一开始即可获得，而临床问诊则是循序渐进的。我们提出了一个合成评估框架，将客观多模态推断与主动问诊区分开来。一个客观模型将合成的舌象、双侧多压脉象和声学观察映射到八个证候大类。一个带有溯源信息的知识核心（Knowledge Core）和一个仅用训练数据构建的回答模型，支持利用25个分类型问题对33个细分证候术语进行贝叶斯逐步收窄，另有七个安全性问题不纳入诊断后验。弱共享症状因子限制了细分术语对客观表型的影响，并通过仅客观信息探针检验信息泄漏。在一项预先注册的600例合成评估中，客观证候大类准确率为87.0%。代价敏感的期望信息增益（cost-EIG）将证候大类准确率提高到95.5%，细分术语精确准确率提高到42.5%；而未经优化的固定顺序基线分别为92.7%和33.0%。选择性证候大类准确率在覆盖率95.3%时达到96.9%。然而，cost-EIG平均提问数多于固定顺序（9.795对9.352）。缺失音频路由保持了94.0%的证候大类准确率，并且当所有客观模态均缺失时，工作流不变量强制执行弃权。对细分术语回答似然进行置换使证候大类准确率降至78.7%。六项冻结检验中有五项通过，但提问效率假设未能成立。由于仅保留了汇总输出而非配对的病例级输出，各项比较仅为描述性的。这些结果确立了一个可复现的合成工作流，而不是临床诊断或治疗的有效性。

title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
zh_title: Alpha-TCM：中医引导的多模态推断九层框架与结构化先验审计
summary: 提出面向中医的九层可审计系统架构，并用合成数据原型验证第1-5层的知识-证据接口；明确为系统设计提案而非完整临床实现。
key_points: 九层架构分离领域知识、病例证据、概率推断与权限
每层明确信息契约、失效边界与验证状态
原型仅基于合成舌象、脉象、问诊与文本数据
reason: 系统设计提案加合成原型，无临床验证
abstract: Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation. Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection. Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.
zh_abstract: Alpha-TCM在一个核心论点下做出两项贡献：可审计系统应将领域知识、病例证据、概率推断和下游决策权限分离开来。第一，它提出了一个面向中医（TCM）的九层架构，涵盖语义定义、多模态采集、质量控制、带溯源信息的知识、概率推断、纵向更新、受约束的决策、语言交互和人类治理。每一层均规定了其信息契约、失效边界、依赖关系和验证状态。这是一项系统设计提案，并不声称已完成完整的临床实现。第二，一个受控的合成原型实例化了第1–5层，以审计知识与证据的接口。四个条件高斯编码器分别处理合成的舌象图像、脉搏波形、问诊字段和文本，同时一个冻结的桥接模块预测五维合成结局。一个版本化的情境先验独立于渲染器编译而成。融合在加入情境之前先去除重复的参考先验信息。等信息量对照、先验正则化、分级污染和结构性破坏被用于检验情境带来的益处、贝叶斯特异性和冲突检测。在十个配对随机种子和四种训练规模下，情境知识在600例和1,200例时相较于边缘委员会融合改善了平均绝对误差，但相较于等信息量神经对照则没有改善。完全错误的情境在每种规模下均损害性能，而先验效应不一致，冲突评分与病例层面的损害并不相符。结果支持在低数据合成情境下情境结构的作用，而不是特定的贝叶斯优势。该原型未对中医理论或临床、诊断、治疗、因果、纵向或迁移有效性作出任何主张。

title: Silhouette-Based Gaitomics for Frailty Assessment in Older Adults
zh_title: 基于轮廓步态组学的老年人衰弱评估
summary: 在66名老年人中，用步态轮廓提取90个描述符，结合特征选择与SHAP解释评估Fried衰弱表型，采用嵌套交叉验证。
key_points: 66名老年人，Fried衰弱表型为标签
90个形状、时序、运动与纹理描述符
嵌套分层交叉验证并用SHAP解释
reason: 单中心小样本，仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: Walking offers a window into physical function that may support interpretable video-based frailty assessment. We developed silhouette-based "gaitomics" to connect frailty predictions with measurable patterns of body configuration and movement. In 66 older adults assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, standardized silhouettes and gait energy images yielded 90 descriptors of shape, temporal variation, motion, and texture. Minimum redundancy maximum relevance selection using the mutual information difference criterion prioritized informative features while limiting redundancy. Each classifier was evaluated using nested stratified cross-validation with five outer and three inner folds at the participant level, with feature ranking and feature-count selection confined to training partitions. Shapley additive explanations examined contributions to held-out predictions. Bilateral silhouette difference led the aggregate feature-selection rankings for three-class classification and both comparisons involving frail participants. Attribution profiles differed across tasks, with texture and consecutive-frame silhouette differences prominent in three-class classification. Among classifier-specific evaluations, CatBoost achieved the highest mean three-class micro-AUC of 0.647 \pm 0.085. Leading pairwise mean micro-AUCs were 0.833 \pm 0.249 for frail versus nonfrail, 0.765 \pm 0.168 for frail versus prefrail, and 0.554 \pm 0.129 for prefrail versus nonfrail classification. These findings connect model predictions to explicit gait characteristics while revealing task-dependent feature priorities and limited separation of prefrail and nonfrail participants. The framework provides an interpretable basis for further investigation, with larger independent studies needed to establish reliability and clinical relevance.
zh_abstract: 步行为了解身体功能提供了一个窗口，可能有助于基于视频的可解释衰弱评估。我们开发了基于轮廓的“步态组学（gaitomics）”，以将衰弱预测与可测量的身体形态和运动模式联系起来。在 66 名采用 Fried 衰弱表型评估的老年人中，标准化轮廓和步态能量图像产生了 90 个涉及形状、时间变化、运动和纹理的描述符。采用基于互信息差准则的最小冗余最大相关（mRMR）特征选择，在限制冗余的同时优先选取信息量大的特征。每个分类器均采用嵌套分层交叉验证（外层五折、内层三折，在受试者层面进行）进行评估，特征排序和特征数量选择仅限于训练分区内。使用 Shapley 加性解释（SHAP）分析各特征对留出样本预测的贡献。在三分类以及两个涉及衰弱参与者的比较中，双侧轮廓差异在汇总的特征选择排名中居首。不同任务的归因特征谱有所差异，其中纹理和相邻帧轮廓差异在三分类中较为突出。在各分类器的评估中，CatBoost 取得了最高的三分类平均 micro-AUC，为 0.647 ± 0.085。成对比较中领先的平均 micro-AUC 分别为：衰弱对非衰弱 0.833 ± 0.249，衰弱对衰弱前期 0.765 ± 0.168，衰弱前期对非衰弱 0.554 ± 0.129。这些发现将模型预测与明确的步态特征联系起来，同时揭示了任务相关的特征优先级，以及衰弱前期与非衰弱参与者之间区分有限。该框架为进一步研究提供了可解释的基础，仍需更大规模的独立研究来确立其可靠性和临床相关性。

title: A Differentiable, GPU-Accelerated Finite-Element Formulation in JAX for Large-Deformation Shells with Contact: Application to Patient-Specific Aortic Valve Simulation
zh_title: JAX可微GPU有限元：用于患者特异性主动脉瓣模拟
summary: 基于JAX开发可微、GPU加速的大变形壳接触有限元求解器，并应用于患者特异性主动脉瓣模拟，用于辅助评估瓣叶变形与对合。
key_points: 能量型有限元框架，含超弹性本构与接触能
无矩阵Newton-Krylov求解，两级预条件
自动微分支持高效导数计算
reason: 计算力学方法预印本，临床验证信息有限
abstract: Patient-specific aortic-valve models can help assess how tissue properties and geometry influence leaflet deformation and coaptation, with potential to inform intervention planning. Large deformations, near-incompressibility, and evolving contact make these simulations computationally demanding and can challenge nonlinear convergence. Differentiable, GPU-accelerated methods offer efficient derivative evaluation and parallel computation, but their matrix-free application to soft-tissue shells with contact remains less established. We developed a forward solver using tatva's energy-based finite-element framework in JAX. The solver combines finite-strain extensible-director shells, hyperelastic constitutive models, and a finite-range repulsive contact energy. Nonlinear equilibrium is solved using a regularized, matrix-free Newton-Krylov method with two-level preconditioning. Automatic differentiation evaluates tangent-vector products without forming or storing the primary tangent matrix, while GPU execution parallelizes element and quadrature-point computations. Constitutive, shell, contact, and self-contact responses were assessed against analytical, semi-analytical, and published benchmarks. At a contact-free plate equilibrium, implicit sensitivities of the converged apex displacement to constitutive parameters, thickness, and pressure agreed with finite differences from independent nonlinear simulations. Simulations of three patient-specific aortic-valve models (two tricuspid and one bicuspid) achieved final relative equilibrium residuals below 10^-4. Median GPU runtimes were approximately 15-25 minutes, with 5.3-6.5-fold speedups relative to corresponding CPU runs on the tested hardware. These results provide component-level verification and demonstrate GPU-accelerated forward valve simulation in the tested cases, supporting future gradient-based inverse studies.
zh_abstract: 患者特异性主动脉瓣模型有助于评估组织特性和几何形态如何影响瓣叶变形与对合，并可能为介入治疗规划提供参考。大变形、近不可压缩性以及不断演化的接触使这些模拟的计算量很大，并可能给非线性收敛带来挑战。可微分、GPU 加速的方法可实现高效的导数计算和并行计算，但其在含接触的软组织壳体上的无矩阵应用仍不够成熟。我们在 JAX 中基于 tatva 的基于能量的有限元框架开发了一个正向求解器。该求解器结合了有限应变可延伸方向子（extensible-director）壳、超弹性本构模型以及有限范围排斥接触能。非线性平衡采用带两级预条件的正则化无矩阵 Newton-Krylov 方法求解。自动微分在不形成或存储主切线矩阵的情况下计算切向量乘积，而 GPU 执行则并行化单元和积分点计算。本构、壳体、接触及自接触响应均与解析、半解析及已发表的基准进行了评估。在无接触的平板平衡状态下，收敛后顶点位移对本构参数、厚度和压力的隐式敏感度与独立非线性模拟得到的有限差分结果一致。对三个患者特异性主动脉瓣模型（两个三叶瓣和一个二叶瓣）的模拟，最终相对平衡残差均低于 10^-4。GPU 运行时间中位数约为 15–25 分钟，在所测试的硬件上相对于相应的 CPU 运行实现了 5.3–6.5 倍的加速。这些结果提供了组件层面的验证，并在所测试的病例中展示了 GPU 加速的主动脉瓣正向模拟，为未来基于梯度的逆问题研究提供支持。

title: Multiscale Spatial Characterization of Glioma MRI with MUSE and Radiomics
zh_title: 基于MUSE与影像组学的胶质瘤MRI多尺度空间表征
summary: 在公开UCSF-PDGM数据上，用MUSE三维变异函数场结合方向性影像组学，表征胶质瘤强化肿瘤的异质性并评估分子分型。
key_points: 使用公开UCSF-PDGM增强T1 MRI
416例基线患者有MUSE输出，375例配对GLCM
保留方向变异函数与物理滞后距离
reason: 单一公开队列、传统影像组学，预印本，增量
abstract: Purpose. Characterizing glioma heterogeneity requires measurements that retain the physical scale and orientation of intratumoral intensity dependence. We evaluate the original 3D variographic field produced by the MUSE tool (Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment) alongside directional radiomics and independent image-based molecular classification. Methods. We analyzed postcontrast T1-weighted magnetic resonance images and enhancing-tumor segmentations from the public UCSF-PDGM collection. Verified MUSE outputs were available for 416 independent baseline patients, of whom 375 had paired directional gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) measurements. Each MUSE field retained 328 original experimental directional variograms with physical lag distances, semivariances, orientations, and voxel-pair support. Agreement was assessed at aligned offsets and through between-tumor comparisons. Patient-level permutation tests evaluated associations with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) status on 2,508 native direction-lag coordinates. A standalone 3D residual convolutional neural network (CNN) provided a separate IDH classification benchmark. Results. At 9,371 geometrically aligned offsets, native MUSE semivariance and half GLCM contrast correlated strongly (Pearson r = 0.954). Across 31,599 eligible between-tumor comparisons, representation-level dissimilarities showed Spearman {rho}_S = 0.862, with sensitivity to GLCM feature family and long-offset sampling support. In 364 grade-4 tumors, including 24 IDH-mutant cases, the original MUSE field was associated with IDH after conventional adjustment (global permutation p = 0.00050), but the association was attenuated after primary directional GLCM adjustment (p = 0.256). The independent CNN achieved an out-of-fold IDH ROC-AUC of 0.792 and PR-AUC of 0.414 across 416 patients. Native MUSE examples revealed scale- and direction-dependent spatial behavior, including distances beyond those sampled by the GLCM protocol. Conclusion. Variograms by MUSE provide a physically indexed description of tumor spatial heterogeneity that can accompany radiomic analysis and CNN classification. The observed statistical overlap is substantial, and incremental clinical discrimination beyond directional GLCM features remains unestablished.

summary: 研究开发了由临床医生参与的AMHART工具，用于审查AI聊天机器人回复是否包含符合指南的内容，并用三模型LLM评估器对四个主流聊天机器人的青少年多轮对话进行评分。
key_points: AMHART涵盖七个领域，经临床医生评审，内容效度与评分者信度较强
三模型LLM评估器与人工参考标签比对一致性
以不同性别、诊断和症状严重度的青少年角色，对ChatGPT-5/4、Claude 4.5、Gemini 2.5进行多轮对话评估
reason: 同行评审的精神健康LLM评估工具，规范但摘要无临床结局或外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Many adolescents seek mental health advice from general-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots, despite limited evaluations against youth-relevant clinical standards. Here we developed the Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool (AMHART), a clinician-informed instrument for auditing the presence of guideline-informed response content across seven domains, and applied it to four major AI chatbots. Candidate items were reviewed by clinicians for their evidence base, objectivity and clinical importance, yielding a subset with strong content validity and inter-rater reliability. We then configured a three-model large language model evaluator ensemble, assessed its agreement with human reference labels and scored multiturn conversations in which adolescent personas (varying by sex, diagnosis and symptom severity) engaged with ChatGPT-5, ChatGPT-4, Claude 4.5 and Gemini 2.5. AMHART scores indicated greater coverage of applicable criteria for anxiety than depression and for moderate than severe presentations. The findings suggest AMHART offers a reliable, clinician-informed benchmark for evaluating chatbot responses to adolescent anxiety and depression disclosures.
zh_abstract: 许多青少年向通用型人工智能（AI）聊天机器人寻求心理健康建议，但针对与青少年相关的临床标准对这些聊天机器人进行的评估十分有限。在此，我们开发了青少年心理健康AI应答工具（Adolescent Mental Health AI Response Tool，AMHART），这是一种由临床医生参与制定的工具，用于审查七个领域中是否存在符合指南的应答内容，并将其应用于四种主流AI聊天机器人。临床医生对候选条目的证据基础、客观性和临床重要性进行了评审，最终得到一组具有较强内容效度和评分者间信度的条目。随后，我们配置了由三个模型组成的大语言模型评估器集成，评估其与人工参考标注的一致性，并对多轮对话进行评分；在这些对话中，青少年角色（按性别、诊断和症状严重程度而异）与ChatGPT-5、ChatGPT-4、Claude 4.5和Gemini 2.5进行互动。AMHART评分显示，对于适用标准的覆盖程度，焦虑高于抑郁，中度表现高于重度表现。这些发现提示，AMHART可为评估聊天机器人对青少年焦虑和抑郁倾诉的应答提供一个可靠的、由临床医生参与制定的基准。

title: Automation Bias and Deskilling in Radiology AI: A Confidence-stratified Triage Model for Workflow Integration.
zh_title: 放射AI中的自动化偏倚与技能退化：置信度分层分诊模型
summary: 讨论放射科AI带来的自动化偏倚与技能退化风险，并提出按置信度分层的分诊模型用于工作流整合。
key_points: 指出AI错误输出会降低各级读者准确率
AI撤除后表现下降，缺乏纵向研究
提出置信度分层分诊模型
reason: 观点类文章，议题相关但无新实证，受观点上限约束
abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Radiology is adopting artificial intelligence (AI) faster than it is studying what AI does to radiologists' perceptual expertise and interpretive skill. The question has partly shifted from whether these tools perform well on benchmark tasks to what happens to clinical judgment when use of these tools becomes routine. Two risks accompany this transition: automation bias, the tendency to follow AI suggestions without adequate scrutiny, and deskilling, the erosion of perceptual and interpretive ability through disuse, typically revealed when AI support is withdrawn. Incorrect AI output degrades accuracy regardless of experience, the benefit of assistance varies unpredictably across readers and tasks, and performance falls after AI withdrawal; neither risk has been studied longitudinally in radiology. A confidence-stratified triage model is proposed in which calibrated AI confidence, not findings alone, routes cases to low-, intermediate-, or high-confidence streams: output withheld until independent reading, shown with uncertainty signals and a checklist, or shown with random blinded audit. Demonstrated local confidence calibration is a precondition for deployment, and stream thresholds and audit rates should be weighted by task and potential clinical harm, not error probability alone. Rather than applying one workflow to every case, the model redistributes radiologist attention to where AI error is most likely and most consequential, operationalizing four principles: keeping the radiologist in the decision loop, making AI uncertainty visible, inserting targeted cognitive friction, and governing the human-AI interaction as a system. A research agenda to determine whether these countermeasures reduce automation bias and skill erosion in practice is also proposed.
zh_abstract: [放射学。人工智能] 放射学采用人工智能（AI）的速度快于对AI如何影响放射科医师感知专长和解读技能的研究速度。问题在一定程度上已从这些工具在基准任务上是否表现良好，转变为这些工具成为常规使用后临床判断会发生什么变化。这一转变伴随两种风险：自动化偏倚，即在未充分审视的情况下倾向于听从AI建议；以及技能退化，即因不再使用而导致感知和解读能力的削弱，通常在撤除AI支持时显现。无论经验如何，错误的AI输出都会降低准确性；辅助带来的获益在不同阅片者和任务之间难以预测；撤除AI后表现会下降；这两种风险在放射学中均尚未经过纵向研究。本文提出一种按置信度分层的分诊模型，由经过校准的AI置信度（而非仅凭影像发现）将病例分流至低、中或高置信度通道：在独立阅片完成之前不显示输出；显示输出并附带不确定性信号和核查清单；或显示输出并配合随机盲法审核。已证明本地置信度校准是部署的前提条件，通道阈值和审核比例应根据任务和潜在临床危害加权确定，而不应仅依据错误概率。该模型并非对每个病例采用同一种工作流程，而是将放射科医师的注意力重新分配到AI最可能出错且后果最严重之处，由此落实四项原则：让放射科医师保持在决策环路之中、使AI的不确定性可见、插入有针对性的认知摩擦，以及将人机交互作为一个系统进行管理。本文还提出了一项研究议程，以确定这些对策在实践中是否能够减少自动化偏倚和技能退化。

title: Ambient Artificial Intelligence Scribe Use and Objective Documentation Effort Among Emergency Physicians.
zh_title: 急诊医生使用环境AI书记员与客观文书工作量
summary: 在20家急诊科的多中心网络中，基于电子病历直接读取AI书记员使用与文书工作量数据，评估其对主治医生文书负担的影响。
key_points: 覆盖3家学术与17家社区急诊科
使用量按知情同意声明逐笔标记
结局取自Epic审计日志，排除教学与证明文书
reason: 多中心真实部署、客观工作流指标，但摘要缺结果
abstract: [Annals of emergency medicine] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes ("AI scribes") are purported to reduce emergency department (ED) documentation burden, but ED evidence is largely single-site, uncontrolled, or self-reported, with exposure inferred rather than measured. We evaluated AI scribe use among attending emergency physicians across a multisite network, with exposure and outcomes read directly from the electronic health record. Across 20 EDs (3 academic and 17 community), AI scribe use was flagged per note from the patient consent statement within the ED note. Analyses were restricted to attending physicians and, to isolate the physician's own documentation, excluded teaching encounters and attestation notes identified from standardized attestation text. Endpoints, computed over the mature-adoption window (December 2025 onward, when Epic audit-log data are retained), were active time in the note (primary), note length, note-start time, completion lag, and 72-hour ED return. Within-physician models (physician and calendar-month fixed effects, clustered by physician) compared each adopter's AI-scribed notes with their own unassisted notes, adjusting only for pre-exposure case mix. Among 275 attending physicians, 31% of encounters were AI-scribed. Physicians spent less active time in AI-scribed notes (median 10.0 versus 12.5 min-2.4 minutes after adjustment), started them about 15 minutes later (median 31 versus 17 minutes after first seeing the patient, and produced notes about 14% longer [median 5,220 versus 4,468 characters; within-physician +629 characters]). Note completion was not delayed (-6 minutes), and 72-hour ED return was not increased (-0.8 percentage point; 95% confidence interval -1.5 to -0.1). Among emergency physicians, AI scribe use was associated with less active time in the note, deferred note-start, and longer notes, without delaying completion or increasing short-term returns, with effect sizes consistent with ambulatory randomized data.
zh_abstract: [Annals of emergency medicine] 环境式人工智能（AI）记录员（“AI记录员”）据称可减轻急诊科（ED）的文书负担，但ED方面的证据大多来自单中心、无对照或自我报告的研究，暴露情况多为推断而非实测。我们在一个多中心网络中评估了急诊主治医师对AI记录员的使用，暴露和结局均直接从电子健康记录中读取。在20个急诊科（3个学术型和17个社区型）中，根据ED病历中的患者知情同意声明对每份病历标记是否使用AI记录员。分析仅限于主治医师，并且为了分离医师本人的文书工作，排除了教学接诊以及根据标准化确认文本识别出的确认性病历。终点指标在成熟应用期（2025年12月起，此时保留有Epic审计日志数据）内计算，包括病历的活动时间（主要终点）、病历长度、病历开始时间、完成滞后时间以及72小时内ED再就诊。医师内模型（医师和日历月份固定效应，按医师聚类）将每位采用者的AI记录病历与其自身未使用辅助的病历进行比较，仅对暴露前的病例组合进行校正。在275名主治医师中，31%的接诊使用了AI记录。医师在AI记录病历上花费的活动时间更少（中位数10.0分钟 vs 12.5分钟；校正后少2.4分钟），开始书写的时间晚约15分钟（首次接诊患者后中位数31分钟 vs 17分钟），且病历长约14%［中位数5,220 vs 4,468字符；医师内增加629字符］。病历完成未被延迟（-6分钟），72小时ED再就诊未增加（-0.8个百分点；95%置信区间 -1.5至-0.1）。在急诊医师中，使用AI记录员与病历活动时间减少、书写开始推迟和病历更长相关，且未延迟完成或增加短期再就诊，其效应大小与门诊随机数据一致。

title: A physics-informed peripheral hemodynamic digital twin for personalized estimation of arterial stiffness
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 基于物理信息的外周血流动力学数字孪生用于动脉僵硬度个体化估计
summary: 该框架利用单一肱动脉压力波形，通过PDE约束优化个性化降阶波传播模型，估计中心-肱动脉僵硬度；118人队列盲测中PWV估计r=0.67。
key_points: 仅需单点肱动脉波形，无需双点测量
118名受试者，自研袖带设备采集
盲测队列r=0.67，RMSE=1.12 m/s
reason: 样本仅118例，相关性中等，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Arterial stiffness, commonly assessed by pulse wave velocity (PWV), is an important biomarker of cardiovascular risk, yet conventional PWV measurements require dual-site recordings that limit scalability in clinical settings. Here we introduce a physics-informed peripheral hemodynamic digital twin framework for estimating central-brachial arterial stiffness from a single brachial pressure waveform. Using our laboratory-developed cuff device, high-resolution brachial pulse waveforms were collected in a cohort of 118 subjects. The digital twin then personalizes a reduced-order wave propagation model through PDE-constrained optimization, generating a compact parameter space that encodes ventricular–vascular characteristics relevant to stiffness. Incorporating digital-twin-derived parameters improved PWV estimation on a blind test cohort (r = 0.67, RMSE = 1.12 m/s) compared with a baseline model using only age and blood pressure (r = 0.22, RMSE = 1.90 m/s). These results indicate that physics-informed digital twins can enable scalable, noninvasive assessment of vascular aging from accessible peripheral waveforms.
zh_abstract: 动脉僵硬度通常通过脉搏波传导速度（PWV）进行评估，是心血管风险的重要生物标志物，但传统 PWV 测量需要双部位记录，限制了其在临床环境中的可推广性。在此，我们提出一种基于物理信息的外周血流动力学数字孪生框架，可由单一肱动脉压力波形估计中心—肱动脉僵硬度。我们利用实验室自行研制的袖带设备，在 118 名受试者的队列中采集了高分辨率肱动脉脉搏波形。随后，数字孪生通过偏微分方程（PDE）约束优化对降阶波传播模型进行个体化，生成一个紧凑的参数空间，用以编码与僵硬度相关的心室—血管特征。在盲法测试队列中，纳入数字孪生衍生参数后 PWV 估计的表现（r = 0.67，RMSE = 1.12 m/s）优于仅使用年龄和血压的基线模型（r = 0.22，RMSE = 1.90 m/s）。这些结果表明，基于物理信息的数字孪生可利用易于获取的外周波形，实现可扩展的、无创的血管老化评估。

title: Verifiable Agentic Science on Public Infrastructure
zh_title: 公共基础设施上的可验证智能体科学
summary: 将自主编码智能体接入共享计算资源以形成可审计记录，并开展大规模智能体复现与发现研究；30个本地智能体在同一数据集上产生18种不兼容流程。
key_points: 本地智能体即兴操作缺乏可验证记录
30个未受引导的智能体产生18种不兼容流程
在公共基础设施上大规模复现多项研究
reason: 预印本，AI用于科学发现与可复现性，命中读者偏好
abstract: Autonomous artificial intelligence agents are transforming the practice of science. Across every discipline, researchers are handing data analysis to coding agents that can design and execute complex studies from a single prompt. Yet this revolution carries a threat. When agents improvise in local environments, they leave no verifiable record, ultimately risking a wave of irreproducible science. Solving this crisis requires moving agentic science onto public infrastructure where every action leaves an examinable trail. Here we connect autonomous coding agents to shared computing resources, turning ephemeral prompts into auditable scientific records. After showing that 30 unguided local agents splinter into 18 incompatible pipelines on the same dataset, we conduct an agentic reproduction and discovery study on a large scale---reproducing a large, diverse array of studies with every workflow, history, and intermediate dataset publicly accessible. This complete provenance trail exposes unstated modeling choices, reference mismatches, and subsampled tutorial inputs in published studies, and establishes a new foundation where human scientists can understand, steer, and trust AI-driven discovery.
zh_abstract: 自主人工智能智能体正在改变科学实践。在各个学科中，研究人员正将数据分析交给编码智能体，这些智能体仅凭一条提示即可设计并执行复杂的研究。然而，这场变革也带来了威胁。当智能体在本地环境中即兴发挥时，不会留下可验证的记录，最终可能引发一波不可重复的科学研究。要解决这一危机，需要将智能体驱动的科学迁移到公共基础设施上，使每一步操作都留下可检查的轨迹。在此，我们将自主编码智能体连接到共享计算资源，把转瞬即逝的提示转变为可审计的科学记录。我们首先表明，30个无引导的本地智能体在同一数据集上分裂成18条互不兼容的分析流程；随后开展了一项大规模的智能体复现与发现研究——复现了大量多样的研究，且每个工作流、历史记录和中间数据集均可公开获取。这一完整的溯源轨迹揭示了已发表研究中未说明的建模选择、参考不匹配以及经过子采样的教程输入，并建立了一个新的基础，使人类科学家能够理解、引导并信任由AI驱动的科学发现。

title: EM-BENCH: A Reproducible Framework for Benchmarking Guideline-Concordant Clinical Decision Making in Large Language Models
zh_title: EM-BENCH：评测大模型遵循急诊指南决策的可复现基准
summary: 构建含210个二元病例、覆盖25项ACEP指南的急诊基准，评测149种LLM配置（79个基础模型）。
key_points: 210个病例覆盖70个关键问题、25项ACEP政策
医师验证，确定性评分
评估149种LLM配置，比较闭源与开源等因素
reason: 新基准、评测面广，但规模较小且为预印本
abstract: Background Physicians increasingly use artificial intelligence tools to support clinical work, yet there is no accepted standard for measuring the competency of large language models (LLMs) in clinical decision support. We developed EM-BENCH, a physician-validated, deterministically scored benchmark for evaluating whether models reliably apply the American College of Emergency Physicians (ACEP) guidelines to clinical decisions. Methods EM-BENCH comprises 210 binary clinical vignettes covering all 70 critical questions across 25 ACEP clinical policies. We evaluated 149 LLM configurations representing 79 base models using prespecified answers and deterministic scoring. Each vignette had a prespecified correct answer to a binary yes-or-no question based on an ACEP recommendation. We examined associations between accuracy and model access tier (closed-access vs. open-weight models), model size, release date, clinical policy, recommendation evidence level, and reasoning settings. Results No configuration achieved complete guideline concordance. The highest performing configuration answered 207 of 210 vignettes correctly (98.6%). Closed-access models outperformed open-weight models (median accuracy, 91% vs. 63%; Hodges-Lehmann location shift, 26 percentage points; 99% CI, 20 to 33; adjusted P<0.001). Among open-weight model families, a 10-fold increase in parameter count was associated with a 14-percentage-point increase in accuracy (99% CI, 7.7 to 20; adjusted P<0.001). Across all models, accuracy increased by 8.9 percentage points per release year (99% CI, 3.6 to 14; adjusted P<0.001). Neither enabling a thinking mode (pseudomedian change, 0.95 percentage points; 99% CI, -2.6 to 3.1; adjusted P=1.00) nor high versus low reasoning effort (0.91 percentage points; 99% CI, -0.69 to 3.1; adjusted P=0.56) consistently improved accuracy. Conclusions Contemporary LLMs showed improving but incomplete ability to apply ACEP guidelines. Concordance varied markedly across models and was associated with access tier, size, and release recency, while additional inference-time reasoning offered inconsistent benefit. Specialty-specific, physician-validated benchmarks may provide a reproducible assessment of LLMs' ability to make guideline-concordant clinical decisions.

abstract: [Oral diseases] Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have shown promise for the detection of periodontal disease. This study aimed to synthesize current evidence on the diagnostic performance of AI models applied to cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) for periodontal disease. A comprehensive literature search of MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Embase was conducted to identify studies on AI-assisted diagnosis of periodontal disease using CBCT published up to December 2025. The Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies-2 (QUADAS-2) tool was used to assess the risk of bias. Among 10,099 records screened, eight studies met the inclusion criteria. These studies indicate that AI models, predominantly based on convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures applied to CBCT images, have substantial potential for detecting periodontal bone loss and related conditions. However, diagnostic performance metrics varied markedly across studies, and direct comparisons with human clinicians produced inconsistent findings, underscoring the need for more rigorous study designs and standardized datasets. Despite limitations arising from heterogeneous methodologies and non-standardized data collection, CBCT-based AI models show considerable promise for enhancing periodontal disease diagnosis. Further high-quality, methodologically robust research is warranted to validate and optimize these approaches for clinical use. PROSPERO: CRD420251273846.

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology in the fields of medicine and ophthalmology. Recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and convolutional neural networks have significantly improved cataract detection and grading, intraocular lens power calculations, surgical decision-making, risk prediction and patient education. Intraoperative AI-assisted surgical phase recognition, workflow analysis, real-time guidance, robotic technologies and femtosecond laser integration can improve surgical precision, efficiency and safety. AI has shown promise in predicting visual outcomes, detecting postoperative complications and facilitating telemedicine follow-up. Though challenges with AI include transparency, data diversity, regulatory oversight and clinical validation, continued advances are expected to further personalise cataract surgery, support clinical decision-making, optimise surgical performance and improve patient outcomes. This narrative summarises the current and emerging applications of AI in preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative management of cataracts.

abstract: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) generation of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) phenotyping SQL and the effect of database implementation context. Materials and Methods: Eight publicly accessible LLM-based systems generated SQL under progressively richer prompts using synthetic and University of North Carolina (UNC) Health electronic health record (EHR) data, both based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model. Outputs were compared with the Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) T2DM reference phenotype using SQL executability, F1, positive predictive value (PPV), and recall. Results: Fewer than 55% of limited-context synthetic outputs and no limited-context UNC EHR outputs executed without modification. Detailed codebooks (L3) increased executability to 81.3% in synthetic OMOP and 100% in UNC EHR; adding sample rows (L4) increased synthetic executability to 100%. Limited-context recall was as low as 0.01, whereas high-context outputs achieved recall [≥]0.99 at synthetic L4 and >0.90 at UNC L3, although UNC PPV remained substantially lower than recall. At the highest available context levels, Beta F1 ranged from 0.72-0.99 in synthetic OMOP and 0.57-0.68 in UNC EHR; all UNC models exceeded the diagnosis-code baseline (F1=0.54). The top synthetic performer fell from F1=0.99 to 0.64 on UNC EHR. Discussion: Richer database context was associated with more consistent SQL executability and recall, while model rankings varied across datasets. Conclusion: LLMs can generate clinically meaningful T2DM phenotyping SQL when provided with sufficient database context, but limited PPV in real-world data underscores the need for local validation.

abstract: Mass spectrometry-based peptide sequencing underpins proteomics. Database search confines to predefined candidates, whereas de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) struggles with incomplete spectra. Existing hybrid methods use databases only for post hoc correction or retrieve previously identified spectra to guide decoding. We instead combine DNPS with a peptide prior: a language model fitted to a reference proteome, tolerating variants yet uncertain on strongly divergent sequences. Relative to prior-free DNPS, our implementation, PepPr, improved reference peptide identification and improved rather than suppressed variant identification. Using a related proteome as prior, it matched or outperformed homology-driven database search, and its gain over prior-free DNPS grew with relatedness. In antibody sequencing, it improved recovery of peptides spanning the variable-constant boundary, deamidation calls, and assembly, while preserving recall of hypervariable regions inaccessible to database search. Peptide priors thus bring reference knowledge into DNPS without limiting discovery.

title: Large language models detect methodological errors that human peer review misses in clinical trials
zh_title: 大语言模型能发现临床试验中人工同行评审遗漏的方法学错误
summary: 预印本测试15个LLM检出临床试验报告中被植入的方法学错误，主要错误检出得分53%–96%，高于此前未经训练人类评审者的27%；对照报告中仍有误报。
key_points: 2026年新发表试验复测，得分51%–99%
开源权重模型得分66%–87%
无错误对照报告中仍标出2%–29%错误类型
reason: LLM对照人类评审，有新意，但仅3份报告、预印本
abstract: Peer review is the principal quality control of published research, but methodological errors can go undetected. In an earlier experiment with errors inserted into three reports of randomized clinical trials, untrained human reviewers achieved a mean major-error detection score of 27%. Here, we tested whether 15 large language models (LLMs), including four open-weight models, detect the same errors. Their major-error detection scores ranged from 53% to 96%. To reduce the risk of memorization, we repeated the test on three clinical trials published in 2026. Scores ranged from 51% to 99%, and from 66% to 87% for the open-weight models. Notably, LLMs still flagged 2% to 29% of the error types in control reports without inserted errors, most often conclusions not supported by the results and missing reasons why screened patients were not enrolled. Across the 12 models, mean review times ranged from 1.4 to 16.3 minutes. Opus 5.5 achieved the highest major-error detection score (99%), while GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna offered cost-effective alternatives with scores of 92% and 87%, respectively. Together, these tests provide a benchmark for specialized review models and suggest that relying on human peer review alone may leave avoidable methodological errors undetected.
zh_abstract: 同行评审是已发表研究的主要质量控制手段，但方法学错误可能未被发现。在先前一项在三篇随机临床试验报告中插入错误的实验中，未经培训的人类评审者的平均主要错误检出得分为27%。在此，我们检验了15个大语言模型（LLM）（包括4个开放权重模型）能否检出相同的错误。它们的主要错误检出得分范围为53%至96%。为降低记忆风险，我们在2026年发表的三项临床试验上重复了该检验。得分范围为51%至99%，开放权重模型为66%至87%。值得注意的是，LLM在未插入错误的对照报告中仍标记了2%至29%的错误类型，最常见的是结论不受结果支持，以及缺少筛查患者未入组的原因。在12个模型中，平均评审时间为1.4至16.3分钟。Opus 5.5取得了最高的主要错误检出得分（99%），而GPT-6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Luna提供了具有成本效益的替代方案，得分分别为92%和87%。总之，这些检验为专业评审模型提供了基准，并提示仅依赖人工同行评审可能会遗漏本可避免的方法学错误。

abstract: [Current urology reports] Advancements in technology have been at the heart of endourology for decades. With the introduction of new and novel technologies, endourology is rapidly changing. This review aims to address the recent innovations and technological advances in endourology by addressing four different areas where tangible outcome improvements are being seen: (1) diagnostic and detection methods; (2) intraoperative optimisation and procedural automation; (3) prediction of treatment outcomes; and (4) the use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) for patients' education and monitoring. AI applications in endourology consistently demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy, with stone detection rates exceeding 95% across imaging modalities. Emerging tools include non-invasive analysis of stone composition and real-time intraoperative segmentation. Intraoperative improvements involve augmented reality-guided renal access, which has reduced puncture times, fluoroscopy exposure, and complications. New instruments, such as flexible, navigable suction devices (FANS) and intrarenal pressure (IRP) and temperature (IRT) monitoring systems, bring the field closer to achieving the endourological quadrifecta. Machine learning models trained on multicentre data can predict perioperative risks and personalise treatment, demonstrating similar effectiveness in managing stone disease. Additionally, generative AI and large language models are increasingly used for clinical documentation, patient communication, and outpatient workflows. However, concerns about hallucination, data privacy, and the need for human oversight remain significant in this growing area. Innovation, technology, and AI in endourology are advancing rapidly, introducing new ideas that are integrated into surgical procedures. These innovations offer numerous benefits to patients at various stages of treatment, leading to improved surgical results. Although combining these technologies can potentially maximise patient benefits, a careful and selective approach should be adopted, accompanied by thorough assessments before implementing these new innovations.
zh_abstract: [Current urology reports] 数十年来，技术进步一直是腔内泌尿外科的核心。随着新技术的引入，腔内泌尿外科正在迅速变化。本综述旨在通过四个已出现切实结局改善的领域，介绍腔内泌尿外科近期的创新和技术进展：（1）诊断与检测方法；（2）术中优化与操作自动化；（3）治疗结局预测；（4）生成式人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLM）在患者教育和监测中的应用。AI在腔内泌尿外科的应用始终显示出较高的诊断准确性，在各种影像学检查方式中结石检出率均超过95%。新兴工具包括结石成分的无创分析和术中实时分割。术中改进包括增强现实引导的肾穿刺通道建立，其缩短了穿刺时间、减少了透视暴露和并发症。新型器械，如可弯曲、可导航的吸引装置（FANS）以及肾内压（IRP）和肾内温度（IRT）监测系统，使该领域更接近实现腔内泌尿外科的“四联征”（quadrifecta）。基于多中心数据训练的机器学习模型可预测围手术期风险并实现个体化治疗，在结石疾病管理中显示出相似的有效性。此外，生成式AI和大语言模型正越来越多地用于临床文书、医患沟通和门诊工作流程。然而，在这一不断发展的领域，对幻觉、数据隐私以及人工监督必要性的担忧仍然十分突出。腔内泌尿外科中的创新、技术和AI正在迅速发展，带来了融入手术操作的新理念。这些创新在治疗的各个阶段为患者带来诸多益处，从而改善手术结果。尽管整合这些技术有可能使患者获益最大化，但在应用这些新创新之前，应采取谨慎且有选择的方法，并进行全面评估。

abstract: [The Hastings Center report] Within public health, the contemporary discourse surrounding AI in this field is dominated by what this paper terms the "standard approach." In this frame, AI appears as a neutral tool to be evaluated for accuracy, privacy protection, and bias mitigation. When direct benefits outweigh direct harms, AI is described as an opportunity to improve public health practice. But the standard approach does not consider how public health's adoption of AI discloses and reinforces different accounts of the underlying purpose of the profession. Drawing insights from the communitarian thinker Wendell Berry, we demonstrate how AI does not merely improve efficiency and add capabilities but tends to align public health practice with purposes and assumptions that, when actualized, increasingly displace community power and authentic human presence. This tendency is clear in three commonly proposed applications of AI in public health practice: health education, community health assessments, and data analysis. Because the advent of AI offers an opportunity for greater technological efficiency, it offers the public health community the opportunity to reflect on what ultimate ends those efficiencies should be directed toward.
zh_abstract: [黑斯廷斯中心报告] 在公共卫生领域，当前围绕 AI 的讨论被本文称为“标准路径”的框架所主导。在这一框架中，AI 被视为一种中立的工具，需从准确性、隐私保护和偏倚缓解等方面进行评估。当直接收益大于直接危害时，AI 即被描述为改善公共卫生实践的机遇。但标准路径没有考虑公共卫生采用 AI 如何揭示并强化对该职业根本目的的不同理解。借鉴社群主义思想家温德尔·贝瑞（Wendell Berry）的见解，我们展示了 AI 并不仅仅是提高效率和增加能力，而是倾向于使公共卫生实践与某些目的和假设相一致，而这些目的和假设一旦实现，会日益取代社区的力量和真实的人的在场。这一倾向在 AI 于公共卫生实践中三种常被提出的应用中十分明显：健康教育、社区健康评估和数据分析。由于 AI 的出现带来了更高技术效率的可能，它也为公共卫生界提供了一个契机，去反思这些效率最终应服务于何种目的。

By synthesizing geroscience and machine learning, practitioners and scientists can effectively bridge the gap between experimental biomarkers and personalized medicine and longevity care. This contribution is timely as the importance of biological age and predictive analytics offer transformative potential for diagnostics while necessitating a focus on modern medical systems. This article aims to elucidate how AI accelerates the clinical implementation of biological age rather than current chronological age in precision medicine.

abstract: [Odontology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanded across digital implant dentistry, with applications ranging from diagnosis and treatment planning to surgical execution, prosthetic rehabilitation, outcome prediction, and biomechanical optimization. However, the clinical readiness and translational value of many proposed AI systems remain uncertain. This comprehensive state-of-the-art narrative review aims to provide an integrated overview of AI applications throughout the implant workflow while critically evaluating current evidence, methodological limitations, and challenges to clinical implementation. A comprehensive narrative literature search was conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, supplemented by Google Scholar and manual reference screening. The review was prepared according to SANRA recommendations. AI has demonstrated promising performance in automated image analysis, implant planning, computer-assisted surgery, prosthetic workflows, implant identification, peri-implant disease detection, predictive modelling, and biomechanical optimization. Nevertheless, most available evidence is derived from retrospective studies, simulation-based investigations, or single-center datasets. Limited external validation, heterogeneity in study design, and insufficient prospective clinical evidence continue to restrict widespread clinical adoption. Furthermore, improvements in technical performance do not necessarily translate into superior patient-centered outcomes. AI has the potential to enhance efficiency, consistency, and clinical decision support throughout the implant workflow. However, current evidence supports its role primarily as an adjunctive tool rather than an autonomous clinical system. Future progress will depend on robust validation, standardized reporting, explainable AI frameworks, and prospective clinical studies demonstrating meaningful improvements in patient outcomes. Clinical Relevance Statement: Artificial intelligence is increasingly embedded in the digital implant workflow, from radiographic analysis and virtual patient construction to computer-assisted surgery, prosthetic design, and outcome prediction. This review helps clinicians distinguish the AI-specific components of these technologies from conventional digital tools, identify which applications are supported by clinical evidence versus those that remain experimental, and understand the current limitations regarding validation, generali
zh_abstract: [Odontology] 人工智能（AI）已迅速扩展到数字化种植牙科的各个领域，应用范围涵盖诊断与治疗计划、手术实施、修复重建、结局预测以及生物力学优化。然而，许多已提出的AI系统的临床成熟度和转化价值仍不确定。这篇全面的、反映最新进展的叙述性综述旨在对整个种植工作流程中的AI应用提供综合概述，同时批判性地评估现有证据、方法学局限以及临床实施面临的挑战。我们使用PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane Library进行了全面的叙述性文献检索，并辅以Google Scholar和人工参考文献筛选。本综述按照SANRA建议撰写。AI在自动化影像分析、种植体规划、计算机辅助手术、修复工作流程、种植体识别、种植体周围疾病检测、预测建模和生物力学优化方面已显示出有前景的表现。然而，大多数现有证据来自回顾性研究、基于模拟的研究或单中心数据集。外部验证有限、研究设计异质性大以及前瞻性临床证据不足，持续制约其广泛的临床应用。此外，技术性能的提升未必能转化为更优的以患者为中心的结局。AI有潜力在整个种植工作流程中提高效率、一致性和临床决策支持。然而，目前的证据主要支持其作为辅助工具的作用，而非自主的临床系统。未来的进展将取决于稳健的验证、标准化报告、可解释AI框架，以及证明患者结局得到有意义改善的前瞻性临床研究。临床意义声明：人工智能正越来越多地嵌入数字化种植工作流程，从影像分析和虚拟患者构建，到计算机辅助手术、修复设计和结局预测。本综述有助于临床医生将这些技术中AI特有的组成部分与传统数字工具区分开来，识别哪些应用有临床证据支持、哪些仍处于实验阶段，并了解目前在验证、泛化性等方面的局限。

abstract: [Journal of pediatric nursing] Infant feeding and nutrition are critical for growth, development, and long-term health outcomes. As paediatric nurses play a central role in infant monitoring and feeding practices, there is growing interest in innovative approaches to support early assessment and personalised nutritional care. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly explored to support clinical decision-making; however, its applications in infant feeding and nutrition have not been comprehensively synthesised. To map AI applications in infant feeding and nutrition and examine their potential implications for clinical care and paediatric nursing practice. This scoping review followed Arksey and O'Malley's framework and adhered to the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. A comprehensive search of research databases was conducted across seven electronic databases, grey literature, and trial registers, including studies published from inception to 26 May 2026. Two reviewers independently screened titles and abstracts and extracted and synthesised data. Twenty-nine studies were included. Seven broad AI application areas were identified: 1) prediction and classification of nutritional status, 2) estimation and monitoring of growth, 3) providing nutritional recommendations, 4) analysing nutritional practices and variations, 5) suckling and feeding behaviour analysis, 6) feeding method and behaviour monitoring, and 7) prediction and classification of feeding status. AI demonstrates potential to support paediatric nurses and healthcare professionals by enabling more timely, personalised interventions to improve nutritional care and long-term infant health outcomes. However, current evidence remains largely developmental, highlighting the need for real-world clinical studies to determine the safety, effectiveness, and integration of AI technologies into paediatric care. Open Science Framework (Registration Number: b45tv).
zh_abstract: [儿科护理杂志] 婴儿喂养和营养对生长发育及长期健康结局至关重要。儿科护士在婴儿监测和喂养实践中发挥核心作用，因此人们对支持早期评估和个性化营养护理的创新方法的兴趣日益增长。人工智能（AI）在支持临床决策方面的探索日益增多；然而，其在婴儿喂养和营养中的应用尚未得到全面综合。目的：梳理 AI 在婴儿喂养和营养中的应用，并探讨其对临床护理和儿科护理实践的潜在影响。本范围综述遵循 Arksey 和 O'Malley 的框架，并符合 PRISMA-ScR 指南。我们在七个电子数据库、灰色文献和试验注册库中进行了全面检索，纳入从建库至 2026 年 5 月 26 日发表的研究。两名评审员独立筛选标题和摘要，并提取和综合数据。共纳入 29 项研究。确定了七大 AI 应用领域：1）营养状况的预测和分类，2）生长的估计和监测，3）提供营养建议，4）分析营养实践及其差异，5）吸吮和喂养行为分析，6）喂养方式和行为监测，7）喂养状况的预测和分类。AI 显示出支持儿科护士和医疗专业人员的潜力，可实现更及时、个性化的干预，以改善营养护理和婴儿的长期健康结局。然而，目前的证据在很大程度上仍处于开发阶段，需要开展真实世界临床研究，以确定 AI 技术融入儿科护理的安全性、有效性和整合方式。开放科学框架（注册号：b45tv）。
